rent","desc":"A local authority may charge rent for land let as allotments pursuant to the 1908 Allotments Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1651"},{"id":"1834","label":"Allotments - rules for letting","desc":"A local authority may make rules regarding its allotments and must publicise the same.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1834"},{"id":"1738","label":"Allotments - sale of Land","desc":"A local authority wishing to sell land bought or appropriated for use as allotments may not do so without obtaining the consent of the Minister of Agriculture and Fisheries to the sale.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1738"},{"id":"1837","label":"Allotments - sale of land.","desc":"A local authority may sell unsuitable or superfluous land.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1837"},{"id":"1839","label":"Allotments - scheme of common pasture","desc":"A local authority may enter into a scheme of common pasture in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1839"},{"id":"1838","label":"Allotments - transfer of allotments","desc":"A local authority may enter into agreements to obtain certain allotments by transfer.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1838"},{"id":"1840","label":"Allotments - use of schoolroom free of charge.","desc":"A local authority may, subject to giving notice, use a room in a maintained primary school free of charge for the purpose of meetings under the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1840"},{"id":"1845","label":"Allotments and smallholdings - co-operative societies","desc":"A local authority may promote the formation or extension of co-operative societies in relation to allotments or small holdings, including the giving of grants or making of loans in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1845"},{"id":"1844","label":"Allotments and smallholdings - compensation for improvements","desc":"A local authority must pay a tenant compensation for improvements in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1844"},{"id":"1843","label":"Allotments and smallholdings - interchange of land","desc":"A local authority may swap land acquired for an allotment or small holding with another local authority.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1843"},{"id":"1842","label":"Allotments and smallholdings - renewal of tenancy","desc":"A local authority may renew its tenancy of compulsory hired land.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1842"},{"id":"1542","label":"Animal boarding establishments - inspections","desc":"An officers of an authority or any veterinary surgeon or veterinary practitioner duly authorised by a local authority may inspect an animal boarding establishment.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1542"},{"id":"1541","label":"Animal boarding establishments - licensing","desc":"A local authority may on application being made to them for that purpose and for payment of a fee licence an animal boarding establishment where the applicant meets prescribed requirements. A licence may be issued with conditions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1541"},{"id":"1543","label":"Animal boarding establishments - prosecutions","desc":"A local authority may prosecute proceedings for any breach of the Act committed in the area of the authority.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1543"},{"id":"3259","label":"Animal by-products - enforcement (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to enforce regulations relating to the use of animal by-products and livestock.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3259"},{"id":"3260","label":"Animal by-products - entry, inspection and seizure","desc":"The local authority has the powers of entry, inspection, seizure, examination and to disclose information in relation to animal by-products.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3260"},{"id":"1650","label":"Animal feed - collection of kitchen waste","desc":"A local authority may collect kitchen waste or similar waste for use as animal feed and may make byelaws in respect of the same.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1650"},{"id":"2761","label":"Animal feed - hygiene, sampling and enforcement","desc":"It is the duty of each feed authority within its area to execute and enforce (as prescribed) the provisions of these Regulations and Regulation (EC) No 183/2005 of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down requirements for feed hygiene; 152/2009 laying down the methods of sampling and analysis for the official control of feed and also make provision as to administration generally in relation to feed law, in particular so as to give effect to Regulation (EC) No 882/2004.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2761"},{"id":"2760","label":"Animal feeds - enforcement","desc":"Local authorities must enforce the Regulations within their respective areas on feed safety, genetically modified feed, feed additives, the marketing and use of feed, undesirable substances (contaminants) in feed and feed for particular nutritional purposes.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2760"},{"id":"2941","label":"Animal health - acquisition of land","desc":"A local authority may acquire land for certain purposes in connection with the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2941"},{"id":"2415","label":"Animal health - appointment of inspectors","desc":"A local authority shall appoint as many inspectors and other officers as the local authority think necessary for the execution and enforcement of this Act.Every local authority shall assign to those inspectors and officers such duties, and salaries or allowances, and may delegate to any of them such authorities and discretion, as to the local authority seem fit, and may at any time revoke any appointment so made.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2415"},{"id":"2939","label":"Animal health - borrowing by Local Authority","desc":"A local authority may borrow for the purposes of the Act","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2939"},{"id":"2943","label":"Animal health - burial of carcasses washed ashore","desc":"A local authority must pay the cost of the burial of carcasses washed ashore and may recover the cost from the ship owner.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2943"},{"id":"2332","label":"Animal health - general duties","desc":"A local authority shall execute and enforce this Act and every order of the Minister so far as they are to be executed and enforced by local authorities and shall appoint inspectors to enable them to do so.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2332"},{"id":"3897","label":"Animal health - low-welfare animal activities","desc":"A local weights and measures authority in England may enforce the provisions of this Act.For the investigatory powers available for the purpose of enforcing this Act, see Schedule 5 to the Consumer Rights Act 2015.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3897"},{"id":"2944","label":"Animal health - payment of Secretary of State's expenses","desc":"A local authority must pay the Secretary of State\u2019s expenses where he acts in default of the Authority","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2944"},{"id":"2940","label":"Animal health - provision of wharves etc.","desc":"A local authority may provide, erect and fit up wharves, stations, lairs, sheds and other places for the landing, reception, keeping, sale, slaughter or disposal of imported or other animals, carcases, fodder, litter, dung and other things.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2940"},{"id":"2942","label":"Animal health - public facilities for sheep dipping","desc":"A local authority may provide public facilities for sheep dipping.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2942"},{"id":"2720","label":"Animal health - child safety orders","desc":"A local authority must co-operate with a court in the court's dealings with a child safety order.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/772"},{"id":"784","label":"Anti-social behaviour - co-operation when making parenting orders","desc":"A local authority must co-operate with a court when the court wishes to make a parenting order.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/784"},{"id":"3937","label":"Anti-social behaviour - consultation","desc":"A local authority may respond to a consultation regarding the draft community remedy document.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3937"},{"id":"443","label":"Anti-social behaviour - contracting out","desc":"A local authority may contract out of some of its functions in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/443"},{"id":"449","label":"Anti-social behaviour - high hedge complaints","desc":"A local authority must consider complaints regarding high hedges according to the procedures under this section.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/449"},{"id":"451","label":"Anti-social behaviour - high hedges power of entry","desc":"A person authorised by a local authority may enter premises for the purposes of the exercise of the local authority's powers and duties relating to high hedges.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/451"},{"id":"447","label":"Anti-social behaviour - notice to remove graffiti and fly posting","desc":"A local authority may serve a notice requiring the removal of graffiti or fly posting and recover its expenditure in so doing and must have regard to guidance from the Secretary of State or National Assembly.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/447"},{"id":"773","label":"Anti-social behaviour - parental compensation order","desc":"A local authority may apply for a parental compensation order or a review of the order in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/773"},{"id":"441","label":"Anti-social behaviour - parenting contracts","desc":"A local authority may, having regard to Guidance from the Secretary of State, enter into a parenting contract if it has reason to believe a child or young person is or is likely to become engaged in anti-social behaviour.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/441"},{"id":"3939","label":"Anti-social behaviour - parenting contracts as social housing provider","desc":"A local authority may, where it is a registered provider of social housing, having regard to Guidance from the Secretary of State, enter into a parenting contract if it has reason to believe a child or young person is or is likely to become engaged in anti-social behaviour.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3939"},{"id":"442","label":"Anti-social behaviour - parenting orders","desc":"A local authority may apply for a parenting order, for a child residing or appearing to reside in its area, if it has reason to believe a child or young person is or is likely to become engaged in anti-social behaviour.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/442"},{"id":"3940","label":"Anti-social behaviour - parenting orders as social housing provider","desc":"A local authority may, where it is a registered provider of social housing, apply for a parenting order, for a child residing or appearing to reside in its area, if it has reason to believe a child or young person is or is likely to become engaged in anti-social behaviour.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3940"},{"id":"445","label":"Anti-social behaviour - penalty notices for graffiti and fly posting","desc":"An authorised officer of a local authority may issue a penalty notice for graffiti or fly posting. The amount of the penalty should be as determined by regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/445"},{"id":"2702","label":"Anti-social behaviour - public spaces protection order","desc":"Where a local authority has made, extended or varied a public spaces protection order it must publish the details it on its website and erect a notice adjacent to the public space concerned. Likewise where it has discharged an order it must publish in the same manner the date and identify the order discharged.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2702"},{"id":"450","label":"Anti-social behaviour - remedial notices for high hedges","desc":"A local authority may issue, withdraw or relax a remedial notice in relation to a complaint regarding high hedges.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/450"},{"id":"448","label":"Anti-social behaviour - sale of aerosol paints to children enforcement","desc":"It is the duty of every local weights and measures authority to consider, at least once in every period of twelve months, the extent to which it is appropriate for the authority to carry out in their area a programme of enforcement action in relation to section 54 and to the extent that they consider it appropriate to do so, carry out such a programme.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/448"},{"id":"3052","label":"Apprenticeships - publication of information","desc":"A local authority with Apprenticeship Targets must publish and send to the Secretary of State prescribed information.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3052"},{"id":"3051","label":"Apprenticeships - regulations regarding targets","desc":"A local authority with Apprenticeship Targets must have regard to the target and must comply with Regulations","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3051"},{"id":"3264","label":"Aquaculture - inspection of premises","desc":"The local authority has a duty to inspect aquaculture premises when required and comply with all requirements concerning aquatic animal health.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3264"},{"id":"466","label":"Areas of outstanding natural beauty - general duties","desc":"A local authority must in carrying out its functions have regard to preserving and enhancing the beauty of areas of outstanding natural beauty.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/466"},{"id":"467","label":"Areas of outstanding natural beauty - management plans","desc":"A local authority must produce and publish management plans in relation to areas of outstanding natural beauty as required by the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/467"},{"id":"3200","label":"Auction premises - registration","desc":"A local authority must licence auction premises in accordance with the terms of the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3200"},{"id":"1648","label":"Barriers at level crossings - financial contributions","desc":"A local authority may contribute to the expenses incurred for providing lifting or other barriers, lights, signs, or other devices or appliances for the protection or convenience of the public at or near any level crossing where a road is crossed by a railway.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1648"},{"id":"1489","label":"Bathing and boating - byelaws","desc":"Where any part of the area of a local authority having power to make byelaws about public bathing and pleasure boats is bounded by or is to seaward of the low water mark, the authority may exercise that power as respects any area of the sea which is outside the area of the authority and within 1,000 metres to seaward of any place where that mark is within or on the boundary of the area of the authority.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1489"},{"id":"2652","label":"Bathing waters - notification","desc":"Every local authority controlling a bathing water must disseminate specified information near it from 15 May to 30 September (the bathing season) including the bathing water's current classification as \u201cpoor\u201d, \u201csufficient\u201d, \u201cgood\u201d or \u201cexcellent\u201d and the source of more complete published information. It has additional obligations regarding advice relating to waters rated as \u201cpoor\u201d; and for publicising the advice and the reasons for any declassification of a former bathing water. In the event of pollution events occurring at a bathing water, a local authority must inform the public about any health risks and provide other specified information.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2652"},{"id":"1017","label":"Best value authorities - accounts","desc":"A best value authority must comply with any regulations regarding the keeping of accounts.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1017"},{"id":"1015","label":"Best value authorities - conditions for new powers","desc":"A local authority must comply with any conditions prescribed by the Secretary of State relating to any new best value authority powers arising from section 6.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1015"},{"id":"1014","label":"Best value authorities - failure to comply with best value duty","desc":"A local authority must comply with any review, inquiry or directions required by or coming from the Secretary of State in circumstances where the Secretary of State believes that the authority is not complying with its best value duties.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1014"},{"id":"1013","label":"Best value authorities - fees for inspections","desc":"A local authority must pay the appropriate best value inspection fee.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1013"},{"id":"1011","label":"Best value authorities - general duties","desc":"A local authority must make arrangements to secure continuous improvement in the way in which its functions are exercised, having regard to a combination of economy, efficiency and effectiveness and must take prescribed steps when doing so.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1011"},{"id":"1012","label":"Best value authorities - inspections","desc":"A local authority must comply with the requirements of a best value inspection.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1012"},{"id":"1016","label":"Best value authorities - non-commercial considerations in contracts","desc":"A local authority must comply with any order relating to the exclusion of non-commercial considerations in contracts.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1016"},{"id":"1018","label":"Best value authorities - regard to guidance","desc":"A local authority must have regard to any guidance to or in respect of best value authorities issued by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1018"},{"id":"3266","label":"Biofuel labelling","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with Regulations relating to Biofuel labelling.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3266"},{"id":"3774","label":"Birmingham Commonwealth Games - direction to traffic authority","desc":"The local traffic authority must comply with any direction from the Secretary of State regarding traffic orders and must pay any associated expenses to the Secretary of State when in default.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3774"},{"id":"3772","label":"Birmingham Commonwealth Games - games transport plan","desc":"Every local authority must when directed by the Secretary of State to do so must prepare and implement a Games transport plan.A \u201cGames transport plan\u201d means a plan that relates to one or more areas in England and addresses transport matters relating to the Games.An authority directed as stated must\u2014(a) comply with the direction;(b)keep the Games transport plan under review;(c)if the authority consider it appropriate, revise the plan;(d)except in so far as the authority consider it undesirable for reasons of security, publish the plan and any revision.(e)implement the plan to the extent applicable.Before preparing or revising the plan, the authority must consult the persons specified in Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3772"},{"id":"3773","label":"Birmingham Commonwealth Games - temporary prohibition or restrictins on roads","desc":"Section 14 of the Road Traffic Regulation Act (RTRA) 1984 has effect in relation to a traffic authority for a road in England as if subsection (1)(c) of that section included the following purposes\u2014(a)implementing a Games transport plan,(b)facilitating transport services in connection with the Games, and(c)facilitating travel by any person for a purpose connected to the Games.(2)The following do not apply in relation to an order made or notice issued by virtue of this section\u2014(a)section 15 of the RTRA 1984;(b)regulations 6 and 8(3) of the Road Traffic (Temporary Restrictions) Procedure Regulations 1992 (S.I. 1992/1215).(3)An order made or notice issued by virtue of this section may not come into force before the beginning of the period of 21 days ending immediately before the day on which the Games begin.(4)An order made by virtue of this section must cease to have effect no later than the end of the period of 5 days beginning with the day after the day on which the Games end.(5)A notice issued by virtue of this section must cease to have effect no later than\u2014(a)the end of the period of 21 days beginning with the day after the day on which the notice comes into force, or(b)the end of the period of 5 days beginning with the day after the day on which the Games end,whichever is earlier.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3773"},{"id":"3770","label":"Birmingham Commonwealth Games - ticket touting","desc":"A local authority may enforce a ticket touting offence (England and Wales), advertising offence (England only) or trading offence (England Only) under sections 10, 13 and 16 of the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3770"},{"id":"3771","label":"Birmingham Commonwealth Games - trading","desc":"Every local authority must provide a copy of any guidance published by the Organising Committee to each relevant trader in the authority's area who the authority consider may be affected by section 16 (the trading offence), andmust provide each such relevant trader with whatever information the authority consider appropriate for the purpose of assisting the relevant trader to mitigate the effect of that section.\u201crelevant trader\u201d, in relation to a local authority, means either a person who holds a trading licence granted by the authority, or a person who has applied to the authority for such a licence, and whose application has not been determined or withdrawn.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3771"},{"id":"1192","label":"Breeding of dogs - inspection of premises not covered by licence","desc":"A local authority may in certain circumstances inspect premises not covered by licence under the Breeding of Dogs Act 1973.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1192"},{"id":"1647","label":"Bridges over railways and inland waterways","desc":"A local authority has responsibility for certain bridges over waterways and railways.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1647"},{"id":"2533","label":"Building control - charges","desc":"LAs may fix and recover charges for the performance of their building control functions relating to building regulations according to a charging scheme governed by principles laid down in the Regulations. Each LA is responsible for setting its own building control charges and for doing so within the accounting and administrative requirements laid down.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2533"},{"id":"2534","label":"Building control - general powers","desc":"LAs may relax some of the building regulations, issue completion certificates where building work complies with regulations and carry out various testing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2534"},{"id":"3080","label":"Building regulations - breaking open of streets","desc":"A local authority may break open the streets in certain circumstances","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3080"},{"id":"3081","label":"Building regulations - compensation for damage","desc":"A local authority must pay compensation for damage sin certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3081"},{"id":"3085","label":"Building regulations - compliance with directions","desc":"A local authority must comply with the directions of the Secretary of State or Welsh Ministers, and pay their expenses when exercising their default powers and comply with any transfer order made.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3085"},{"id":"3078","label":"Building regulations - enforcement notice","desc":"A local authority may, issue an enforcement notice and in certain circumstances carry out the required works and charge the owner or occupier for the same.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3078"},{"id":"3076","label":"Building regulations - entry of premises","desc":"An authorised officer of a local authority may, in certain circumstances enter premises to ensure compliance with building regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3076"},{"id":"3077","label":"Building regulations - execution of works","desc":"A local authority may, with the agreement of the owner or occupier of the premises execute works at the expense of the owner or occupier.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3077"},{"id":"3075","label":"Building regulations - forms and notices","desc":"It is the duty of local authorities to issue forms and notices, authenticate and serve the same in writing and to comply with any statutory instruments.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3075"},{"id":"3084","label":"Building regulations - indemnity of Members and officers","desc":"A local authority must indemnify its Members and officers in certain circumstances","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3084"},{"id":"3083","label":"Building regulations - power to prosecute","desc":"A local authority may commence the prosecution of offences under this Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3083"},{"id":"3082","label":"Building regulations - recovery of expenses","desc":"A local authority may recover its expenses and interest for work done in connection with the Act in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3082"},{"id":"3079","label":"Building regulations - sale of materials","desc":"A local authority may sell materials removed from premises in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3079"},{"id":"3837","label":"Building safety - application of guidance","desc":"Local authorities and fire and rescue authorities must take guidance from the Building safety Regulator into account, when carrying out any directions from the Regulator.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3837"},{"id":"3834","label":"Building safety - assistance etc. to the regulator","desc":"A local authority or a fire and rescue authority may at the request of the building safety regulator (Health and Safety Executive) do anything for the purpose of -(a) facilitating the exercise by the regulator of a relevant function relating to:- the regulation of higher-risk buildings - higher risk building work- regulation of any work for which the regulator is the building control authorityor(b) enabling the local authority or fire and rescue authority to facilitate the exercise by the regulator of a relevant function.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3834"},{"id":"3838","label":"Building safety - co-operation with the regulator","desc":"The Regulator, local authorities and fire and rescue authorities must comply with Schedule 3 relating to co-operation and sharing of information in the exercise of their relevant functions in relation to higher risk buildings.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3838"},{"id":"3835","label":"Building safety - compliance with direction of the regulator","desc":"A relevant authority must comply with a direction of the building safety Regulator in relation to higher-risk buildings , providing the Regulator has complied with the correct procedure before making the Direction.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3835"},{"id":"3836","label":"Building safety - ensuring staff competence","desc":"When assisting the Regulator in matters relating to higher-risk buildings a relevant authority must ensure that any of its staff involved in providing relevant assistance to the regulator have the appropriate skills, knowledge, experience and behaviours.\"Relevant assistance\" means anything done by the authority pursuant to a request or direction, for the purpose of facilitating the exercise by the regulator of a relevant function.A local authority must also comply with any regulations issued by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3836"},{"id":"3839","label":"Building safety - information sharing with the regulator","desc":"Local authorities and fire and rescue authorities may share information with the Regulator and others in accordance with Schedule 3.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3839"},{"id":"2356","label":"Buildings and building regulations - execution of Act","desc":"It is the duty of local authorities to carry this Act into execution, subject to sections 91ZD, the provisions of Part I of the Public Health Act 1936 relating to united districts and joint boards;section 151 of the Local Government, Planning and Land Act 1980 (urban development areas); section 1(3) of the Public Health (Control of Disease) Act 1984 (port health authorities); Regulations and the provisions of 91ZA and 91ZB (relating to the duties of the Regulator) . It is the function of local authorities to enforce building regulations in their areas.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2356"},{"id":"3928","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 a Local Authority acting as Building Control Authority restricted activities and functions","desc":"A local authority acting as building control authority may out carry out a restricted activity in relation to any work only through a registered building inspector, acting on the authority's behalf, whose registration has effect in relation to work of that description.Before each exercise of a restricted function in relation to any work, a building control authority must obtain and consider the advice of a registered building inspector whose registration has effect in relation to work of that description.The registered building inspector who carries out the restricted activity, or advises on the exercise of the restricted function, may (but need not) be employed by the authority. must keep, maintain, make publicly available and provide information from such registers as are prescribed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3928"},{"id":"3929","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 acceptance or rejection of initial notice","desc":"A local authority must either accept or reject a notice from a registered building control approver in accordance with the prescribed grounds and within the prescribed period.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3929"},{"id":"3959","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 advertisement of proposals to relax Building Regulations","desc":"A local authority must advertise proposals to relax building regulations in local newspaper in certain circumstances, within at a timescale specified by section 9 and must consider relevant representations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3959"},{"id":"3958","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 applications for the relaxation of Building Regulations","desc":"A local authority must pass any application for relaxation of Building Regulations to the appropriate National Authority and must respond to the consultation arising from the National Authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3958"},{"id":"3934","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 cancellation of initial notice","desc":"A local authority must cancel an initial notice in certain prescribed circumstances by following the prescribed procedure.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3934"},{"id":"3935","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 cancellation of Initial Notice when work becomes higher-risk building","desc":"A local authority must cancel an initial notice when a building becomes a higher risk building in prescribed circumstances by following the prescribed procedure and must give a copy of the notice to the Regulator.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3935"},{"id":"3955","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 Compliance Notices","desc":"A local authority in England may, give a compliance notice as prescribed by section 35B to a person who appears to the authority to have contravened, be contravening or be likely to contravene - (a) a relevant provision of building regulations, or(b) a requirement imposed by virtue of such a provision.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3955"},{"id":"3941","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 Consideration of transfer of certificate and report","desc":"Where a registered building control approver gives a transfer certificate and a transfer report to a local authority in accordance with section 53B(3), the local authority must consider and accept or reject the certificate and report before the end of the relevant period in the prescribed manner. The local authority may request further information to enable it do so. NOTE this is a power AND a duty.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3941"},{"id":"3946","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 Continuing failure to meet standards","desc":"A local authority may challenge the Regulator\u2019s recommendation (transfer of functions to the Secretary of State or another local authority) in relation to a continuing failure to meet standards.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3946"},{"id":"3957","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 continuing requirements, power to execute work, recover costs and give directions","desc":"Where continuing requirements of The Building Regulations have been breached a local authority may execute the works themselves and recover their reasonable costs in doing so and/or by notice direct the owner or occupier of the building to carry out the required work.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3957"},{"id":"3932","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 final certificate","desc":"Where applicable a local authority must consider, accept or reject a Final Certificate.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3932"},{"id":"3925","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 keeping of Register","desc":"It is the duty of local authorities to keep a register of prescribed information required by the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3925"},{"id":"3950","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 Means of access by which refuse or faecal matter is removed from a building","desc":"A local authority may consent of the building control authority to the closure or obstruct the means of access by which refuse or faecal matter is removed from a building, and in giving their consent may impose such conditions as they think fit with respect to the improvement of an alternative means of access or the substitution of other means of access.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3950"},{"id":"3936","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 new initial notice","desc":"A local authority must take prescribed steps where a new initial notice is given under section 53(7)(a) of the Building Act 1984.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3936"},{"id":"3931","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 plans certificates","desc":"Where applicable a local authority must consider, accept or reject and may rescind a Plans Certificate taking into account prescribed grounds. NOTE - this is a power AND a duty.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3931"},{"id":"3930","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 prohibition on exercising certain functions or exercising certain proceedings whilst initial notice is in force","desc":"For as long as the initial notice is in force the function of enforcing building regulations that is conferred on a local authority by section 91(2) is not exercisable in relation to the work to which the notice relates, and accordingly\u2014(a) a local authority may not give a notice under section 35B, 35C or 36(1) above in relation to that work, and(b) a local authority may not institute proceedings under section 35 above for a contravention that arises out of the carrying out of that work.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3930"},{"id":"3949","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 provision of drainage","desc":"A local authority may when considering an application for building control for a building or an extension to a building require it to drain into a sewer in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3949"},{"id":"3951","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 Provision of exits from certain types of building to which the public have access","desc":"A local authority must reject an application for building control approval for a building or an extension to a building if it cannot be shown that the building or extension as adequate means of ingress or egress.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3951"},{"id":"3952","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 provision of water supply","desc":"A local authority must reject an application for building control approval for a house unless satisfactory provision for supply of water has been made.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3952"},{"id":"3942","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 Public Body\u2019s Notice","desc":"A local authority must consider and accept or reject a public body notice in the prescribed manner.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3942"},{"id":"3943","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 Recording and furnishing information","desc":"Every local authority shall keep, in such manner as may be prescribed, a register containing such information as may be prescribed with respect to initial notices, amendment notices, notices under section 51C, public body's notices, transfer reports and certificates given to them, including information (where applicable) as to whether such notices, reports or certificates have been accepted or rejected and must keep the same available for public inspection at all reasonable hours.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3943"},{"id":"3944","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 Regulator\u2019s Improvement Notice","desc":"Subject to the right to appeal a local authority must comply with an Improvement Notice received from the Regulator.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3944"},{"id":"3945","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 Regulator\u2019s Serious Contravention Notice","desc":"Subject to the right to appeal a local authority must comply with a Serious Contravention Notice received from the Regulator.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3945"},{"id":"3954","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 removal or alteration of offending work","desc":"A local authority may, without prejudice to their right to take proceedings for a fine in respect of the contravention, may by notice require the owner to remove or alter the offending work.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3954"},{"id":"3956","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 Stop Notices","desc":"A local authority in England may, give a stop notice as prescribed by section 35C to a person appearing to the authority to be in control of any work if it appears to the authority that - (a) the carrying out of the work would contravene a provision of building regulations prescribed for the purposes of this paragraph,(b) a compliance notice relating to the work has been contravened, or(c) the work contravenes a provision of building regulations or a requirement imposed by virtue of such a provision, and the risk of serious harm (as defined by section 35C is met).","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3956"},{"id":"3953","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 tests for conformity with the Building Regulations","desc":"A local authority may, where work to which building regulations are applicable is proposed or carried out, utilise the powers listed in section 33 for the purpose of ascertaining whether any provision of building regulations is or would be contravened-(a) by or in connection with the work, or(b) in relation to the building that the work has been, is being or will be carried out on.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3953"},{"id":"3926","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 the Local Authority to be the Building Control Authority","desc":"A local authority will be the Building Control Authority save in situations where sections 91ZA or 91ZB (higher risk buildings in England) provide that the Regulator shall be the Building Control Authority; and will also be the Building Control Authority where Regulations under section 91ZD provide that it is the Building Control Authority (in respect of higher risk buildings in Wales).","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3926"},{"id":"3927","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 the Local Authority to reject the Building Regulator\u2019s notice","desc":"A local authority must reject the Building Regulator\u2019s notice under section 91ZB if prescribed grounds exist and must have regard to and comply with Building Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3927"},{"id":"3948","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 Use of materials unsuitable for a permanent building","desc":"A local authority may when considering an application for building control reject the use of materials unsuitable for a permanent building or otherwise attach conditions to their use.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3948"},{"id":"3947","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 use of short lived materials","desc":"A local authority may when considering an application for building control reject the use of short lived materials or otherwise attach conditions to their use.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3947"},{"id":"3933","label":"Buildings and building regulations \u2013 variation of work","desc":"Where applicable a local authority must consider, accept or reject or may impose conditions upon a notice of variation of work taking into account prescribed grounds. NOTE - this is a power AND a duty.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3933"},{"id":"3212","label":"Burial and cremation - charging for municipal funeral","desc":"An authority may recover from the estate of the deceased person expenses incurred under subsection (1) or subsection (2) above.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3212"},{"id":"1747","label":"Burial and cremation - crematoria fees","desc":"A local authority may charge fees for cremations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1747"},{"id":"1746","label":"Burial and cremation - crematoria regulations","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations concerning crematoria and burning.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1746"},{"id":"1745","label":"Burial and cremation - donations of land, money or property for crematoria","desc":"A local authority may accept donations of land, money or property to enable them to provide and maintain crematoria.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1745"},{"id":"3127","label":"Burial and cremation - municipal funerals","desc":"It shall be the duty of a local authority to cause to be buried or cremated the body of any person who has died or been found dead in their area, in any case where it appears to the authority that no suitable arrangements for the disposal of the body have been or are being made otherwise than by the authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3127"},{"id":"3143","label":"Burial and cremation - person in care accommodation (England)","desc":"Any council which is the local authority for the purposes of the Local Authority Social Services Act 1970 may cause to be buried or cremated the body of any deceased person who immediately before his death was being provided with accommodation under Part 1 of the Care Act 2014","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3143"},{"id":"3144","label":"Burial and cremation - person in care accommodation (Wales)","desc":"A local authority within the meaning of the Social Services and Well-being (Wales) Act 2014 may cause to be buried or cremated the body of any deceased person who immediately before his death was being provided with accommodation under Part 4 of that Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3144"},{"id":"1744","label":"Burial and cremation - provision of crematoria","desc":"A local authority may provide and maintain burial grounds or cemeteries, or anything essential, ancillary or incidental thereto and may provide and maintain crematoria.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1744"},{"id":"4084","label":"Bus network accessibility plan","desc":"A local transport authority whose area is in England must, before 27 October 2026, publish a bus network accessibility plan in relation to the authority's area containing the prescribed information.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/4084"},{"id":"3155","label":"Bus services - advanced quality partnership scheme - variation or revocation","desc":"The authority or authorities responsible for a Scheme may vary or revoke Scheme.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3155"},{"id":"3153","label":"Bus services - advanced quality partnership scheme postponement","desc":"The authority or authorities must, as detailed in the Section-(a) provide each of the specified facilities or take each of the specified measures not later than the date specified for it to be provided or taken under the scheme, and(b) continue to provide the facilities or keep the measures in effect throughout the remainder of the period for which the scheme is in operation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3153"},{"id":"3126","label":"Bus services - advanced quality partnership schemes","desc":"A local transport authority whose area is in England, or two or more such authorities acting jointly, may make an advanced quality partnership scheme if they are satisfied that the scheme will contribute to the implementation of their local transport policies.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3126"},{"id":"3154","label":"Bus services - advanced quality partnership schemes - regulations and guidance","desc":"The Transport Authorities must comply with Regulations and have regard to Guidance issued by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3154"},{"id":"3170","label":"Bus services - advanced ticketing schemes","desc":"A local transport authority or two or more such authorities acting jointly, may make a ticketing scheme (an \"advanced ticketing scheme\") covering the whole or any part of their area, or combined area, if they consider that the proposed scheme-(a) would be in the interests of the public, and(b) would contribute to the implementation of their local transport policies.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3170"},{"id":"3158","label":"Bus services - assessment and approval of franchising schemes","desc":"Subject to Regulations, a franchising authority, or two or more franchising authorities acting jointly, proposing to make a franchising scheme must carry out an assessment as required by Section 123B, publish the same and where necessary obtain the Secretary of State's approval.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3158"},{"id":"3159","label":"Bus services - audit of franchising schemes","desc":"Subject to Regulations, a franchising authority, or two or more franchising authorities acting jointly, proposing to make a franchising scheme must carry out an independent audit of the scheme, whilst having regard to the Secretary of State's guidance.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3159"},{"id":"1184","label":"Bus services - civil penalties for bus lane contraventions","desc":"A local authority may levy charges for bus lane contravention in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1184"},{"id":"3181","label":"Bus services - compliance with enhanced partnership plans or schemes","desc":"A local authority or authorities must comply with their own enhanced partnership plans and schemes.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3181"},{"id":"3160","label":"Bus services - consultation on franchising schemes","desc":"Subject to Regulations, a franchising authority, or two or more franchising authorities acting jointly, proposing to make a franchising scheme must carry out a consultation exercise in relation to the scheme, in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3160"},{"id":"1186","label":"Bus services - enforcement of mandatory travel concessions","desc":"A local authority may take proceedings to enforce mandatory travel concessions for free travel for elderly and disabled persons.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1186"},{"id":"3174","label":"Bus services - enhanced partnership plans and schemes","desc":"A local transport authority or two or more such authorities acting jointly, may make-(a) an enhanced partnership plan in relation to the whole or part of their area, or combined area, and(b) one or more enhanced partnership schemes relating to the whole or part of the area to which the plan relates.The authority must also list socially necessary schemes and must review and amend the same from time to time.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3174"},{"id":"3175","label":"Bus services - enhanced partnership plans and schemes - frequency of service","desc":"An enhanced partnership scheme may specify requirements about the frequency or timing of particular local services or local services of particular descriptions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3175"},{"id":"3125","label":"Bus services - enhanced partnership scheme notification","desc":"If a local transport authority or two or more such authorities acting jointly make or modify an enhanced partnership scheme to provide bus services the authorities must provide the Traffic Commissioner with certain information.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3125"},{"id":"3176","label":"Bus services - facilities and measures for enhanced partnership plans and schemes","desc":"Any facilities and measures set out in an enhanced partnership scheme must comply with the requirements of the section.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3176"},{"id":"3157","label":"Bus services - franchising schemes","desc":"Subject to Regulations, a franchising authority, or two or more franchising authorities acting jointly, may make a franchising scheme covering the whole or any part of their area, or their combined area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3157"},{"id":"3166","label":"Bus services - franchising schemes - interim service where operator failure","desc":"A franchising authority, or two or more franchising authorities acting jointly, may provide an interim service in circumstances of operator failure.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3166"},{"id":"3169","label":"Bus services - franchising schemes - obtaining information","desc":"A franchising authority, or two or more franchising authorities acting jointly, may obtain information regarding local services in connection with Franchising Schemes.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3169"},{"id":"3162","label":"Bus services - franchising schemes - postponement of local service contracts","desc":"A franchising authority, or two or more franchising authorities acting jointly, may postpone Local Service Contracts in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3162"},{"id":"3168","label":"Bus services - franchising schemes - regulations and guidance","desc":"A franchising authority, or two or more franchising authorities acting jointly, must comply with Regulations and have regard to Guidance issued by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3168"},{"id":"3163","label":"Bus services - franchising schemes - restrictions on local service contracts","desc":"A franchising authority, or two or more franchising authorities acting jointly, must comply with restrictions on Local Service Contracts where a franchising scheme is in force.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3163"},{"id":"3167","label":"Bus services - franchising schemes - service permits","desc":"A franchising authority, or two or more franchising authorities acting jointly, may grant, attach conditions to, revoke or suspend a service permit.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3167"},{"id":"3150","label":"Bus services - guidance for enhanced partnership plans or schemes","desc":"A local authority or authorities must have regard to Guidance regarding enhanced partnership plans and schemes.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3150"},{"id":"3173","label":"Bus services - guidance on advanced ticketing schemes","desc":"If a local transport authority or two or more such authorities, must have regard to Guidance from the Secretary of State when making an advanced ticketing scheme may make a scheme.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3173"},{"id":"1183","label":"Bus services - information from service operator","desc":"A local authority may obtain information from service providers regarding local bus services.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1183"},{"id":"3149","label":"Bus services - information when creating a new enhanced partnership plan or scheme","desc":"If a local transport authority or two or more such authorities acting jointly, are preparing an enhanced partnership plan or scheme, the authority or any of the authorities may, in connection with preparing the plan or scheme, require an operator of a local service in their area or combined area to supply relevant information.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3149"},{"id":"1177","label":"Bus services - making an advanced quality partnership scheme","desc":"If, after taking the steps described in section 113G, an authority or authorities decide that it is appropriate to make the advanced quality partnership scheme, they may make it as proposed or with modifications. The Scheme must contain certain proscribed particulars.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3146"},{"id":"3172","label":"Bus services - making an advanced ticketing scheme","desc":"If a local transport authority or two or more such authorities, propose to make an advanced ticketing scheme may make a scheme but must comply with various requirements when so doing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3172"},{"id":"1182","label":"Bus services - making information available","desc":"A local authority must having considered certain matters make information about bus services available.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1182"},{"id":"1185","label":"Bus services - mandatory travel concessions","desc":"A local authority must issue a permit for free travel to elderly and disabled persons in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1185"},{"id":"3145","label":"Bus services - notice and consultation of advanced quality partnership schemes","desc":"If an authority or authorities propose to make an advanced quality partnership scheme, they must give notice of the proposed scheme in such manner as they consider appropriate for drawing it to the attention of persons in the area to which it relates. The notices must contain the required particulars and be sent to the statutory consultees.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3145"},{"id":"3171","label":"Bus services - notice and consultation of advanced ticketing schemes","desc":"If a local transport authority or two or more such authorities, propose to make an advanced ticketing scheme, they must give notice of the proposed scheme and undertake consultation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3171"},{"id":"3179","label":"Bus services - notice and making content of enhanced partnership plans and schemes","desc":"If made, enhanced partnership plans and schemes must comply with the prescribed notice requirements and contain the prescribed content.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3179"},{"id":"3147","label":"Bus services - postponement of advanced quality contract scheme","desc":"If it appears to the authority or authorities appropriate to do so, they may decide that any of the dates specified the scheme may be postponed, subject to restrictions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3147"},{"id":"3180","label":"Bus services - postponement of enhance partnership plans or schemes","desc":"If it appears to a local authority or authorities that have made an enhanced partnership scheme appropriate to do so, they may decide that certain dates relating to the Scheme are to be postponed by such period as they think fit, subject to limitations","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3180"},{"id":"3178","label":"Bus services - preparation, notice and consultation for enhanced partnership plans and schemes","desc":"A proposed enhanced partnership scheme must be prepared, notice of the same given and be subject to consultation","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3178"},{"id":"3148","label":"Bus services - provision of information","desc":"If a local transport authority or two or more such authorities acting jointly, must comply with Regulations requiring the provision of information about bus services.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3148"},{"id":"3161","label":"Bus services - publication of franchising scheme","desc":"Subject to Regulations, a franchising authority, or two or more franchising authorities acting jointly, proposing to make a franchising scheme must publish the scheme, in the required manner.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3161"},{"id":"3151","label":"Bus services - regulations for enhanced partnership plans or schemes","desc":"A local authority or authorities must comply with Regulations regarding enhanced partnership plans and schemes.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3151"},{"id":"1187","label":"Bus services - revocation and variation of enhanced partnership plans and schemes","desc":"An enhanced partnership scheme may be revoked or varied.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3177"},{"id":"3152","label":"Bus services - revocation of enhanced partnership plan or scheme","desc":"A local authority or authorities may revoke their own enhanced partnership plans and schemes, but must comply with notice and consultation requirements.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3152"},{"id":"3165","label":"Bus services - revocation of franchising scheme","desc":"A franchising authority, or two or more franchising authorities acting jointly, may revoke a franchising scheme in accordance with the provision of the statute.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3165"},{"id":"3164","label":"Bus services - variation of franchising scheme","desc":"A franchising authority, or two or more franchising authorities acting jointly, may vary a franchising scheme in accordance with the provision of the statute.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3164"},{"id":"4086","label":"Bus Services Act 2025","desc":"A relevant authority must have regard to Guidance issued by the Secretary of State regarding the provision and design of floating bus stops and must comply with Regulations regarding to the provision of information to the Secretary of State regarding the same.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/4086"},{"id":"1181","label":"Bus services joint and through ticketing schemes - notice and consultation","desc":"A local authority or two or more authorities acting jointly proposing to make a joint and through ticketing scheme must comply with certain notice and consultation requirements.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1180"},{"id":"3182","label":"Bus services of enhanced partnership plans and schemes","desc":"A local authority or authorities may vary their own enhanced partnership plans and schemes but must comply with notice and consultation requirements.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3182"},{"id":"1174","label":"Bus services quality contract scheme - approval of proposed scheme","desc":"A local authority or two or more authorities acting jointly proposing to make a quality contract scheme must apply to the appropriate national body for approval.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1174"},{"id":"1175","label":"Bus services quality contract scheme - making of scheme","desc":"A local authority or two or more authorities acting jointly, when making a quality contract scheme must comply with certain requirements including the appeals procedure.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1175"},{"id":"1172","label":"Bus services quality contract scheme - new scheme","desc":"A local authority or two or more authorities acting jointly may make a quality contract scheme as part of their local transport policy.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1172"},{"id":"1173","label":"Bus services quality contract scheme - notice and consultation","desc":"A local authority or two or more authorities acting jointly proposing to make a quality contract scheme as part of their local transport policy must observe certain notice and consultation requirements.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1173"},{"id":"1176","label":"Bus services quality contract scheme - postponement of scheme","desc":"A local authority or two or more authorities acting jointly may postpone a quality contract scheme in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1176"},{"id":"1158","label":"Bus services quality contract schemes - continuance of schemes","desc":"A local authority or two or more authorities acting jointly may continue a quality contract scheme for further periods in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1158"},{"id":"1162","label":"Bus services quality contract schemes - guidance about schemes","desc":"A local authority or two or more authorities acting jointly must comply with guidance relating to quality contract schemes.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1162"},{"id":"1161","label":"Bus services quality contract schemes - regulations about schemes","desc":"A local authority or two or more authorities acting jointly must comply with regulations relating to quality contract schemes.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1161"},{"id":"1157","label":"Bus services quality contract schemes - tendering for contracts","desc":"The authority, or the authorities acting jointly, must invite tenders for the provision of services to which the scheme relates for such period and on such basis as may be specified in the invitation to tender.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1157"},{"id":"1160","label":"Bus services quality contract schemes - variation or revocation","desc":"A local authority or two or more authorities acting jointly may vary or revoke a quality contract scheme for further periods in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1160"},{"id":"1156","label":"Bus services quality partnership scheme - guidance about schemes","desc":"A local authority or two or more authorities acting jointly, providing a bus partnership scheme must have regard to guidance.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1156"},{"id":"1170","label":"Bus services quality partnership scheme - making of scheme","desc":"A local authority or two or more authorities acting jointly proposing to make a quality partnership scheme as part of their local transport policy must comply with certain requirements when making the scheme.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1170"},{"id":"1168","label":"Bus services quality partnership scheme - new scheme","desc":"A local authority or two or more authorities acting jointly may make a quality partnership scheme as part of their local transport policy.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1168"},{"id":"1169","label":"Bus services quality partnership scheme - notice and consultation","desc":"A local authority or two or more authorities acting jointly proposing to make a quality partnership scheme as part of their local transport policy must observe certain notice and consultation requirements.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1169"},{"id":"1171","label":"Bus services quality partnership scheme - postponement of scheme","desc":"A local authority or two or more authorities acting jointly may postpone a quality partnership scheme in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1171"},{"id":"1153","label":"Bus services quality partnership scheme - provision of facilities","desc":"A local authority or two or more authorities acting jointly must provide specified facilities for the duration of the scheme.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1153"},{"id":"1154","label":"Bus services quality partnership scheme - regulations","desc":"A local authority or two or more authorities acting jointly, providing a bus partnership scheme must comply with regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1154"},{"id":"1155","label":"Bus services quality partnership scheme - variation or revocation of scheme","desc":"A local authority or two or more authorities acting jointly, providing a bus partnership scheme may vary or revoke the scheme.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1155"},{"id":"3703","label":"Business and service delivery - Coronavirus tier restrictions","desc":"Where a local authority runs a business or provides a service, it must have regard to the Schedules of the Regulations which describe which businesses and services are affected and to what extent depending upon which of the three tiers that local authority\u2019s area is in.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3703"},{"id":"681","label":"Business improvement district - additional contributions and action","desc":"A local authority may make contributions or take action towards BID arrangements for its area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/681"},{"id":"685","label":"Business improvement district - administration of BID levy","desc":"A local authority comply with statutory instruments regarding administration of the BID Levy.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/685"},{"id":"689","label":"Business improvement district - appeal against veto","desc":"A local authority must comply with the outcome of any appeal against its veto of BID proposals.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/689"},{"id":"687","label":"Business improvement district - approval in ballot","desc":"A local authority must carry out a ballot regarding BID proposals in the required manner.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/687"},{"id":"680","label":"Business improvement district - arrangements","desc":"A local authority may make business improvement district arrangements for all or part of its area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/680"},{"id":"683","label":"Business improvement district - BID levy","desc":"A local authority must calculate the BID Levy in accordance with any BID arrangements in force for its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/683"},{"id":"686","label":"Business improvement district - BID proposals","desc":"A local authority comply with statutory instruments regarding the drawing up, content and approval of BID proposals.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/686"},{"id":"684","label":"Business improvement district - BID revenue account","desc":"A local authority must when BID arrangements are in force for its area keep and maintain a BID revenue account.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/684"},{"id":"690","label":"Business improvement district - commencement and duration of BID arrangements","desc":"The billing authority concerned must ensure that BID arrangements which give effect to the proposals are made by the time the arrangements are to come into force and are to have effect for such period as may be specified in the arrangements in accordance with regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/690"},{"id":"682","label":"Business improvement district - compliance","desc":"A local authority must comply with any BID arrangements in force for its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/682"},{"id":"688","label":"Business improvement district - veto","desc":"A local authority may veto BID proposals in certain prescribed circumstances taking certain prescribed steps.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/688"},{"id":"2703","label":"Business improvement districts - ballot regulations","desc":"The returning officer for local elections in the billing authority area is to be the ballot holder for any ballot in respect of BRS-BIDs required under the Regulations and must follow prescribed arrangements for the conduct and determination of a ballot. A billing authority may recover the costs of a BRS-BID ballot or a renewal ballot from the BRS-BID proposer or BRSBID body in the prescribed circumstances; may veto BRS-BID proposals in the prescribed period and circumstances, but is subject to the appeals provision. It must have regard to prescribed rules regarding the imposition, administration, collection, recovery and application of the BRS-BID levy.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2703"},{"id":"3112","label":"Business improvement districts - BRS-BID levy prescribed rules","desc":"A billing authority must have regard to prescribed rules regarding the imposition, administration, collection, recovery and application of the BRS-BID levy.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3112"},{"id":"3111","label":"Business improvement districts - recovery of ballot costs","desc":"A billing authority may recover the costs of a BRS-BID ballot or a renewal ballot from the BRS-BID proposer or BRSBID body in the prescribed circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3111"},{"id":"3113","label":"Business improvement districts - veto of BRS-BID proposals","desc":"A billing authority may veto BRS-BID proposals in the prescribed period and circumstances, but is subject to the appeals provision.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3113"},{"id":"2536","label":"Business rate supplement - accounting","desc":"LAs may treat specified items as debits or credits to the revenue account, must make good any deficits in the BRS revenue accounts of a levying authority or a functional body out of general funds and must make refunds and credits where the imposition of a BRS has come to an end or has been cancelled by the Secretary of State under section 24 of the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2536"},{"id":"2535","label":"Business rate supplement - expenses","desc":"LAs may deduct administrative expenses in relation to collection and recovery of the Business Rate Supplement.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2535"},{"id":"47","label":"Business rates - accounting provisions for BRS","desc":"A local authority must comply with accounting provisions in connection with business rate supplement.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/47"},{"id":"46","label":"Business rates - BRS collection and enforcement and administrative expenses","desc":"A local authority must comply with Regulations regarding collection and enforcement and administrative expenses in connection with business rate supplements.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/46"},{"id":"42","label":"Business rates - BRS relief","desc":"A levying authority that imposes a BRS may apply such reliefs in relation to the BRS as it thinks appropriate","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/42"},{"id":"45","label":"Business rates - calculation of chargeable amount where BRS imposed","desc":"The authority must calculate the chargeable amount which each person who is to be subject to a BRS imposed for a financial year is to be liable to pay in respect of that year.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/45"},{"id":"50","label":"Business rates - compliance with guidance for BRS","desc":"Local authority must comply with guidance issued by the Secretary of State when carrying out its functions under the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/50"},{"id":"48","label":"Business rates - directions on cancellation of BRS","desc":"A levying authority, a billing authority or a functional body must comply with a direction given to it, or a requirement imposed on it by the Secretary of State in relation to the cancellation of a BRS.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/48"},{"id":"43","label":"Business rates - interaction with BID levy where BRS imposed","desc":"A levying authority must set rules for the purposes of cases where a person is, by reference to a hereditament, liable for BID levy for the whole or part of a financial year in respect of which the person is, in relation to that hereditament, subject to a BRS imposed by the authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/43"},{"id":"44","label":"Business rates - notice of BRS to billing authority","desc":"A levying authority which is not a billing authority must, for each financial year for which it intends to impose a BRS, give a written notice relating to the BRS to each billing authority which is a lower-tier authority in relation to it.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/44"},{"id":"41","label":"Business rates - procedures for imposing a BRS","desc":"A local authority must draw up and publish an initial prospectus, consult relevant persons, hold a ballot, where relevant, which approves the imposition and publish a final prospectus which sets out the arrangements for the imposition before imposing a business rate supplement.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/41"},{"id":"3097","label":"Business rates - provision of information on BRS","desc":"The billing authority has a duty to comply with any request for information from the billing authority in respect of the business rate supplement.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3097"},{"id":"49","label":"Business rates - request for information in respect of BRS","desc":"The levying authority may request information from the billing authority in respect of the business rate supplement and the billing authority has a duty to comply with that request.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/49"},{"id":"40","label":"Business rates - supplement (BRS)","desc":"A local authority may impose a business supplemental rate non-domestic ratepayers to raise money for expenditure on a project that the authority is satisfied will promote economic development in its area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/40"},{"id":"1852","label":"Canals - safety works on dangerous canals","desc":"A local authority may require a canal company to carry out safety related work on dangerous places on a canal in its area and may carry out the work itself and recover costs in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1852"},{"id":"1546","label":"Caravan sites - alteration of conditions","desc":"A local authority may alter conditions attaching to caravan site licences in certain circumstances and in accordance with the prescribed procedure.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1546"},{"id":"1545","label":"Caravan sites - annual fee for licences","desc":"A local authority may charge an annual fee for certain caravan sites.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1545"},{"id":"1550","label":"Caravan sites - carrying out of works","desc":"A local authority may take steps to carry out works required by a compliance notice in certain circumstances following conviction of the occupier.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1550"},{"id":"1548","label":"Caravan sites - compliance notice for breach of licence conditions","desc":"A local authority may issue, revoke or vary a compliance notice in relation to the breach of conditions of certain caravan site licences or apply to a court for revocation upon conviction for breach.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1548"},{"id":"1551","label":"Caravan sites - emergency action","desc":"A local authority may take emergency action in respect of a licenced caravan site in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1551"},{"id":"1552","label":"Caravan sites - expenses for works or emergency action","desc":"A local authority may demand expenses in respect of action taken under sections 9D and 9E in respect of a licenced caravan site in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1552"},{"id":"1554","label":"Caravan sites - fee policy for licences","desc":"A local authority proposing to charge fees under the Act must prepare and publish a fee policy.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1554"},{"id":"1544","label":"Caravan sites - licensing","desc":"A local authority may issue a licence for a caravan site in certain circumstances and in accordance with the prescribed procedure.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1544"},{"id":"1558","label":"Caravan sites - powers of entry","desc":"An officer authorised by a local authority may enter a caravan site for certain purposes in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1558"},{"id":"1556","label":"Caravan sites - provision","desc":"A local authority may acquire land and provide sites for caravans together with facilities and arrange for the same to be managed.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1556"},{"id":"1549","label":"Caravan sites - recovery of expenses for compliance notice","desc":"A local authority may recover certain expenses associated with the issue of a compliance notice in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1549"},{"id":"1557","label":"Caravan sites - register of site licences","desc":"A local authority must compile, keep and make available a register of caravan site licences for their area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1557"},{"id":"1547","label":"Caravan sites - revocation of licence for breach of conditions","desc":"A local authority may apply to the court for a caravan site licence to be revoked where the holder is convicted of breaching its conditions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1547"},{"id":"1553","label":"Caravan sites -
