search, seizure and detention","desc":"A duly authorised officer of an enforcement authority may at any reasonable hour and on production, if required, of his credentials - If the officer has reasonable grounds for suspecting that any goods are manufactured or imported goods which have not been supplied in the United Kingdom since they were manufactured or imported he may\u2014(a) for the purpose of ascertaining whether there has been any contravention of any safety provision in relation to the goods, require any person carrying on a business, or employed in connection with a business, to produce any records relating to the business;(b) for the purpose of ascertaining (by testing or otherwise) whether there has been any such contravention, seize and detain the goods;(c) take copies of, or of any entry in, any records produced by virtue of paragraph (a) above.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2926"},{"id":"3431","label":"Consumer protection - sunbeds (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to premises occupied by, or to any extent under the control or management of, a person who carries on a sunbed business.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3431"},{"id":"3430","label":"Consumer protection - sunbeds (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to premises occupied by, or to any extent under the control or management of, a person who carries on a sunbed business.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3430"},{"id":"2559","label":"Consumer protection - timeshare regulations","desc":"LAs must enforce the Regulations within its area","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2559"},{"id":"3434","label":"Consumer protection - tobacco and related products","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to the labelling and content of tobacco and related products.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3434"},{"id":"2573","label":"Consumer protection - toy safety","desc":"An enforcement authority may request a manufacturer or a distributor who has placed a toy on the market to cooperate with it in relation to any action taken or to be taken to eliminate any risk posed by the toy and may serve a compliance notice on an economic operator in cases of formal non-compliance and toys presenting a risk. The LA must carry out an evaluation in relation to the toy covering all the requirements of the Regulations and may require appropriate corrective action to bring the toy into compliance or may serve a withdrawal or recall notice If it does so it must give immediate notice to the Secretary of State","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2573"},{"id":"3279","label":"Consumer protection - unfair trading enforcement","desc":"The local weights and measures authority has a duty to protect consumers from unfair, aggressive or misleading commercial practices and to enforce regulations","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3279"},{"id":"3281","label":"Consumer protection - unfair trading investigation","desc":"The local authority has the power to undertake actions that they consider appropriate in the enforcement of unfair trading regulations","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3281"},{"id":"2982","label":"Consumer rights - complaints regarding unfair contract terms and notices","desc":"A local authority may consider a complaint about a term or notice to which the Schedule applies (a \u201crelevant complaint\u201d).If a regulator other than the Competition and Markets Authority intends to consider a relevant complaint, it must notify the CMA that it intends to do so, and must then consider the complaint.If a regulator considers a relevant complaint, but decides not to make an application relation to the complaint, it must give reasons for its decision to the person who made the complaint.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2982"},{"id":"2986","label":"Consumer rights - exercising of enforcement powers","desc":"A local authority may only exercise a power under this Schedule for the purposes listed in the Schedule, subject to the restrictions in the Schedule.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2986"},{"id":"2983","label":"Consumer rights - injunction for unfair contract terms","desc":"A local authority may apply for an injunction against a person if the regulator thinks that\u2014(a) the person is using, or proposing or recommending the use of, a term or notice to which this Schedule applies, and(b) the term or notice purports to exclude or restrict liability of the kind mentioned in sections 31, 47, 57 or 65(1) or is unfair or does not meet the transparency test.The CMA must be notified of any such application and its outcome.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2983"},{"id":"2985","label":"Consumer rights - investigatory powers and duties","desc":"A local authority has enforcement powers and duties in relation to the following legislation under the Act, if and where applicable to that Authority and where allowed for by the Act.section 26(1) or 40(1)(b) of the Trade Descriptions Act 1968 (including as applied by regulation 8(3) of the Crystal Glass (Descriptions) Regulations 1973 (SI 1973/1952) and regulation 10(2) of the Footwear (Indication of Composition) Labelling Regulations 1995 (SI 1995/2489));section 9(1) or (6) of the Hallmarking Act 1973;paragraph 6 of the Schedule to the Prices Act 1974 (including as read with paragraph 14(1) of that Schedule);section 161(1) of the Consumer Credit Act 1974;section 26(1) of the Estate Agents Act 1979;section 16A(1) or (4) of the Video Recordings Act 1984;section 27(1) of the Consumer Protection Act 1987 (including as applied by section 12(1) of the Fireworks Act 2003 to fireworks regulations under that Act);section 215(1) of the Education Reform Act 1988;section 107A(1) or (3) or 198A(1) or (3) of the Copyright, Designs and Patents Act 1988;paragraph 1 of Schedule 3 to the Package Travel, Package Holidays and Package Tours Regulations 1992 (SI 1992/3288);section 30(4) or (7) or 31(4)(a) of the Clean Air Act 1993;paragraph 1 of Schedule 2 to the Sunday Trading Act 1994;section 93(1) or (3) of the Trade Marks Act 1994;section 8A(1) or (3) of the Olympic Symbol etc (Protection) Act 1995;paragraph 2(a) or 3(1) of Schedule 15 to the Lifts Regulations 1997 (SI 1997/831);regulation 5C(5) of the Motor Fuel (Composition and Content) Regulations 1999 (SI 1999/3107);paragraph 1(1)(b) or (2)(b) or 2 of Schedule 9 to the Radio Equipment and Telecommunications Terminal Equipment Regulations 2000 (SI 2000/730);paragraph 1(a) of Schedule 10 to the Personal Protective Equipment Regulations 2002 (SI 2002/1144);section 3(1) of the Christmas Day Trading Act 2004;regulation 10(1) of the General Product Safety Regulations 2005 (SI 2005/1803);regulation 10(1) of the Weights and Measures (Packaged Goods) Regulations 2006 (SI 2006/659);regulation 17 of the Measuring Instruments (Automatic Discontinuous Totalisers) Regulations 2006 (SI 2006/1255);regulation 18 of the Measuring Instruments (Automatic Railweighbridges) Regulations 2006 (SI 2006/1256);regulation 20 of the Measuring Instruments (Automatic Catchweighers) Regulations 2006 (SI 2006/1257);regulation 18 of the Measuring Instruments (Automatic Gravimetric Filling Instruments) Regulations 2006 (SI 2006/1258);regulation 18 of the Measuring Instruments (Beltweighers) Regulations 2006 (SI 2006/1259);regulation 16 of the Measuring Instruments (Capacity Serving Measures) Regulations 2006 (SI 2006/1264);regulation 17 of the Measuring Instruments (Liquid Fuel and Lubricants) Regulations 2006 (SI 2006/1266);regulation 16 of the Measuring Instruments (Material Measures of Length) Regulations 2006 (SI 2006/1267);regulation 17 of the Measuring Instruments (Cold-water Meters) Regulations 2006 (SI 2006/1268);regulation 18 of the Measuring Instruments (Liquid Fuel delivered from Road Tankers) Regulations 2006 (SI 2006/1269);regulation 13(1) or (1A) of the Business Protection from Misleading Marketing Regulations 2008 (SI 2008/1276);regulation 19(1) or (1A) of the Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008 (SI 2008/1277);paragraph 2 or 5 of Schedule 5 to the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008 (SI 2008/1597);regulation 32(2) or (3) of the Timeshare, Holiday Products, Resale and Exchange Contracts Regulations 2010 (SI agents fees","desc":"A local authority must enforce the duty upon letting agents to publicise their fees.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2995"},{"id":"2996","label":"Consumer rights - secondary ticketing","desc":"A local authority may enforce the law relating to secondary ticketing, where a person re-sells a ticket for a recreational, sporting or cultural event in the United Kingdom through a secondary ticketing facility.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2996"},{"id":"2601","label":"Consumer rights - surcharges","desc":"Local authorities (weights and measures authorities) may consider complaints about surcharges, and may apply to a court for an injunction against a trader acting in breach of regulation 4.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2601"},{"id":"2984","label":"Consumer rights - undertaking regarding unfair contract terms","desc":"A local authority may accept an undertaking from a person against whom it has applied, or thinks it is entitled to apply, for an injunction.The undertaking may provide that the person will comply with the conditions that are agreed between the person and the regulator about the use of terms or notices, or terms or notices of a kind, specified in the undertaking.The CMA must be notified\u2014(a) the conditions on which the undertaking is accepted, and(b) the person who gave it.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2984"},{"id":"2992","label":"Consumer rights enforcement - access to goods and compensation","desc":"A local authority must allow access to seized goods in certain circumstances and pay compensation for damaged goods in certain circumstances","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2992"},{"id":"2991","label":"Consumer rights enforcement - application for warrant","desc":"A local authority may apply for a warrant to enter premises, enter those premises in accordance with the conditions set out in the Schedule and require assistance from those present upon the premises.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2991"},{"id":"2994","label":"Consumer rights enforcement - civil and criminal proceedings","desc":"A local authority may bring civil and/or criminal proceedings in certain circumstances","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2994"},{"id":"2989","label":"Consumer rights enforcement - entry and observation","desc":"A local authority or an authorised officer may may enter premises to which the public has access in order to observe the carrying on of a business on those premises.The power may be exercised at any reasonable time (whether or not the public has access at that time).The power of entry may be exercised without first giving notice or obtaining a warrant.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2989"},{"id":"2990","label":"Consumer rights enforcement - entry without warrant","desc":"A local authority authorised officer may enter non-domestic premises without a warrant providing appropriate notice has been given for routine inspections. Upon so entering the officer may (so far is allowed for)-Inspect products or procedures;Test equipment;Require the production of documents;Seize and detain goodsSeize documents andBreak open a container or open a vending machine.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2990"},{"id":"2993","label":"Consumer rights enforcement - notice of testing results","desc":"A local authority must inform the relevant person of the result of testing in certain circumstance.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2993"},{"id":"2987","label":"Consumer rights enforcement - notice to provide information","desc":"A local authority or an authorised officer may give notice to a person requiring the person to provide the authority with the information specified in the notice. A local authority may take court action if the notice is not complied with.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2987"},{"id":"2988","label":"Consumer rights enforcement - purchase, entry and inspection","desc":"A local authority or an authorised officer may make a purchase of a product, or enter into an agreement to secure the provision of a product.And for these purposes an officer may \u2014at any reasonable time, enter premises to which the public has access (whether or not the public has access at that time), and inspect any product on the premises which the public may inspect.The power of entry may be exercised without first giving notice or obtaining a warrant.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2988"},{"id":"1239","label":"Contaminated land - compliance with guidance","desc":"A local authority must comply with site specific guidance with regard to contaminated land.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1239"},{"id":"1234","label":"Contaminated land - inspection and notice","desc":"A local authority must inspect its area to identify contaminated land, to designate special sites and give notice of the same.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1234"},{"id":"1238","label":"Contaminated land - provision of information","desc":"A local authority must supply the appropriate agency with information, or with a report on the state of contaminated land in their area, when requested.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1238"},{"id":"1237","label":"Contaminated land - register of notices","desc":"A local authority must maintain a register of remediation and other notices in the manner prescribed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1237"},{"id":"1235","label":"Contaminated land - remediation notice","desc":"A local authority must serve a remediation notice, in the prescribed manner, in respect of contaminated land (non-special sites) in its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1235"},{"id":"1236","label":"Contaminated land - remediation works","desc":"A local authority may carry out remediation works on contaminated land in certain circumstances and to recover its costs.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1236"},{"id":"1020","label":"Contracts - certified contracts requirements","desc":"A local authority must meet certain requirements for a contract to be a certified contract.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1020"},{"id":"2150","label":"Contracts - standing orders for the supply of goods or materials or for the execution of works","desc":"A local authority must make standing orders with respect to the making by them or on their behalf of contracts for the supply of goods or materials or for the execution of works.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2150"},{"id":"2151","label":"Contracts - standing orders with respect to the making of contracts","desc":"A local authority may make standing orders with respect to the making by them or on their behalf of contracts other than for the supply of goods or materials or for the execution of works.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2151"},{"id":"1227","label":"Controlled waste - compliance with directions","desc":"A local authority must comply with direction from the Secretary of State regarding controlled waste.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1227"},{"id":"2102","label":"Controlled waste - directions regarding special waste","desc":"A local authority must comply with directions from the Secretary of State regarding the disposal of special waste.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2102"},{"id":"1222","label":"Controlled waste - directions to waste collection authorities regarding disposal","desc":"A local authority must give directions to waste collection authorities in relation to the disposal of the controlled waste collected in its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1222"},{"id":"1213","label":"Controlled waste - discretionary emptying of privies and cesspools","desc":"An authority may, if requested by the person who controls any other privy or cesspool in its area to empty the privy or cesspool, empty the privy or, as the case may be, remove from the cesspool such of its contents as the authority consider appropriate on payment, if the authority so requires, of a reasonable charge.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1213"},{"id":"1220","label":"Controlled waste - disposal","desc":"A local authority must arrange for the disposal of the controlled waste collected in its area by the waste collection authorities.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1220"},{"id":"1224","label":"Controlled waste - disposal of non-household waste","desc":"A local authority may provide facilities for the disposal of non-household waste and may charge for the same.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1224"},{"id":"1218","label":"Controlled waste - disposal of non-recyclable waste","desc":"A local authority must deliver (non-recyclable) collected waste to a waste disposal authority for disposal.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1218"},{"id":"1219","label":"Controlled waste - disposal of recyclable waste","desc":"A local authority must inform a waste disposal authority of its plans to dispose of recyclable waste and may only do so to the extent agreed by the waste disposal authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1219"},{"id":"1223","label":"Controlled waste - financial assistance for disposal of commercial waste","desc":"A local authority may give prescribed financial assistance directions to assist in the disposal of commercial of industrial waste","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1223"},{"id":"1214","label":"Controlled waste - household recycling collection","desc":"A local authority must collect waste separated in accordance with the requirements of sections 45A, 45AZA, 45AZB, 45AZC, 45AZD and 45AZE.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1214"},{"id":"1210","label":"Controlled waste - household waste collection","desc":"A local authority must collect domestic waste (subject to limited exceptions).","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1210"},{"id":"1211","label":"Controlled waste - industrial waste collection","desc":"A local authority may collect industrial waste in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1211"},{"id":"1231","label":"Controlled waste - information from waste authority","desc":"A local authority must comply with a request from the Secretary of State for information.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1231"},{"id":"1212","label":"Controlled waste - mandatory emptying of privies and cesspools","desc":"A local authority must make such arrangements for the emptying, without charge, of privies serving one or more private dwellings in its area as the authority considers appropriate and if requested by the person who controls a cesspool serving only one or more private dwellings in its area to empty the cesspool, to remove such of the contents of the cesspool as the authority considers appropriate on payment, if the authority so requires, of a reasonable charge.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1212"},{"id":"1230","label":"Controlled waste - minimising generation","desc":"A local authority may take steps to minimise the generation of controlled waste.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1230"},{"id":"2101","label":"Controlled waste - notice to remove waste","desc":"A local authority may give notice for controlled waste deposited in breach of a licence to be removed and may remove the waste itself in certain circumstances and recover its expenses.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2101"},{"id":"1225","label":"Controlled waste - payments for retained recyclable and pre-separated waste","desc":"A local authority must make certain payments to waste collection authorities in respect of retained recyclable and pre-separated waste.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1225"},{"id":"2089","label":"Controlled waste - production of heat and electricity","desc":"A local authority may produce heat and electricity from waste and may sell or dispose of the same.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2089"},{"id":"2088","label":"Controlled waste - reclamation","desc":"A local authority may do such things as it considers appropriate for the purpose of enabling waste to be used again or substances to be reclaimed from waste, acquire waste to enable its reuse of for substances to be reclaimed from it, and use, sell or dispose of waste or anything produced from it.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2088"},{"id":"1226","label":"Controlled waste - recycling of waste","desc":"A local authority has powers to purchase, sell and utilise recycled waste.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1226"},{"id":"1232","label":"Controlled waste - requesting of information","desc":"A local authority may request information regarding controlled waste.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1232"},{"id":"1233","label":"Controlled waste - use of fixed penalty receipts","desc":"A local authority may use certain fixed penalty notice receipts for certain purposes.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1233"},{"id":"3710","label":"Coronavirus regulations, all tiers - enforcement","desc":"A local authority may designate a person to enforce any of the restrictions mentioned in these regulations.Enforcement may include the issuing of a prohibition notice, directing a gathering to disperse, direct any person in a gathering to return to the place they are living or removing an individual from a gathering.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3710"},{"id":"3709","label":"Coronavirus regulations, all tiers - fixed penalty notices","desc":"An authorised person may issue a fixed penalty notice to any person that the authorised person reasonably believes has committed an offence under these Regulations, and is (in the case of an individual) aged 18 or over.A fixed penalty notice is a notice offering the person to whom it is issued the opportunity of discharging any liability to conviction for the offence by payment of a fixed penalty to an authority specified in the notice.The amount and conditions of issue of any fixed penalty notice are as specified in Regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3709"},{"id":"2659","label":"Coroners - allowances, fees and expenses","desc":"A local authority (coroner\u2019s relevant authority) (if not paid by the coroner) must pay expenses to a person under the Regulations and return any receipts if requested. It must reimburse the coroner in respect of payments in submitted accounts (if correct) keep a record of all fees and expenses paid for 3 years; submit those records to the Chief Coroner if requested and indemnify the Coroner for costs reasonably incurred.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2659"},{"id":"2108","label":"Coroners - appointment of senior, area and assistant coroners","desc":"A local authority must appoint a senior coroner for its area and area and assistant coroners as directed by the Lord Chancellor.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2108"},{"id":"2109","label":"Coroners - provision of staff and accommodation","desc":"A local authority must secure the provision of whatever officers and other staff are needed by the coroners for that area to carry out their functions; must provide, or secure the provision of, accommodation that is appropriate to the needs of those coroners in carrying out their functions and must maintain, or secure the maintenance of, that accommodation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2109"},{"id":"3820","label":"Cosmetic procedures - licensing and enforcement","desc":"A local authority must issue premises and personal licences and enforce Regulations relating to the carrying out of cosmetic procedures.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3820"},{"id":"3271","label":"Cosmetics - enforcement of regulations","desc":"The local weights and measures authority is responsible for enforcement of regulations concerning the safety and labelling of cosmetic products.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3271"},{"id":"3272","label":"Cosmetics - inspection, sampling and seizure","desc":"The local weights and measures authority has the power to inspect premises, sample and seize goods which do not comply with regulations on cosmetic products.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3272"},{"id":"2056","label":"Cottage holdings - prohibition","desc":"A local authority must not sell, let or acquire land to be used as a cottage holding.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2056"},{"id":"1282","label":"Council tax - administration, penalties and enforcement","desc":"A local authority must comply with provisions regarding administration, penalties and enforcement.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1282"},{"id":"2893","label":"Council tax - alteration of requisite calculations (England)","desc":"A local authority must comply with the Regulations when making the calculations which fall within those Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2893"},{"id":"2894","label":"Council tax - alteration of requisite calculations (Wales)","desc":"A local authority must comply with the Regulations when making the calculations which fall within those Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2894"},{"id":"2615","label":"Council tax - calculation of base","desc":"A local authority must follow the prescribed rules for the calculation of the council tax base","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2615"},{"id":"1294","label":"Council tax - consultation with ratepayers","desc":"A local authority must consult ratepayers in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1294"},{"id":"2602","label":"Council tax - default reduction schemes","desc":"The regulations contain the default scheme for reductions and appeals prescribed by the Secretary of State under the Local Government Finance Act 1992 (as amended by the Local Government Finance Act 2012) where a local authority has failed to make its own scheme by 31 January.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2602"},{"id":"2540","label":"Council tax - demand notices","desc":"Specified information must be included in council tax demand notices including the dwelling to which the notice relates, the valuation band applicable to the dwelling, the amount of council tax payable in respect of the dwelling and comparisons with the preceding year. Precepting authorities and levying bodies must also supply information to billing authorities","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2540"},{"id":"1293","label":"Council tax - designation and nomination in relation to excessive council tax","desc":"A local authority must comply with the procedure relating to designation and nomination.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1293"},{"id":"1276","label":"Council tax - discretionary charges for empty dwellings","desc":"A local authority may exercise powers under regulations relating to empty dwellings.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1276"},{"id":"1274","label":"Council tax - discretionary discounts in England","desc":"A local authority may exercise its powers arising from regulations relating to discounts.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1274"},{"id":"1278","label":"Council tax - discretionary discounts in Wales","desc":"A local authority may exercise powers relating to discounts contained in regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1278"},{"id":"1288","label":"Council tax - excessive council tax","desc":"A local authority must determine whether its relevant basic amount of council tax for a financial year is excessive.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1288"},{"id":"1295","label":"Council tax - functions to be discharged only by authority","desc":"A local authority may not delegate certain matters.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1295"},{"id":"2626","label":"Council tax - increases by precepting authority","desc":"An authority which is a major or local precepting authority must notify its billing authorities if it has set an excessive relevant basic amount of council tax for a financial year by a specified date.Where a billing authority holds a referendum on behalf of a major or local precepting authority it can recover its costs from the precepting authority unless it has failed to do so or is in default.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2626"},{"id":"1284","label":"Council tax - information for purposes of setting council tax","desc":"A local authority must provide certain information to a billing authority in the manner prescribed by regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1284"},{"id":"1286","label":"Council tax - issue of precepts by local precepting authorities","desc":"A local authority must issue a precept in accordance with section 41.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1286"},{"id":"1285","label":"Council tax - issue of precepts by major precepting authorities","desc":"For each financial year a major precepting authority shall issue a precept or precepts in accordance with section 40.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1285"},{"id":"1272","label":"Council tax - levying and collection","desc":"Each local authority must levy and collect a tax, to be called council tax, which is payable in respect of dwellings situated in its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1272"},{"id":"2827","label":"Council tax - listing and appeals","desc":"A local authority must comply with the content of the Regulations relating to the content of lists and appeals.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2827"},{"id":"2523","label":"Council tax - listing of valuation bands","desc":"A local authority must comply with the content of the Regulations relating to the content of lists and appeals.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2523"},{"id":"2587","label":"Council tax - precepting authorities information","desc":"Regulations making provision about information in council tax demand notices including the dwelling to which the notice relates, the valuation band applicable to the dwelling, the amount of council tax payable in respect of the dwelling and comparisons with the preceding year and whether an authority's relevant basic amount of council tax for a year is excessive. Precepting authorities and levying bodies must also supply information to billing authorities.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2587"},{"id":"1287","label":"Council tax - provision of information to any precepting authority","desc":"A billing authority must supply prescribed information within a prescribed period to any precepting authority which has power to issue a precept to the billing authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1287"},{"id":"1296","label":"Council tax - provision of information to Secretary of State","desc":"A local authority must comply with a request for information from the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1296"},{"id":"2524","label":"Council tax - rating appeals","desc":"A local authority must comply with the appeals procedure set out in the Regulations","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2524"},{"id":"1279","label":"Council tax - reduced amounts","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations relating to reduced amounts.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1279"},{"id":"1280","label":"Council tax - reduction schemes","desc":"A local authority must make a council tax reduction scheme.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1280"},{"id":"2662","label":"Council tax - reduction schemes (Wales)","desc":"A local authority (a billing authority in Wales) must make a scheme specifying the reductions which are to apply to amounts of council tax payable by persons, or classes of person considered to be in financial need.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2662"},{"id":"1289","label":"Council tax - regulations","desc":"A local authority must comply with certain regulations made under the Act regarding powers to require information, offences and penalties.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1281"},{"id":"1292","label":"Council tax - regulations and directions on excessive council tax","desc":"A local authority must comply with various regulations and directions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1292"},{"id":"1273","label":"Council tax - regulations on discounts in England","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations relating to discounts.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1273"},{"id":"1277","label":"Council tax - regulations on discounts in Wales","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations relating to discounts.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1277"},{"id":"1275","label":"Council tax - regulations on empty dwellings","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations relating to empty dwellings.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1275"},{"id":"1297","label":"Council tax - restrictions on voting by members","desc":"A local authority must ensure that members do not vote in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1297"},{"id":"1283","label":"Council tax - setting of council tax","desc":"For each financial year and each category of dwellings in its area, a billing authority shall, in accordance with regulations, set an amount of council tax.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1283"},{"id":"1291","label":"Council tax - substitute calculations by local precepting authority where excessive council tax","desc":"A local authority must make substitute calculations in certain circumstances and to take other prescribed steps.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1291"},{"id":"1290","label":"Council tax - substitute calculations by major precepting authority where excessive council tax","desc":"A local authority must make substitute calculations in certain circumstances and take other prescribed steps.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1290"},{"id":"2828","label":"Council tax - valuation tribunal","desc":"A local authority must comply with the procedure set out in the Valuation Tribunal for England (Council Tax and Rating Appeals) (Procedure) Regulations 2009/2269.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2828"},{"id":"1387","label":"Council tax benefit - funding and administration","desc":"A local authority must fund and administer council tax benefit.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1387"},{"id":"1386","label":"Council tax benefits - nature of benefits","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations regarding council tax benefits.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1386"},{"id":"2660","label":"Council tax reduction - fraud (England)","desc":"A local authority (billing authority) may require information from specified persons for the purpose of preventing, detecting and securing evidence of the commission of offences connected with a reduction under a council tax reduction scheme and impose penalties in connection with council tax reduction schemes.It may invite a person to agree to pay a penalty as an alternative to prosecution for an offence relating to the award of a reduction under a council tax reduction scheme or impose a penalty of \u00a370 on a person in prescribed circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2660"},{"id":"2661","label":"Council tax reduction - fraud (Wales)","desc":"A local authority (billing authority) may require information from specified persons for the purpose of preventing, detecting and securing evidence of the commission of offences connected with a reduction under a council tax reduction scheme and impose penalties in connection with council tax reduction schemes.It may invite a person to agree to pay a penalty as an alternative to prosecution for an offence relating to the award of a reduction under a council tax reduction scheme or impose a penalty of \u00a370 on a person in prescribed circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2661"},{"id":"1023","label":"Councils in Wales - council funds","desc":"A local authority in Wales must establish and maintain a council fund.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1023"},{"id":"1022","label":"Councils in Wales - service agency agreements","desc":"A local authority in Wales may enter into a service agency agreement with another.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1022"},{"id":"3000","label":"Counter terrorism - assessment and support panel","desc":"A local authority must ensure that there is an assessment and support panel for its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3000"},{"id":"2999","label":"Counter terrorism - compliance with guidance","desc":"A local authority must comply with directions from the Secretary of State or from Welsh Ministers.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2999"},{"id":"3001","label":"Counter terrorism - membership of assessment and support panel","desc":"A local authority must be a member of the assessment and support panel for its area, appoint a representative and co-operate with the other members in carrying out its functions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3001"},{"id":"2997","label":"Counter terrorism - prevention of people from falling into terrorism","desc":"A local authority must, in the exercise of its functions, have due regard to the need to prevent people from being drawn into terrorism.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2997"},{"id":"2998","label":"Counter terrorism - regard to guidance from Secretary of State","desc":"A local authority must, in the exercise of its duty under the Act, have regard to Guidance from the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2998"},{"id":"1569","label":"Country parks - provision","desc":"A local authority may provide, maintain and manage a country park, acquire land to enable it to do so and issue byelaws regarding its use.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1569"},{"id":"1576","label":"Countryside - access agreement terms","desc":"A local authority may impose terms into access agreements to prevent land becoming excepted land.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1576"},{"id":"1695","label":"Countryside - access agreements","desc":"A local authority may enter into an access agreement to allow public access to the open countryside.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1695"},{"id":"1696","label":"Countryside - access orders","desc":"A local authority may make access orders in certain circumstances in accordance with the prescribed procedure.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1696"},{"id":"1575","label":"Countryside - access to open country, rivers, canals and woodlands","desc":"A local authority may exercise powers under Part V of the National Parks and Countryside Act 1949 in relation to certain strips of land bordering rivers, canals and woodlands.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1575"},{"id":"1700","label":"Countryside - acquisition of land for public access","desc":"A local authority may acquire land for public access.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1700"},{"id":"1703","label":"Countryside - byelaws for National Parks, AONB or access land","desc":"A local authority may make byelaws in relation to national parks, areas of outstanding natural beauty or land or a waterway to which the public are given access by an agreement or order in their area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1703"},{"id":"1571","label":"Countryside - camping and picnic sites","desc":"A local authority may provide camping and picnic sites and may acquire land in order to do so.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1571"},{"id":"1699","label":"Countryside - compensation for access orders","desc":"A local authority must pay compensation where it makes an access order in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1699"},{"id":"1705","label":"Countryside - contribution to towards expenses of other local authorities","desc":"A local authority may make contributions towards expenditure incurred by any other local authority under the National Parks and Access to the Countryside Act 1949.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1705"},{"id":"1574","label":"Countryside - control of boats in national parks","desc":"A local authority may make byelaws to control the use of boats on lakes in a national park in its area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1574"},{"id":"1577","label":"Countryside - display of maps and notices","desc":"A local planning authority shall have power, as respects any land in their area which is subject to an access agreement or order, to defray or contribute towards, or to undertake to defray or contribute towards, expenditure incurred or to be incurred in relation to the land by any person interested therein in displaying, at places where the public obtain access to any such land any reproduction of the relevant map prepared by the local planning authority under section 78 of the Act of 1949, or any notice specifying restrictions on access to the land or any part thereof.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1577"},{"id":"1579","label":"Countryside - economic and social interests","desc":"A local authority must have regard to agriculture, forestry and the economic and social interests of the countryside when exercising functions under various pieces of legislation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1579"},{"id":"1697","label":"Countryside - enforcement of access","desc":"A local authority may enforce access to the countryside in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1697"},{"id":"468","label":"Countryside - local access forums","desc":"The appointing authority for any area shall in accordance with regulations establish for that area, or for each part of it, an advisory body to be known as a local access forum.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/468"},{"id":"1701","label":"Countryside - maps of land subject to public access","desc":"A local authority must compile and maintain maps of land subject to public access.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1701"},{"id":"1581","label":"Countryside - national park wardens","desc":"A local planning authority whose area consists of or includes the whole or any part of a National Park may appoint such number of persons as may appear to the authority to be necessary or expedient to act as wardens as respects any land within the National Park subject to certain conditions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1581"},{"id":"1573","label":"Countryside - national parks facilities","desc":"A local authority may provide various facilities for national parks in its area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1573"},{"id":"1583","label":"Countryside - non-discrimination for use of facilities","desc":"A local authority must not discriminate against people from outside its area in relation to the exercise of its powers under the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1583"},{"id":"1582","label":"Countryside - provision of and charging for facilities","desc":"A local authority may provide facilities in connection with the exercise of its powers under the Act and may charge for so doing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1582"},{"id":"1698","label":"Countryside - suspension of access due to fire risk","desc":"A local authority may suspend access to the countryside where they are satisfied that, by reason of any exceptional conditions of weather for the time being prevailing, access by the public to the land or any part of it is likely to result in fires occurring on it.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1698"},{"id":"1704","label":"Countryside - wardens in National Parks, AONB or access land","desc":"A local authority may appoint wardens in respect of any land for which byelaws have been made or could be made under section 90.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1704"},{"id":"1572","label":"Countryside -natural beauty and amenity","desc":"A local authority must have regard to the desirability of conserving the natural beauty and amenity of the countryside when exercising its functions as to land.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1572"},{"id":"1580","label":"Countryside and country parks - byelaws","desc":"A local authority may make byelaws in relation to country parks and other land as specified in regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1580"},{"id":"3705","label":"COVID secure business obligations - Coronavirus Immediate Restriction Notice (CIRN)","desc":"A Coronavirus Immediate Restriction Notice can be issued by enforcement officers where rapid action is needed to close a premises or restrict an activity to stop the spread of the virus, without first issuing a CIN to stop the spread of the virus. Closure will be for a 48-hour period initially. The local authority will be required to review the notice. A CIRN can be withdrawn or allowed to expire where the premise has taken necessary steps to remedy unsafe practices.Where necessary, a local authority can decide to issue a CRN at the end of the 48 hours, so that the premises is required to close for a further 7-day period, or where it is assessed that the premises is causing a serious and imminent threat to public health, a direction can be issued under separate regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3705"},{"id":"3704","label":"COVID secure business obligations - Coronavirus Improvement Notice (CIN)","desc":"A Coronavirus Improvement Notice can be issued by a local authority when a business is failing to fulfil a provision set out in the relevant coronavirus regulations. This will often be the first step for local authority enforcement officers to encourage businesses to remedy unsafe practices. A CIN will be applied for a minimum of 48 hours. Its actual duration will be at the discretion of the local authority enforcement officer.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3704"},{"id":"3706","label":"COVID secure business obligations - Coronavirus Restriction Notice (CRN)","desc":"A Coronavirus Restriction Notice may be issued by a local authority when there has been a breach of the provisions of the relevant coronavirus regulations, and a premises has failed to comply with the terms of a Coronavirus Improvement Notice, where this non-compliance creates a risk of exposure to coronavirus.Following the 7-day period of application, a CRN can be withdrawn or allowed to expire where the premise has taken necessary steps to remedy unsafe practices.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3706"},{"id":"3707","label":"COVID secure business obligations - fixed penalty notices","desc":"A local authority officer designated for the purposes of this regulation may issue a fixed penalty notice to any person that the officer reasonably believes has committed an offence under this Part and is (in the case of an individual) aged 18 or over.No more than one fixed penalty notice may be issued in relation to a failure to comply with a single Coronavirus Improvement Notice, Coronavirus Immediate Restriction Notice or Coronavirus Restriction Notice.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3707"},{"id":"3708","label":"COVID secure business obligations - prosecutions","desc":"Where a recipient issued with a Coronavirus Improvement Notice, a Coronavirus Immediate Restriction Notice or a Coronavirus Restriction Notice fails to comply with such a notice the local authority may bring about proceedings for an offence. Proceedings may not be initiated until the end of a period of 28 days from the day after the notice was issued and may only be initiated where the appropriate fixed penalty has been paid before the end of this period.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3708"},{"id":"3592","label":"Crematoria - temporary restrictions on use","desc":"A person who is responsible for a crematorium must ensure that, during the emergency period, the crematorium is closed to members of the public, except for funerals or burials. The above does not apply to the grounds surrounding a crematorium, including any burial ground or garden of remembrance.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3592"},{"id":"780","label":"Crime and disorder - anti-social behaviour orders","desc":"A local authority may apply for an anti-social behaviour order if certain conditions are met.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/780"},{"id":"782","label":"Crime and disorder - combination agreements","desc":"Two or more local authorities may enter into a combination agreement for their area with regard to reducing crime and disorder and must comply with prescribed requirements in so doing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/782"},{"id":"241","label":"Crime and disorder - committee","desc":"A local authority must have a crime and disorder committee with powers of scrutiny and to make reports and recommendations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/241"},{"id":"774","label":"Crime and disorder - consideration of crime and disorder implications","desc":"Without prejudice to any other obligation imposed on it, it shall be the duty of each authority to which this section applies to exercise its various functions with due regard to the likely effect of the exercise of those functions on, and the need to do all that it reasonably can to prevent, crime and disorder in its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/774"},{"id":"783","label":"Crime and disorder - formulation and implementation of strategies","desc":"A local authority shall, with regard to its area, in accordance with section 5 and with regulations formulate and implement a strategy for the reduction of crime and disorder, drug use and serious violence in the area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/783"},{"id":"781","label":"Crime and disorder - review of anti-social behaviour orders","desc":"A local authority must take part in a review of an anti-social behaviour order in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/781"},{"id":"775","label":"Crime and disorder - sharing of information","desc":"A relevant authority is under a duty to disclose to all other relevant authorities any information held by the authority which is of a prescribed description, at such intervals and in such form as may be prescribed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/775"},{"id":"408","label":"Crime reduction - breach of drinking banning order","desc":"A local authority may bring proceedings in respect of the breach of a drinking banning order.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/408"},{"id":"407","label":"Crime reduction - drinking banning order in county court","desc":"A local authority may make an application in the county court for a drinking banning order or to vary or discharge that order if certain conditions are met.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/407"},{"id":"406","label":"Crime reduction - drinking banning order in magistrates court","desc":"A local authority may make an application in the magistrates' court for a drinking banning order or to vary or discharge that order if certain conditions are met.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/406"},{"id":"2417","label":"Criminal Behaviour Order - review","desc":"A local authority must co-operate with the chief officer of police when reviewing a criminal behaviour order and have regard to guidance published by the Secretary of State when so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2417"},{"id":"3276","label":"Crystal glass - enforcement of regulations","desc":"A local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to the description and labelling of crystal glass.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3276"},{"id":"3116","label":"Cycle tracks - conversion of footpaths into cycle tracks","desc":"A local highway authority may, to the extent allowed by the Act, in the case of any footpath for which they are the highway authority by order made by them and either-(a) submitted to and confirmed by the Secretary of State, or(b) confirmed by them as an unopposed order,designate the footpath or any part of it as a cycle track, with the effect that, on such date as the order takes effect in accordance with the following provisions of this section, the footpath or part of the footpath to which the order relates shall become a highway which for the purposes of the 1980 Act is a highway maintainable at the public expense and over which the public have a right of way on pedal cycles (other than pedal cycles which are motor vehicles) and a right of way on foot.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3116"},{"id":"1877","label":"Damage - compensation","desc":"A local authority must pay compensation for damages caused when exercising any powers of this Act where the person sustaining the damage is not in default.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1877"},{"id":"2196","label":"Dangerous buildings - demolition and recovery of expenses","desc":"A local authority may demolish or carry out other works upon a ruinous or dangerous building or wall or anything affixed thereon if the same is not carried out by the owner and may charge the owner for that work or recover cost by selling materials.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2196"},{"id":"1195","label":"Dangerous dogs - seizure, entry of premises and inspection","desc":"An authorised officer of a local authority may, with a warrant, enter premises, inspect and seize a dangerous dog and other evidence.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1195"},{"id":"1493","label":"Dangerous excavations","desc":"A local authority may deal with dangerous excavations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1493"},{"id":"1492","label":"Dangerous trees","desc":"A local authority may deal with dangerous trees.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1492"},{"id":"1481","label":"Dangerous wild animals - inspection of premises","desc":"A competent person authorised by a local authority may inspect premises for the purposes of the Act and the local authority may recover certain costs connected with the inspection.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1481"},{"id":"1480","label":"Dangerous wild animals - licensing","desc":"A local authority shall not grant a licence for the keeping of a dangerous wild animal unless certain conditions are met.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1480"},{"id":"1482","label":"Dangerous wild animals - seizure and disposal of animals without compensation","desc":"A local authority may seize and dispose of dangerous wild animals without compensation and recover costs in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1482"},{"id":"3209","label":"Data protection - appointment of data protection officer","desc":"All public bodies must appoint a data protection officer.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3209"},{"id":"785","label":"Data protection - compliance","desc":"A local authority must comply with the Data Protection Act 1998.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/785"},{"id":"3208","label":"Data protection - GDPR compliance","desc":"All public bodies must comply with the requirements of the General Data Protection Regulations and of the Data Protection Act 2018.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3208"},{"id":"4067","label":"Data Use and Access \u2013 Enforcement of Regulations","desc":"A local authority must, if ordered to do so by Regulations, enforce Regulations made under the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/4067"},{"id":"4069","label":"Delegation of planning functions","desc":"A local planning authority must comply with Regulations issued by the Secretary of State regarding the delegation of planning functions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/4069"},{"id":"1025","label":"Democracy - elections of councillors","desc":"A local authority must select one of the three statutory options for council elections.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1025"},{"id":"2174","label":"Democracy - promotion or opposition of local or personal Bills","desc":"Where a local authority, other than a parish or community council, are satisfied that it is expedient to promote, or any local authority are satisfied that it is expedient to oppose, any local or personal Bill in Parliament, the local authority may, but only in accordance with regulations, promote or oppose the Bill accordingly, and may defray any expenses incurred in relation to this action.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2174"},{"id":"1026","label":"Democracy - schemes and orders for elections","desc":"A local authority must comply with any prescribed scheme for elections or other order.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1026"},{"id":"1702","label":"Derelict land - Planting of trees and treatment","desc":"A local authority may carry out works to improve land including derelict land including the planting of trees and may compulsorily acquire derelict land for that purpose.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1702"},{"id":"2489","label":"Detained young persons \u2013 Keeping an EHC plan","desc":"Where an authority was maintaining an EHC plan immediately before the beginning of his or her detention or where the home authority has secured the preparation of an EHC plan the home authority must keep the EHC plan while a person is detained in relevant youth accommodation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2489"},{"id":"2487","label":"Detained young persons \u2013 post detention education, health and care needs","desc":"In certain circumstances a local authority must carry out an assessment of a detained persons post detention education, health and care needs.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2487"},{"id":"2488","label":"Detained young persons \u2013 securing EHC Plan","desc":"In certain circumstances a local authority must secure an EHC plan for a detained young person.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2488"},{"id":"2490","label":"Detained young persons \u2013 supply and charge for goods and services","desc":"A local authority may provide goods and services to a person or body providing a service to a detained young person under section 74 and may charge for the same.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2490"},{"id":"721","label":"Development control - response to consultation","desc":"A local authority must respond to consultation in accordance with regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/721"},{"id":"1587","label":"Development of land","desc":"A local authority may for the benefit of its area develop land including powers to construct, repair and maintain.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1587"},{"id":"2525","label":"Direct payments - determination of eligibility","desc":"The regulations identify the eligibility criteria for persons entitled to receive direct payments from local authorities in England","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2525"},{"id":"2526","label":"Direct payments - review, repayment and termination","desc":"A responsible authority must review the making of direct payments:a) at least once within the first year of the direct payments being made, b) at appropriate intervals, not exceeding twelve months, thereafterc) where they receive information that the payment has not been used as intendedAs a result of any review they may require repayment or may terminate any provision of direct payments","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2526"},{"id":"103","label":"Disability - National Autism Strategy","desc":"A local authority must comply with National Autism Strategy guidance issued by Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/103"},{"id":"3711","label":"Disabled children - short breaks","desc":"Every local authority shall provide services designed to assist individuals who provide care for such children to continue to do so, or to do so more effectively, by giving them breaks from caring.The authority should:give families the choice to access short breaks services using a direct payment;\u2022 publish a statement of their short breaks services on their website;\u2022 keep their short breaks statement under review;","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3711"},{"id":"979","label":"Disabled facilities grant - approved purposes","desc":"A local authority must only consider an application for a disabled facilities grant for approved purposes.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/979"},{"id":"978","label":"Disabled facilities grant - occupier's certificate","desc":"A local authority must only consider an application for a grant if by an occupier applicant if it is accompanied by an occupier's certificate.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/978"},{"id":"982","label":"Disabled facilities grant - owner's and tenant's applications","desc":"A local authority must only consider an application for a grant if certain conditions, as detailed in the legislation, are met.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/982"},{"id":"983","label":"Disabled facilities grant - owner's certificate","desc":"A local authority must only consider an application for a grant if by an owner applicant if it is accompanied by an owner's certificate.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/983"},{"id":"977","label":"Disabled facilities grant - tenant's certificate","desc":"A local authority must only consider an application for a grant if by a tenant applicant if it is accompanied by a tenant's certificate.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/977"},{"id":"2166","label":"Disabled people - consultation on accommodation for infirm or disabled people","desc":"A local authority shall from time to time consult together with respect to the nature and extent of the accommodation needed for people who by reason of infirmity or disability (whether arising from age or otherwise) are in need of accommodation of a special character","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2166"},{"id":"2068","label":"Disabled persons - access to and facilities at public buildings","desc":"A local authority must provide parking and sanitary facilities suitable for persons with a disability in buildings to which the public has access, including maintained schools and offices.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2068"},{"id":"1951","label":"Disabled persons - assessment by local authorities of needs of disabled persons","desc":"If it falls to a local authority to decide whether the needs of a disabled person call for the provision by the authority of any statutory services for that person, the authority shall afford an opportunity to the disabled person or his authorised representative to make, within such reasonable period as the authority may allow for the purpose, representations","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1951"},{"id":"2071","label":"Disabled persons - badges for display on motor vehicles","desc":"A local authority must issue motor vehicle badges in the prescribed form for motor vehicles driven by, or used for the carriage of, disabled persons, maintain a register of such badges and withdraw them in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2071"},{"id":"2070","label":"Disabled persons - co-option to local authority committees","desc":"A local authority when appointing a committee of the authority under any enactment, and the members of the committee include or may include persons who are not members of the authority, then in considering the appointment to the committee of such persons regard shall be had, if the committee is concerned with matters in which the chronically sick or disabled have special needs, to the desirability of appointing to the committee persons with experience of work among and of the needs of the chronically sick and disabled, and to the person or persons with that experience being or including a chronically sick or disabled person or persons.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2070"},{"id":"2922","label":"Disabled persons - consultation before co-opting representative to committee","desc":"Where any enactment provides for the appointment or co-option to any council, committee or body of one or more persons with special knowledge of the needs of disabled persons, such appointment or co-option shall only be made after consultation with such organisation or organisations of disabled people as may be appropriate in each case.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2922"},{"id":"1953","label":"Disabled persons - disabled persons leaving special education","desc":"Where a local authority have made a SEN statement in respect of a child and the statement is still maintained by the authority when they review the statement the authority shall at that time require the appropriate officer to give to the authority his opinion as to whether the child is or is not a disabled person.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1953"},{"id":"1956","label":"Disabled persons - duty of local authority to take into account abilities of carer","desc":"Where a disabled person is living at home and receiving a substantial amount of care on a regular basis from another person (who is not a person employed to provide such care by any body in the exercise of its functions under any enactment), and it falls to a local authority to decide whether the disabled person's needs call for the provision by them of any services for him under any of the welfare enactments, the local authority shall, in deciding that question, have regard to the ability of that other person to continue to provide such care on a regular basis.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1956"},{"id":"1952","label":"Disabled persons - duty to consider needs of disabled persons","desc":"When requested to do so by\u2014(a) a disabled person,(b) his authorised representative, or(c) any person who provides care for him in the circumstances mentioned in section 8,a local authority shall decide whether the needs of the disabled person call for the provision by the authority of any services in accordance with section 2(1) or (4) of the 1970 Act (provision of welfare services).In the case of a local authority in England this section applies only if the disabled person is aged under 18.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1952"},{"id":"2065","label":"Disabled persons - information as to need for and existence of welfare services","desc":"A local authority must appraise the need for certain welfare service, make sure that information regarding those services is generally available and is specifically provided to those in need where relevant.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2065"},{"id":"1955","label":"Disabled persons - persons discharged from hospital","desc":"Where a local authority receive a notification given with respect to a person that a person is to be discharged from a hospital after having received medical treatment for mental disorder as an in-patient for a continuous period of not less than 6 months, the authority shall make arrangements for an assessment of the needs of that person with respect to the provision of any services under any of the welfare enactments.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1955"},{"id":"2067","label":"Disabled persons - provision of housing services","desc":"A local authority must consider the needs of disabled persons when considering the housing need for their area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2067"},{"id":"2066","label":"Disabled persons - provision of welfare services","desc":"A local authority must provide certain welfare services, such as adaptations in the home, to certain individuals.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2066"},{"id":"2069","label":"Disabled persons - public conveniences","desc":"A local authority in the provision of a public sanitary convenience must ensure that it caters, in so far as it is in the circumstances both practicable and reasonable, for the needs of disabled persons.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2069"},{"id":"1954","label":"Disabled persons - review of expected leaving dates from full - time education of disabled persons","desc":"The authority shall keep under review the date when any disabled student is expected to cease to receive relevant full-time education.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1954"},{"id":"1950","label":"Disabled persons - rights of authorised representatives of disabled persons","desc":"A local authority shall permit the authorised representative of a disabled person, if so requested by the disabled person to act as their representative in connection with the provision by the authority of any services in the exercise of any of their functions under the welfare enactments, or to accompany the disabled person (otherwise than as his representative) to any meeting or interview held by or on behalf of the authority in connection with the provision by them of any such services.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1950"},{"id":"1668","label":"Disabled persons - sheltered employment","desc":"A local authority may provide employment and training opportunities designed to meet the needs of registered disabled person.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1668"},{"id":"2921","label":"Disabled persons - taking into account ability of carer","desc":"Where a disabled person is living at home and receiving a substantial amount of care on a regular basis from another person (who is not a person employed to provide such care by any body in the exercise of its functions under any enactment), and it falls to a local authority in Wales or Scotland to decide whether the disabled person's needs call for the provision by them of any services for him under any of the welfare enactments, the local authority shall, in deciding that question, have regard to the ability of that other person to continue to provide such care on a regular basis.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2921"},{"id":"2928","label":"Disabled persons - transition for children to adult care and support","desc":"A local authority must carry out a needs assessment under the care act for children reaching the age of 18 to whom this act applies and for whom they are responsible under the this Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2928"},{"id":"3190","label":"Disclosure of information - for research purposes","desc":"A local authority may disclose information for research purposes in certain circumstances and must have regard to any Code of Practice when so doing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3190"},{"id":"3242","label":"Disclosure of information - relating to public sector debt","desc":"A local authority may disclose information held by the person in connection with any of the person's functions to another specified person for the purposes of the taking of action in connection with debt owed to a public authority or to the Crown. The local authority must comply with certain restrictions, any Regulations and any Code of Practice when so doing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3242"},{"id":"3241","label":"Disclosure of information - to gas and electricity suppliers","desc":"A local authority may disclose information to gas and electricity suppliers to improve public service delivery in certain circumstances and must have regard to regulations and any code of practice when so doing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3241"},{"id":"3243","label":"Disclosure of information - to Statistics and Registration Service","desc":"A local authority must disclose certain information to the Statistics and Information Service in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3243"},{"id":"2100","label":"Disposal of waste - use and charging for facilities","desc":"A local authority may permit another person to use facilities provided by the authority in pursuance of the preceding provisions of this section and may provide for the use of another person any such facilities as the authority has power to provide in pursuance of those provisions and may charge in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2100"},{"id":"1750","label":"Disused burial grounds - transfer to local authority","desc":"A local authority may accept that certain disused burial grounds be transferred into its possession.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1750"},{"id":"1600","label":"Disused tips - compensation for damage and disturbance during remedial operations","desc":"A local authority must pay compensation for damage and disturbance arising from remedial operations and works of reinstatement in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1600"},{"id":"1599","label":"Disused tips - contribution notice for remedial operations","desc":"A local authority may, in certain circumstances, apply to the court for a contribution order in respect of the expense involved in remedial operations and works of reinstatement.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1599"},{"id":"1603","label":"Disused tips - criminal proceedings in relation to remedial works","desc":"A local authority may bring criminal proceedings for offences under Part II of the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1603"},{"id":"1596","label":"Disused tips - direction for remedial operations","desc":"A local authority may by notice in the prescribed form require the owner of a disused tip to carry out remedial operations or cancel such a notice.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1596"},{"id":"1602","label":"Disused tips - grants towards expenditure for remedial works","desc":"A local authority must comply with the conditions of any grants made by the Secretary of State","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1602"},{"id":"1594","label":"Disused tips - information","desc":"A local authority may require information necessary to assess the stability of a disused tip and whether it presents a danger to public safety.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1594"},{"id":"1601","label":"Disused tips - recovery of expenses for remedial works","desc":"A local authority may recover its expenses connected to remedial works in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1601"},{"id":"1597","label":"Disused tips - remedial operations and works of reinstatement","desc":"A local authority may carry out remedial operations and works of reinstatement in certain circumstances and may sell materials in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1597"},{"id":"1598","label":"Disused tips - right of entry for remedial operations and reinstatement","desc":"A local authority may, in certain circumstances, enter land to carry out remedial operations and works of reinstatement.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1598"},{"id":"1595","label":"Disused tips - right to enter land etc.","desc":"A person duly authorised by a local authority may enter land to perform inspections and investigations and to carry out exploratory tests.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1595"},{"id":"220","label":"Dog control orders - designation","desc":"A local authority may make an order providing for an offence or offences relating to the control of dogs in respect of any land in its area. an offence relates to the control of dogs if it relates to one of the following matters: (a)fouling of land by dogs and the removal of dog faeces; (b)the keeping of dogs on leads; (c)the exclusion of dogs from land; (d)the number of dogs which a person may take on to any land.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/220"},{"id":"221","label":"Dog control orders - fixed penalty notice","desc":"An authorised officer of a local authority may issue a Fixed Penalty Notice in the prescribed form relating to the breach of a dog control order.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/221"},{"id":"222","label":"Dog control orders - request for personal details","desc":"An authorised officer of a local authority may require an individual to whom he wishes to issue a Fixed Penalty Notice to provide him with his name and address.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/222"},{"id":"3798","label":"Domestic abuse - annual reports","desc":"As soon as reasonably practicable after the end of each financial year, a relevant local authority in England must submit to the Secretary of State an annual report in relation to the exercise of the authority's functions under this Part during the year. In accordance with the requirements of the section and any Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3798"},{"id":"3792","label":"Domestic abuse - co-operation with Domestic Abuse Commissioner","desc":"A public authority must co-operate with the Domestic Abuse Commissioner when requested.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3792"},{"id":"3800","label":"Domestic abuse - disclosure of information","desc":"A local authority may disclose certain information, in certain circumstances, when assisting the Domestic Abuse Commissioner.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3800"},{"id":"3801","label":"Domestic abuse - domestic homicide review report","desc":"A local authority that establishes a domestic homicide review must send a copy of any report setting out the conclusions of the review to the Domestic Abuse Commissioner.The copy must be sent as soon as reasonably practicable after the report is completed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3801"},{"id":"3797","label":"Domestic abuse - local partnership board","desc":"A local authority must appoint a domestic abuse local partnership board for the purposes of providing advice to the authority about\u2014(a) the exercise of the authority's functions under section 57, and(b) the provision of other local authority support in the authority's area.This must be done in accordance with the requirements of that section.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3797"},{"id":"3796","label":"Domestic abuse -
