monitoring of strategy","desc":"A local authority must monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of the strategy for supporting victims of domestic abuse in its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3796"},{"id":"3799","label":"Domestic abuse - regard to guidance from Secretary of State","desc":"A local authority must have regard to the Guidance of the Secretary of State when exercising its functions under this Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3799"},{"id":"3793","label":"Domestic abuse - response to Commissioner's recommendations","desc":"A local authority must respond to the Domestic Abuse Commissioner recommendations in the manner specified and within the timeframe specified by section 16.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3793"},{"id":"3795","label":"Domestic abuse - strategy for victim support","desc":"A local authority must prepare and publish a strategy for the provision of support for victims of domestic abuse in its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3795"},{"id":"3794","label":"Domestic abuse - support for victims","desc":"A local authority must assess, or make arrangements for the assessment of, the need for accommodation-based support in its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3794"},{"id":"3207","label":"Door to door collections licence","desc":"A local authority must issue a door to door collections licence, in accordance with the requirements of the Act, if the requirements of the Act are satisfied.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3207"},{"id":"3199","label":"Dry cleaning - regulation","desc":"A local authority must regulate dry cleaning activities in accordance with regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3199"},{"id":"3719","label":"Early years - assessment arrangements","desc":"An English local authority must make provision to ensure the accuracy and consistency of foundation profile assessments made by early years providers in their area.An authority must have regard to any guidance given by the Qualifications and Curriculum Authority in exercising their function with regard to foundation profile assessments.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3719"},{"id":"3739","label":"Early years - foundation stage profile data","desc":"Local authorities must supply information about individual children receiving early years provision in their area to the Secretary of State when requested to do so. Authorities must ensure that schools have a secure electronic system to submit EYFS profile data and that all other EYFS providers have an appropriate means for accuratelyrecording profile results, and submitting data to their LA if requested.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3739"},{"id":"3675","label":"Early years - learning and development requirements","desc":"Early years providers must have regard to the relevant provisions of the \"Statutory Framework for the Early Years Foundation Stage\" published by the Secretary of State in securing that the early years provision they provide meets the learning and development requirements.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3675"},{"id":"3676","label":"Early years - welfare requirements","desc":"A local authority must comply with obligatory requirements in relation to welfare in securing early years provision","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3676"},{"id":"2826","label":"Early years provision - information about young children","desc":"The regulations identify when a local authority will have the responsibility of the duties of a prescribed person pursuant to the Childcare Act 2006.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2826"},{"id":"794","label":"Education - education for persons aged 19 and over","desc":"A local authority may secure education and training provision for persons aged 19 or over.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/794"},{"id":"522","label":"Education - academic and vocational qualifications","desc":"A local authority may award or authenticate academic or vocational qualifications.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/522"},{"id":"3758","label":"Education - accessibility of schools","desc":"A local authority in England and Wales must, in relation to schools for which it is the responsible body, prepare and implement an accessibility strategy, an accessibility plan and further such strategies and plans at such times as may be prescribed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3758"},{"id":"498","label":"Education - accounts of maintained schools","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must prepare, keep and distribute accounts as required by regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/498"},{"id":"1002","label":"Education - action plans in response to inspection","desc":"A local authority and the governing bodies of the schools which it maintains must complete, publish and distribute an action plan in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1002"},{"id":"1099","label":"Education - additional governors in schools causing concern","desc":"A local authority may appoint additional governors in a school causing concern in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1099"},{"id":"1138","label":"Education - admissions appeal arrangements","desc":"A local authority shall make arrangements for admissions appeals in accordance with any relevant provisions of the appeals code.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1138"},{"id":"1136","label":"Education - admissions arrangements","desc":"A local authority must comply with the statutory scheme for admissions arrangements.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1136"},{"id":"1134","label":"Education - admissions forums","desc":"A local education authority shall in accordance with regulations establish for their area a body, to be known as an admission forum, for the purpose of advising the authority on such matters connected with the exercise of the authority's functions under this Chapter as may be prescribed, and advising the admission authorities for maintained schools in the area for which the forum is established onsuch matters connected with the determination of admission arrangements, and such other matters connected with the admission of pupils,as may be prescribed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1134"},{"id":"500","label":"Education - advisory services","desc":"A local authority must comply with a direction to obtain advisory services.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/500"},{"id":"1003","label":"Education - approved qualifications for persons under 19","desc":"A local authority and the governing bodies of the schools which it maintains must ensure only approved qualifications are utilised in schools.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1003"},{"id":"494","label":"Education - arrangements for government of new schools","desc":"A local authority must make arrangements for the constitution of a temporary governing body for a new maintained school.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/494"},{"id":"1008","label":"Education - assessments relating to learning difficulties","desc":"A local authority must carry out assessments for persons aged over 16, but under 25, who have learning difficulties and comply with guidance when so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1008"},{"id":"488","label":"Education - attendance outside school premises","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority may require pupils to attend anywhere outside of the school premises for the purposes of education or training.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/488"},{"id":"854","label":"Education - board and lodging at boarding schools","desc":"A local authority of a maintained school should charge for board and lodging provided at a boarding school in accordance with regulations.The amount of the charge should not exceed the cost to the local authority.In certain circumstances, as defined in regulations, the authority should not charge for some or all of the costs of board and lodging.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/854"},{"id":"1104","label":"Education - categories of maintained school","desc":"A local authority and the governing body of a school maintained by the local authority must ensure that a maintained school belongs to one of prescribed categories.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1104"},{"id":"1121","label":"Education - certification of statements by the Auditor General for Wales","desc":"A local authority must comply with directions for certifying financial statements by the Auditor General for Wales.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1121"},{"id":"1113","label":"Education - change of school category","desc":"A local authority or a governing body of a maintained school may change school categories.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1113"},{"id":"853","label":"Education - charges and remissions policy","desc":"A local authority or governing body of a maintained school must prepare, keep under review and publish a charges and remissions policy and may only charge in accordance with that policy, section 457 and regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/853"},{"id":"3785","label":"Education - charges at boarding academies","desc":"Where a registered pupil is provided with board and lodging at an academy, the authority must pay an amount which is determined by conditions as specified in Regulations to the proprietor of an academy in respect of board and lodging.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3785"},{"id":"2603","label":"Education - charges for early years provision","desc":"Maintained schools may charge for Early Years provision where it is not provided in pursuance of the duty imposed by section 7 of the Childcare Act 2006 (duty to secure prescribed early years provision free of charge), the early years provision is for a pupil who is below compulsory school age, and must not otherwise be funded by the local authority in accordance with regulations made under section 47 of the School Standards and Framework Act 1998 (determination of school's budget share).","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2603"},{"id":"909","label":"Education - Chief Education Officer","desc":"A local authority must appoint a chief education officer.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/909"},{"id":"798","label":"Education - children in youth detention","desc":"A local authority must arrange education for children (aged under 19) in youth detention.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/798"},{"id":"3784","label":"Education - children not in mainstream education","desc":"Each local authority shall make arrangements for the provision of suitable education at school or otherwise than at school for those children of compulsory school age who, by reason of illness, exclusion from school or otherwise, may not for any period receive suitable education unless such arrangements are made for them.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3784"},{"id":"799","label":"Education - children not receiving education at a school","desc":"A local authority must make arrangements for the provision of suitable education at school or otherwise than at school for those children of compulsory school age who, by reason of illness, exclusion from school or otherwise, may not for any period receive suitable education.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/799"},{"id":"1148","label":"Education - children with special educational needs in nursery education","desc":"A local authority and any education provider must have regard to the code of practice on special educational needs when discharging its duties with regard to early years/nursery education.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1148"},{"id":"481","label":"Education - clerk to the governing body","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must appoint a clerk in accordance with the regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/481"},{"id":"1102","label":"Education - closure of schools causing concern","desc":"A local authority must comply with a direction from the National Assembly that a school should close.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1102"},{"id":"936","label":"Education - co-operation with careers advisors","desc":"A local authority and the governing body of a school maintained by the local authority must co-operate with providers of independent career guidance.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/936"},{"id":"1133","label":"Education - code for school admissions","desc":"A local authority and the governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must comply with the code for school admissions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1133"},{"id":"1149","label":"Education - code of practice for local authorities and maintained schools","desc":"A local authority and the governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must have regard to the code practice for local authorities and maintained schools when discharging its duties.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1149"},{"id":"2598","label":"Education - collaboration between education bodies","desc":"Local authorities and governing bodies can develop joint working arrangements under The Education (Wales) Measure 2011 and these regulations make further provision in relation to the arrangements that may be made for their functions to be discharged by joint committees.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2598"},{"id":"484","label":"Education - collaboration between schools","desc":"Where prescribed by regulations the governing bodies of two or more schools maintained by a local authority may collaborate.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/484"},{"id":"835","label":"Education - complaints management","desc":"A local education authority must consult governing bodies and make arrangements for the consideration and disposal of complaints. A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must comply with Regulations regarding the provision of information.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/835"},{"id":"487","label":"Education - complaints procedure in maintained schools","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must establish and publicise a complaints procedure.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/487"},{"id":"908","label":"Education - compulsory purchase of land","desc":"A local authority may compulsorily purchase land for educational purposes where authorised to do so by the Secretary of State.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/908"},{"id":"790","label":"Education - consideration of parental representations","desc":"A local authority must consider and respond to parental representations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/790"},{"id":"523","label":"Education - consideration of regional SEN provision","desc":"A local authority in Wales, must when directed to do so by the National Assembly, consider whether their SEN duties could be carried out more efficiently or effectively if regional provision was made.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/523"},{"id":"3755","label":"Education - consultation and guidance on provision for named individuals","desc":"Before giving notice requiring a further education institution to provide education for a named individual, a local authority must consult the governing body of the institution, and such other persons as the authority think appropriate.In deciding whether to require a particular institution to provide education to a particular individual a local authority in England must have regard to any guidance given from time to time by the Secretary of State","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3755"},{"id":"521","label":"Education - consultation with pupils","desc":"The local authority of a maintained school and its governing body in relation to the exercise of their school related functions must have regard to guidance about consultation with pupils.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/521"},{"id":"939","label":"Education - continuous service for employment on change of employer","desc":"There is a duty to recognise continuity of service for employment purposes as follows. If an employee of the governing body of a school maintained by a local authority is taken into the employment of the authority or an employee of a local authority is taken into the employment of the governing body of a school maintained by the authority his period of employment at the time of the change of employer counts as a period of employment with the second employer, and the change does not break the continuity of the period of employment.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/939"},{"id":"1114","label":"Education - control and use of school premises","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority may control and use the school premises.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1114"},{"id":"3049","label":"Education - conversion to academy","desc":"A local authority and the school\u2019s governing body must where an Academy order under section 4(A1) or (1)(b) take all reasonable steps to facilitate the conversion of the school into an Academy.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3049"},{"id":"3757","label":"Education - core entitlement over school age","desc":"A local authority in England must exercise their functions in such a way as to secure that the core entitlement, as described in regulations, is satisfied in relation to persons in their area who are over compulsory school age but under 19.In exercising their functions as required, a local authority in England must have regard to any guidance given from time to time by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3757"},{"id":"1150","label":"Education - deduction of General Teaching Council fees from salaries","desc":"A local authority and the governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must comply with regulation regarding the deduction of General Teaching Council fees from teacher's salaries.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1150"},{"id":"1118","label":"Education - delegated budget for maintained schools","desc":"A local authority must provide the schools which it maintains with a delegated budget.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1118"},{"id":"1143","label":"Education - designation of grammar schools","desc":"A local authority or the governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must comply with the legislative framework relating to the continuance and cessation of grammar schools.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1143"},{"id":"861","label":"Education - determination of disputes","desc":"A local authority or the governing body of a school maintained by them may refer a dispute with the other party to the Secretary of State.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/861"},{"id":"3765","label":"Education - determination of post-compulsory education awards","desc":"A local education authority shall determine, in respect of each financial year, whether to grant post-compulsory education awards and, if it is going to do so in that year, whether it is to do so generally, or only in the cases of eligible persons who satisfy such criteria as may be determined by the authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3765"},{"id":"1115","label":"Education - determination of school budget share in England","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations regarding the determination of a school's budget share.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1115"},{"id":"1116","label":"Education - determination of school budget share in Wales","desc":"A local authority must comply with Regulations regarding the determination of a school's budget share or with a direct or order from the National Assembly.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1116"},{"id":"910","label":"Education - direct payments for person with SEN or learning disability assessment","desc":"A local authority may make direct payments in prescribed circumstances to assist persons with SEN or a learning disability assessment.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/910"},{"id":"524","label":"Education - directed regional SEN provision","desc":"A local authority in Wales, must comply with directions from the National Assembly regarding regional provision for SEN.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/524"},{"id":"865","label":"Education - direction of appointment of members of education committees","desc":"A local authority must comply with directions from the Secretary of State in relation to the constitution of education committees.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/865"},{"id":"1111","label":"Education - direction requiring discontinuance of community or foundation special schools","desc":"A local authority must comply with a direction from the National Assembly regarding the discontinuance of community or foundation special schools.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1111"},{"id":"1139","label":"Education - direction to admit a child to a specified school","desc":"A local authority may direct the admission of a child to a school in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1139"},{"id":"1128","label":"Education - disposal of land on discontinuance of a school","desc":"A local authority must comply with provisions relating to the disposal on land on discontinuance of a school.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1128"},{"id":"1129","label":"Education - disposal or change of use of school playing fields","desc":"A local authority must obtain the appropriate consent before disposing of or changing the use of a school playing field.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1129"},{"id":"917","label":"Education - distribution of information about further education institutions","desc":"A governing body of a secondary school maintained by a local authority must comply with directions from the Secretary of State requiring the distribution of information regarding further education.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/917"},{"id":"916","label":"Education - distribution of information about schools providing secondary education","desc":"A governing body of a primary school maintained by a local authority must treat all requests from secondary schools regarding the distribution of information, equally.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/916"},{"id":"520","label":"Education - duties in relation to welfare of children","desc":"The local authority of a maintained school and its governing body must exercise its education function with a view to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, having regard to guidance when so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/520"},{"id":"838","label":"Education - early transfer to secondary education","desc":"A local authority must make arrangements to enable children to be withdrawn from primary education for the purpose of receiving secondary education in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/838"},{"id":"1147","label":"Education - early years development partnership","desc":"A local authority in Wales must develop an early years development and childcare partnership.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1147"},{"id":"2730","label":"Education - early years provision","desc":"A local authority must secure the early years provision (570 hours over at least 38 weeks) free of charge to the children and in the manner prescribed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2730"},{"id":"1097","label":"Education - education action zones or forums.","desc":"A local authority and the governing body of a school maintained by the local authority must comply with regulations regarding education action zones or forums.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1097"},{"id":"791","label":"Education - education provision for persons above compulsory school age","desc":"A local authority must secure that sufficient education and training provision is provided for young people of 6th form age and for young people aged between 19 and 24 who are subject to a learning difficulty assessment and must co-operate with each other and have regard to guidance when doing so.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/791"},{"id":"858","label":"Education - education standards grants","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations governing education standards grants.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/858"},{"id":"845","label":"Education - education supervision orders","desc":"Before instituting proceedings under sections 443 or 444 of the Act, a local authority must consider whether to apply to the court for an education supervision order.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/845"},{"id":"906","label":"Education - educational conferences","desc":"A local education authority may organise, or participate in the organisation of, conferences for the discussion of questions relating to education, and expend such sums as may be reasonable in paying, or contributing towards, any expenditure incurred in connection with conferences for the discussion of such questions, including the expenses of any person authorised by them to attend such a conference.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/906"},{"id":"931","label":"Education - educational records","desc":"A local authority and the governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must comply with regulations regarding educational records.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/931"},{"id":"905","label":"Education - educational research","desc":"A local education authority may make such provision for conducting, or assisting the conduct of, research as appears to them to be desirable for the purpose of improving the educational facilities provided for their area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/905"},{"id":"927","label":"Education - employment of children","desc":"A local authority may serve notice upon an employer requiring an employer to provide it with certain information and may serve a notice prohibiting or restricting the employer from employing children. A local authority may commence proceedings against a person who contravenes or fails to comply with such notices.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/927"},{"id":"3754","label":"Education - encouragement for persons over compulsory school age","desc":"A local authority in England must encourage participation in education and training by persons in their area who are are over compulsory school age but under 19 or are aged 19 or over but under 25 and are subject to learning difficulty assessment.A local authority must also encourage employers to participate in the provision of education and training for such persons.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3754"},{"id":"792","label":"Education - encouragement of education and training for persons over compulsory school age","desc":"A local authority must encourage participation in education by young people of 6th form age and for young people aged between 19 and 24 who are subject to a learning difficulty assessment and by employers and have regard to guidance when so doing..","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/792"},{"id":"929","label":"Education - encouragement of employers and pupils to participate in work experience","desc":"A local authority must encourage participation in work experience by employers and by those eligible under section 560A.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/929"},{"id":"829","label":"Education - entering pupils for public examinations","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must, in certain circumstances, enter pupils for public examinations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/829"},{"id":"796","label":"Education - establishment, maintenance and assistance of nursery schools","desc":"A local authority may establish, maintain and assist nursery schools.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/796"},{"id":"795","label":"Education - establishment, maintenance and assistance of primary and secondary schools","desc":"A local authority may establish, maintain and assist primary and secondary schools for children of compulsory school age.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/795"},{"id":"832","label":"Education - exemption from sex education","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must comply with a parental request that his or her child be excused from sex education.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/832"},{"id":"868","label":"Education - facilities for recreation and social and physical training for school age children","desc":"A local authority must secure that the facilities for primary and secondary education provided for their area include adequate facilities for recreation and social and physical training.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/868"},{"id":"869","label":"Education - facilities for recreation and social and physical training in further education","desc":"A local authority may provide facilities for recreation and social and physical training as part of the facilities for further education provided (whether or not by them) for their area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/869"},{"id":"866","label":"Education - facilities for recreation and training for children under 13","desc":"A local authority must secure that the facilities for primary and secondary education provided for their area include adequate facilities for recreation and social and physical training for children who have not attained the age of thirteen.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/866"},{"id":"842","label":"Education - failure to comply with school attendance order","desc":"A local authority may issue proceedings for breach of a school attendance order.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/842"},{"id":"843","label":"Education - failure to secure regular attendance at school","desc":"A local authority may issue proceedings for failing to secure regular attendance at school.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/843"},{"id":"483","label":"Education - federations of schools","desc":"Where prescribed by regulations the governing bodies of two or more schools maintained by a local authority may establish a federation.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/483"},{"id":"2600","label":"Education - financial reporting","desc":"Governing bodies of maintained schools (other than maintained nursery schools and pupil referral units) must prepare annual statements, in the prescribed format, about the school's financial position at the end of year and send to the local authority who must then send the statements to the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2600"},{"id":"1010","label":"Education - financial resources for school sixth forms","desc":"A local authority and the governing bodies of the schools which it maintains must comply with any conditions laid down by Welsh Ministers relating to the allocation of financial resources.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1010"},{"id":"1117","label":"Education - financial scheme","desc":"A local authority must prepare and maintain a financial scheme relating to the financing of schools.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1117"},{"id":"1120","label":"Education - financial statements","desc":"A local authority must prepare financial statements as required by regulations. in respect of its educational expenditure.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1120"},{"id":"476","label":"Education - formation of or investment in companies to provide services","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority may form a governing body company to deliver certain prescribed functions and services.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/476"},{"id":"3060","label":"Education - free early years budget provision","desc":"A local authority proposing to allocate an amount of relevant financial assistance to a relevant childcare provider for a funding period out of the authority's individual schools budget for the period, must comply with regulations issued by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3060"},{"id":"793","label":"Education - full-time education for 16 to 18 year olds","desc":"A local authority may secure education and training provision for young people aged 16 to 18.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/793"},{"id":"519","label":"Education - funded nursery education","desc":"The local authority in Wales must have regard to guidance from the Assembly when making arrangements under section 118 of the School Standards and Frameworks Act 1998.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/519"},{"id":"863","label":"Education - general default powers","desc":"A local authority or the governing body of a school maintained by them must comply with directions from the Secretary of State in relation to a declaration that they are in default of their duties.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/863"},{"id":"479","label":"Education - general responsibility for conduct of schools","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must conduct its school with a view to promoting high standards of educational achievement and in accordance with regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/479"},{"id":"788","label":"Education - general responsibility for education","desc":"A local authority must in so far as their powers enable them to do so contribute towards the spiritual, moral, mental and physical development of the community by securing that efficient primary education and secondary education and, in the case of a local authority in England, further education and to achieve high standards and fulfil potential.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/788"},{"id":"491","label":"Education - governers' report in Wales","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by the local authority in Wales shall, once in every school year, prepare a governing body report as required by regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/491"},{"id":"492","label":"Education - governing body reports","desc":"A local authority may require any school maintained by it to provide such reports as it requires relating to the discharge of the governing body's functions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/492"},{"id":"3050","label":"Education - guidance on academy conversion","desc":"A local authority and the school\u2019s governing body must comply with the Directions of the Secretary of State regarding a proposed conversion.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3050"},{"id":"489","label":"Education - health and safety on school premises or for activities elsewhere","desc":"A governing body of certain maintained schools must comply with a direction given by the local authority concerning the health and safety of persons on the school's premises or taking part in any school activities elsewhere.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/489"},{"id":"1144","label":"Education - home school agreements","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must adopt a home school agreement accompanied by a parental declaration.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1144"},{"id":"839","label":"Education - identifying children not receiving education","desc":"A local authority must make arrangements to identify children of compulsory school age who are not registered pupils at a school and who are not receiving suitable education otherwise than at school and have regard to guidance when so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/839"},{"id":"502","label":"Education - implementation of National Curriculum in England","desc":"A local authority and a governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must ensure that school implements the National Curriculum.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/502"},{"id":"507","label":"Education - implementation of National Curriculum in Wales","desc":"A local authority and a governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must ensure that school implement the national curriculum.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/507"},{"id":"477","label":"Education - incorporation of governing body","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must be corporate and must be incorporated in accordance with regulations and having regard to guidance.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/477"},{"id":"1096","label":"Education - infant class size","desc":"A local authority and the governing body of a school maintained by the local authority must comply with regulations regarding infant class sizes and must prepare a statement setting out the arrangements which the authority propose to make for the purpose of securing that any limit imposed is complied with.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1096"},{"id":"2530","label":"Education - information about child in alternative provision","desc":"A local authority may request such information regarding the education of children in alternative provision as is allowed for by the Regulations","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2530"},{"id":"855","label":"Education - information on school hours","desc":"A local authority or the governing body of a maintained school must comply with regulations regarding the making of information regarding school hours and other prescribed information available.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/855"},{"id":"1137","label":"Education - information regarding admissions","desc":"A local authority and a governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must publicise information about school admissions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1137"},{"id":"1106","label":"Education - information requested by school adjudicator","desc":"A local authority or a governing body of a maintained school must comply with a request by the school adjudicator for certain information.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1106"},{"id":"933","label":"Education - inspections of local education authorities","desc":"A local authority must provide the Chief Inspector with such information and such rights of entry as he requires in connection with an inspection.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/933"},{"id":"478","label":"Education - instruments of government","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must have an instrument of government which determines the constitution of the governing body and other matters relating to the school and which must accord with regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/478"},{"id":"1100","label":"Education - interim executive members for schools causing concern","desc":"A local authority may order, having taken prescribed steps that the governing body of a maintained school will consist of interim executive members.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1100"},{"id":"1098","label":"Education - intervention in schools causing concern","desc":"A local authority may intervene in a school causing concern in certain circumstances and must take certain prescribed steps before so doing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1098"},{"id":"3764","label":"Education - Key Stage 1 assessments","desc":"In any school year a local authority must carry out the functions imposed on it by regulations in relation to at least 10% of the schools it maintains at which an assessment under these regulations is being administered in that school year (\u201cmonitored schools\u201d).The authority should visit at least 10% of relevant schools and should submit information to the Department as required.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3764"},{"id":"836","label":"Education - late school admissions","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must not refuse to admit a child to a school where the late application was due to circumstances beyond the child's control.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/836"},{"id":"867","label":"Education - leisure time activities for certain under 25's","desc":"A local authority must, so far as reasonably practicable, secure for qualifying young persons in the authority's area access to sufficient educational leisure-time activities which are for the improvement of their well-being, and sufficient facilities for such activities; and sufficient recreation and leisure-time activities for the same purpose.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/867"},{"id":"1009","label":"Education - local curricula for students age 16 to 18","desc":"A local authority and the governing bodies of the schools which it maintains must ensure delivery of local curricula entitlements.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1009"},{"id":"2531","label":"Education - local curriculum for key stage 4","desc":"A local authority must form for its area one or more local curricula in accordance with section 116A of the 2002 Act and these Regulations in sufficient time before the start of a school year to enable pupils to elect to follow a course of study in accordance with regulation 8.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2531"},{"id":"512","label":"Education - local curriculum key stage 4 in Wales","desc":"A local authority must form, plan and deliver one or more local curricula for key stage 4 pupils in the prescribed manner.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/512"},{"id":"1105","label":"Education - maintenance and other funding of schools","desc":"A local authority must maintain a maintained school and defray its expenditure.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1105"},{"id":"830","label":"Education - manner of provision of sex education","desc":"The governing body and head teacher shall take such steps as are reasonably practicable to secure that where sex education is given to any registered pupils at a maintained school, it is given in such a manner as to encourage those pupils to have due regard to moral considerations and the value of family life. and must have due regard to guidance when so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/830"},{"id":"1131","label":"Education - modifications to employment legislation","desc":"A local authority and the governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must comply with modifications made to employment legislation applying during financial delegation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1131"},{"id":"1132","label":"Education - modifications to trust deeds","desc":"A local authority and the governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must comply with modifications made by order to trust deeds.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1132"},{"id":"503","label":"Education - National Curriculum exceptions by direction and regulations in England","desc":"A local authority and a governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must modify or not apply the National Curriculum where directed to do so by the Secretary of State","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/503"},{"id":"508","label":"Education - National Curriculum exceptions by direction and regulations in Wales","desc":"A local authority and a governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must modify or not apply the national curriculum where directed to do so by the Assembly.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/508"},{"id":"501","label":"Education - National Curriculum minimum requirements in England","desc":"A local authority and a governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must ensure that school meets the minimum requirements on the National Curriculum as set out in section 78 of the Act.In exercising any function which may affect the provision of sex education in maintained schools every local authority in England must have regard to relevant guidance issued by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/501"},{"id":"506","label":"Education - National Curriculum minimum requirements in Wales","desc":"A local authority and a governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must ensure that school meets the minimum requirements on the national curriculum as set out in section 99 of the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/506"},{"id":"1126","label":"Education - new schools","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations relating to new schools.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1126"},{"id":"1109","label":"Education - notice by governing body to discontinue foundation or voluntary school.","desc":"A governing body of a foundation or voluntary school wishing to discontinue the same must give notice as required by this section.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1109"},{"id":"2532","label":"Education - notification of pupil not entitled to course of study","desc":"A headteacher must comply with the Regulations when deciding not to award or to remove an entitlement of a pupil to a course of study.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2532"},{"id":"1146","label":"Education - nursery education","desc":"A local authority must secure provision for nursery education in accordance with regulations and guidance.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1146"},{"id":"1145","label":"Education - nutritional requirements for food and drink on school premises","desc":"A local authority or the governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must comply with regulations relating to nutritional standards for food and drink provided on school premises.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1145"},{"id":"482","label":"Education - parent council for foundation school","desc":"A governing body of certain foundation schools maintained by a local authority must establish a parent council in accordance with regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/482"},{"id":"1135","label":"Education - parental preferences","desc":"A local authority must make arrangements for enabling parents to express a parental preference and to provide advice or assistance in respect of the same.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1135"},{"id":"2558","label":"Education - parenting contracts","desc":"LAs/Governing Bodies applying or entering into must bear the costs associated with the requirements of parenting orders or contracts including in each case the costs of providing counselling or guidance programmes and may recover the costs from another LA or GB by agreement","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2558"},{"id":"915","label":"Education - participation in international surveys","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must comply with a request from the Secretary of State that it participates in a survey.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/915"},{"id":"526","label":"Education - partnership agreements and statements","desc":"A local authority must enter into a partnership agreement with the governing body of each school maintained by that authority, or each such school of a prescribed class when required to do so by Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/526"},{"id":"897","label":"Education - payment of fees for SEN pupils at non-maintained schools","desc":"A local authority must pay fees for SEN pupils attending institutions not maintained by a local authority in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/897"},{"id":"898","label":"Education - payment of school expenses and grants","desc":"A local authority, for the purpose of enabling persons to take advantage of any educational facilities available to them, may in such circumstances as may be specified in or determined in accordance with regulations pay such expenses of children attending community, foundation, voluntary or special schools as may be necessary to enable them to take part in any school activities and grant scholarships, exhibitions, bursaries and other allowances in respect of persons over compulsory school age.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/898"},{"id":"497","label":"Education - payments in respect of dismissal","desc":"A local authority must meet the cost of the dismissal, resignation or retirement of staff employed by the governing body in schools maintained by the same in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/497"},{"id":"844","label":"Education - penalty notice for failure to secure regular attendance at school","desc":"An authorised officer of a local authority may issue a penalty notice where it appears that a parent has committed an offence under section 444.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/844"},{"id":"851","label":"Education - permitted charges for pupils at maintained schools","desc":"A local authority or governing body of a maintained school may charge for matters allowed for by section 455.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/851"},{"id":"930","label":"Education - persons detained in youth accommodation","desc":"A local authority has certain duties arising from and restricted to the purpose of regulations in respect of persons detained in youth accommodation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/930"},{"id":"911","label":"Education - pilot schemes for direct payments","desc":"A local authority must comply with an order from the Secretary of State regarding pilot schemes for assisting persons with SEN or a learning disability assessment with direct payments.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/911"},{"id":"833","label":"Education - political indoctrination","desc":"A local education authority and a governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must forbid political indoctrination and adopt a balanced approach to political issues.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/833"},{"id":"3766","label":"Education - post-compulsory education awards","desc":"A local education authority shall have power, in any financial year in relation to which this regulation applies to them, to grant a post-compulsory education award, that is to say a scholarship, an exhibition, a bursary, or an other allowance, granted in respect of an eligible person for the purpose of enabling that person to take advantage of any educational facilities available to him.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3766"},{"id":"789","label":"Education - primary and secondary schooling","desc":"A local authority must secure sufficient primary and secondary schooling in their area for the needs of all children of compulsory school age. This includes securing that special educational provision is made for pupils who have special educational needs and the expediency of securing the provision of boarding accommodation (in boarding schools or otherwise) for pupils for whom education as boarders is considered by their parents and the authority to be desirable.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/789"},{"id":"846","label":"Education - prohibition of charges for admission to a maintained school","desc":"A local authority or governing body of a maintained school must not charge for admission to the school in relation to the provision of education to pupils of compulsory school age or for full time education for those aged over 16, but under 19.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/846"},{"id":"847","label":"Education - prohibition of charges for provision of education at a maintained school","desc":"A local authority or governing body of a maintained school must not charge for education for registered pupils unless it is allowed for by the sections 451 or 452 or by Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/847"},{"id":"850","label":"Education - prohibition of incidental charges","desc":"A local authority or governing body of a maintained school may not charge for incidental charges save where allowed for by section 454 or by regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/850"},{"id":"849","label":"Education - prohibition on charging for examination fees","desc":"A local authority or governing body of a maintained school may not charge for entering registered pupil into a prescribed public examination.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/849"},{"id":"786","label":"Education - promotion of high standards in primary and secondary education","desc":"A local authority must exercise its functions so as to promote high standards, ensure fair access to opportunity for education and training and fulfilment of potential.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/786"},{"id":"907","label":"Education - property on trust","desc":"A local authority may hold and administer property upon trust for educational purposes.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/907"},{"id":"1108","label":"Education - proposals for discontinuance of a maintained school","desc":"A local authority must publish its proposals for the discontinuance of a community, voluntary, foundation or maintained nursery school in accordance with this section.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1108"},{"id":"1107","label":"Education - proposals for establishment or alteration of a maintained school","desc":"A local authority must publish its proposals for the establishment or alteration of a community, voluntary or foundation school in accordance with this section.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1107"},{"id":"1110","label":"Education - proposals regarding community or foundation special schools","desc":"A local authority must publish its proposals for the establishment, alteration or discontinuance of community or foundation special schools in accordance with this section.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1110"},{"id":"486","label":"Education - provision and funding of higher education in maintained schools","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority may arrange the provision to pupils at the school courses in preparation for professional examinations at a higher level or providing education at a higher level. A governing body may exercise the power in relation to a particular pupil only if they are satisfied that the provision to that pupil of the course in question will not to any significant extent interfere with the other education with which he is being provided at the school.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/486"},{"id":"490","label":"Education - provision for improving behaviour","desc":"The governing body of a maintained school may require any registered pupil to attend at any place outside the school premises for the purpose of receiving educational provision which is intended to improve the behaviour of the pupil. Any such provision must comply with regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/490"},{"id":"3756","label":"Education - provision for named individuals","desc":"A local authority may by notice given to the governing body of an institution in England within the further education sector, which provides education suitable to the requirements of persons over compulsory school age but under the age of 19, require them to provide specified individuals with such education falling as is appropriate to the individuals' abilities and aptitudes or withdraw such a requirement.A local authority may specify an individual in a notice only if the individual is in the authority's area, and is over compulsory school age but under the age of 19.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3756"},{"id":"3753","label":"Education - provision for persons over compulsory school age","desc":"A local authority in England must secure that enough suitable education and training is provided to meet the reasonable needs of persons in their area who are over compulsory school age but under 19, and persons in their area who are aged 19 or over but under 25 and are subject to learning difficulty assessment.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3753"},{"id":"895","label":"Education - provision of board and lodging","desc":"A local authority may provide board and lodging for certain children and young people subject to certain conditions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/895"},{"id":"934","label":"Education - provision of careers guidance in schools","desc":"The governing body of a school maintained by the local authority, or the local authority for a pupil referral unit, must ensure that pupils are provided with independent career guidance.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/934"},{"id":"937","label":"Education - provision of careers information at schools and other institutions","desc":"A local authority and the governing body of a school maintained by the local authority must provide pupils with careers information.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/937"},{"id":"485","label":"Education - provision of community facilities","desc":"The governing body of a maintained school shall have power to provide any facilities or services whose provision furthers any charitable purpose for the benefit of pupils at the school or their families, or people who live or work in the locality in which the school is situated.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/485"},{"id":"938","label":"Education - provision of curriculum information","desc":"A local authority and the governing body of a school maintained by the local authority must provide a careers information provider with such curriculum information as it requests.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/938"},{"id":"797","label":"Education - provision of education at non-maintained schools","desc":"A local authority may arrange for primary or secondary educational provision at schools not maintained by a local authority.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/797"},{"id":"1130","label":"Education - provision of education for those aged over sixteen","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must decide whether or not to provide education to those aged 16+ but must only cease provision with the consent of the local authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1130"},{"id":"1966","label":"Education - provision of higher and further education","desc":"A local authority shall have power to secure the provision for their area of such facilities for higher education as appear to them to be appropriate for meeting the needs of the population of their area; secure the provision of higher education for persons [from other areas] and do anything which appears to them to be necessary or expedient for the purposes of or in connection with such provision.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1966"},{"id":"834","label":"Education - provision of information","desc":"A local education authority and a governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must comply with regulations regarding the provision of information.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/834"},{"id":"2906","label":"Education - provision of information on learner travel","desc":"A local authority must provide such of the information specified in Part 2 of the Schedule to these Regulations as is in its possession on request and free of charge to the persons prescribed in the regulations","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2906"},{"id":"914","label":"Education - provision of information to the Secretary of State by governing body","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must comply with a request from the Secretary of State for certain information.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/914"},{"id":"913","label":"Education - provision of teaching services for day nurseries","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority may provide teaching services to day nurseries in certain circumstances with the approval of the local authority.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/913"},{"id":"928","label":"Education - provision of work experience for people over compulsory school age","desc":"A local authority may secure the provision of work experience for people aged between 16 and 18. It may also secure work experience for people aged between 19 and 24 who are subject to a learning disability assessment.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/928"},{"id":"525","label":"Education - publication and provision of materials","desc":"A local authority or governing body of a maintained school in Wales, must publish and provide certain materials when directed to do so by the National Assembly.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/525"},{"id":"2905","label":"Education - publication of learner travel information","desc":"A local authority must publish the information specified in Part 1 of the Schedule to these Regulations in the manner prescribed and at the times prescribed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2905"},{"id":"18","label":"Education - pupil or student information","desc":"The responsible person must provide relevant information about a pupil or student who is attending an educational institution to an English local authority with an education function where that information is required for the provision of services under section 68 and 70 of the same act..","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/18"},{"id":"2722","label":"Education - pupil referral units (PRU)","desc":"Local authorities must establish management committees to run pupil referral units (PRUs) in their area, and make provision for the constitution and procedures of such committees.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2722"},{"id":"3650","label":"Education - pupil registration","desc":"The proprietor of every school shall cause to be kept an admission register and except in the case of a school of which all the pupils are boarders, an attendance register.The contents of the admissions register and the attendance register must be as specified in regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3650"},{"id":"787","label":"Education - pupils to be educated in accordance with their parents' wishes","desc":"A local authority must in performing its powers and duties must have regard to the general principle that children should be educated in accordance with their parents' wishes in so far as that is compatible with the provision of efficient instruction and training and the avoidance of unreasonable public expenditure.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/787"},{"id":"504","label":"Education - pupils with EHC plan in England","desc":"The special educational provision for any pupil specified in an EHC plan maintained for the pupil may include provision\u2014 excluding the application of the National Curriculum for England, orapplying the National Curriculum for England with such modifications as may be specified in the plan.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/504"},{"id":"509","label":"Education - pupils with statements of special educational needs in Wales","desc":"A local authority and a governing body of a school maintained by a local authority may not apply or may modify the national curriculum in statements of special educational need.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/509"},{"id":"1112","label":"Education - rationalisation of school places","desc":"A local authority and a governing body of a school maintained by it must comply with a direction from the National Assembly to bring forward proposals for the rationalisation of school places.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1112"},{"id":"859","label":"Education - recoupment for cross border provision","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations governing payments for cross border provision of education.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/859"},{"id":"860","label":"Education - recoupment for excluded pupils","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations governing recoupment for excluded pupils.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/860"},{"id":"848","label":"Education - recovery of wasted examination fees","desc":"A local authority or governing body of a maintained school may only recover wasted examination fees in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/848"},{"id":"837","label":"Education - registration of pupils","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must keep a school register in accordance with regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/837"},{"id":"1125","label":"Education - religious education and worship","desc":"A local authority and governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must secure due provision of religious education and collective worship and must ensure that all registered pupils take part in a daily act of collective worship.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1125"},{"id":"1123","label":"Education - reserve power to prevent a breakdown of discipline","desc":"A local authority may exercise its reserve power to prevent a breakdown of discipline in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1123"},{"id":"1141","label":"Education - restriction on selection by ability or aptitude","desc":"A local authority or the governing body of a school maintained by a local authority may not make arrangements for admission based upon ability and aptitude other than those prescribed by legislation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1141"},{"id":"841","label":"Education - revocation of school attendance orders","desc":"A local authority must revoke a school attendance order at the request of the parent in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/841"},{"id":"1140","label":"Education - school admissions for looked after children","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations regarding the admission of looked after children to schools.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1140"},{"id":"840","label":"Education - school attendance orders","desc":"A local authority must issue and serve a school attendance order in certain circumstances in accordance with the prescribed procedure including amendments to SEN statements where necessary.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/840"},{"id":"1124","label":"Education - school attendance targets.","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must comply with regulations regarding school attendance targets.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1124"},{"id":"3790","label":"Education - school day and school year","desc":"Amends Regulations 3 and 4 of the Education (School Day and School Year) (England) Regulations 1999/3181 so as to reduce the number of school sessions that need to be held in school year 2021/2022 and changes the way what counts as a qualifying session in that school year.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3790"},{"id":"2723","label":"Education - school development plans","desc":"Governing bodies must draw up a school development plan in order to assist it to exercise its responsibility for conducting a maintained school with a view to promoting high standards of educational achievement with the prescribed contents and revise it annually and following an inspection by HMI for Education and Training in Wales.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2723"},{"id":"932","label":"Education - school performance targets","desc":"A governing body of a maintained school in Wales must comply with regulations made by Welsh Ministers regarding performance targets.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/932"},{"id":"2555","label":"Education - schools budget","desc":"LAs must make an initial determination of the schools budget before 14 February preceding a funding period and notify schools' governing bodies of the amount of their budget shares and how the budget share was calculated together with estimates of the budget shares for the following two funding periods. It must determine a formula for budget shares and consult on any changes made. Various factors and criteria must be taken into account in determining budget shares and which must be dealt with in schemes","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2555"},{"id":"3752","label":"Education - securing of work experience placements","desc":"A local authority must encourage participation in work experience by persons in their area who over compulsory school age but under 19 or who are aged 19 or over but under 25 and are subject to learning difficulty assessment.An authority must also encourage employers to participate in the provision of work experience for such persons","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3752"},{"id":"2753","label":"Education - SEN personal budgets","desc":"Local authorities must make arrangements to ensure information, advice and support is available in relation to personal budgets for children and young people with SEN for whom there is an EHC plan. They must consider prescribed criteria and procedures when considering whether to make; reduce; stop or request repayment of a direct payment; provide the written reasons for its decision with a right to a review.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2753"},{"id":"2752","label":"Education - SEN regulations","desc":"Local authorities must have regard to prescribed procedures and Regulations which supplement the procedural framework for assessing a child or young person with special educational needs, and the procedure for making, reviewing, amending and ceasing to maintain an EHC plan, set out in Part 3 of the Children and Families Act 2014.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2752"},{"id":"831","label":"Education - sex education statements of policy","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must make, keep up to date and provide free of charge a statement of policy on sex education.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/831"},{"id":"1122","label":"Education - staff in schools with or without religious character","desc":"A local authority and the governing body of a school maintained by it, must comply with regulations with regard to the appointment and dismissal of teachers at schools with or without a religious character.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1122"},{"id":"495","label":"Education - staffing of community, voluntary controlled, community special, maintained nursery schools","desc":"A local authority must be the employer in community, voluntary controlled, community special and maintained nursery schools and has certain powers and duties accordingly.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/495"},{"id":"496","label":"Education - staffing of foundation, voluntary aided and foundation special schools","desc":"A governing body of a school maintained by the local authority must be the employer in voluntary aided and foundation and foundation special schools and has certain powers and duties accordingly.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/496"},{"id":"2588","label":"Education - students age 16 to 18","desc":"Local authorities/schools must make the determination of the pupil's relevant school or institution under section 33D(1) of the 2000 Act within 5 working days following receipt of the pupil's request The school/local authority must follow a prescribed procedure when determining, reviewing or determining whether the student is entitled to follow or continue with a course of study.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2588"},{"id":"518","label":"Education - supply of information following teacher dismissal","desc":"The local authority of a maintained school must where appropriate supply the Secretary State with prescribed information in a situation where a teacher's employment terminates in circumstances where there is (alleged) gross misconduct.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/518"},{"id":"1151","label":"Education - supply of information to General Teaching Council","desc":"A local authority and the governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must comply with regulation requiring them to supply information to the GTC for Wales in circumstances relating to dismissals or resignations relating to misconduct or incompetence.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1151"},{"id":"1119","label":"Education - suspension of delegated budget for financial mismanagement","desc":"A local authority may suspend a delegated budget of a maintained school for financial mismanagement.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1119"},{"id":"1101","label":"Education - suspension of right to a delegated budget for schools causing concern","desc":"A local authority may, having taken prescribed steps, suspend the right of the governing body of a maintained school to a delegated budget.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1101"},{"id":"475","label":"Education - suspension of statutory requirements","desc":"A local authority may apply to the Secretary of State or National Assembly to have certain statutory requirements suspended or altered. The application must be in the prescribed form and the application process is subject to prescribed steps.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/475"},{"id":"516","label":"Education - teacher appraisal","desc":"The local authority of a maintained school and its governing body must comply with regulations regarding teacher appraisals.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/516"},{"id":"517","label":"Education - teacher health and fitness","desc":"The local authority of a maintained school and its governing body must comply with regulations regarding teacher health and fitness for certain activities.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/517"},{"id":"513","label":"Education - teachers pay and conditions","desc":"A local authority and governing body of a maintained school must ensure that maintained schools comply with an Order and any guidance made regarding teachers pay and conditions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/513"},{"id":"514","label":"Education - teachers pay and conditions in education action zones","desc":"A governing body of a maintained school may where there is an education action zone in force apply to the Secretary of State for an order giving it control over teachers pay and conditions. The local education authority shall do anything necessary to give effect to the governing body's determination.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/514"},{"id":"896","label":"Education - teaching services for day nurseries","desc":"Subject to the concurrence of the governing body of the school, a local education authority may, in accordance with arrangements made by them for that purpose, make available to a day nursery the services of any teacher who is employed by them in a nursery school or in a primary school having one or more nursery classes, and has agreed to provide his services for the purposes of the arrangements.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/896"},{"id":"505","label":"Education - temporary exceptions to National Curriculum for individual pupils in England","desc":"A head teacher of a school maintained by a local authority may, where prescribed, not apply or may modify the national curriculum in relation to an individual pupil.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/505"},{"id":"510","label":"Education - temporary exceptions to National Curriculum for individual pupils in Wales","desc":"A head teacher of a school maintained by a local authority may, where prescribed, not apply or may modify the National Curriculum in statements of special educational need in relation to an individual pupil.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/510"},{"id":"493","label":"Education - term and holiday dates","desc":"A local authority or the governing body, depending on the type of maintained school, must set the start and end dates of school terms and comply with regulations when so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/493"},{"id":"480","label":"Education - training and support of governors","desc":"The local education authority shall (to the extent that they are not otherwise required to secure the provision of such information) secure that every governor is provided, free of charge, with such information as they consider appropriate in connection with the discharge of his functions as governor, and secure that there is made available to every governor, free of charge, such training as they consider necessary for the effective discharge of those functions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/480"},{"id":"1127","label":"Education - transfer of staff and land","desc":"A local authority must comply with staff and land transfer provision in respect of schools which become community, foundation, voluntary or community special schools.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1127"},{"id":"527","label":"Education - transition plans","desc":"A governing body of a maintained school must co-operate with other governing bodies to draw up transition plans from primary to secondary school and comply with guidance.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/527"},{"id":"862","label":"Education - unreasonable exercise of functions","desc":"A local authority or the governing body of a school maintained by them must comply with directions from the Secretary of State in relation to an unreasonable exercise of their functions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/862"},{"id":"856","label":"Education - voluntary contributions for the benefit of the school","desc":"A local authority or the governing body of a maintained school may request or receive voluntary contributions for the benefit of the school or any school activities that accord with section 460.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/856"},{"id":"1103","label":"Education - warning notice for schools causing concern","desc":"A local authority must comply with a direction from the Welsh Ministers to issue a Teachers' pay and conditions warning notice.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1103"},{"id":"14","label":"Education and children's social work - expenditure","desc":"A local authority must comply with a request of Secretary of State for information about planned and actual expenditure on education or children's social services functions","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/14"},{"id":"20","label":"Education and training -
