provision for 14 - 19 year olds","desc":"A local authority must incorporate arrangements as to education and training suitable to the requirements of persons during the period beginning with the start of the academic year in which they attain the age of 15 and ending when they attain the age of 19 into co-operation arrangements under section 10 of the Children Act 2004.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/20"},{"id":"13","label":"Education and training - sharing of information","desc":"Any person authorised by the relevant legislation may provide information to a person or organisation identified in the legislation for the purpose of enabling or facilitating any relevant function related to education and training.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/13"},{"id":"15","label":"Education and training - supplementary powers for provision of services","desc":"A local authority may co-operate with another local authority in delivering its section 68 duty under the same act and may provide, secure the provision of or participate in the provision of services for encouraging, enabling or assisting the effective participation in education or training of\u2014(i)young persons, or(ii)relevant young adults,(including such persons from other areas) otherwise than in accordance with section 68.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/15"},{"id":"16","label":"Education and training - young people and young adults","desc":"A local authority must make available to young persons and relevant young adults such services as it considers appropriate to encourage, enable or assist the effective participation of those persons in education or training.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/16"},{"id":"3475","label":"Education establishment and registered childcare providers - complying with temporary continuity direction","desc":"A local authority must comply with a temporary continuity direction given by the Secretary of State (England) or by Welsh Ministers (Wales) relating to education, training or childcare and ancillary services of facilities.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3475"},{"id":"3476","label":"Education establishment and registered childcare providers - disapplying or modifying enactments","desc":"A local authority must comply with Notices given by the Secretary of State (England) or by Welsh Ministers (Wales) disapplying or modifying enactments relating to such facilities. The enactments that can be disapplied of modified are defined by the Schedule 16, but this list is subject to amendment by the Secretary of State or Welsh Ministers by passing of Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3476"},{"id":"3478","label":"Education establishment and registered childcare providers - issuing of temporary continuity direction","desc":"A local authority if and to the extent that powers are delegated to it, by the Secretary of State or by Welsh Ministers, may issue temporary continuity directions relating to education, training or childcare and ancillary services of facilities.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3478"},{"id":"3477","label":"Education establishment and registered childcare providers - publication of temporary continuity direction","desc":"Where a local authority has been authorised to issue temporary continuity directions the authority must publish such directions and must give a copy of the directions to the person responsible for the facility to which the direction applies. The published version of the direction should not identify any individual without their permission.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3477"},{"id":"3474","label":"Education establishments and childcare providers temporary closure - direction","desc":"The local authority must comply with any temporary closure direction that requires the responsible body of any educational institution or registered childcare provider to which the direction applies to take reasonable steps to secure that persons do not, for a specified period, attend premises of the institution.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3474"},{"id":"151","label":"Elections - alteration to years of ordinary elections of parish councillors","desc":"A district council may pass a resolution to alter the years in which parish councillors are elected.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/151"},{"id":"2354","label":"Elections - appointment of registration officer","desc":"In England the council of every district and London borough shall appoint an officer of the council to be registration officer for any constituency or part of a constituency conterminous with or situated in the district or borough, in relation to any constituency part of which consists of some or all of the area of the City and the Inner and Middle Temples, the Common Council shall appoint an officer to be registration officer for that part of the constituency and in Wales, the council of every county or county borough shall appoint an officer of the council to be registration officer for any constituency or part of a constituency coterminous with or situated in the area of the council.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2354"},{"id":"2962","label":"Elections - appointment of returning officer","desc":"In England every non-metropolitan county council shall appoint an officer of the council to be the returning officer for elections of councillors of the county and every district council shall appoint an officer of the council to be the returning officer for the elections of councillors of the district and an officer of the council to be the returning officer for elections of councillors of parishes within the district. In Wales the council of every county or county borough shall appoint\u2014an officer of the council to be the returning officer for elections of councillors of the county or county borough; andan officer of the council to be the returning officer for elections of councillors of communities within the county or county borough.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2962"},{"id":"2960","label":"Elections - assistance to returning officer","desc":"A local authority may appoint officers to assist the returning officer.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2960"},{"id":"152","label":"Elections - change of name of electoral area","desc":"A local authority may pass a resolution to change the name of an electoral area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/152"},{"id":"2355","label":"Elections - discharge of registration duties","desc":"It shall be the duty in England, of a district council or London borough council and in Wales, of a county or county borough council to assign such officers to assist the registration officer as may be required for carrying out his functions under this Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2355"},{"id":"149","label":"Elections - notice to Electoral Commission on passing resolution for election by halves or thirds","desc":"A district council adopting a scheme for elections by halves or by thirds must inform the Local Government Boundary Commission for England that it has passed that resolution.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/149"},{"id":"145","label":"Elections - notice to Electoral Commission on passing resolution for whole council elections","desc":"A district council passing a resolution for whole council elections must give notice of that resolution to the Local Government Boundary Commission for England.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/145"},{"id":"153","label":"Elections - notification of change of name of electoral area","desc":"A local authority must obtain the approval of the Electoral Commission before changing the names of certain electoral areas and must inform the Electoral Commision, the Boundary Commission for England, Office of National Statistics and the Director General of the Ordnance Survey once the resolution has been passed. In a two tier area a county must inform the district or a district inform the county within whose area the electoral area lies.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/153"},{"id":"150","label":"Elections - order by Electoral Commission for election by halves or thirds","desc":"A council must produce an explanatory document and make the document available for inspection as soon as practicable after the Electoral Commission have made an order for elections by halves or for elections by thirds in relation to it.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/150"},{"id":"2961","label":"Elections - polling districts and stations","desc":"For elections of county councillors in England, the county council may divide an electoral division into polling districts, and may alter any polling district, and for elections of London borough or district councillors the London borough or district council may divide the London borough or district or any ward thereof into polling districts, and may alter any polling district.For elections of county or county borough councillors in Wales, the county or county borough council may divide an electoral division into polling districts and may alter any polling district.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2961"},{"id":"148","label":"Elections - publicity of explanatory document for elections by halves or thirds","desc":"A district council adopting a scheme for elections by halves or by thirds must, produce make available and publicise an explanatory document.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/148"},{"id":"144","label":"Elections - publicity of explanatory document for whole council elections","desc":"A district council adopting a scheme for whole council elections must, produce and publicise an explanatory document.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/144"},{"id":"2958","label":"Elections - register of electors - compilation and maintenance","desc":"A Registration Officer shall compile, canvass for and maintain a register of electors for both national and local elections.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2958"},{"id":"2959","label":"Elections - register of electors - publication","desc":"A Registration Officer shall publish a revised version of the Register of Electors in certain circumstances and make certain alterations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2959"},{"id":"2692","label":"Elections - register of proxies","desc":"A registration officer may require another registration officer to provide information as soon as reasonably practicable about whether a proxy has an entry in a relevant register.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2692"},{"id":"146","label":"Elections - resolution for elections by halves","desc":"A non-metropolitan district council that was formerly subject to a scheme for elections by halves, but is for the time being subject to a scheme for whole-council elections, may resolve that it is to revert to being subject to a scheme for elections by halves. The council must comply with requirements when passing a resolution for elections by halves.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/146"},{"id":"147","label":"Elections - resolution for elections by thirds","desc":"A district council that was formerly subject to a scheme for elections by thirds, but is for the time being subject to a scheme for whole-council elections,may resolve that it is to revert to being subject to a scheme for elections by thirds. A council must comply with requirements in passing a resolution for elections by thirds.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/147"},{"id":"143","label":"Elections - resolution for whole-council elections","desc":"A district council that is subject to a scheme for elections by halves or by thirds may resolve that it is to be subject instead to the scheme for whole-council elections. A council must comply with requirements in passing a resolution for whole-council elections.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/143"},{"id":"81","label":"Electoral areas - provision of information to Boundary Commission","desc":"A local authority must comply with a request for information from the Local Government Boundary Commission for England in connection with its functions under the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/81"},{"id":"83","label":"Electoral areas - request for Boundary Commission review.","desc":"A local authority may request the Local Government Boundary Commission for England to conduct a review of the Council's area and make recommendations as to single member electoral areas.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/83"},{"id":"2747","label":"Electoral register - supply of information","desc":"Local authorities (electoral registration officers) must supply national and local political parties, for a limited period, with information as to whether entries on an electoral register were either made following an application under the system of individual electoral registration or were included as a result of the entry having been confirmed in accordance with the transitional arrangements for the new system. The information may only be used for the purposes of electoral registration (or of civil or criminal proceedings) and may not be used after 7th May 2015.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2747"},{"id":"3293","label":"Electrical equipment safety - enforcement","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance and enforce Regulations relating to electrical equipment for domestic use .","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3293"},{"id":"204","label":"Emergencies - advice and assistance to the public","desc":"A local authority shall provide advice and assistance to the public in connection with the making of arrangements for the continuance of commercial activities by the public, or the continuance of the activities of bodies other than public or local authorities whose activities are not carried on for profit, in the event of an emergency. and must comply with regulations and have regard to guidance when so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/204"},{"id":"203","label":"Emergencies - assess, plan and advise","desc":"A local authority must assess risk in respect of emergencies, prepare and maintain plans as prescribed and in so doing comply with Regulations and have regard to guidance.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/203"},{"id":"205","label":"Emergencies - charging for advice and assistance","desc":"A local authority may charge for advice and assistance in relation to the giving of information to the public regarding the continuation of certain activities during an emergency as allowed for by regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/205"},{"id":"206","label":"Emergencies - consultation, co-operation and delegation","desc":"A Minister of the Crown may by order require an authority to perform a function in connection with an emergency. The order may require the authority to consult, collaborate, delegate, co-operate or provide information to another person or body.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/206"},{"id":"207","label":"Emergencies - disclosure of information","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations regarding disclosure of information in connection with a function of the provider or of the recipient which relates to emergencies.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/207"},{"id":"209","label":"Emergencies - enforcement action","desc":"A local authority may take enforcement action in respect of the failure by another responsible authority to comply with the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/209"},{"id":"208","label":"Emergencies - provision of information to Government","desc":"A local authority must comply with a request from a Minister of the Crown for information about action taken in relation to any emergency.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/208"},{"id":"2155","label":"Emergencies or disasters - expenditure","desc":"A local authority may incur expense or make grants or loans to certain bodies in certain circumstances in situations where there is an emergency or a disaster.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2155"},{"id":"2904","label":"Emergency plan - extraction sites","desc":"A local authority must draw up an emergency plan, ensure compliance with and enforce the Regulations","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2904"},{"id":"2956","label":"Employment and training - arrangements","desc":"A local Authority may enter into arrangements with the Secretary of State pursuant to the Employment and Training Act 1973","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2956"},{"id":"1739","label":"Employment of children - byelaws","desc":"A local authority may make byelaws to regulate the employment of children.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1739"},{"id":"1740","label":"Employment of children in sreet trading - byelaws","desc":"A local authority may make byelaws to regulate the employment of children in street trading.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1740"},{"id":"3291","label":"Energy information - enforcement","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure that suppliers are in compliance with regulations relating to indication by labelling and standard product information of the consumption of energy and other resources by energy-related products. The authority has a duty to enforce these regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3291"},{"id":"234","label":"Energy measures report - regard when exercising functions","desc":"A local authority must have regard to energy measures reports published by the Secretary of State when exercising their functions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/234"},{"id":"3292","label":"Energy performance of buildings - enforcement","desc":"The local authority has a duty to enforce regulations regarding the energy performance of buildings and the availability of energy performance certificates. The authority has a duty to enforce these regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3292"},{"id":"2163","label":"Entertainment - provision of facilities","desc":"A local authority may provide or contribute to the provision of certain entertainments for use by the public.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2163"},{"id":"2887","label":"Environment - assessment of damage and remediation","desc":"Where the Regulations apply to the local authority and damage has been caused the local authority must assess that damage notify the operator of any remedial action and in certain circumstances served a remediation notice in the prescribed form.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2887"},{"id":"2838","label":"Environment - co-operation regarding flood risk","desc":"A local authority must co-operate with other named bodies when exercising its functions under these Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2838"},{"id":"2886","label":"Environment - compensation for damage under instruction","desc":"Where local authority has instructed the operator to takes steps that have themselves resulted in environmental damage the authority may have to pay certain costs to the operator.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2886"},{"id":"2885","label":"Environment - damage enforcement notice","desc":"Where the regulations apply to the local authority and environment damage seems likely the local authority must take all practicable steps, may serve an enforcement notice and may carry out certain operations itself.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2885"},{"id":"2884","label":"Environment - damage prevention and remediation","desc":"Where a local authority has granted a permit pursuant to Part II or in some circumstances Part III of the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2010 it must enforce that permit.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2884"},{"id":"2790","label":"Environment - damage under environmental permitting","desc":"If damage as prescribed is caused by an activity that requires a permit or registration under the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2010 and the LA is responsible for granting the permit, the LA must enforce the provisions of Part 2 and, if the damage is to land, Part 3.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2790"},{"id":"2834","label":"Environment - flood risk and flood hazard maps","desc":"A local authority must prepare (within any time limits prescribed) in relation to each relevant flood risk area\u2014(a) a flood hazard map, and(b) a flood risk map.Following a review by the lead agency, a local authority may revise its flood hazard map or flood risk map.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2834"},{"id":"2831","label":"Environment - flood risk assessment","desc":"A local authority must, (subject to Part V) prepare a preliminary assessment report in relation to flooding in its area and a Welsh local authority must do so by a prescribed date. The local authority must have regard to relevant guidance when so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2831"},{"id":"2833","label":"Environment - flood risk assessment review","desc":"A local authority must (subject to Part V) review\u2014(a) the preliminary assessment report prepared by it under regulation 10, and(b) its determination and identification of flood risk areas under regulation 14.Following a review, a lead local authority may prepare a revised preliminary assessment report.The first review must be completed before 22nd June 2017.Subsequent reviews must be carried out at intervals of no more than 6 years.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2833"},{"id":"2836","label":"Environment - flood risk management plan","desc":"A local authority must prepare (within any time limits prescribed) a flood risk management plan in relation to each relevant flood risk area.Following a review by the lead agency, a local authority may revise its flood risk management plan.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2836"},{"id":"2839","label":"Environment - information requests regarding flood risk","desc":"A local authority may require information in relation to the exercise of its functions under the Regulations from certain other bodies.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2839"},{"id":"2840","label":"Environment - provision of information regarding flood risk","desc":"A local authority must provide information to certain bodies in relation to the exercise of the functions of those bodies under the Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2840"},{"id":"2835","label":"Environment - review of flood hazard and flood risk maps","desc":"A local authority must review each flood hazard map and each flood risk map prepared by it under regulation 19.Following a review, a lead local flood authority may prepare\u2014(a) a revised flood hazard map;(b) a revised flood risk map.The first review must be completed before 22nd June 2019.Subsequent reviews must be carried out at intervals of no more than 6 years.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2835"},{"id":"2837","label":"Environment - review of flood risk management plan","desc":"A local authority must review its Flood Risk Management PlanFollowing a review, a lead local flood authority may prepare\u2014(a) a revised flood hazard map;(b) a revised flood risk map.The first review must be completed before 22nd June 2021.Subsequent reviews must be carried out at intervals of no more than 6 years.Following a review, the lead local flood authority must prepare a revised flood risk management plan.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2837"},{"id":"2832","label":"Environment - significant flood risk","desc":"A local authority must (subject to Part V)\u2014determine whether, in its opinion, there is a significant flood risk in its area, andidentify the part of the area affected by the risk (the \u201cflood risk area).In so doing it must also have regard to appropriate guidance and the dispute resolution mechanism in relation to the final determination","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2832"},{"id":"2891","label":"Environmental damage - appointment of authorised persons","desc":"Where the Regulations apply the local authority may appoint authorised persons to exercise its powers and carry out its duties in accordance with the Regulations","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2891"},{"id":"2888","label":"Environmental damage - carrying out remedial work","desc":"Where the Regulations apply to the local authority and damage has been caused the local authority may carry out remedial works itself in certain circumstances","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2888"},{"id":"2892","label":"Environmental damage - provision of information by operator","desc":"Where the Regulations apply the local authority may require the operator to provide it with certain information","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2892"},{"id":"2889","label":"Environmental damage - recovery of costs for remedial work","desc":"Where the Regulations apply the local authority may, in certain circumstances, take action to recover its costs","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2889"},{"id":"2890","label":"Environmental damage - requests from interested parties","desc":"Where the Regulations apply the local authority must consider requests for action from interested parties","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2890"},{"id":"4070","label":"Environmental Delivery Plans - Consultation","desc":"A local authority may respond to a consultation by Natural England regarding an Environmental Delivery Plan.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/4070"},{"id":"4071","label":"Environmental Delivery Plans \u2013 Duty to co-operate","desc":"A local authority must cooperate Natural England regarding an Environmental Delivery Plan and carry out certain development related actions when requested to do so by Natural England, having regard to Guidance from the Secretary of State when so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/4071"},{"id":"3322","label":"Environmental health - EC fertilisers","desc":"The local authority has a to to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to the marking of EC fertilisers.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3322"},{"id":"1204","label":"Environmental protection - appeals as respect authorisations","desc":"A local authority must comply with the outcome of any appeal.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1204"},{"id":"1197","label":"Environmental protection - authorisation for prescribed process","desc":"A local authority must consider applications to carry out prescribed processes.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1197"},{"id":"3803","label":"Environmental protection - co-operation with Office for Environmental Protection","desc":"A local authority must co-operate with the office of Environmental Protection.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3803"},{"id":"3804","label":"Environmental protection - compliance with Information Notice","desc":"A local authority must comply with the requirements of an Information Notice issued by the Office of Environmental Protection.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3804"},{"id":"1198","label":"Environmental protection - conditions of authorisations","desc":"A local authority must place certain conditions in any authorisations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1198"},{"id":"1886","label":"Environmental protection - control of pesticides","desc":"If there has been a breach in relation to any pesticide the local authority shall have power to seize or dispose of it or to require that some other person shall dispose of it; to seize or dispose of anything treated with it or to require that some other person shall dispose of any such thing; or to direct some other person to take such remedial action","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1886"},{"id":"1207","label":"Environmental protection - enforcement action in the High Court","desc":"A local authority may take enforcement action in the High Court in circumstances where criminal proceedings would provide insufficient sanction.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1207"},{"id":"1202","label":"Environmental protection - enforcement notices","desc":"If the enforcing authority is of the opinion that the person carrying on a prescribed process under an authorisation is contravening any condition of the authorisation, or is likely to contravene any such condition, the authority may serve on him a notice (an enforcement notice).","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1202"},{"id":"1887","label":"Environmental protection - enforcement powers (for control of pesticides)","desc":"An authorised person may enter any land/vehicle and/or obtain information if he has reasonable grounds to believe that any pesticide is being or has been used","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1887"},{"id":"1199","label":"Environmental protection - fees and charges for authorisations","desc":"A local authority must charge fees for authorisations in accordance with the Secretary of State's scheme.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1199"},{"id":"3806","label":"Environmental protection - local nature recovery strategy","desc":"Where required to do so by the Secretary of State a local authority must prepare, publish and review a local nature recovery strategy.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3806"},{"id":"1205","label":"Environmental protection - obtaining of information from persons and authorities","desc":"A local authority must provide with a Notice from the Secretary of State requesting the provision of information.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1205"},{"id":"1203","label":"Environmental protection - prohibition notices","desc":"If the enforcing authority is of the opinion, as respects the carrying on of a prescribed process under an authorisation, that the continuing to carry it on, or the continuing to carry it on in a particular manner, involves an imminent risk of serious pollution of the environment the authority shall serve a notice (a prohibition notice) on the person carrying on the process.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1203"},{"id":"1206","label":"Environmental protection - public register of information","desc":"A local authority must maintain a public register of prescribed information.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1206"},{"id":"3805","label":"Environmental protection - response to decision notice","desc":"A local authority must respond to a decision notice issued by the Office of Environmental Protection within the period allowed for by the legislation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3805"},{"id":"1201","label":"Environmental protection - revocation of authorisation","desc":"A local authority may revoke an authorisation in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1201"},{"id":"3117","label":"Environmental protection - smoke free premises","desc":"Premises must be smoke free to the extent that they are open to the public or used as a place of work.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3117"},{"id":"1200","label":"Environmental protection - variation of authorisations","desc":"A local authority may vary an authorisation in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1200"},{"id":"85","label":"Equality - duty to eliminate discrimination, enhance equality and foster good relations","desc":"A local authority must in the exercise of its functions have due regard to the need to eliminate discrimination, enhance equality of opportunity and to enhance good relations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/85"},{"id":"87","label":"Equality - prepare and publish an equality objective","desc":"A local authority must prepare and publish equality information as required by secondary legislation","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/87"},{"id":"84","label":"Equality - public sector duty regarding socio-economic inequalities","desc":"An authority to which this duty applies must, when making decisions of a strategic nature about how to exercise its functions, have due regard to the desirability of exercising them in a way that is designed to reduce the inequalities of outcome which result from socio-economic disadvantage.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/84"},{"id":"86","label":"Equality - publication of information to demonstrate compliance","desc":"A local authority must publish equality information as required by secondary legislation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/86"},{"id":"3004","label":"Events - health and safety notifications","desc":"If in relation to a required permission to hold an event. for a reason related to the health or safety of any person, or for reasons that include such a reason, the decision has effect to\u2014(i) stop the holding of the event,(ii) impose restrictions on the holding of the event,(iii) impose conditions to be met in connection with the holding of the event, or(iv) do all, or any two, of those things.The local authority must take prescribed steps to notify relevant people of that decision and to review that decision if required.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3004"},{"id":"1497","label":"Execution of works outside of area","desc":"A local authority may carry out works outside of its area unless the contrary intention appears in the authorising statute.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1497"},{"id":"2152","label":"Expenditure - concurrent functions of two or more authorities","desc":"Two or more local authorities may make arrangements for defraying any expenditure incurred by one of them in exercising any functions exercisable by both or all of them.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2152"},{"id":"2153","label":"Expenditure - not otherwise authorised","desc":"A local authority may incur expenditure which in their opinion is in the interests of and will bring direct benefit to their area or any part of it or all or some of its inhabitants, but a local authority shall not, by virtue of this subsection, incur any expenditure for a purpose for which they are, either unconditionally or subject to any limitation or to the satisfaction of any condition, authorised or required to make any payment by or by virtue of any other enactment; nor unless the direct benefit accruing to their area or any part of it or to all or some of the inhabitants of their area will be commensurate with the expenditure to be incurred.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2153"},{"id":"3283","label":"Explosives - licence for manufacture/storage","desc":"A local authority may issue a licence for the manufacture or storage of explosives. Where a licence has been issued the authority may revoke, vary or transfer the licence where the conditions comply with regulations and the authority considers it appropriate to do so.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3283"},{"id":"3284","label":"Explosives licence - enforcement","desc":"The local authority must enforce regulations relating to the manufacture and storage of explosives.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3284"},{"id":"3432","label":"Fair trading - Sunday trading","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce the Sunday Trading Act 1994.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3432"},{"id":"1860","label":"Fairs - setting dates and abolition","desc":"A local authority shall be responsible for the abolition of fairs and moving the days upon which fairs are to be held.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1860"},{"id":"2902","label":"Families - forced marriage protection order","desc":"A local authority is a relevant third party for the purposes of applying for a forced marriage protection order under section 63C(2) of the Family Law Act 1996","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2902"},{"id":"3301","label":"Feed hygiene - enforcement","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to animal feed hygiene, sampling etc.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3301"},{"id":"2064","label":"Fees for licensing and inspection of dog breeding premises","desc":"A local authority may charge fees for the granting of licences or for the inspection of premises under the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2064"},{"id":"2059","label":"Fertilisers and animal feeding stuff - analysis of feeding stuff sample","desc":"An inspector appointed by a local authority must collect and have analysed any fertiliser or feeding stuff sample when requested to do so by a purchaser.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2059"},{"id":"2061","label":"Fertilisers and animal feeding stuff - division and analysis of samples","desc":"An agricultural analyst appointed by a local authority must deal with samples taken by an inspector in the prescribed manner.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2061"},{"id":"2057","label":"Fertilisers and animal feeding stuff - enforcement","desc":"A local authority must appoint an agricultural analyst and such inspectors and deputy agricultural analysts as they think necessary to enforce the legislation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2057"},{"id":"2060","label":"Fertilisers and animal feeding stuff - power of entry and to take samples","desc":"An inspector appointed by a local authority may enter premises and take samples of fertiliser or feeding stuff.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2060"},{"id":"673","label":"Finance - accounting practices","desc":"A local authority must comply with statutory instruments regarding the accounting practices that it should follow.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/673"},{"id":"666","label":"Finance - affordable borrowing limit","desc":"A local authority must determine its affordable borrowing limit.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/666"},{"id":"2699","label":"Finance - Audit and inspection","desc":"Local authorities and fire authorities in Wales are public bodies whose accounts are required to be audited in accordance with section 39 of the Public Audit (Wales) Act 2004 and must ensure financial management of the body is adequate and effective and have a sound system of internal control which is regularly reviewed. They must keep records, prepare accounts, sign, give notice, publicise and allow inspection as prescribed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2699"},{"id":"665","label":"Finance - borrowing money","desc":"A local authority may borrow money for any purpose relevant to its functions under any enactment, or for the purposes of the prudent management of its financial affairs. Any borrowing is subject to conditions as specified in regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/665"},{"id":"674","label":"Finance - budget calculations","desc":"A chief finance officer of a local authority must report on the robustness of estimates and the adequacy of financial reserves.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/674"},{"id":"676","label":"Finance - budget monitoring","desc":"A local authority must review its budget calculations during the year from time to time.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/676"},{"id":"2686","label":"Finance - budgets and council tax","desc":"Local authorities (billing authorities and major precepting authorities) in Wales must calculate their budget requirements for a financial year and the basic amount of their council tax as prescribed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2686"},{"id":"678","label":"Finance - compliance with terms of grant for service excellence/best value","desc":"A local authority must comply with the terms of any grant made for service excellence/best value.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/678"},{"id":"677","label":"Finance - compliance with terms of grants","desc":"A local authority must comply with the terms of any grant made by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/677"},{"id":"668","label":"Finance - control of credit arrangements","desc":"A local authority must comply with restrictions imposed in relation to it entering into credit arrangements.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/668"},{"id":"2164","label":"Finance - council funds and accounts","desc":"A local authority must comply with the rules relating to funds, accounts and returns in the manner prescribed and must appoint an officer to have overall responsibility for the administration of those affairs.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2164"},{"id":"679","label":"Finance - payments towards local authority indebtedness","desc":"A local authority must comply with the terms of any payment made to deal with its indebtedness.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/679"},{"id":"670","label":"Finance - power to invest","desc":"A local authority may invest for any purpose relevant to its functions under any enactment, or for the purposes of the prudent management of its financial affairs.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/670"},{"id":"671","label":"Finance - providing information to the Secretary of State","desc":"A local authority must provide the Secretary of State with such information relating to borrowing and investment as he shall request.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/671"},{"id":"2494","label":"Finance - Public service pension scheme","desc":"A local authority must comply with the pension scheme regulations made by the responsible authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2494"},{"id":"672","label":"Finance - regard to guidance from Secretary of State","desc":"A local authority must comply with guidance and statutory instruments issued by the Secretary of State with regard to its borrowing and investment powers and duties.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/672"},{"id":"675","label":"Finance - report on inadequacy of controlled reserve","desc":"A chief finance officer of a local authority must report upon any inadequacy of any controlled reserve.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/675"},{"id":"667","label":"Finance - transfer of headroom","desc":"A local authority may transfer any headroom that it has in relation to a borrowing limit to another local authority in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/667"},{"id":"669","label":"Finance - use of capital receipts","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations regarding capital receipts","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/669"},{"id":"293","label":"Fire and rescue - arrangements for discharge of functions by others","desc":"A fire and rescue authority may enter into arrangements with another fire and rescue service or another person to enable it to carry out its duties.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/293"},{"id":"292","label":"Fire and rescue - arrangements with other employers of fire-fighters","desc":"A fire and rescue authority may enter into arrangements with other (non-fire and rescue service) employers of fire-fighters to enable it to carry out its duties.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/292"},{"id":"3211","label":"Fire and rescue - authorisation for Chief Constable to carry out Fire and Rescue functions","desc":"A Mayor of a combined authority may authorise the Chief Constable to carry out the functions of a fire and rescue authority where an Order has been made by the Secretary of State, to the extent permitted by the Order.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3211"},{"id":"300","label":"Fire and rescue - best value","desc":"A fire and rescue authority must comply with the best value/measures regime.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/300"},{"id":"296","label":"Fire and rescue - charging by authorities","desc":"A fire and rescue authority may charge a person for any action taken by the authority in the United Kingdom or at sea or under the sea, and otherwise than for a commercial purpose subject to provisions and limits defined in this section, sections 18B and 18C.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/296"},{"id":"3210","label":"Fire and rescue - co-operation with creation of corporation sole","desc":"The Secretary of State may make proposals for an Order to create a corporation sole as the fire and rescue authority for the area specified in the order, andfor the person who is for the time being the police and crime commissioner for the relevant police area to be for the time being that fire and rescue authority. The relevant local authorities must cooperate with those proposals.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3210"},{"id":"3140","label":"Fire and rescue - collaboration agreement","desc":"A Fire and Rescue Body may enter into a collaboration agreement with an ambulance trust or with a police body in England. A collaboration agreement is an agreement in writing that sets out how the parties to the agreement will work together in discharging their functions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3140"},{"id":"528","label":"Fire and rescue - conditions of service of fire brigade members","desc":"A fire and rescue authority must comply with a Direction made by the Secretary of State regarding the conditions of service of fire brigade members.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/528"},{"id":"3141","label":"Fire and rescue - consideration of collaboration agreement","desc":"A Fire and Rescue Body must keep under consideration whether entering into a collaboration agreement with one or more other relevant emergency services in England could be in the interests of the efficiency or effectiveness of that service and those other services. The Body must share any proposals and consider any such proposals received from others.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3141"},{"id":"303","label":"Fire and rescue - directions for public safety purposes","desc":"A fire and rescue authority must comply with a direction of the Secretary of State given for public safety purposes.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/303"},{"id":"288","label":"Fire and rescue - directions relating to particular fires and emergencies","desc":"A fire and rescue authority must comply with direction from the Secretary of State to take, or not to take, action specified in the direction in relation to a fire specified in the direction, or an emergency of another kind specified in the direction.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/288"},{"id":"294","label":"Fire and rescue - directions to make arrangements with another fire authority","desc":"A fire and rescue authority must comply with a direction of the Secretary of State to enter into arrangements under Section 16.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/294"},{"id":"287","label":"Fire and rescue - emergencies","desc":"A fire and rescue authority must comply with regulations made by the Secretary of State relating to emergencies.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/287"},{"id":"302","label":"Fire and rescue - equipment, facilities, services and organisations","desc":"A fire and rescue authority must comply with an order of the Secretary of State to utilise the Secretary of State's equipment or facilities etc.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/302"},{"id":"297","label":"Fire and rescue - exercise of powers at or under sea","desc":"If a fire and rescue authority has power to act, or is required to act, outside the authority's area, the authority may exercise the power, or perform the duty, at sea or under the sea.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/297"},{"id":"285","label":"Fire and rescue - fire fighting","desc":"A fire and rescue authority must make provision for the purposes of extinguishing fires in its area, and protecting life and property in the event of fires in its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/285"},{"id":"308","label":"Fire and rescue - fire hydrants","desc":"The expenses incurred by a water authority in relation to a fire hydrant are to be borne by the fire and rescue authority in whose area the hydrant is located.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/308"},{"id":"284","label":"Fire and rescue - fire safety","desc":"A fire and rescue authority must make provision for the purpose of promoting fire safety in its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/284"},{"id":"2725","label":"Fire and rescue - firefighters pension schemes","desc":"Fire and rescue authorities are appointed as the \u201cscheme managers\u201d and \u201cscheme employer\u201d and pay contributions and otherwise act in accordance with the regulations as prescribed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2725"},{"id":"283","label":"Fire and rescue - general powers of authorities","desc":"Subject to the boundaries defined in section 5B a fire and rescue authority may do: - anything it considers appropriate for the purposes of the carrying-out of any of its functions - anything it considers appropriate for purposes incidental to its functional purposes - anything it considers appropriate for purposes indirectly incidental to its functional purposes through any number of removes - anything it considers to be connected with any of its functions, or anything it may do under the above - for a commercial purpose anything which it may do under any of the above paragraphs otherwise than for a commercial purpose.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/283"},{"id":"2606","label":"Fire and rescue - improvement plans","desc":"A fire and rescue authority (Wales) must publish the required information as soon as is reasonably practicable after 31 December in the year prior to the financial year to which the improvement plan relates.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2606"},{"id":"299","label":"Fire and rescue - intervention by Secretary of State","desc":"A fire and rescue authority must comply with an order made by the Secretary of State under the intervention protocol.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/299"},{"id":"298","label":"Fire and rescue - National Framework","desc":"A fire and rescue authority must have regard to the National Framework when carrying out its functions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/298"},{"id":"310","label":"Fire and rescue - obtaining information and investigating fires","desc":"A fire and rescue authority may authorise officers to enter premises at a reasonable time for the purposes of obtaining information or investigating fires.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/310"},{"id":"290","label":"Fire and rescue - other services","desc":"A fire and rescue authority may provide the services of any persons employed by it or any equipment maintained by it to any person for any purpose that appears to the authority to be appropriate. A fire and rescue authority may provide services under this section outside as well as within the authority's area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/290"},{"id":"309","label":"Fire and rescue - powers of fire-fighters etc in an emergency","desc":"A fire and rescue authority may authorise its fire fighters, in writing, to undertake certain actions in an emergency.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/309"},{"id":"291","label":"Fire and rescue - reinforcement schemes","desc":"A fire and rescue authority must enter into reinforcement schemes with other fire and rescue authorities and notify the Secretary of State when so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/291"},{"id":"301","label":"Fire and rescue - reports, returns and information to Secretary of State","desc":"A fire and rescue authority must submit to the Secretary of State any reports and returns required by him give the Secretary of State any information with respect to its functions required by him.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/301"},{"id":"289","label":"Fire and rescue - response to other eventualities","desc":"A fire and rescue authority may take any action in response to an event or situation that causes or is likely to cause one or more individuals to die, be injured or become ill or harm to the environment (including the life and health of plants and animals).","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/289"},{"id":"286","label":"Fire and rescue - road traffic accidents","desc":"A fire and rescue authority must make provision for the purpose of rescuing people in the event of road traffic accidents in its area and protecting people from serious harm, to the extent that it considers it reasonable to do so, in the event of road traffic accidents in its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/286"},{"id":"304","label":"Fire and rescue - securing adequate water supply","desc":"A fire and rescue authority must take all reasonable measures for securing that an adequate supply of water will be available for the authority's use in the event of fire. An authority may use any suitable supply of water for the purposes of extinguishing a fire or protecting life or property in the event of a fire (but must pay reasonable compensation for the water).","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/304"},{"id":"307","label":"Fire and rescue - supply of water by other persons","desc":"a fire and rescue authority may enter into an agreement to secure the use of water under the control of a person other than a water undertaker, to improve access to any such water or to lay and maintain pipes and to carry out other works in connection with the use of such water.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/307"},{"id":"306","label":"Fire and rescue - supply of water by water undertakers","desc":"A fire and rescue authority may enter into agreements with water undertakers for the purpose of securing a water supply.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/306"},{"id":"295","label":"Fire and rescue - training centres","desc":"A fire and rescue authority may establish and maintain one or more training centres for providing education and training in matters in relation to which fire and rescue authorities have functions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/295"},{"id":"305","label":"Fire and rescue - use of and payment for water supply","desc":"A fire and rescue authority may use any suitable supply of water for the purposes of extinguishing a fire or protecting life or property in the event of a fire (but must pay reasonable compensation for the water).","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/305"},{"id":"2903","label":"Fire compliance - sub-surface railway stations","desc":"Where a fire and rescue authority is satisfied in respect of any particular station premises that compliance with a requirement of any of the provisions of regulations 5(2), 6(2), 9(8) and 10(2) is inappropriate, unnecessary or not reasonably practicable, the fire and rescue authority may by notice in writing to the occupier of the premises grant exemption from compliance with the requirement to such extent as is reasonable having regard to all the circumstances of the case and in particular to the risk in case of fire to persons in the premises.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2903"},{"id":"92","label":"Flooding - delegation of flood risk management function","desc":"A risk management authority may delegate its flood risk management function to another relevant authority.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/92"},{"id":"88","label":"Flooding - flood risk management strategy","desc":"A local authority must develop, consult upon, maintain, apply and monitor a strategy for local flood risk management in its area (a local flood risk management strategy) and have regard to Guidance from the Secretary of State in doing so.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/88"},{"id":"89","label":"Flooding - guidance on flood risk management strategy","desc":"A local authority may issue guidance in respect of its local flood risk management strategy.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/89"},{"id":"97","label":"Flooding - investigation of flooding incident","desc":"A local authority must to the extent it considers necessary or appropriate in case of flooding in its area, carry out an investigation, publish its results and issue notifications.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/97"},{"id":"98","label":"Flooding - register of structures or features with significant effect on flood risk","desc":"A lead local flood authority must establish and maintain (a)a register of structures or features which, in the opinion of the authority, are likely to have a significant effect on a flood risk in its area, and (b)a record of information about each of those structures or features, including information about ownership and state of repair. The authority must comply with guidance from the Secretary of State about the content of the register. The register must be available for inspection at all reasonable times.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/98"},{"id":"90","label":"Flooding and coastal erosion - co-operation and arrangements","desc":"A local authority must cooperate with other relevant authorities in the exercise of their flood and coastal erosion risk management functions","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/90"},{"id":"100","label":"Flooding and coastal erosion - designation of features which may affect the flood or coastal erosion risk","desc":"A local authority may designate a structure or a natural or man-made feature of the environment where the designating authority thinks the existence or location of the structure or feature affects a flood risk or a coastal erosion risk.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/100"},{"id":"96","label":"Flooding and coastal erosion - enforcement notice for failure to provide information","desc":"A local authority may issue enforcement notice in respect of failure to provide information requested under section 14.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/96"},{"id":"95","label":"Flooding and coastal erosion - request for information","desc":"A local authority may request any person to provide information in respect of flood or coastal erosion risk management functions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/95"},{"id":"91","label":"Flooding and coastal erosion - sharing of information","desc":"A relevant authority may share information with another relevant authority for the purpose of discharging its duty in the exercise of their flood and coastal erosion risk management functions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/91"},{"id":"99","label":"Flooding and coastal erosion - sustainable development","desc":"A local authority must have regard to achieving sustainable development when having regard to flood risk or coastal erosion functions.. The local authority must also comply with any guidance from the Minister.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/99"},{"id":"3331","label":"Food composition - food for specific groups (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance and to enforce the Regulations relating to information and composition of food intended for infants and young children, food for special medical purposes, and total diet replacement for weight control.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3331"},{"id":"3332","label":"Food composition - food for specific groups (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance and to enforce the Regulations relating to information and composition of food intended for infants and young children, food for special medical purposes, and total diet replacement for weight control.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3332"},{"id":"3294","label":"Food labelling - cocoa and chocolate products","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations regarding the labelling and description of cocoa and chocolate products.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3294"},{"id":"3273","label":"Food labelling - coffee and chicory extracts (England)","desc":"A local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and enforce regulations relating to coffee and chicory extracts.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3273"},{"id":"3274","label":"Food labelling - coffee and chicory extracts (Wales)","desc":"A local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and enforce regulations regarding coffee and chicory extracts.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3274"},{"id":"3336","label":"Food labelling - food intended for use in energy restricted diets","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance and enforce the Regulations relating to specially formulated food intended for use in energy-restricted diets for weight reduction and which, when used as instructed by the manufacturer, replaces the whole of the total daily diet orone or more meals of the daily diet.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3336"},{"id":"3256","label":"Food safety - addition of vitamins, minerals, etc. - prosecution","desc":"The relevant local authority may prosecute for a breach of these Regulations and relevant EC Regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3256"},{"id":"3255","label":"Food safety - additions of vitamins, minerals, etc.","desc":"The relevant local authority must enforce the requirements of these Regulations and relevant EC Regulations relating to the addition of vitamins, minerals, etc. to food.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3255"},{"id":"1266","label":"Food safety - analysis of samples","desc":"A local authority must take prescribed steps regarding the analysis of samples.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1266"},{"id":"2861","label":"Food safety - animal feed - recovery of expenses","desc":"A local authority may, recover its expenses from the Operator in certain cases.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2861"},{"id":"2867","label":"Food safety - animal feed recovery of expenses (Wales)","desc":"A local authority may, recover its expenses from the Operator in certain cases.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2867"},{"id":"2762","label":"Food safety - animal products","desc":"The local authority must enforce the Regulations regarding residue limits of pharmacologically active substances in foodstuffs of animal origin in its area (as prescribed).","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2762"},{"id":"2621","label":"Food safety - articles in contact with food (England)","desc":"Local authorities acting as a food authority in its area must execute and enforce Regulation 1935/2004, Regulation 1895/2005, Regulation 450/2009; Regulation 10/2011 and Regulation 2023/2006 and the Regulations which forbid placing on the market ceramic articles that do not meet the specifications set out in the Directive and conditions relating to the substances that may be used for the manufacture of regenerated cellulose film.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2621"},{"id":"2635","label":"Food safety - articles in contact with food (Wales)","desc":"A local authority acting as a food authority in its area must execute and enforce Regulation 1935/2004, Regulation 1895/2005, Regulation 450/2009; Regulation 10/2011 and Regulation 2023/2006 and the Regulations which forbid placing on the market ceramic articles that do not meet the specifications set out in the Directive and conditions relating to the substances that may be used for the manufacture of regenerated cellulose film.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2635"},{"id":"3399","label":"Food safety - baby foods (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to processed cereal based foods and baby foods for infants (under the age of twelve months) and young children (aged between one and three years).","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3399"},{"id":"3400","label":"Food safety - baby foods (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to processed cereal based foods and baby foods for infants (under the age of twelve months) and young children (aged between one and three years).","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3400"},{"id":"3454","label":"Food safety - beef and veal labelling","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to the labelling of beef and veal.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3454"},{"id":"2806","label":"Food safety - bottled drinking water","desc":"Local authorities (food authorities) must execute and enforce the Regulations and take the remedial action prescribed in relation to water bottled and labelled as \u201cspring water\u201d or \u201cdwr ffynnon\u201d and bottled drinking water in the event of non-compliance with the parametric values for the parameters set out. (applying Council Directive 98/83/EC relating to the quality of water intended for human consumption ; Directive 2009/54/EC on the exploitation and marketing of natural mineral waters; Commission Directive 2003/40/EC establishing the list, concentration limits and labelling requirements for the constituents of natural mineral waters and the conditions for using ozone-enriched air for the treatment of natural mineral waters and spring waters; Commission Regulation (EU) No 115/2010 laying down the conditions for use of activated alumina for the removal of fluoride from natural mineral waters and spring waters and Council Directive 2013/51/Euratom laying down the requirements for the protection of the health of the general public with regard to radioactive substances in water intended for human consumption).","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2806"},{"id":"3267","label":"Food safety - bread and flour","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with Regulations relating to the composition of and ingredients in bread and flour","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3267"},{"id":"2764","label":"Food safety - brucellosis testing","desc":"Local authorities must enforce the Order regarding regular testing of milk for Brucellosis","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2764"},{"id":"3310","label":"Food safety - caseins and caseinates (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance and enforce Regulations relating to caseins and caseinates.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3310"},{"id":"3311","label":"Food safety - caseins and caseinates (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance and enforce Regulations relating to caseins and caseinates.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3311"},{"id":"1271","label":"Food safety - charging and expenses","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations as to charges which it may make in relation to it's food safety functions. Expenses of authorised officers and county councils should be defrayed in accordance with regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1271"},{"id":"1268","label":"Food safety - code of practice and directions","desc":"A local authority must have regard to any code of practice issued and must comply with directions made pursuant to the code.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1268"},{"id":"2786","label":"Food safety - condensed and dried milk","desc":"Local authorities (food authorities) must enforce these regulations in their areas (implementing Council Directive 2001/114/EC relating to certain partly or wholly dehydrated preserved milk products intended for human consumption and Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 of the European Parliament and of the Council on the provision of food information to consumers). The regulations define condensed milk and dried milk products and the reserved descriptions that apply to them; prohibit labelling with reserved descriptions of food other than the designated condensed and dried milk products to which they relate, enabling improvement notices to be served to require compliance with regulations, 3, 4 and 5 and make failure to comply an offence.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2786"},{"id":"2657","label":"Food safety - contaminants (England)","desc":"It is the duty of each local authority (food authority) within its area or district to execute and enforce the Regulations regarding levels of Eruric acid prescribed contaminants in food, Regulation 1881/2006 and Regulation 124/2009 and it is the competent authority for executing and enforcing prescribed Articles of those regulations in relation to concentration or dilution factors investigating the reasons for contamination.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2657"},{"id":"2658","label":"Food safety - contaminants (Wales)","desc":"It is the duty of each local authority (food authority) within its area or district to execute and enforce the Regulations regarding levels of Eruric acid and prescribed contaminants in food, Regulation 1881/2006 and Regulation 124/2009 and it is the competent authority for executing and enforcing prescribed Articles of those regulations in relation to concentration or dilution factors and investigating the reasons for contamination.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2658"},{"id":"1270","label":"Food safety - default powers","desc":"A local authority where deemed to be in default by the Secretary of State must comply with the Secretary of State when exercising default powers and must pay various expenses.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1270"},{"id":"2547","label":"Food safety - eggs","desc":"LAs acting as food authorities must enforce the Regulations in the local area (relating to marketing standards for eggs) and give assistance and information to other enforcement authorities","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2547"},{"id":"2844","label":"Food safety - eggs and chicks","desc":"Each local authority acting as food authority must\u2014(a) enforce the provisions mentioned in Schedule 2, as read with regulation 9, and the provisions mentioned in Schedule 3, as read with regulation 16, insofar as they apply to\u2014the retail sale of eggs within their area;the sale of eggs to a mass caterer in their area; andthe use of eggs within their area.(b) enforce the provisions of regulation 20(3) and (4) in the case of a direction given by an authorised officer who is authorised by the food authority (\u201ca food authority officer\u201d);(c) enforce the provisions of regulation 20(6) in the case of a pack or container secured by a food authority officer;(d) enforce the provisions of regulation 20(11) and (12) in the case of the disturbance or removal of any item or computer equipment in contravention of the terms of a notice given by a food authority officer;(e) enforce the provisions of regulation 22(3) in the case of a compliance notice given by a food authority officer;(f) enforce the provisions of regulation 22(7) in the case of a compliance notice given by a food authority officer; and(g) enforce the provisions of regulation 26 in the case of an obstruction of a food authority officer.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2844"},{"id":"2847","label":"Food safety - eggs and chicks compliance notice","desc":"An authorised officer may serve a compliance notice in certain circumstances having followed a prescribed procedure.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2847"},{"id":"2845","label":"Food safety - eggs and chicks enforcement","desc":"Each local authority must assist the secretary of state or another food authority in the enforcement of the Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2845"},{"id":"2846","label":"Food safety - eggs and chicks entry to premises","desc":"An authorised officer may enter premises and seize samples after following certain procedures for the purpose of the enforcement of these Regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2846"},{"id":"2850","label":"Food safety - eggs and chicks penalty notice","desc":"A local authority may serve (and withdraw) a penalty notice to deal with certain contraventions of the Regulations in certain circumstances. The penalty notice must be in the prescribed form and served in the prescribed manner.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2850"},{"id":"2849","label":"Food safety - eggs and chicks prosecution","desc":"A local authority may bring a prosecution for offences within 1 year of having sufficient information in which to do so.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2849"},{"id":"2848","label":"Food safety - eggs and chicks publishing information","desc":"A local authority must publicise certain information regarding enforcement action in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2848"},{"id":"1259","label":"Food safety - emergency prohibition notices","desc":"An officer authorised by a local authority may in certain circumstances issue an emergency prohibition notice and must take certain steps regarding the notice and any order made by a court.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1259"},{"id":"1255","label":"Food safety - enforcement","desc":"Where a local authority is the enforcement authority as defined by the Act or by regulations it may enforce the provisions of the Act or regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1255"},{"id":"1264","label":"Food safety - facilities for examination","desc":"A local authority may provide facilities for microbiological examination of food.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1264"},{"id":"2864","label":"Food safety - feed and food controls enforcement (Wales)","desc":"A local authority must, where appropriate execute and enforce the Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2864"},{"id":"2862","label":"Food safety - feed and food controls information exchange (Wales)","desc":"A local authority may, where appropriate obtain, provide and exchange information with another competent authority.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2862"},{"id":"2863","label":"Food safety - feed and food controls regard to guidance (Wales)","desc":"A local authority must have regard to Guidance Issues by the Assembly when exercising its functions under the Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2863"},{"id":"2668","label":"Food safety - fish labelling (England)","desc":"A local authority (food authorities) must enforce and execute these Regulations in its area and is the competent authority in its area for the purposes of Article 58(4) of Regulation 1224/2009 and Article 67(5) of Regulation 404/2011.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2668"},{"id":"2667","label":"Food safety - fish labelling (Wales)","desc":"Each food authority must enforce and execute these Regulations in its area and is the competent authority in its area for the purposes of Article 58(4) of Regulation 1224/2009 and Article 67(5) of Regulation 404/2011.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2667"},{"id":"2674","label":"Food safety - food additives (England)","desc":"Local authorities (food authorities) must execute and enforce the Regulations and the EU Regulations in their area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2674"},{"id":"2675","label":"Food safety - food additives (Wales)","desc":"Local authorities (food authorities) must execute and enforce the Regulations and the EU Regulations in their areas.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2675"},{"id":"2851","label":"Food safety - food for particular nutritional purposes (England)","desc":"A local authority must enforce these Regulations in its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2851"},{"id":"2852","label":"Food safety - food for particular nutritional purposes (Wales)","desc":"A local authority must enforce these Regulations in its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2852"},{"id":"1261","label":"Food safety - food hygiene training","desc":"A local authority may provide food hygiene training for persons who are or intend to become involved in food businesses, whether as proprietors or employees or otherwise or may contribute towards the expenses of another authority which provides such training.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1261"},{"id":"3333","label":"Food safety - food information","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance and enforce the Regulations relating to providing information about food ingredients.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3333"},{"id":"2727","label":"Food safety - food information regulations","desc":"Local authorities (food authorities) must enforce the Regulations and other non-metropolitan district councils (which are not defined as food authorities for this purpose) are also empowered to enforce certain allergen-related provisions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2727"},{"id":"2853","label":"Food safety - food irradiation (England)","desc":"A local authority must enforce these Regulations in its area and give assistance to other authorities.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2853"},{"id":"2854","label":"Food safety - food irradiation (Wales)","desc":"A local authority must enforce these Regulations in its area and give assistance to other authorities.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2854"},{"id":"3330","label":"Food safety - food lot marking","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance and enforce the Regulations relating to food lot marking","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3330"},{"id":"3334","label":"Food safety - food supplements (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance and enforce the Regulations relating to food supplements sold as food and presented as such.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3334"},{"id":"3335","label":"Food safety - food supplements (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance and enforce the Regulations relating to food supplements sold as food and presented as such.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3335"},{"id":"2682","label":"Food safety - fruit juices and fruit nectars (England)","desc":"Each food authority must enforce the Regulations regarding content and labelling of fruit juice and other fruit drinks in its area","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2682"},{"id":"2683","label":"Food safety - fruit juices and fruit nectars (Wales)","desc":"Each food authority must enforce the Regulations regarding content and labelling of fruit juice and other fruit drinks in its area","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2683"},{"id":"3344","label":"Food safety -
