genetically modified food (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance and enforce the Regulations relating to the safety of genetically modified (GM) food.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3344"},{"id":"3345","label":"Food safety - genetically modified food (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance and enforce the Regulations relating to the safety of genetically modified (GM) food.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3345"},{"id":"3346","label":"Food safety - genetically modified organisms (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance and to enforce the Regulations relating to the the traceability and labelling of genetically modified organisms and the traceability of food and feed products produced from genetically modified organisms.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3346"},{"id":"3347","label":"Food safety - genetically modified organisms (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance and to enforce the Regulations relating to the the traceability and labelling of genetically modified organisms and the traceability of food and feed products produced from genetically modified organisms.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3347"},{"id":"2549","label":"Food safety - gluten intolerance","desc":"An LA (food authority) shall execute and enforce Regulations relating to foodstuffs for people intolerant to Gluten within its area","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2549"},{"id":"2676","label":"Food safety - hygiene rating","desc":"A local authority (food authority) must send prescribed information to food business establishments when notifying the operator of the food hygiene rating given following an inspection (in addition to information required under the Act) and when notifying the operator of its decision to change the food hygiene rating as a result of an appeal; the operator\u2019s request to be re-rated under section 12 or within 14 days of an establishment\u2019s registration. A local authority must send to the FSA a breakdown of an establishment's rating into its component scores for each of the rating criteria published by the FSA under section 14(1)(c) of the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2676"},{"id":"2859","label":"Food safety - imported animal feed analysis (Wales)","desc":"A local authority may, in order to enforce the Regulations with regard to imported animal feed procure, analyse and where necessary enter premises to obtain samples.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2866"},{"id":"2858","label":"Food safety - imported animal feed enforcement (England)","desc":"A local authority must, where appropriate enforce the Regulations with regard to imported animal feed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2858"},{"id":"2865","label":"Food safety - imported animal feed enforcement (Wales)","desc":"A local authority must, where appropriate enforce the Regulations with regard to imported animal feed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2865"},{"id":"2860","label":"Food safety - imported animal feed samples (England)","desc":"A local authority may, in order to enforce the Regulations with regard to imported animal feed procure, analyse and where necessary enter premises to obtain samples.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2860"},{"id":"1257","label":"Food safety - improvement notices","desc":"An officer authorised by a local authority may issue an improvement notice in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1257"},{"id":"3354","label":"Food safety - infant formula and follow-on formula (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to infant formula and follow-on formula","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3354"},{"id":"3355","label":"Food safety - infant formula and follow-on formula (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to infant formula and follow-on formula.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3355"},{"id":"2726","label":"Food safety - information for customers","desc":"Local authorities (food authorities) must enforce the Regulations on the provision of food information to consumers","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2726"},{"id":"2855","label":"Food safety - information regarding feed and food controls","desc":"A local authority may, where appropriate obtain, provide and exchange information with another competent authority.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2855"},{"id":"1256","label":"Food safety - inspection and seizure of suspected food","desc":"An officer authorised by a local authority may inspect, prevent the use of or seize suspected food intended, commercially, for human consumption.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1256"},{"id":"3357","label":"Food safety - jam and similar products (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to jam and similar products.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3357"},{"id":"3358","label":"Food safety - jam and similar products (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to jam and similar products.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3358"},{"id":"3359","label":"Food safety - kava-kava in food (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations regarding kava-kava in food.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3359"},{"id":"3360","label":"Food safety - kava-kava in food (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations regarding kava-kava in food.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3360"},{"id":"2582","label":"Food safety - labelling of beef and veal","desc":"The LA are responsible for enforcing the regulations and may serve a notice requiring re-labelling of beef and veal and exercise powers of entry for inspection or sampling purposes.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2582"},{"id":"2797","label":"Food safety - labelling of honey (England)","desc":"Local authorities (food authorities) are required to enforce the Regulations (by serving improvement notices) which regulate the use of various prescribed names including \u201choney\u201d and the compositional criteria with which such products must comply when placed on the market as honey and when used in a product intended for human consumption and other labelling conditions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2797"},{"id":"2798","label":"Food safety - labelling of honey (Wales)","desc":"Local authorities (food authorities) are required to enforce the Regulations (by serving improvement notices) which regulate the use of various prescribed names including \u201choney\u201d and the compositional criteria with which such products must comply when placed on the market as honey and when used in a product intended for human consumption and other labelling conditions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2798"},{"id":"2745","label":"Food safety - meat products (England)","desc":"A local authority (food authority) must enforce the Regulations within its area which prohibit the use of specified names in the sale and advertising of regulated products if the products do not satisfy specific compositional requirements; and the sale of uncooked regulated products which include among their ingredients specified parts of the carcass of any mammalian species of animal.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2745"},{"id":"2746","label":"Food safety - meat products (Wales)","desc":"A LA (food authority) must enforce the Regulations within its area which prohibit the use of specified names in the sale and advertising of regulated products if the products do not satisfy specific compositional requirements; and the sale of uncooked regulated products which include among their ingredients specified parts of the carcass of any mammalian species of animal.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2746"},{"id":"3366","label":"Food safety - medical food (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to food coming within the classification of dietary foods for special medical purposes for which compositional and labelling requirements are laid down in regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3366"},{"id":"3367","label":"Food safety - medical food (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to food coming within the classification of dietary foods for special medical purposes for which compositional and labelling requirements are laid down in regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3367"},{"id":"2542","label":"Food safety - milk","desc":"Each food authority must enforce the provisions of the Regulations within its area and give such assistance and information to any other food authority in Great Britain","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2542"},{"id":"3377","label":"Food safety - novel foods (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relation to novel foods.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3377"},{"id":"3378","label":"Food safety - novel foods (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relation to novel foods.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3378"},{"id":"3379","label":"Food safety - nutrition and health claims (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to the nutrition and health claims of food products.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3379"},{"id":"3380","label":"Food safety - nutrition and health claims (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to the nutrition and health claims of food products.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3380"},{"id":"2857","label":"Food safety - official feed and food controls execution (England)","desc":"A local authority must, where appropriate execute and enforce the Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2857"},{"id":"3383","label":"Food safety - olive oil","desc":"The local authority may ensure compliance with and enforce regulations relating to marketing standards for olive oil.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3383"},{"id":"2868","label":"Food safety - organic products","desc":"A local authority must, where relevant enforce the Regulations and where appropriate exercise the powers therein.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2868"},{"id":"2787","label":"Food safety - origin of meat products (England)","desc":"Local authorities that are food authorities must enforce these Regulations within their areas (applying Regulation (EU) No 1337/2013 ; (EU) No 1169/2011 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the indication of the country of origin or place of provenance for fresh, chilled and frozen meat of swine, sheep, goats and poultry and records to be kept by food business operators for 12 months from the end of the calendar year to which each record relates.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2787"},{"id":"2788","label":"Food safety - origin of meat products (Wales)","desc":"A local authority must enforce in its area Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) No 1337/2013 laying down rules for the application of Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 as regards the indication of the country of origin for fresh, chilled and frozen meat of swine, sheep, goats and poultry and these Regulations, which require food business operators to keep records for 12 months from the end of the calendar year to which each record relates.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2788"},{"id":"2569","label":"Food safety - plastic kitchenware importation","desc":"Each LA (\u201cfood authority\u201d) in its area or district must execute and enforce the Commission Regulation and the Regulations which lay down specific conditions and detailed procedures for the import of polyamide and melamine plastic kitchenware originating in or consigned from the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2569"},{"id":"2570","label":"Food safety - poultrymeat storage (England)","desc":"Each LA (\u201cfood authority\u201d) must enforce the European poultry meat provisions in its area (other than at slaughterhouses and cutting plants); and that retail shop and premises adjacent to sales points where cutting and handling are performed solely for the purpose of supplying the consumer directly on the spot with fresh poultrymeat must keep it at a temperature not below \u2013 2\u00baC and not higher than 8\u00baC","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2570"},{"id":"2593","label":"Food safety - poultrymeat storage (Wales)","desc":"Each local authority (\u201cfood authority\u201d) must enforce the European poultry meat provisions in its area (other than at slaughterhouses and cutting plants); at retail shop and premises adjacent to sales points where cutting and handling are performed solely for the purpose of supplying the consumer directly on the spot with fresh poultrymeat (which must be kept at a temperature not below \u2013 2\u00baC and not higher than 8\u00baC).","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2593"},{"id":"1267","label":"Food safety - powers of entry, inspection and seizure","desc":"An authorised officer of a local authority may in accordance with the Act enter premises and apply for a warrant if entry is refused and may carry out certain inspections and seize records.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1267"},{"id":"3394","label":"Food safety - preserved sardines","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to preserved sardines.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3394"},{"id":"3395","label":"Food safety - preserved tuna and bonito","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to preserved tuna and bonito.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3395"},{"id":"3401","label":"Food safety - products containing meat (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to products containing meat.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3401"},{"id":"3402","label":"Food safety - products containing meat (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to products containing meat.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3402"},{"id":"1258","label":"Food safety - prohibitions orders","desc":"An officer authorised by a local authority must take certain steps with regard to prohibition orders in certain circumstances. Steps for an order issued by a court include serving a copy of the order on the proprietor of the business and affixing a copy of the order in a conspicuous place in the business premises.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1258"},{"id":"1269","label":"Food safety - provision of returns","desc":"A local authority must provide reports or returns to the Secretary of state or to the Food Standards Agency as required.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1269"},{"id":"1263","label":"Food safety - public analyst","desc":"A local authority must appoint a one or more persons to act as a public analyst with the authority's area in the manner prescribed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1263"},{"id":"3406","label":"Food safety - quick frozen foodstuffs (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to quick frozen foodstuffs.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3406"},{"id":"3407","label":"Food safety - quick frozen foodstuffs (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to quick frozen foodstuffs.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3407"},{"id":"1260","label":"Food safety - registration and licensing of food premises","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations relating to the registration and licensing of food premises.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1260"},{"id":"3403","label":"Food safety - restricted animals and poultry (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to the control of meat from restricted animals or restricted poultry where infected or disease is suspected.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3403"},{"id":"3404","label":"Food safety - restricted animals and poultry (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to the control of meat from restricted animals or restricted poultry where infected or disease is suspected.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3404"},{"id":"2869","label":"Food safety - scotch whisky regulations","desc":"A local authority must, where relevant enforce the Regulations and where appropriate exercise the powers therein.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2869"},{"id":"1262","label":"Food safety - shellfish cleansing","desc":"A local authority may provide facilities for cleansing shellfish or contribute towards the expenses of another authority which provides such facilities.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1262"},{"id":"3423","label":"Food safety - specified products from China (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to specified animal feed and food products.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3423"},{"id":"3424","label":"Food safety - specified products from China (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to specified animal feed and food products.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3424"},{"id":"3425","label":"Food safety - specified sugar products (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to sugar products as specified in schedule 1 of the regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3425"},{"id":"3426","label":"Food safety - specified sugar products (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to sugar products as specified in schedule 1 of the regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3426"},{"id":"3427","label":"Food safety - spirit drinks","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to spirit drinks as defined in regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3427"},{"id":"3428","label":"Food safety - spreadable fats, milk and milk products (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to the content, descriptions and marketing of spreadable fats, milk and milk products.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3428"},{"id":"3429","label":"Food safety - spreadable fats, milk and milk products (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to the content, descriptions and marketing of spreadable fats, milk and milk products.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3429"},{"id":"1265","label":"Food safety - test purchases and the taking of samples","desc":"An officer authorised by a local authority may make test purchases and take samples of food and other substances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1265"},{"id":"3437","label":"Food safety - tryptophan in food (England)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations regarding the addition of tryptophan to food.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3437"},{"id":"3438","label":"Food safety - tryptophan in food (Wales)","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations regarding the addition of tryptophan to food.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3438"},{"id":"3449","label":"Food safety - wine sector products","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to the sale of wine sector products.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3449"},{"id":"2671","label":"Food safety and hygiene - enforcement","desc":"A local authority must execute and enforce the Hygiene Regulations in its area which are not enforced by the Food Standards Agency and/or as prescribed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2671"},{"id":"2856","label":"Food safety official feed and food controls enforcement (England)","desc":"A local authority must have regard to Guidance Issues by the Secretary of State when exercising its functions under the Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2856"},{"id":"3596","label":"Fostering - appointment of fostering agency manager","desc":"The registered provider must appoint an individual to manage the fostering agency.Where the registered provider is an organisation, it must not appoint the person who is the responsible individual as the manager, Where the registered provider is a partnership, it must not appoint any of the partners as the manager.The registered provider must notify the Chief Inspector as soon as is reasonably practicable of the name of any person appointed in accordance with this regulation, and the date on which the appointment is to take effect.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3596"},{"id":"3609","label":"Fostering - approval of foster parents","desc":"A fostering service provider must not approve a person who has been approved as a foster parent by another fostering service provider where that approval has not been terminated.A fostering service provider must not approve X as a foster parent unless they have completed their assessment of X\u2019s suitability, and the fostering panel, where the case has been referred to the fostering panel, has considered the application.A fostering service provider must, in deciding whether to approve X as a foster parent and as to the terms of any approval, take into account the recommendation of, where the case was referred to the fostering panel, the fostering panel.If a fostering service provider decide to approve X as a foster parent they must give X notice in writing specifying any terms on which the approval is given, and enter into a written agreement with X covering the matters specified in Schedule 5 (the \u201cfoster care agreement\u201d).If a fostering service provider consider that X is not suitable to be a foster parent they must, subject to paragraph (7) )give X written notice that they propose not to approve X as suitable to be a foster parent (a \u201cqualifying determination\u201d), together with their reasons and, where the case has been referred to the fostering panel, a copy of the fostering panel\u2019s recommendation, and advise X that, within 28 days of the date of the qualifying determination, X may\u2014(i)submit any written representations that X wishes to make to the fostering service provider, or(ii)apply to the Secretary of State for a review by an independent review panel of the qualifying determination.If within the period referred to above the fostering provider receive any written representations, they may refer the case to the fostering panel for further consideration and, where a case is referred, the fostering service provider must make their decision taking into account any further recommendation made by the fostering panel.If, within the period referred to above, X applies to the Secretary of State for a review by an independent review panel of the qualifying determination, the fostering service provider must make their decision taking into account any recommendation of the fostering panel and the recommendation of the independent review panel.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3609"},{"id":"3608","label":"Fostering - assessment of prospective foster parent","desc":"Where a person (\u201cX\u201d) applies to become a foster parent and the fostering service provider decide to assess X\u2019s suitability to become a foster parent, any such assessment must be carried out in accordance with this regulation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3608"},{"id":"3602","label":"Fostering - care records relating to foster parents and others","desc":"A fostering service provider must maintain a case record for each foster parent approved by them which must include copies of the documents specified below and the information specified in this Regulation.The documents referred to are:(a)the report prepared under regulation 26(3)(b) and any other reports submitted to the fostering panel, if any,(b)any recommendations made by the fostering panel,(c)the notice of approval given under regulation 27(5)(a),(d)the foster care agreement,(e)any report of a review of approval prepared under regulation 28(4), and(f)any notice given under regulation 28(12).","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3602"},{"id":"3599","label":"Fostering - constitution and membership of fostering panel","desc":"The fostering service provider must maintain a list of persons who are considered by them to be suitable to be members of a fostering panel (\u201cthe central list\u201d), including one or more social workers who have at least three years\u2019 relevant post-qualifying experience.Where the fostering service provider are of the opinion that a person included in the central list is unsuitable or unable to remain on the list, the fostering service provider may remove that person\u2019s name from the list by giving them one month\u2019s notice in writing.Subject to paragraph (5) of these Regulations, the fostering service provider must constitute one or more fostering panels, as necessary, to perform the functions of a fostering panel under these Regulations, and, where a panel is constituted, the fostering service provider must appoint panel members including:(i)a person to chair the panel who, in the case of any appointment made after 1st October 2011, must be independent of the fostering service provider, and(ii)one or two persons who may act as chair if the person appointed to chair the panel is absent or that office is vacant (\u201cthe vice chairs\u201d) from the persons on the central list.The fostering service provider must ensure that the individual members have between them the experience and expertise necessary, to effectively discharge the functions of the panel.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3599"},{"id":"3605","label":"Fostering - events and notifications","desc":"The notifications as detailed in Schedule 7 must be submitted to one or more of the:Chief inspectorResponsible authoritySecretary of StateArea authorityPolicePrimary Care Trustas detailed in the table in Schedule 7","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3605"},{"id":"3601","label":"Fostering - functions of fostering panel","desc":"(1) The functions of the fostering panel in respect of cases referred to it by the fostering service provider are:(a)to consider each application for approval and to recommend whether or not a person is suitable to be a foster parent,(b)where it recommends approval of an application, to recommend any terms on which the approval is to be given,(c)to recommend whether or not a person remains suitable to be a foster parent, and whether or not the terms of their approval (if any) remain appropriate\u2014(i)on the first review carried out in accordance with regulation 28(2), and(ii)on the occasion of any other review, if requested to do so by the fostering service provider in accordance with regulation 28(5), and(d)to consider any case referred to it under regulation 27(9) or 28(10).(2) In considering what recommendation to make under paragraph (1), the fostering panel:(a)must consider and take into account all of the information passed to it in accordance with regulation 26, 27 or 28 (as the case may be),(b)may request the fostering service provider to obtain any other relevant information or to provide such other assistance as the fostering panel considers necessary, and(c)may obtain such legal advice or medical advice as it considers necessary.(3) The fostering service provider must obtain such information as the fostering panel considers necessary and send that information to the panel, and provide such other assistance as the fostering panel may request, so far as is reasonably practicable.(4) The fostering panel may also:(a)advise, where appropriate, on the procedures under which reviews in accordance with regulation 28 are carried out by the fostering service provider, and periodically monitor their effectiveness,(b)oversee the conduct of assessments carried out by the fostering service provider, and(c)give advice, and make recommendations, on such other matters or cases as the fostering service provider may refer to it.(5) In this regulation \u201crecommend\u201d means recommend to the fostering service provider.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3601"},{"id":"3604","label":"Fostering - information about foster parent and prospective family","desc":"The following information is required as to prospective foster parent (\u201cX\u201d) and other members of their household and family:PART 11. Full name, address and date of birth.2. Details of health3. Particulars of any other adult members of the household.4. Particulars of the children in the family, whether or not members of the household, and any other children in the household.5. Particulars of their accommodation.6. The outcome of any request or application made by them or any other member of their household to foster or adopt children, or for registration as an early years provider or later years provider under Part 3 of the Childcare Act 2006(1), including particulars of any previous approval or refusal of approval relating to them or to any other member of the household.7. If X has, in the preceding twelve months, been a foster parent approved by another fostering service provider, the name and address of that fostering service provider.8. Names and addresses of two persons who will provide personal references for X.9. In relation to X and any other member of X\u2019s household who is aged 18 or over, an enhanced criminal record certificate issued under section 113B of the Police Act 1997 which includes suitability information relating to children (within the meaning of section 113BA(2) of that Act).10. Details of current, and any previous, marriage, civil partnership or similar relationship.PART 211. Details of personality.12. Religious persuasion, and capacity to care for a child from any particular religious persuasion.13. Racial origin, cultural and linguistic background and capacity to care for a child from any particular racial origin or cultural or linguistic background.14. Past and present employment or occupation, standard of living, leisure activities and interests.15. Previous experience (if any) of caring for their own and other children.16. Skills, competence and potential relevant to their capacity to care effectively for a child placed with them.\u201d.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3604"},{"id":"3600","label":"Fostering - meetings of fostering panel","desc":"No business may be conducted by a fostering panel unless at least the following meet as the panel:(i)either the person appointed to chair the panel or one of the vice chairs,(ii)one member who is a social worker who has at least three years\u2019 relevant post-qualifying experience, and(iii)three, or in the case of a fostering panel established under regulation 23(5) four, other members(2) A fostering panel must make a written record of its proceedings and the reasons for its recommendations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3600"},{"id":"3597","label":"Fostering - notification of offences","desc":"Where the registered person or the responsible individual is convicted of any criminal offence, whether in England and Wales or elsewhere, that person must as soon as is reasonably practicable give notice in writing to the Chief Inspector of the date and place of the conviction, the offence of which they were convicted, and the penalty imposed on them in respect of the offence.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3597"},{"id":"2017","label":"Fostering - power to prohibit private fostering","desc":"Where the local authority for the area within which the child is proposed to be, or is being, fostered are of the opinion that he is not a suitable person to foster a child; the premises in which the child will be, or is being, accommodated are not suitable; or it would be prejudicial to the welfare of the child for him to be, or continue to be, accommodated by that person in those premises, the authority may impose a prohibition on him","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2017"},{"id":"178","label":"Fostering - registration of private fosterers","desc":"Local authorities must comply with regulations regarding the registration and inspection of private fosterers.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/178"},{"id":"453","label":"Fostering - regulation of the exercise of relevant fostering functions","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations in relation to its exercise of its fostering functions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/453"},{"id":"3606","label":"Fostering - reviews and terminations of approval","desc":"The fostering service provider must review the approval of each foster parent in accordance with this regulation.A review must, where reasonably practicable, take place not more than a year after approval, and thereafter whenever the fostering service provider consider it necessary.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3606"},{"id":"3598","label":"Fostering - service manager","desc":"Each local authority must appoint one of its officers to manage the local authority fostering service, and must notify the Chief Inspector as soon as is reasonably practicable of the name of the person appointed, and the date on which the appointment is to take effect.The local authority must notify the Chief Inspector as soon as is reasonably practicable if the person appointed ceases to manage the local authority fostering service.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3598"},{"id":"3603","label":"Fostering - short breaks","desc":"In the circumstances set out below, these Regulations apply in relation to a child with the modifications set out in these Regulations.The circumstances are that the child:(a)is not in the care of a local authority, and(b)is placed in a series of short-term placements with the same foster parent (\u201cshort breaks\u201d), where\u2014(i)no single placement is intended to last for more than 17 days,(ii)at the end of each such placement the child returns to the care of the child\u2019s parent or a person who is not his parent but who has parental responsibility for the child,(iii)the short breaks do not exceed 75 days in total in any period of 12 months.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3603"},{"id":"3595","label":"Fostering - statement of purpose and children's guide","desc":"The fostering service provider must:(a)keep under review and, where appropriate, revise the statement of purpose and children\u2019s guide,(b)notify the Chief Inspector of any such revision as soon as is reasonably practicable, and(c)if the children\u2019s guide is revised, supply a copy to each foster parent approved by the fostering service provider, and to each child placed by them (subject to the child\u2019s age and understanding).","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3595"},{"id":"2932","label":"Fostering - staying put arrangements","desc":"A \u201cstaying put arrangement\u201d is an arrangement under which\u2014a person who is a former relevant child by virtue of section 23C(1)(b), anda person (a \u201cformer foster parent\u201d) who was the former relevant child's local authority foster parent immediately before the former relevant child ceased to be looked after by the local authority,continue to live together after the former relevant child has ceased to be looked after.It is the duty of the local authority (in discharging the duties in section 23C(3) and by other means)\u2014to monitor the staying put arrangement, andto provide advice, assistance and support to the former relevant child and the former foster parent with a view to maintaining the staying put arrangement.Support provided to the former foster parent under subsection (3)(b) must include financial support.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2932"},{"id":"2016","label":"Fostering - welfare of privately fostered children","desc":"It shall be the duty of every local authority to satisfy themselves that the welfare of children who are or are proposed to be privately fostered within their area is being or will be satisfactorily safeguarded and promoted and to secure that such advice is given to those as appears to the authority to be needed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2016"},{"id":"1888","label":"Further education - powers to supply goods and services through further education establishments","desc":"Empowers local authorities to supply goods and services through further education establishments and to make loans to certain other persons to enable them to do so","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1888"},{"id":"326","label":"Gambling - access by children to casino premises","desc":"A local authority must incorporate certain conditions, determined by the Commission, into certain premises licences regarding access by children.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/326"},{"id":"327","label":"Gambling - betting machines","desc":"A local authority may incorporate certain conditions into betting or casino premises licences regarding betting machines.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/327"},{"id":"317","label":"Gambling - charge for register entry copy","desc":"A local authority may charge a reasonable fee for providing a copy of entry or information from the register of gambling premises licences.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/317"},{"id":"347","label":"Gambling - charge for temporary use register copy","desc":"A local authority may make a reasonable charge for copies of information contained upon the register of temporary use notices.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/347"},{"id":"329","label":"Gambling - Christmas Day closure","desc":"A local authority must ensure that certain premises licences exclude gambling premises from operating on Christmas Day.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/329"},{"id":"349","label":"Gambling - club gaming and club machine permits","desc":"A local authority must comply with the regime for Club gaming permits and club machine permits.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/349"},{"id":"333","label":"Gambling - copy of premises licence","desc":"A licensing authority shall consider an application under this section as soon as is reasonably practicable and shall grant, and issue a copy licence, it if satisfied that the licence or summary to which the application relates has been lost, stolen or damaged, and where the licence or summary has been lost or stolen, that the loss or theft has been reported to the police.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/333"},{"id":"325","label":"Gambling - credit on licensed premises","desc":"A premises licence shall be subject to the condition that the licensee does not give credit in connection with gambling authorised by the licence, or participate in, arrange, permit or knowingly facilitate the giving of credit in connection with gambling authorised by the licence.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/325"},{"id":"315","label":"Gambling - delegation of licensing authority functions","desc":"A local authority must delegate certain functions to the licensing committee of the authority established under section 6 of the Licensing Act 2003.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/315"},{"id":"345","label":"Gambling - delegation of temporary use of premises functions","desc":"A local authority must delegate certain functions in respect of the temporary use of premises notice procedure to the licensing committee of the authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/345"},{"id":"319","label":"Gambling - determination of application","desc":"On considering an application for a premises licence (whether at a hearing or not) a licensing authority shall grant it, or reject it.. A local authority must hold a hearing to determine a gambling premises licence application in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/319"},{"id":"359","label":"Gambling - exchange of information with regard to licensing functions","desc":"A local authority may exchange information to another authorised body or person or to Her Majesty's Commissioners of Customs and Excise for use in the exercise of any function related to gambling licensing functions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/359"},{"id":"328","label":"Gambling - exclusion of children from track areas","desc":"A premises licence in respect of a track shall by virtue of this section be subject to the condition that the licensee shall ensure that children and young persons are excluded from any area where facilities for betting are provided, and any area where a gaming machine, other than a Category D machine, is situated.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/328"},{"id":"323","label":"Gambling - exclusion of licence conditions","desc":"A premises licence may not be subject to a condition (whether imposed by virtue of section 167, 168 or 169) requiring all or part of the premises, or any activity taking place on the premises, to be operated or carried on as a club or other body with membership, or restricting use of any part of the premises wholly or partly by reference to membership of a club or other body. A premises licence may not be subject to a condition (whether imposed by virtue of section 167, 168 or 169) imposing limits on stakes, fees, winnings, or prizes.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/323"},{"id":"348","label":"Gambling - family entertainment centre gaming machine permit","desc":"A local authority must comply with the regime for family entertainment gaming machine permits.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/348"},{"id":"324","label":"Gambling - gaming machines","desc":"A local authority must incorporate certain conditions into certain premises licences regarding gaming machines.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/324"},{"id":"312","label":"Gambling - guidance from Gambling Commission","desc":"A local authority must comply with guidance published from time to time by the Gambling Commission in relation to the exercise of its functions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/312"},{"id":"352","label":"Gambling - inspection of family entertainment centre","desc":"A constable, enforcement officer or authorised local authority officer may enter premises in respect of which an application has been made for a family entertainment centre gaming machine permit for a purpose connected with the consideration of the application or in respect of which a family entertainment centre gaming machine permit has effect for the purpose of determining whether the gaming machines used on the premises, and the arrangements for their use, comply with the requirements of this Act and regulations under it.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/352"},{"id":"355","label":"Gambling - inspection of premises for prize gaming permit","desc":"A constable, enforcement officer or authorised local authority officer may enter premises in respect of which an application has been made for a prize gaming permit for a purpose connected with the consideration of the application. A constable, enforcement officer or authorised local authority officer may enter premises in respect of which a prize gaming permit has effect for the purposes of determining whether prize gaming on the premises complies with the requirements of this Act and regulations under it.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/355"},{"id":"353","label":"Gambling - inspection of premises licensed for alcohol","desc":"A local authority may authorise an officer to enter a premises licensed for alcohol for certain purposes.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/353"},{"id":"356","label":"Gambling - inspection of premises of society registered for lotteries","desc":"A local authority may authorise an officer to enter premises of registered lottery societies in certain circumstances for certain purposes.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/356"},{"id":"336","label":"Gambling - lapse of premises licence","desc":"If a licensing authority become aware that a premises licence issued by them has lapsed, they shall as soon as is reasonably practicable notify the Commission, the chief officer of police for any area in which the premises are wholly or partly situated and Her Majesty's Commissioners of Customs and Excise.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/336"},{"id":"354","label":"Gambling - licensed premises gaming machine permits","desc":"A local authority must comply with the regime for gaming machine permits.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/354"},{"id":"313","label":"Gambling - licensing authority information","desc":"A local authority must provide the Gambling Commission with information in relation to the exercise of its functions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/313"},{"id":"320","label":"Gambling - notice of grant or rejection of gambling premises licence","desc":"A local authority must give notice of the grant or rejection of a gambling premises licence in the prescribed form to the applicant, the Commission, any person who made representations about the application under section 161, the chief officer of police for any area in which the premises are wholly or partly situated and Her Majesty's Commissioners of Customs and Excise.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/320"},{"id":"341","label":"Gambling - planning permission and premises licence","desc":"In making a decision in respect of an application under this part a licensing authority shall not have regard to whether or not a proposal by the applicant is likely to be permitted in accordance with the law relating to planning or building. A decision by a licensing authority under this Part shall not constrain any later decision by the authority under the law relating to planning or building.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/341"},{"id":"314","label":"Gambling - premises licence","desc":"A local authority must aim to permit the use of premises for gambling in so far as the authority think in accordance with any relevant code of practice, any relevant guidance issued by the Commission and in a manner which is reasonably consistent with the licensing objectives and in accordance with the statement published by the authority under section 349.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/314"},{"id":"330","label":"Gambling - premises licence annual fee","desc":"A local authority must charge a premises licence holder a first annual fee within such period after the issue of the licence as may be prescribed, and an annual fee before each anniversary of the issue of the licence. The amount of the fee should be as prescribed by regulations made by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/330"},{"id":"322","label":"Gambling - premises licence conditions","desc":"A local authority must attach mandatory conditions to a gambling premises licences and default conditions in certain circumstances as prescribed by regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/322"},{"id":"343","label":"Gambling - premises licence fees","desc":"A local authority has must comply with regulations regarding fees to be charged.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/343"},{"id":"351","label":"Gambling - prize gaming permit","desc":"A local authority must comply with the regime for prize gaming permits.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/351"},{"id":"357","label":"Gambling - prosecution by licensing authority","desc":"A local authority may institute criminal proceedings in respect of an offence under stipulated provisions of the Gambling Act 2005.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/357"},{"id":"339","label":"Gambling - provisional statement for premises licence","desc":"A local authority must issue a provisional statement in respect of a premises licence where the applicant expects the premises to be constructed, expects the premises to be altered or expects to acquire a right to occupy the premises.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/339"},{"id":"337","label":"Gambling - re-instatement of premises licence","desc":"A licensing authority shall grant an application for reinstatement unless they think it would be wrong to do so having regard to representations made.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/337"},{"id":"316","label":"Gambling - register of premises licences","desc":"A local authority must maintain a register of premises licences in the manner prescribed and make information available to members of the public.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/316"},{"id":"350","label":"Gambling - removal of exemption","desc":"A local authority may remove certain statutory exemptions to the need to have certain gaming licences if certain conditions are met.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/350"},{"id":"318","label":"Gambling - representations in relation to licence application","desc":"Where an application is made to a licensing authority for a premises licence, an interested party or responsible authority in relation to the premises may make representations in writing to the licensing authority.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/318"},{"id":"321","label":"Gambling - resolution not to issue casino licences","desc":"A licensing authority may resolve not to issue casino premises licences.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/321"},{"id":"338","label":"Gambling - review of premises licence","desc":"A local authority must carry out a review of a premises licence in certain circumstances and determine that review.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/338"},{"id":"335","label":"Gambling - revocation of premises licence for failure to pay fee","desc":"A local authority must, revoke a premises licence where the holder has failed to pay the prescribed fee, unless non-payment was as a result of administrative error.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/335"},{"id":"340","label":"Gambling - stay pending appeal for premises licence","desc":"A local authority may direct that the stay on a determination pending an appeal be lifted.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/340"},{"id":"334","label":"Gambling - surrender of premises licence","desc":"As soon as is reasonably practicable after receipt of notification from the licensee that they wish to surrender a licence the licensing authority shall notify the Commission, the chief officer of police for any area in which the premises are wholly or partly situated and Her Majesty's Commissioners of Customs and Excise.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/334"},{"id":"344","label":"Gambling - temporary use notice","desc":"A local authority must comply with the temporary use of premises notice procedure.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/344"},{"id":"346","label":"Gambling - temporary use register","desc":"A local authority must maintain, update and make available a register of temporary use notices and follow any regulations made by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/346"},{"id":"358","label":"Gambling - three year licensing policy","desc":"A local authority must prepare and publish a three year licensing policy statement, review the same and comply with regulations published by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/358"},{"id":"332","label":"Gambling - transfer of premises licence","desc":"A licensing authority shall grant an application for transfer unless they think it would be wrong to do so having regard to representations made.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/332"},{"id":"331","label":"Gambling - variation to licence","desc":"A local authority may vary a premises licence having been notified of a change of circumstances or a request for variation from the licence holder.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/331"},{"id":"1870","label":"Gas and water pipes - requirement to move","desc":"A local authority may by notice, at its expense, require gas and water pipes to be moved.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1870"},{"id":"2156","label":"Gifts of property - acceptance and improvement","desc":"A local authority may accept, hold and administer for the purpose of discharging any of their functions, gifts of property, whether real or personal, made for that purpose; or for the benefit of the inhabitants of their area and may execute any work incidental to or consequential on the exercise of that power.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2156"},{"id":"4085","label":"Grants for bus services","desc":"(1) A local transport authority whose area is in England may make grants to operators of the services mentioned in (2) towards their costs in operating those services in that area.(2) The services are\u2014(a) local services which have one or more stopping places in the authority's area, and(b) services which have one or more stopping places in the authority's area and would be local services but for section 2(4)(b) of the Transport Act 1985.(3) Grants under this section are to be of such amount and subject to such conditions (including conditions requiring their repayment in specified circumstances) as may be determined by the authority.(4) If a local transport authority is a mayoral combined authority, the function under (1) is a function of the combined authority exercisable only by the mayor acting on behalf of the combined authority.(5) If a local transport authority is a mayoral CCA, the function under (1) is a function of the combined county authority exercisable only by the mayor acting on behalf of the combined county authority.When awarding grants the local authority must have regard to guidance from the Secretary of State.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/4085"},{"id":"608","label":"Gypsies and travellers - preparation of strategy for accommodation needs","desc":"A local authority must where it is required under section 87 of the Local Government Act 2003 to prepare a strategy in respect of the meeting of such accommodation needs, take that strategy into account when exercising its functions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/608"},{"id":"607","label":"Gypsies and travellers - review of accommodation needs","desc":"A local authority must incorporate a review of the housing needs of gypsies and travellers into their review carried out under section 8 of the Housing Act 1985.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/607"},{"id":"2193","label":"Hackney carriage - bye laws for regulating hackney carriages","desc":"A local authority may make bye laws governing hackney carriages.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2193"},{"id":"2192","label":"Hackney carriage - driver's licences","desc":"A local authority may licence a driver of a hackney carriage in accordance with the prescribed procedure.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2192"},{"id":"2189","label":"Hackney carriage - licences","desc":"A local authority may licence a hackney carriage in accordance with the prescribed procedure.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2189"},{"id":"2190","label":"Hackney carriage - register of licences","desc":"A local authority must maintain a register of hackney carriage licences.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2190"},{"id":"2191","label":"Hackney carriage - suspension or revocation of licences","desc":"A local authority may suspend or revoke a hackney carriage licence for misconduct of the proprietor or driver in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2191"},{"id":"1502","label":"Hackney carriages - application of Part II","desc":"A local authority may resolve that Part II of the Act in relation to hackney carriages and private hire vehicles shall apply to its area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1502"},{"id":"1515","label":"Hackney carriages - fixing of fares","desc":"A local authority may fix the rates or fares of hackney carriages.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1515"},{"id":"1503","label":"Hackney carriages - licensing","desc":"A local authority may attach conditions to the grant of a hackney carriage licence.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1503"},{"id":"1514","label":"Hackney carriages - stands upon the highway","desc":"A local authority may place stands for hackney carriages upon the highway.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1514"},{"id":"1517","label":"Hackney carriages and private hire vehicles - fees for vehicle or operator's licence","desc":"A local authority may charge fees for the issue of a vehicle or operator's licence.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1517"},{"id":"1509","label":"Hackney carriages and private hire vehicles - information from licence applicants","desc":"A local authority may require information from applicants for licences.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1509"},{"id":"1505","label":"Hackney carriages and private hire vehicles - information, inspections and testing","desc":"A local authority may, in certain circumstances, require information regarding and the inspection and testing of hackney carriages and private hire vehicles.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1505"},{"id":"1516","label":"Hackney carriages and private hire vehicles - inspection and testing","desc":"An officer authorised by a local authority may inspect and test hackney carriage or private hire vehicles.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1516"},{"id":"1506","label":"Hackney carriages and private hire vehicles - licensing of drivers","desc":"A local authority must only licence (subject to conditions or otherwise) the drivers of hackney carriages and private hire vehicles in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1506"},{"id":"1508","label":"Hackney carriages and private hire vehicles - licensing of operators","desc":"A local authority must only licence (subject to conditions or otherwise) the operators of hackney carriages and private hire vehicles provided they are satisfied that the applicant is a fit and proper person to hold an operator's licence.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1508"},{"id":"1507","label":"Hackney carriages and private hire vehicles - register of drivers","desc":"A local authority must maintain a register of drivers of hackney carriages and private hire vehicles.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1507"},{"id":"1510","label":"Hackney carriages and private hire vehicles - return of plate or disc","desc":"A local authority may require the return of an identification plate or disc upon expiry or revocation of a licence.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1510"},{"id":"1512","label":"Hackney carriages and private hire vehicles - suspension or revocation of driver's licence","desc":"A local authority may suspend or revoke a hackney carriage or private hire vehicle driver's licence in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1512"},{"id":"1513","label":"Hackney carriages and private hire vehicles - suspension or revocation of operator's licence","desc":"A local authority may suspend or revoke a hackney carriage or private hire vehicle operator's licence in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1513"},{"id":"1511","label":"Hackney carriages and private hire vehicles - suspension or revocation of vehicle licences","desc":"A local authority may suspend or revoke a hackney carriage or private hire vehicle licence in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1511"},{"id":"2110","label":"Hallmarking - enforcement","desc":"A local authority must enforce the Hallmarks Act 1973 and may utilise certain powers under schedule 5 of the Consumer Rights Act 2015 in order to do so.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2110"},{"id":"3055","label":"Health - consistent identifiers","desc":"A local authority must comply with Regulations relating to consistent identifiers.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3055"},{"id":"3056","label":"Health - sharing of information","desc":"A local authority must disclose information in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3056"},{"id":"1586","label":"Health and care - financial assistance to voluntary organisations","desc":"A local authority may give financial assistance to certain voluntary organisations in respect of certain health and care activities.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1586"},{"id":"1585","label":"Health and care workers - training","desc":"A local authority must ensure that certain health and care workers comply with training prescribed by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1585"},{"id":"2653","label":"Health and safety - labelling of biocidal products","desc":"A local authority (weights and measures authority) is the enforcing authority regarding labelling of products in English and regarding the use of active substances without authorisation and other Articles of the Biocides Regulations prescribed where any biocidal product is placed on the market in a shop, mobile vehicle, market stall or other retail outlet; or otherwise to members of the public or as otherwise prescribed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2653"},{"id":"1967","label":"Health and safety - maintaining of and access to registers of notices","desc":"Duty of those with duties/powers under the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, Safety of Sports Grounds Act 1975, Food and Environment Protection Act 1985 and The Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005 to maintain an indexed register of relevant notices open for inspection by the public free of charge at all reasonable hours","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1967"},{"id":"368","label":"Health and social care - appointment of mental capacity advocate","desc":"A local authority must in certain prescribed circumstances appoint an independent mental capacity advocate when dealing with certain issues relating to residential accommodation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/368"},{"id":"367","label":"Health and social care - independent advocacy services","desc":"A local authority must make arrangements it considers appropriate for independent advocacy services in its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/367"},{"id":"364","label":"Health and social care - joint strategic needs assessments","desc":"A local authority must prepare a health and social care joint strategic needs assessment and well-being strategy, co-operate with its partners and publish the same when required to do so by the Secretary of State and must have regard to those strategies when exercising its functions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/364"},{"id":"366","label":"Health and social care - local involvement networks","desc":"A local authority must make prescribed arrangements for its area relating to the commissioning, promoting, provision and scrutiny of local care services.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/366"},{"id":"2343","label":"Health and social services - charges for local authority services","desc":"A local authority may recover such charge (if any) for it as they consider reasonable when providing a service under paragraph 1 of Part II of Schedule 9 to this Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2343"},{"id":"3665","label":"Health emergency - approval of directions in respect of Crown Land","desc":"A local authority may not, without the agreement of the appropriate authority, give a direction under regulation 6(1) in relation to a public outdoor place which forms part of Crown land and includes property to which section 73 of the Public Health (Control of Disease) Act 1984 (Crown property) applies.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3665"},{"id":"3659","label":"Health emergency - county directions to district","desc":"(1) A county council for an area for which there is also a district council may direct the district council to exercise any of the district council's functions in a specified way.(2) But a county council may only give a direction under this regulation if it considers that it is necessary and proportionate to do so in order to prevent, protect against, delay or otherwise control the incidence or spread of infection by coronavirus in the district council's area.(3) A direction under this regulation may be varied or revoked by the county council.(4) In determining whether to give a direction under this regulation, or to vary or revoke such a direction, a county council must have regard to any advice given to it by(a) its director of public health or its interim or acting director of public health (as the case may be), or(b) a registered public health consultant approved for the purposes of this regulation by a person mentioned in sub-paragraph (a).","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3659"},{"id":"3667","label":"Health emergency - directions on prohibitions on public outdoor places","desc":"A local authority may give a direction imposing prohibitions, requirements or restrictions in relation to access to a specified public outdoor place in its area, or public outdoor places in its area of a specified description.Such a direction may in particular prohibit access at specified times.A direction must:- specify or describe the public outdoor place or places to which it relates in sufficient detail to enable the boundaries of the place or places to be determined- state the date and time on which any prohibition, requirement or restriction imposed by the direction comes into effect, and the date and time on which it will end, and- give details of the right of appeal to a magistrates' court, and the time within which such an appeal may be brought.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3667"},{"id":"3674","label":"Health emergency - duty to comply with Secretary of State","desc":"A local authority must give a direction in relation to the imminent threat of a public health emergency where directed to do so by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3674"},{"id":"3661","label":"Health emergency - fixed penalty notice for local restrictions","desc":"A person authorised by a local authority may issue a fixed penalty notice to anyone that the authorised person reasonably believes has committed an offence under these Regulations, and is aged 18 or over.A fixed penalty notice is a notice offering the person to whom it is issued the opportunity of discharging any liability to conviction for the offence by payment of a fixed penalty to an authority specified in the notice.The authority specified in the notice must be the local authority (or as the case may be, any of the local authorities) in whose area the offence is alleged to have been committed (\"the relevant local authority\"), or an officer designated by the Secretary of State, or by the relevant local authority, for the purposes of this regulation. The amount of the fixed penalty is as specified in Regulations","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3661"},{"id":"3664","label":"Health emergency - giving and publishing directions","desc":"Where a local authority gives a direction under regulation 4(1), 5(1) or 6(1) which imposes a prohibition, requirement or restriction on a person specified by name, or revokes such a direction, the direction or notice of revocation must be given in writing to that person, andmay be published in such manner as the local authority considers appropriate to bring it to the attention of other persons who may be affected by it.In any other case, a direction given by a local authority under regulation 4(1), 5(1) or 6(1) or notice of revocation of such a direction must be published on the website of the local authority, and may be published in such other manner as the local authority considers appropriate to bring it to the attention of persons who may be affected by the direction or the revocation.A direction given by a local authority under regulation 4(1), 5(1) or 6(1) must specify the power in these Regulations under which the direction is given.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3664"},{"id":"3672","label":"Health emergency - giving of directions","desc":"Where they consider that there is an imminent threat to public health a local authority may give directions on the imposition of prohibitions, requirements or restrictions in relation to:- the entry into, departure from, or location of persons in, specified premises in the local authority\u2019s area- the holding of an event in its area- access to a specified public outdoor place in its area, or public outdoor places in its area of a specified description.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3672"},{"id":"3663","label":"Health emergency - notification of directions","desc":"Where a local authority (the \"initiating authority\") gives a direction under regulation 4(1), 5(1) or 6(1), or revokes such a direction, the initiating authority must notify: (a) any local authority whose area is adjacent to the initiating authority's area,(b) where the initiating authority is a London borough council, every other London borough council,(c) where the initiating authority is the county council for an area for which there is also a district council, the district council, and(d) where the initiating authority's area is adjacent to the area of a council in Scotland constituted under section 2 of the Local Government etc (Scotland) Act 1994 or a county or county borough council in Wales, that council.Where a local authority is notified under paragraph (1)(a) or (b), the authority must:(a) consider, as soon as may be reasonably practicable, whether to exercise its own powers under these Regulations,(b) notify the initiating authority of what it has decided to do, and(c) if it is a county council for an area for which there is also a district council, notify the district council of the matter notified to it by the initiating authority and of its own decision.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3663"},{"id":"3673","label":"Health emergency - notification, review and revocation of directions","desc":"Where a local authority has given directions in response to a serious and imminent threat to public health the authority must:- notify the Secretary of State as soon as reasonably practicable after the direction is given- at least once every 7 days review whether the threat to public health still exists- revoke the direction where the conditions under which it was given no longer apply","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3673"},{"id":"3662","label":"Health emergency - prohibition notices","desc":"A local authority designated officer or a constable may take such action as is necessary to enforce a direction under regulation 4(1), 5(1) or 6(1).A local authority designated officer may give a prohibition notice to a person if the officer reasonably believes that\u2014(a) the person is contravening a direction under regulation 4(1) or 5(1), and (b) it is necessary and proportionate to give the prohibition notice for the purpose of preventing that person from continuing to do so. \"Local authority designated officer\" means a person designated by a local authority for the purposes of this regulation.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3662"},{"id":"3668","label":"Health emergency - prohibitions, requirements or restrictions on events","desc":"A local authority may give a direction imposing prohibitions, requirements or restrictions in relation to the holding of an event in its area.(2) A direction may be given in relation to a specified event, or events of a specified description.(3) A direction may only have the effect of imposing prohibitions, requirements or restrictions on:- the owner or any occupier of premises for an event to which the direction relates,- the organiser of such an event, and- any other person involved in holding such an event.A direction may, among other things, impose requirements about informing persons who may be planning to attend an event of any prohibitions, requirements or restrictions imposed in relation to the holding of it.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3668"},{"id":"3666","label":"Health emergency - restriction of access to a public outdoor place","desc":"A local authority which has given a direction under regulation 6(1) must take reasonable steps to prevent or restrict public access to the public outdoor place or places to which the direction relates in accordance with the direction.Any person, other than a local authority mentioned in paragraph (1), who owns, occupies or is responsible for land in a public outdoor place to which a direction under regulation 6(1) relates must take reasonable steps to prevent or restrict public access to that land in accordance with the direction.No person may without reasonable excuse enter or remain in a public outdoor place to which a direction under regulation 6(1) relates in contravention of a prohibition, requirement or restriction imposed by the direction.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3666"},{"id":"3669","label":"Health emergency - restrictions on premises","desc":"A local authority may give a direction imposing prohibitions, requirements or restrictions in relation to the entry into, departure from, or location of persons in, specified premises in the local authority's area.A direction may be given only for the purposes of closing the premises, restricting entry to the premises, or securing restrictions in relation to the location of persons in the premises.Conditions which must be complied with when issuing directions are specified in the Regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3669"},{"id":"3660","label":"Health emergency -proceedings for an offence","desc":"Proceedings for an offence under these Regulations may be brought by a local authority, the Crown Prosecution Service and any person designated by the Secretary of State (but this does not affect any other power to bring proceedings for such an offence).","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3660"},{"id":"3679","label":"Health protection - collection of group contact details","desc":"Where a group of individuals enter premises providing services other than for exempt purposes a local authority running services from the premises must either collect information from each individual who has not scanned the QR code or is unable to do so because of health or disability or is under aged 16 or:a relevant person must request that a single member of the group provides those details in place of any other member of the group doing so. Contact details, the time and place of entry and the number of people in the group must be recorded.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3679"},{"id":"3678","label":"Health protection - collection of individual contact details","desc":"The local authority has a duty to collect required contact details from anyone entering indoor or outdoor premises run by the authority providing services to customers. Certain types of visit are exempt from the requirement and details do not need to be collected where an individual has scanned the QR code, is unable to do so because of health or disability or is under 16.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3678"},{"id":"3681","label":"Health protection - disclosure of contact details records","desc":"A local authority must disclose records of contact details collected pursuant to these regulations when required to do so by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3681"},{"id":"3685","label":"Health protection - enforcement and prohibition notices","desc":"A local authority may designate a relevant person to take such action as is necessary to enforce the requirement to close premises and businesses during the emergency.A relevant person may take such action as is necessary to enforce any requirement imposed by Regulation 4, 4A or 4B.A relevant person may give a prohibition notice to a person if the relevant person reasonably believes that\u2014(a) the person is contravening a requirement in Regulation 4, 4A or 4B, and(b) it is necessary and proportionate to give the prohibition notice for the purpose of preventing that person from continuing to contravene the requirement.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3685"},{"id":"3593","label":"Health protection - enforcement of regulations","desc":"A local authority may designate a relevant person to take such action as is necessary to enforce any requirement imposed by regulation 4 or 5 of these Regulations.Regulation 4 being the requirement to close premises and businesses during the emergency.Regulation 5 being further restrictions and closures during the emergency period.A relevant person may give a prohibition notice to a person if the relevant person reasonably believes that:(a) the person is contravening a requirement in regulation 4 or 5, and(b) it is necessary and proportionate to give the prohibition notice for the purpose of preventing that person from continuing to contravene the requirement.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3593"},{"id":"3691","label":"Health protection -
