enforcement of self-isolation regulations","desc":"A person authorised by a local authority may, where the authorised person considers that P is away from the place that they are self-isolating in contravention of regulation 2, the authorised person may direct P to return to the place where they are self-isolating, or remove P to the place that they are self-isolating.An authorised person may use reasonable force, if necessary, in exercise of the power.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3691"},{"id":"3686","label":"Health protection - fixed penalty notice relating to closures and access to public places","desc":"A local authority may designate an authorised person to issue fixed penalty notices in relation to an alleged offence arising from a breach the requirements imposed by these regulations or the obstruction of a person carrying out a function under regulations related to premises closures or access to public spaces.The conditions under which a fixed penalty notice can be issued and the amount of the fixed penalty are as specified in these regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3686"},{"id":"3594","label":"Health protection - fixed penalty notices","desc":"A local authority may designate an authorised person to issue fixed penalty notices in relation to an alleged offence arising from a breach the requirements imposed by regulation 4 or 5 of these Regulations.An authorised person may issue a fixed penalty notice to anyone that the authorised person reasonably believes has committed an offence under Regulation 4 or 5 of these Regulations and is aged 18 or over.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3594"},{"id":"3683","label":"Health protection - fixed penalty notices for contact details offences","desc":"An authorised person may issue a fixed penalty notice to anyone that the authorised person reasonably believes\u2014 (a)has committed an offence under these Regulations, and(b)is aged 18 or over.The authority in the notice must be\u2014 (a)the local authority, (or as the case may be, any of the local authorities), in whose area the offence is alleged to have been committed (\u201cthe relevant local authority\u201d), or(b)an officer designated by the Secretary of State, or by the relevant local authority, for the purposes of this regulation (\u201cthe designated officer\u201d).The content of the fixed penalty notice and the amount of the fixed penalty must be as specified in these Regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3683"},{"id":"3692","label":"Health protection - fixed penalty notices regarding self-isolation","desc":"A person authorised by a local authority may, issue a fixed penalty notice to anyone that the authorised person reasonably believes has committed an offence under these Regulations. The conditions for issuing and the amount of a fixed penalty are detailed in Regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3692"},{"id":"3689","label":"Health protection - fixed penalty notices relating to hospitality settings","desc":"Where a hospitality setting has committed a breach of the requirements of the Regulations an authorised person may issue a fixed penalty notice.The authority specified in the notice must be either the local authority (or as the case may be, any of the local authorities) in whose area the offence is alleged to have been committed or an officer designated by the Secretary of State, or by the relevant local authority, for the purposes of this regulation.The procedures for issuing a fixed penalty notice and the amount of the penalty should be as described in the Regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3689"},{"id":"3688","label":"Health protection - food and drink premises","desc":"A local authority where it is responsible for carrying on a business of a public house, caf\u00e9, restaurant or other relevant business must, during the emergency period, take all reasonable measures to ensure that\u2014 (a)no bookings for a table are accepted for a group of more than six persons unless one of the exemptions in regulation 5 of the Principal Regulations applies;(b)no persons are admitted to the premises in a group of more than six, unless one of the exemptions in regulation 5 of the Principal Regulations applies;(c)no person in one qualifying group mingles with any person in another qualifying group where this is not permitted under the Principal Regulations;(d)an appropriate distance is maintained between tables occupied by different qualifying groups.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3688"},{"id":"3684","label":"Health protection - proceedings for an offence","desc":"Proceedings for an offence related to the collection of contact details under these Regulations may be brought by a local authority and the Crown Prosecution Service.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3684"},{"id":"3693","label":"Health protection - prosecutions regarding self-isolation","desc":"A local authority may commence criminal proceedings in respect of an offence under these Regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3693"},{"id":"3677","label":"Health protection - provision of QR code for collection of contact details","desc":"A local authority running any services included in these regulations from indoor or outdoor premises must display and make available a QR code at relevant premises with a view to enabling an individual to scan the QR code.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3677"},{"id":"3682","label":"Health protection - refusal of entry","desc":"Where the local authority (in respect of their property from which the Service is run) becomes aware that either:- an individual has not provided the details required by these regulations, having been requested to do so in accordance with regulations or - where it becomes aware that no member of a group has provided the required details, at least one of them having been requested to do soit must take all reasonable steps to prevent entry by an individual to the relevant premises that they occupy or operate or by every member of a group which seeks to enter those premises.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3682"},{"id":"3680","label":"Health protection - retention and destruction of contact details records","desc":"A local authority must retain, securely, the details provided to, or recorded by, them in respect of contact details for a period of 21 days beginning with the day on which the details are provided.The authority must then destroy those details as soon as is reasonably practicable after the expiry of the 21 day period unless there is another basis on which the details may lawfully be retained.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3680"},{"id":"3690","label":"Health protection - self-isolation notifications","desc":"A local authority may appoint officers to deal with notifications from people who are self-isolating","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3690"},{"id":"3694","label":"Health protection - sharing of information","desc":"A local authority may share certain information collected under these Regulations in the following circumstances-An authorised person may disclose relevant information regarding an individual required to self-isolate, to any person (H) for the purposes of carrying out a function under these Regulations, or preventing danger to the health of the public as a result of the spread of infection or contamination with coronavirus or coronavirus disease.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3694"},{"id":"3687","label":"Health protection - temporary restrictions on businesses/services","desc":"A local authority where it is responsible for carrying on any of the businesses or facilities referred to in these regulations must carry on that business or to provide that service in accordance with restrictions on: -Opening hours- Selling for consumption off premises- Timing of cinema, theatre or concert hall performances- Motorway service areas- Sale of food and alcohol to seated customers only","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3687"},{"id":"1484","label":"Heat and electricity production and supply","desc":"A local authority may generate, buy or sell heat, electricity or both and acquire and or invest in land and equipment to enable them to do so and pass byelaws in respect of the same.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1484"},{"id":"2585","label":"Higher education - bursary payment","desc":"A local authority may pay the bursary of \u00a32,000 payable to a former relevant child who begins a higher education course on or after 1 September 2010 in accordance with their pathway plan as a lump sum or by instalments, within prescribed time limits.The authority may withhold any unpaid element when the former child is not pursuing the higher education course in accordance with their pathway plan.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2585"},{"id":"2310","label":"Highway finance - contributions by councils towards expenses of highway authorities","desc":"A council may contribute towards any expenses incurred or to be incurred by a highway authority if, in the opinion of the council, the expenditure is or will be of benefit to the council's area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2310"},{"id":"2309","label":"Highway finance - contributions by county councils to expenses of district councils","desc":"The council of a county may contribute towards the expenses incurred by the council of any district in the county in exercise of their powers to plant trees, lay out grass verges, etc","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2309"},{"id":"2311","label":"Highway finance - contributions by parish or community councils for traffic calming","desc":"A parish council or community council may contribute towards any expenses incurred or to be incurred by a highway authority in constructing, removing or maintaining traffic calming works, or other works (including signs or lighting) required in connection with traffic calming works, if, in the opinion of the council, the expenditure is or will be of benefit to their area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2311"},{"id":"2302","label":"Highways - acquisition of land between improvement line and boundary of street","desc":"Where a highway authority have prescribed an improvement line they may acquire any land, not occupied by buildings, lying between the improvement line and the boundary of the street.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2302"},{"id":"2306","label":"Highways - acquisition of land for buildings etc. needed for discharge of functions of highway authority","desc":"A local highway authority may acquire land, whether situated within or without their area, which in their opinion is required for the provision of any buildings or facilities needed for the purposes of their functions as a highway authority","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2306"},{"id":"2304","label":"Highways - acquisition of land for cattle-grids etc.","desc":"A highway authority may acquire land which they require for the purpose of providing, altering or improving a cattle-grid or bypass","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2304"},{"id":"2300","label":"Highways - acquisition of land for construction or improvement of highway : general powers","desc":"Any highway authority may acquire land required for the construction of a highway which is to be a highway maintainable at the public expense, other than a trunk road.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2300"},{"id":"2301","label":"Highways - acquisition of land for construction or improvement of highway: further general powers","desc":"A highway authority may acquire land which is required for use by them in connection with the construction or improvement of a highway, or with the carrying out of works authorised by an order relating to a trunk road. The authority may also acquire land for the purposes of diverting a watercourse, providing public sanitary conveniences or for a lorry area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2301"},{"id":"2303","label":"Highways - acquisition of land for execution of works in connection with certain bridges","desc":"A highway authority may acquire land which they require to enable them to comply with a requirement or direction contained in an order to construct as part of a trunk road a highway for the purpose of relieving a main carriageway of the trunk road from local traffic.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2303"},{"id":"2307","label":"Highways - acquisition of land for mitigating adverse effects of constructing or improving highway","desc":"A highway authority may acquire land for the purpose of mitigating any adverse effect which the existence or use of a highway constructed or improved by them, or proposed to be constructed or improved by them, has or will have on the surroundings of the highway.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2307"},{"id":"2305","label":"Highways - acquisition of land for road-ferries","desc":"A highway authority may acquire land which they require for the purpose of providing or improving a road-ferry in the exercise of powers conferred on them by this Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2305"},{"id":"2518","label":"Highways - adoption by agreement","desc":"A local authority may adopt a highway by agreement","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2518"},{"id":"2197","label":"Highways - agreement for exercise by Minister of certain functions where impacted by trunk road","desc":"The Minister or a strategic highway company may enter into an agreement in certain circumstances for the Minister to provide functions usually exercisable by the authority.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2197"},{"id":"2198","label":"Highways - agreement for local highway authority to maintain certain highways constructed by Minister","desc":"The local highway authority may by agreement with the Minister undertake the maintenance and improvement of a highway in their area, being a highway (other than a trunk road) which the Minister or a Strategic Highway Company propose to construct or has, whether before or after the commencement of this Act, constructed.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2198"},{"id":"2241","label":"Highways - agreement with bridge owner","desc":"A highway authority may agree with the owners of a bridge for the payment by the highway authority of contributions towards the cost of the reconstruction, improvement or maintenance of the bridge, or of the highway carried by the bridge, or of the approaches to the bridge","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2241"},{"id":"2313","label":"Highways - agreements as to execution of works","desc":"A highway authority may, if they are satisfied it will be of benefit to the public, enter into an agreement with any person for the execution by the authority of any works which the authority are or may be authorised to execute, or for the execution by the authority of such works incorporating particular modifications, additions or features, or at a particular time or in a particular manner, on terms that that person pays the whole or such part of the cost of the works as may be specified in or determined in accordance with the agreement.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2313"},{"id":"2308","label":"Highways - agreements as to use of land near highways","desc":"The highway authority may enter into an agreement with any person interested in land adjoining or in the vicinity of the highway for restricting or regulating the use of the land either permanently or during such period as may be specified in the agreement.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2308"},{"id":"2199","label":"Highways - agreements between local highway authorities for doing of certain works","desc":"Local highway authorities may enter into agreements with each other or with a Strategic Highway Company for or in relation to the construction, reconstruction, alteration, improvement or maintenance of a highway for which any party to the agreement are the highway authority.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2199"},{"id":"2231","label":"Highways - alteration of levels","desc":"A highway authority may raise or lower or otherwise alter, as they think fit, the level of a highway maintainable at the public expense by them.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2231"},{"id":"2314","label":"Highways - borrowing power of councils","desc":"A council may borrow for the purposes of this Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2314"},{"id":"2228","label":"Highways - building line","desc":"A highway authority may prescribe, in relation to either one side or both sides of a highway maintainable at the public expense for which they are the highway authority, a frontage line for building","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2228"},{"id":"3204","label":"Highways - building materials licence","desc":"The highway authority may issue a licence to permit the deposit of building materials on the highway or to allow the excavation of streets, either with or without conditions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3204"},{"id":"2619","label":"Highways - charging for street works","desc":"A local authority which is an \u201cApproved Authority\u201d may deduct from charges received from undertakers pursuant to the Regulations, its reasonable costs of operating and evaluating the effectiveness of the scheme under which they are paid. It must apply the net proceeds for purposes intended to reduce the disruption and other adverse effects caused by street works and must keep and publish yearly accounts of sums received by way of charges.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2619"},{"id":"2298","label":"Highways - compensation for damage caused by execution of private street works","desc":"A street works authority shall pay compensation to any person who sustains damage by reason of the execution of street works by the authority under the private street works code.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2298"},{"id":"2201","label":"Highways - compensation for works carried out","desc":"Where a local highway authority conduct works in certain circumstances, they shall pay compensation to a person who sustains damage by reason of the works","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2201"},{"id":"2219","label":"Highways - construction and maintenance of cycle tracks","desc":"A highway authority may, in or by the side of a highway maintainable at the public expense by them which consists of or comprises a made-up carriageway, construct a cycle track as part of the highway; and they may light any cycle track constructed by them under this section.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2219"},{"id":"2218","label":"Highways - construction and maintenance of dual carriageways and roundabouts","desc":"Where a highway maintainable at the public expense consists of or comprises a made-up carriageway, the highway authority liable to maintain it may construct and maintain works in that carriageway along any length of the highway, for separating a part of the carriageway which is to be used by traffic moving in one direction from a part of the carriageway which is to be used (whether at all times or at particular times only) by traffic moving in the other direction or at crossroads or other junctions, for regulating the movement of traffic.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2218"},{"id":"2239","label":"Highways - construction of bridge to carry existing highway","desc":"A highway authority may construct a bridge to carry a highway maintainable at the public expense but the Minister shall not construct such a bridge without the approval of the Treasury.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2239"},{"id":"2237","label":"Highways - construction of road humps","desc":"A highway authority may construct road humps in a highway maintainable at the public expense for which they are the highway authority if the highway is subject to a statutory speed limit for motor vehicles of 30 miles per hour or less and may remove any road humps so constructed by them.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2237"},{"id":"2224","label":"Highways - construction, lighting and maintenance of bridges","desc":"In certain circumstances the highway authority for any highway may, construct, light and maintain a bridge over the highway for the use of pedestrians, and may alter, remove or close temporarily any such bridge.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2224"},{"id":"2223","label":"Highways - construction, lighting and maintenance of subways","desc":"In certain circumstances the highway authority for the highway may construct, light and maintain subways under the highway for the use of pedestrians, and may alter, remove or close temporarily any such subway.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2223"},{"id":"2299","label":"Highways - contribution by street works authority to expenses of private street works","desc":"A street works authority may at any time resolve to bear the whole or a portion of the expenses of any street works in their area under the private street works code and where an authority so resolve the liabilities of the owners of premises in respect of those expenses are to be treated as discharged or as proportionately reduced, accordingly.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2299"},{"id":"1483","label":"Highways - control of road-side sales","desc":"A local authority may issue or revoke a control order prohibiting road-side sales.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1483"},{"id":"2515","label":"Highways - conversion of private street","desc":"A local authority may convert a private street into a highway.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2515"},{"id":"2514","label":"Highways - creation of roads","desc":"A local authority may construct certain roads after taking the prescribed steps.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2514"},{"id":"2516","label":"Highways - creation of walkway","desc":"A local authority may create a walkway by agreement having followed the prescribed procedure.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2516"},{"id":"2232","label":"Highways - cutting off of corners","desc":"A highway authority may execute works for cutting off the corners of a highway maintainable at the public expense by them.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2232"},{"id":"2284","label":"Highways - cutting or felling trees that overhang or are a danger to roads or footpaths","desc":"Where a hedge, tree or shrub overhangs a highway or any other road or footpath to which the public has access so as to endanger or obstruct the passage of vehicles or pedestrians, or obstructs or interferes with the view of drivers of vehicles or the light from a public lamp, [ or overhangs a highway so as to endanger or obstruct the passage of horse-riders, a competent authority may, by notice either to the owner of the hedge, tree or shrub or to the occupier of the land on which it is growing, require him within 14 days from the date of service of the notice so to lop or cut it as to remove the cause of the danger, obstruction or interference.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2284"},{"id":"2272","label":"Highways - damage to footways of streets by excavations","desc":"If the footway of a street that is a highway maintainable at the public expense is damaged by or in consequence of any excavation or other work on land adjoining the street, the highway authority for the highway may make good the damage and recover the expenses reasonably incurred by them in so doing from the owner of the land in question or the person causing or responsible for the damage","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2272"},{"id":"2288","label":"Highways - dangerous land adjoining street","desc":"If, in or on any land adjoining a street, there is an unfenced or inadequately fenced source of danger to persons using the street, the local authority in whose area the street is situated may, by notice to the owner or occupier of that land, require him within such time as may be specified in the notice to execute such works of repair, protection, removal or enclosure as will obviate the danger.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2288"},{"id":"2213","label":"Highways - declaration of unnecessary highway to be not maintainable at public expense","desc":"Where a highway authority are of opinion that a highway maintainable at the public expense by them is unnecessary for public use and therefore ought not to be maintained at the public expense, they may, apply to a magistrates' court for an order declaring that the highway shall cease to be so maintained.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2213"},{"id":"2206","label":"Highways - dedication of highway by agreement with parish or community council","desc":"The council of a parish or community may enter into an agreement with any person having the necessary power in that behalf for the dedication by that person of a highway over land in the parish or community or an adjoining parish or community in any case where such a dedication would in the opinion of the council be beneficial to the inhabitants of the parish or community or any part thereof. Where the council of a parish or community have entered into an agreement under subsection (1) above for the dedication of a highway they may carry out any works (including works of maintenance or improvement) incidental to or consequential on the making of the agreement or contribute towards the expense of carrying out such works, and may agree or combine with the council of any other parish or community to carry out such works or to make such a contribution.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2206"},{"id":"2245","label":"Highways - delegation of lighting functions of highway authority","desc":"A highway authority may agree with a lighting authority for the delegation to the lighting authority of any of the functions of the highway authority with respect to the lighting of any highway or part of a highway within the area of the lighting authority.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2245"},{"id":"2320","label":"Highways - disposal of certain materials","desc":"The council of a county or a council who are a local authority may remove, appropriate, or use, sell or otherwise dispose of all old materials existing in any street other than a highway maintainable at the public expense at the time of the execution by the council of any works in the street, unless those materials are removed by the owners of premises in the street within 3 days from the date of service of a notice from the proper officer of the council requiring the owners of those premises to remove the materials.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2320"},{"id":"2253","label":"Highways - diversion of non-navigable watercourses and works on any watercourse","desc":"A highway authority may divert any part of a watercourse, other than a navigable watercourse, or carry out any other works on any part of a watercourse, including a navigable watercourse, if, in the opinion of that authority, the carrying out of the works is necessary or desirable in connection with the construction, improvement or alteration of a highway; the provision of a new means of access to any premises from a highway; or the provision of a maintenance compound, a trunk road picnic area, a lorry area or a service area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2253"},{"id":"2283","label":"Highways - doors etc. in streets not to open outwards","desc":"Where a door, gate or bar contravenes the Act the local authority for the area in which the premises are situated or alternatively, if the street concerned is a highway, the highway authority may, by notice to the occupier, require him to alter, so as not to open outwards, the door, gate or bar.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2283"},{"id":"2247","label":"Highways - drainage of highways","desc":"The highway authority for a highway may, for the purpose of draining it or of otherwise preventing surface water from flowing on to it, do all or any of the following construct or lay, in the highway or in land adjoining or lying near to the highway, such drains as they consider necessary; erect barriers in the highway or in such land as aforesaid to divert surface water into or through any existing drain; scour, cleanse and keep open all drains situated in the highway or in such land as aforesaid.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2247"},{"id":"2519","label":"Highways - entering premises","desc":"The highway authority may enter premises for surveying, making plans and certain other purposes.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2519"},{"id":"2319","label":"Highways - entry of highway authority for purpose of maintaining, etc. certain structures and works","desc":"Where a highway authority have power or a right to maintain, alter or remove any structure or work which is situated on, over or under any land, and that land neither belongs to the highway authority nor forms part of a highway for which they are the highway authority, then, if for the purpose of exercising that power or that right it is necessary for a person to enter on that land or any other land, a person duly authorised in writing by that authority may at any reasonable time enter on that land or any other land for that purpose. The local authority may have to pay compensation in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2319"},{"id":"2318","label":"Highways - entry of highway authority for the purpose of surveying","desc":"A person duly authorised in writing by a highway authority may at any reasonable time enter on any land for the purpose of surveying that or any other land in connection with the exercise by that authority, in their capacity as a highway authority, of any of their functions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2318"},{"id":"2317","label":"Highways - erection of barriers in streets in cases of emergency etc.","desc":"For the purpose of securing public order or public safety or preventing congestion of traffic a competent authority may, in any case of emergency or on any occasion on which it is likely by reason of some special attraction that any street will be thronged or obstructed, cause barriers to be erected in any street and kept in position for so long as may be necessary for that purpose.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2317"},{"id":"2275","label":"Highways - erection of flagpoles etc. on highways","desc":"A local authority may erect flagpoles, pylons and other structures on any highway in their area for the purpose of displaying decorations; make slots in such a highway for the purpose of erecting the structures; and remove any structure erected or slot made by the authority","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2275"},{"id":"2321","label":"Highways - execution of certain works on behalf of other person","desc":"A highway authority or a council may by agreement with any person execute at his expense any work which they have under this required him to execute, or any work in connection with a highway which he is otherwise under an obligation or is entitled to execute, and for that purpose they have all such rights as he would have.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2321"},{"id":"2234","label":"Highways - fencing of highways","desc":"A highway authority may erect and maintain fences or posts for the purpose of preventing access to a highway or other specified land","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2234"},{"id":"2248","label":"Highways - filling in roadside ditches etc.","desc":"If it appears to the highway authority for any highway that a ditch on land adjoining or lying near to the highway constitutes a danger to users of the highway, the authority may if they consider the ditch unnecessary for drainage purposes and any occupier of the land known to the authority agrees in writing that it is unnecessary for those purposes, fill it in; or place in the ditch, or in land adjoining or lying near to it, such pipes as they consider necessary in substitution for the ditch, and thereafter fill it in.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2248"},{"id":"2296","label":"Highways - financial provisions for private street works","desc":"A street works authority shall keep separate accounts of all money expended and recovered by them in the execution of the private street works code.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2296"},{"id":"2220","label":"Highways - footways and guard-rails etc. for publicly maintainable highways","desc":"It is the duty of a highway authority to provide in or by the side of a highway maintainable at the public expense by them which consists of or comprises a made-up carriageway, a proper and sufficient footway as part of the highway in any case where they consider the provision of a footway as necessary or desirable for the safety or accommodation of pedestrians; and they may light any footway provided by them","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2220"},{"id":"2289","label":"Highways - forecourt abutting on streets","desc":"If it appears to a competent authority that the forecourt of premises abutting on a street, or any steps or projection or goods (whether for sale or not) placed in such a forecourt, is or are a source of danger, obstruction or inconvenience to the public, the authority may by notice require the owner or occupier of the forecourt to fence the forecourt from the street or, at his election, to take such other steps as may be specified in the notice to obviate the danger, obstruction or inconvenience to the public.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2289"},{"id":"2268","label":"Highways - further provisions with respect to new means of access","desc":"A highway authority may provide a new means of access to premises from any highway or proposed highway.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2268"},{"id":"2276","label":"Highways - gates across highways","desc":"Where there is a gate of less than the minimum width across so much of a highway as consists of a carriageway, or across a highway that is a bridleway, the highway authority for the highway may by notice to the owner of the gate require him to enlarge the gate to that width or remove it.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2276"},{"id":"2269","label":"Highways - gating orders","desc":"A highway authority may provide a new means of access to premises from any highway or proposed highway.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2269"},{"id":"2217","label":"Highways - general power of improvement","desc":"Highway authorities may carry out, in relation to a highway maintainable at the public expense by them, any work (including the provision of equipment) for the improvement of the highway.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2217"},{"id":"2221","label":"Highways - guard-rails etc. in private streets","desc":"In any street which is not a highway maintainable at the public expense and which consists of or comprises a carriageway a local authority may provide and maintain such pillars, rails or fences as they think necessary for the purpose of safeguarding persons using the street.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2221"},{"id":"2227","label":"Highways - improvement line for widening street","desc":"Where in the opinion of a highway authority a street which is a highway maintainable at the public expense by them is narrow or inconvenient, or without any sufficiently regular boundary line, or it is necessary or desirable that such a street should be widened, the authority may prescribe in relation to either one side or both sides of the street, or at or within a distance of 15 yards from any corner of the street, a line to which the street is to be widened","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2227"},{"id":"2252","label":"Highways - improvements to road-ferries","desc":"A highway authority may improve any road-ferry provided by them under this Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2252"},{"id":"2242","label":"Highways - installation of equipment for detection of traffic offences","desc":"A highway authority may install and maintain on or near a highway structures and equipment for the detection of traffic offences.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2242"},{"id":"2293","label":"Highways - installation of refuse or storage bins in streets","desc":"A competent authority may provide and maintain in or under a street orderly bins or other receptacles, of such dimensions and in such positions as the authority may determine, for the collection and temporary deposit of street refuse and waste paper, or the storage of sand, grit or other materials.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2293"},{"id":"2291","label":"Highways - licence for bridge construction","desc":"The highway authority for a highway may grant to the owner or occupier of any premises adjoining the highway a licence to construct a bridge over the highway on such terms and conditions, and to use it for such period and on such terms and conditions, as the authority think fit.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2291"},{"id":"3202","label":"Highways - Licence to place a builder's skip on the Highway","desc":"The highway authority may issue a licence to permit a builder's skip to be placed on the highway, either with or without conditions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3202"},{"id":"2273","label":"Highways - licence to plant trees, shrubs, etc., in a highway","desc":"The highway authority for a highway may permit the occupier or the owner of any premises adjoining the highway to plant and maintain, or to retain and maintain, trees, shrubs, plants or grass in such part of the highway as may be specified in the licence.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2273"},{"id":"3201","label":"Highways - Licence to provide recreation and refreshment facilities on certain highways","desc":"The highway authority may issue a licence (subject to conditions) to permit the provision of recreation or refreshment facilities on certain highways in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3201"},{"id":"2244","label":"Highways - lighting of highways","desc":"Every local highway authority may provide lighting for the purposes of any highway or proposed highway.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2244"},{"id":"2517","label":"Highways - list of maintainable highways","desc":"A local authority must maintain a list of highways maintainable at the public expense for its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2517"},{"id":"2210","label":"Highways - maintenance by district councils","desc":"The council of a district may undertake the maintenance of any eligible footpath, bridleway or road in the non-metropolitan district which is a highway maintainable at the public expense.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2210"},{"id":"2209","label":"Highways - maintenance of highways by highway authority","desc":"The authority who are for the time being the highway authority for a highway maintainable at the public expense are under a duty to maintain the highway.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2209"},{"id":"2225","label":"Highways - margins for horses and livestock","desc":"It is the duty of a highway authority to provide in or by the side of a highway maintainable at the public adequate grass or other margins as part of the highway in any case where they consider the provision of margins necessary or desirable for the safety or accommodation of ridden horses and driven livestock; and a highway authority may light a margin provided by them","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2225"},{"id":"2212","label":"Highways - materials for repair of publicly maintainable highways","desc":"For the purpose of repairing highways maintainable at the public expense by them, a highway authority may exercise the powers set out with respect to the getting of materials as are mentioned in this section.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2212"},{"id":"2246","label":"Highways - metalling of highways","desc":"A highway authority may, in relation to a highway maintainable at the public expense by them, execute works for the conversion of the highway into a metalled highway.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2246"},{"id":"2251","label":"Highways - mitigating nuisance of dust","desc":"A highway authority may, in relation to a highway maintainable at the public expense by them, treat the highway for mitigating the nuisance of dust.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2251"},{"id":"2258","label":"Highways - notice for services, amenties, refreshments or recreation facilities","desc":"A council shall publish a notice giving details of any proposal to construct or provide facilities under sections 115B, 115C and 115E of this Act and shall specify a period (being not less than 28 days after the publication of the notice) during which representations regarding the proposal may be made to the council.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2258"},{"id":"3248","label":"Highways - notice of regulated special vehicle journeys","desc":"A local highway/bridge authority must comply with the notice requirements relating to the journeys of certain regulated vehicles","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3248"},{"id":"3206","label":"Highways - pavement lights and ventilators","desc":"The highway authority may issue a permission to allow the opening of cellars under streets, and the installation and use of pavement lights over and ventilators on to the highway.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3206"},{"id":"2222","label":"Highways - pedestrian refuges","desc":"A highway authority may, in relation to a highway maintainable at the public expense by them which consists of or comprises a made-up carriageway, construct and maintain works in that carriageway for providing places of refuge for the protection of pedestrians crossing the carriageway.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2222"},{"id":"3205","label":"Highways - Permission to construct a cellar under the highway","desc":"The highway authority may issue a permission to enable the construction of a cellar under the highway.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3205"},{"id":"2250","label":"Highways - posts to indicate depth of flood water","desc":"It shall be the duty of a highway authority to provide, in connection with any highway for which they are the highway authority and which is subject to flooding to any considerable depth, graduated posts or stones in any case where they consider the provision thereof necessary or desirable for the purpose of indicating the depth of water covering the highway.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2250"},{"id":"2233","label":"Highways - prevention of obstruction to view at corners","desc":"Where the highway authority for the highway deem it necessary for the prevention of danger arising from obstruction to the view of persons using the highway to impose restrictions with respect to any land at or near any corner or bend in the highway or any junction of the highway with a road to which the public has access, the authority may serve a notice directing the wall, fence, hoarding, paling, tree, shrub or other vegetation on the land be altered","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2233"},{"id":"2281","label":"Highways - prevention of soil etc. being washed on to street","desc":"A competent authority may, by notice to the owner or occupier of any land adjoining a street which is a highway maintainable at the public expense, require him, within 28 days from the date of service of the notice, to execute such works as will prevent soil or refuse from that land from falling, or being washed or carried, on to the street or into any sewer or gully in it in such quantities as to obstruct the street or choke the sewer or gully.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2281"},{"id":"2286","label":"Highways - prevention of water falling on or flowing on to highway","desc":"A competent authority may, by notice to the occupier of premises adjoining a highway, require him within 28 days from the date of service of the notice to construct or erect and thereafter to maintain such channels, gutters or downpipes as may be necessary to prevent water from the roof or any other part of the premises falling upon persons using the highway, or so far as is reasonably practicable, surface water from the premises flowing on to, or over, the footway of the highway.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2286"},{"id":"2249","label":"Highways - protection against hazards of nature","desc":"The highway authority for a highway maintainable at the public expense may provide and maintain such barriers or other works as they consider necessary for the purpose of affording to the highway protection against snow, flood, landslide or other hazards of nature; and those works may be provided on the highway or on land which, or rights over which, has or have been acquired by the highway authority in the exercise of highway land acquisition powers for that purpose.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2249"},{"id":"2270","label":"Highways - protection of public rights.","desc":"It is the duty of the highway authority to assert and protect the rights of the public to the use and enjoyment of any highway for which they are the highway authority, including any roadside waste which forms part of it.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2270"},{"id":"2255","label":"Highways - provision of areas for parking heavy goods vehicles, etc.","desc":"A highway authority may provide on land adjoining, or in the vicinity of, a highway or proposed highway an area, for parking of heavy goods vehicles; transfer of goods to or from any such vehicle from or to any other vehicle; and for the temporary storage of goods","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2255"},{"id":"2236","label":"Highways - provision of cattle-grids and by-passes","desc":"Where it appears to the highway authority for a highway which consists of or comprises a carriageway expedient so to do for controlling the passage of animals along the highway, the authority may provide for the highway, and maintain, a cattle-grid in the highway or partly in the highway and partly in adjoining land.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2236"},{"id":"2235","label":"Highways - provision of highway boundary posts","desc":"A highway authority may erect and maintain, in a highway for which they are the highway authority, posts or stones to mark the boundary of the highway and may alter or remove any post or stone erected by them","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2235"},{"id":"2323","label":"Highways - provision of information by non-metropolitan district councils","desc":"Every non-metropolitan district council shall furnish, and shall instruct their officers to furnish, any information in their power which may reasonably be required by any county council for the purpose of enabling that council to discharge their functions under this Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2323"},{"id":"2254","label":"Highways - provision of public conveniences","desc":"Where the highway authority for a highway or proposed highway are or, as the case may be, will be a county council or metropolitan district council they may provide public sanitary conveniences (including lavatories) in proper and convenient situations on or under land adjoining, or in the vicinity of, the highway or proposed highway, and may manage such conveniences.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2254"},{"id":"2257","label":"Highways - provision of recreation and refreshment facilities","desc":"A council shall have power to provide, maintain and operate facilities for recreation or refreshment or both on a highway","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2257"},{"id":"2256","label":"Highways - provision of services and amenities","desc":"Subject to conditions detailed in the legislation, a council shall have power to carry out works on, in or over a highway to which this Part of this Act applies and to place objects or structures on, in or over such a highway, for the purpose of giving effect to a pedestrian planning order, of enhancing the amenity of the highway and its immediate surroundings or of providing a service for the benefit of the public or a section of the public. A council shall have the power to maintain any such works or structures and to impose conditions on others carrying out such works.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2256"},{"id":"2240","label":"Highways - reconstruction of a bridge","desc":"Without prejudice to any other powers they have under this Part of this Act, a highway authority may reconstruct a bridge which is a highway maintainable at the public expense by them, either on the same site or on a new site within 200 yards of the old one.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2240"},{"id":"2295","label":"Highways - recovery of expenses and charges for street works","desc":"A street works authority may from time to time recover from the owner for the time being of any premises in respect of which any sum is due for expenses of street works the whole or any portion of that sum together with interest at such reasonable rates as the authority may determine from the date of the final apportionment.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2295"},{"id":"2325","label":"Highways - recovery of expenses by councils and highway authorities","desc":"Where a council or a highway authority have incurred expenses for the repayment of which the owner of the premises in respect of which the expenses were incurred is liable (a) under any of the provisions of this Act to which this section applies, or (b) by agreement with the council or highway authority, those expenses, together with interest at such reasonable rate as the council may determine from the date of service of a demand for the expenses, may be recovered by the council or the highway authority from the owner for the time being of the premises; and as from the date of the completion of the works the expenses and interest accrued due thereon are, until recovered, a charge on the premises and on all estates and interests therein.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2325"},{"id":"2216","label":"Highways - recovery of expenses due to extraordinary traffic","desc":"Where it appears to the highway authority for a highway maintainable at the public expense, that having regard to the average expense of maintaining the highway or other similar highways in the neighbourhood extraordinary expenses have been or will be incurred by the authority in maintaining the highway by reason of the damage caused by excessive weight passing along the highway, or other extraordinary traffic thereon, the highway authority may recover from any person by or in consequence of whose order the traffic has been conducted the excess expenses.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2216"},{"id":"2290","label":"Highways - regard to needs of disabled and blind in executing works","desc":"A local authority must control building works in the highway and in executing works in a street which may impede the mobility of disabled persons or blind persons highway authorities, local authorities and any other person exercising a statutory power to execute works on a highway shall have regard to the needs of such persons.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2290"},{"id":"2207","label":"Highways - register of maps, statements and declarations.","desc":"The appropriate council shall keep a register of maps and statements deposited and declarations lodged with that council concerning land dedicated as a highway.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2207"},{"id":"3247","label":"Highways - regulated special vehicle journeys","desc":"A local highway/bridge authority may enter into an indemnity agreement in relation to journeys of certain regulated vehicles.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3247"},{"id":"2287","label":"Highways - removal of barbed wire","desc":"Where on land adjoining a highway there is a fence made with barbed wire, or having barbed wire in or on it, and the wire is a nuisance to the highway, a competent authority may by notice served on the occupier of the land require him to abate the nuisance within such time, not being less than one month nor more than 6 months from the date of service of the notice, as may be specified in it.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2287"},{"id":"2282","label":"Highways - removal of projections from buildings","desc":"A competent authority may by notice to the occupier of any building require him to remove or alter any porch, shed, projecting window, step, cellar, cellar door, cellar window, sign, signpost, sign iron, showboard, window shutter, wall, gate, fence or other obstruction or projection which has been erected or placed against or in front of the building and is an obstruction to safe or convenient passage along a street.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2282"},{"id":"2280","label":"Highways - removal of snow, soil etc. from highway","desc":"If an obstruction arises in a highway from accumulation of snow or from the falling down of banks on the side of the highway, or from any other cause, the highway authority shall remove the obstruction.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2280"},{"id":"2274","label":"Highways - removal of structures from highways","desc":"Where a structure has been erected or set up on a highway a competent authority may by notice require the person having control or possession of the structure to remove it within such time as may be specified in the notice.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2274"},{"id":"2279","label":"Highways - removal of things so deposited on highways as to be a nuisance etc","desc":"If any thing is so deposited on a highway as to constitute a nuisance, the highway authority for the highway may by notice require the person who deposited it there to remove it forthwith and if he fails to comply with the notice the authority may make a complaint to a magistrates' court for a removal and disposal order under this section.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2279"},{"id":"2322","label":"Highways - request for information as to ownership of land","desc":"A highway authority or a council may, for the purpose of enabling them to discharge or exercise any of their functions under this Act, require the occupier of any premises and any person who, either directly or indirectly, receives rent in respect of any premises, to state in writing the nature of his own interest therein and the name and address of any other person known to him as having an interest therein, whether as freeholder, mortgagee, lessee or otherwise.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2322"},{"id":"2316","label":"Highways - requiring angles of new buildings at corners of streets to be rounded off","desc":"A local authority or, if there is a local highway authority for either of the two streets in question, that highway authority, may require the corner of a building intended to be erected at the corner of two streets in the area of the local authority to be rounded or splayed off to the height of the first storey or to the full height of the building, and to such extent otherwise as they may determine.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2316"},{"id":"2324","label":"Highways - right to discharge water","desc":"Where there has been constructed or laid in land, or in the exercise of rights, acquired by a highway authority in the exercise of highway land acquisition powers, any drain or other work for the purpose of draining surface water from a highway, proposed highway, maintenance compound, trunk road picnic area, lorry area or service area, the water may be discharged into or through that drain or other work and into any inland waters, whether natural or artificial, or any tidal waters. A highway authority shall pay compensation to the owner or occupier of any land who suffers damage as a result.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2324"},{"id":"2520","label":"Highways - right to use vehicles on footways and bridleways","desc":"A local authority may use vehicles and appliances on footways and bridleways for cleansing, maintaining or improving footpaths, footways or bridleways or their verges, for preventing or removing obstructions to them or otherwise preventing or abating nuisances or other interferences with them, or for maintaining or altering structures or other works situated therein.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2520"},{"id":"2495","label":"Highways - road safety and accident assessment","desc":"A local authority must prepare and carry out a programme of measures designed to promote road safety and must take appropriate measures to reduce or prevent such accidents including the dissemination of information (which may include practical training).","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2495"},{"id":"3203","label":"Highways - scaffolding licence","desc":"The highway authority must issue a licence to permit scaffolding to be placed on the highway, providing the requirements of the Act are met.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3203"},{"id":"2200","label":"Highways - seconding of staff etc.","desc":"A council may enter into an agreement with the Minister or with a Strategic Highway Company for placing at his disposal, the services of persons employed by the council and any premises, equipment and other facilities under the control of the council.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2200"},{"id":"2267","label":"Highways - stopping up private access to premises by agreement","desc":"The highway authority for a highway may agree with the occupier of any premises and any other person having an interest in them that any private means of access to the premises from the highway shall be stopped up by that authority in any way which seems to them appropriate but not so as to obstruct any highway","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2267"},{"id":"2294","label":"Highways - street works in private streets","desc":"Where a private street is not, to the satisfaction of the street works authority, sewered, levelled, paved, metalled, flagged, channelled, made good and lighted, the authority may from time to time resolve with respect to the street to execute street works and, subject to the private street works code, the expenses incurred by the authority in executing those works shall be apportioned between the premises fronting the street.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2294"},{"id":"2238","label":"Highways - traffic calming works","desc":"A highway authority may, in a highway maintainable at the public expense for which they are the highway authority, construct traffic calming works and may remove such works (whenever constructed).","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2238"},{"id":"2243","label":"Highways - tree planting and laying of grass verges","desc":"A highway authority may, in a highway maintainable at the public expense by them, plant trees and shrubs and lay out grass verges, and may erect and maintain guards or fences and otherwise do anything expedient for the maintenance or protection of trees, shrubs and grass verges planted or laid out, whether or not by them, in such a highway.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2243"},{"id":"2271","label":"Highways - unauthorised marks on highways","desc":"The highway authority for a highway may remove any picture, letter, sign or other mark which has, without either the consent of the authority or an authorisation given by or under an enactment, been painted or otherwise inscribed or affixed upon the surface of the highway or upon any tree, structure or works on or in the highway.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2271"},{"id":"2297","label":"Highways - urgent repairs to private streets","desc":"Where repairs are needed to obviate danger to traffic in a private street the street works authority may by notice require the owners of the premises fronting the street to execute, within such time as may be specified in the notice, such repairs as may be so specified.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2297"},{"id":"2229","label":"Highways - variation of widths of carriageways and footways","desc":"Where a highway maintainable at the public expense comprises both a footway or footways and a carriageway, the highway authority may vary the relative widths of the carriageway and of any footway.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2229"},{"id":"2292","label":"Highways - vehicle crossings over footways and verges","desc":"Where the occupier of any premises adjoining or having access to a highway maintainable at the public expense habitually takes or permits to be taken a mechanically propelled vehicle across a kerbed footway or a verge in the highway to or from those premises, the highway authority for the highway may serve a notice on the owner and the occupier of the premises stating that they propose to execute such works for the construction of a vehicle crossing over the footway or verge as may be specified in the notice; or imposing such reasonable conditions on the use of the footway or verge as a crossing as may be so specified.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2292"},{"id":"2226","label":"Highways - widening of carriageway","desc":"A highway authority may widen any highway for which they are the highway authority","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2226"},{"id":"2315","label":"Highways - works for mitigating adverse effect of constructing or improving highway","desc":"A highway authority may carry out works for mitigating any adverse effect which the construction, improvement, existence or use of a highway has or will have on the surroundings of the highway.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2315"},{"id":"2230","label":"Highways -levelling of highways","desc":"A highway authority may execute works for levelling a highway maintainable at the public expense by them.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2230"},{"id":"4072","label":"Highways \u2013 Fees paid by other public authorities","desc":"A highway authority must comply with Regulations made by the National Authority in relation to fees it may charge to other public authorities.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/4072"},{"id":"2208","label":"Highways- provision whereby highway created by dedication may become maintainable at public expense","desc":"Where it is proposed to dedicate a way as a highway, if the council consider that the proposed highway will not be of sufficient utility to the public to justify its being maintained at the public expense, they may make a complaint to a magistrates' court for an order to that effect. If the council certify that the way has been dedicated in accordance with the terms of the notice and has been made up in a satisfactory manner, the highway shall become for the purposes of this Act a highway maintainable at the public expense.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2208"},{"id":"956","label":"Homelessness - advisory service","desc":"A local housing authority must offer a free service covering homelessness prevention, securing accommodation, rights, duties, and accessible help tailored to vulnerable groups.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/956"},{"id":"3194","label":"Homelessness - assessment and plans","desc":"A local housing authority has a duty to assess every eligible applicant\u2019s case and agree a plan to secure and retain suitable accommodation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3194"},{"id":"3192","label":"Homelessness - assistance","desc":"The authority may give to any person by whom the service is provided on behalf of the authority assistance by way of grant or loan and/or may also assist any such person-by permitting the person to use premises belonging to the authority,by making available furniture or other goods, whether by way of gift, loan or otherwise, andby making available the services of staff employed by the authority.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3192"},{"id":"957","label":"Homelessness - assistance for voluntary organisations","desc":"A local housing authority may give assistance by way of grant or loan to voluntary organisations concerned with homelessness or matters relating to homelessness. A local housing authority may also assist any such organisation by permitting them to use premises belonging to the authority, by making available furniture or other goods, whether by way of gift, loan or otherwise, and by making available the services of staff employed by the authority.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/957"},{"id":"974","label":"Homelessness - co-operation between relevant housing authorities and bodies","desc":"A local authority must co-operate with other housing authorities and other bodies in circumstances detailed in the legislation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/974"},{"id":"3741","label":"Homelessness - co-operation in cases involving children","desc":"Where someone under 18 lives with a person who is or might become homeless the local housing authority should co-operate with the local social services authority regarding the case.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3741"},{"id":"3197","label":"Homelessness - codes of practice","desc":"A local housing authority must have regard to any code of practice issued by the Secretary or State when exercising its functions relating to homelessness or the prevention of homelessness.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3197"},{"id":"969","label":"Homelessness - discharge of functions by local housing authorities","desc":"A local housing authority may discharge their housing functions in relation to a homeless person only by securing that suitable accommodation provided by them is available, by securing that he obtains suitable accommodation from some other person, or by giving him such advice and assistance as will secure that suitable accommodation is available from some other person.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/969"},{"id":"959","label":"Homelessness - inquiry into homelessness or threatened homelessness","desc":"A local authority must carry out an inquiry into homelessness or threatened homelessness in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/959"},{"id":"962","label":"Homelessness - intentional homelessness","desc":"A local authority has certain duties, as defined in this legislation, towards someone intentionally homeless.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/962"},{"id":"971","label":"Homelessness - interim arrangements made with private landlord","desc":"A local authority may discharge its duties regarding certain interim arrangements with a private landlord.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/971"},{"id":"961","label":"Homelessness - interim duty to accommodate","desc":"A local authority must accommodate a person who is homeless, eligible for assistance or with a priority need in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/961"},{"id":"3195","label":"Homelessness - non-priority cases","desc":"A local authority has certain duties towards someone who is not in priority need but who is not intentionally homeless.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3195"},{"id":"970","label":"Homelessness - out of area placement","desc":"A local authority must where proposing to house a person in another housing authority's district, give that authority written notice containing prescribed information.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/970"},{"id":"963","label":"Homelessness - persons not in priority need who are not homeless intentionally","desc":"A local authority has certain duties, as detailed in legislation, towards someone who is not in priority need but who is not intentionally homeless.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/963"},{"id":"3196","label":"Homelessness - priority need cases","desc":"A local authority has certain duties towards someone who is in priority need but who is not intentionally homeless or who is homeless and is eligible for assistance.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3196"},{"id":"973","label":"Homelessness - protection of personal property","desc":"Where a local housing authority have reason to believe that there is danger of loss of, or damage to, any personal property of an applicant who is homeless or threatened with homelessness, by reason of his inability to protect it or deal with it, and no other suitable arrangements have been or are being made, the authority shall take reasonable steps to prevent the loss of the property or prevent or mitigate damage to it.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/973"},{"id":"966","label":"Homelessness - referral to another housing authority","desc":"A local authority may refer the case of someone who is homeless to another housing authority under conditions detailed in the legislation.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/966"},{"id":"967","label":"Homelessness - referral to another local authority","desc":"A local authority has certain duties to the applicant where it exercises it power to refer the case of someone who is homeless to another housing authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/967"},{"id":"958","label":"Homelessness - regards to guidance","desc":"A local authority must have regard to guidance when considering their functions in relation to homelessness.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/958"},{"id":"968","label":"Homelessness - review of decisions on request","desc":"A local authority must review certain decisions under the Act when requested to do so by the applicant and must comply with procedure when carrying out the review.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/968"},{"id":"972","label":"Homelessness - suitability of accommodation","desc":"A local authority must have regard to certain legislative provisions and regulations in determining the question of whether accommodation is suitable.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/972"},{"id":"2607","label":"Homelessness - suitability of accommodation (England)","desc":"In determining whether accommodation is suitable for a person, the Housing LA must take into account the location of the accommodation and shall not regard it as suitable in the prescribed circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2607"},{"id":"965","label":"Homelessness - threatened homelessness","desc":"A local authority has certain duties, as detailed in legislation, towards someone who is in a position of threatened homelessness.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/965"},{"id":"533","label":"Homelessness strategy","desc":"A local authority must exercise its power to review provision for homelessness in its district and must formulate and publish a strategy for dealing with the same.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/533"},{"id":"534","label":"Homelessness strategy - co-operation with housing authority","desc":"A local authority with a social services function must co-operate with any separate housing authority for its area in assisting it to draw up a homelessness strategy and must take that strategy into account when exercising its functions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/534"},{"id":"2175","label":"Honorary titles - alderman/woman and freeman/woman","desc":"A local authority may bestow honorary titles in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2175"},{"id":"3348","label":"Household appliances - noise emission","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance and enforce the Regulations relating to noise emissions from household appliances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3348"},{"id":"2799","label":"Household waste - penalty charge","desc":"A local authority (waste collection authority) may issue a penalty under section 20B(1) of the London Local Authorities Act 2007 Act within the range of \u00a360 to \u00a380 and, under section 20B(3) of the 2007 Act, may make provision for treating a penalty as having been paid if a lesser amount (not less than \u00a340) is paid before the end of a specified period.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2799"},{"id":"1215","label":"Household waste - receptacles for collection","desc":"A local authority may make provision by notice as to the type of receptacles to be used for the collection of household waste and how they are to be provided and funded. The local authority may issue a penalty notice for failure to comply.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1215"},{"id":"1221","label":"Household waste - sites for deposit by residents","desc":"A local authority must arrange for places to be provided at which persons resident in its area may deposit their household waste free of charge and for the disposal of waste so deposited.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1221"},{"id":"565","label":"Houses in multiple occupation - additional licensing","desc":"A local authority may in certain circumstances designate their area or part of their area as subject to additional licensing in relation to HMOs.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/565"},{"id":"564","label":"Houses in multiple occupation - general duties","desc":"A local authority must - (i) make such arrangements as are necessary to secure the effective implementation in their district of the licensing regime (housing conditions); (ii) ensure that all applications for licences and other issues falling to be determined by them are determined within a reasonable time; and (iii) satisfy itself, as soon as is reasonably practicable, that there are no Part 1 functions that ought to be exercised by them in relation to the premises.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/564"},{"id":"571","label":"Houses in multiple occupation - grant or refusal of licence","desc":"A local authority must grant or refuse an application for a HMO licence in accordance with the requirements of sections 64 to 68, subject to such conditions as may be prescribed or determined by the authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/571"},{"id":"570","label":"Houses in multiple occupation - licence fees","desc":"A local authority may set requirements for and charge a fee in respect of applications for HMO licences.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/570"},{"id":"568","label":"Houses in multiple occupation - licensing applications","desc":"A local authority must take reasonable steps to ensure licensing applications are received from all HMOs.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/568"},{"id":"566","label":"Houses in multiple occupation - publication of additional licensing designation","desc":"A local authority must publish a notice regarding the designation of an area as a special licensing area for HMOs in the manner prescribed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/566"},{"id":"574","label":"Houses in multiple occupation - rent repayment order","desc":"A local authority may apply for a rent repayment order where an HMO is being operated without the appropriate licence in the prescribed manner.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/574"},{"id":"567","label":"Houses in multiple occupation - review of additional licensing designation","desc":"A local authority must review the designation of an area as a special licensing area for HMOs and if a decision to revoke is made they must publish a notice in the manner prescribed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/567"},{"id":"573","label":"Houses in multiple occupation - revocation of licence","desc":"A local authority may revoke a licence relating to a HMO.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/573"},{"id":"569","label":"Houses in multiple occupation - temporary exemption from licensing requirements","desc":"A local authority may issue a temporary exemption notice from licensing requirements in respect of HMOs.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/569"},{"id":"572","label":"Houses in multiple occupation - variation of licence","desc":"The local housing authority may vary a licence if they do so with the agreement of the licence holder, or if they consider that there has been a change of circumstances since the time when the licence was granted.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/572"},{"id":"3960","label":"Housing - duties in relation to social housing","desc":"A local authority must comply with the requirements of the HCA where it is a registered provider of social housing that provides local cost rental accommodation as a result of the HCA disposal, acquisition, construction or conversion any housing or other land.NOTE this is applicable to any local authority, which is a registered provider of social housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3960"},{"id":"3963","label":"Housing - Non registered providers duty to notify the social housing regulator","desc":"A local authority who is not a social housing provider must notify the social housing regulator if it becomes or intends to become a provider of social housing.NOTE this is applicable to any local authority eligible to become a registered provider of social housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3963"},{"id":"3962","label":"Housing - Registration as a provider of social housing","desc":"A local authority must comply with any regulation or decision of the Secretary of State that it is to be registered as a provider of social housing.NOTE this is applicable to any local authority eligible to become a registered provider of social housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3962"},{"id":"2796","label":"Housing - accommodation suitability for homeless","desc":"The local authority must take into account prescribed matters when determining the suitability of accommodation; including circumstances when B&B and shared accommodation are not suitable to be used for temporary accommodation and when private rented sector accommodation is not suitable for discharging the duties under section 75 of the Housing (Wales) 2014 Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2796"},{"id":"610","label":"Housing -
