acquisition and use of information","desc":"A local authority may obtain and utilise information in certain circumstances as defined in regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/610"},{"id":"1898","label":"Housing - acquisition of land for housing purposes","desc":"Local housing authority may acquire land as a site for the erection of houses, acquire houses, or buildings which may be made suitable as houses, together with any land occupied with the houses or buildings and acquire land in order to alter, enlarge, repair or improve an adjoining house.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1898"},{"id":"612","label":"Housing - additional notice requirements for protection of owners","desc":"A local authority must provide the owner of premises with notice of any action taken by them in relation to the premises in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/612"},{"id":"1897","label":"Housing - additional powers of authorities in London","desc":"A London borough council may provide and maintain in connection with housing accommodation provided by them, buildings or parts of buildings adapted for use for any commercial purpose. The council of an inner London borough and the Common Council of the City of London may, for the purpose of facilitating the erection of houses in their district, suspend, alter or relax the provisions of any enactment or byelaw relating to the formation or laying out of new streets or the construction of sewers or of buildings intended for human habitation.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1897"},{"id":"1922","label":"Housing - advances regarding disposal on shared ownership lease","desc":"Where a lease of a house relating to shared ownership contains a provision re the right of the tenant to acquire additional shares and a housing authority (other than the Homes and Communities Agency or the Greater London Authority) has, in the exercise of any of its powers, left outstanding or advanced any amount on the security of the house, that power includes power to advance further amounts for the purpose of assisting the tenant.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1922"},{"id":"1921","label":"Housing - agreement by local authority to indemnify mortgagee","desc":"For housing purposes a local authority may enter into an agreement with a person or body making an advance on the security of a house (or a building to be converted into a house that, in the event of default by the mortgagor, the authority binds itself to indemnify the mortgagee","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1921"},{"id":"975","label":"Housing - anti-social behaviour policy","desc":"A local authority must produce, publish and review anti-social behaviour policies and procedures.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/975"},{"id":"582","label":"Housing - application and fee for selective licence","desc":"A local authority may set requirements for and charge a fee in respect of applications for selective licensing areas.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/582"},{"id":"3229","label":"Housing - application for a rent repayment order","desc":"A Local Authority in England may apply to the First-tier Tribunal for a rent repayment order against a person who has committed an offence under Chapter 4 of the Housing and Planning having had regard to guidance from the Secretary of State.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3229"},{"id":"1900","label":"Housing - appropriation of land","desc":"A local housing authority may appropriate any land for the time being vested in them or at their disposal for the purposes of housing","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1900"},{"id":"1923","label":"Housing - assistance for provision of separate service pipe for water supply","desc":"The local housing authority may give assistance in respect of the provision of a separate service pipe for a house which has a piped supply of water from a water main but no separate service pipe.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1923"},{"id":"941","label":"Housing - assistance for social landlords","desc":"The local authority may promote the formation of bodies to act as social landlords or the extension of the objects or activities of registered social landlords. The authority may also provide them with certain forms of financial assistance or sell equipment to them under a hire purchase agreement.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/941"},{"id":"3865","label":"Housing - assistance with local supported housing strategy","desc":"A local authority in England acting as a social services authority must\u2014in respect of a district in England give the local housing authority for that district (where that is a different authority) such assistance in connection with the carrying out of its duties relating to local supported housing strategies as the local housing authority may reasonably require; and must, in the exercise of its social services functions\u2014where it is also a local housing authority, have regard to its supported housing strategy, orin any other case, have regard to the supported housing strategy of each local housing authority in respect of whose district it is the social services authority; andmust have regard to Guidance issued by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3865"},{"id":"3850","label":"Housing - assisting tenant in recovering prohibited rent","desc":"An enforcement authority may help a tenant:(a) to make an application (under section 13) for a recovery order;(b) to make an application under section 15 for a declaration as to the effect of section 7 on the terms of a regulated lease (within the meaning of those sections);(c) to recover an amount that the appropriate tribunal orders to be paid under a recovery order.For example, the enforcement authority may help by conducting proceedings or giving advice.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3850"},{"id":"3230","label":"Housing - banning order for rogue landlords or property agents","desc":"A Local Authority in England may apply for a banning order against a person who has been convicted of a banning order offence.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3230"},{"id":"948","label":"Housing - breach of tenancy agreement injunction","desc":"The local authority may apply for a breach of tenancy agreement injunction in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/948"},{"id":"2817","label":"Housing - carbon monoxide and smoke alarms","desc":"Local authorities (housing authorities) must serve a remedial notice where there are reasonable grounds to believe a landlord is in breach of a duty under the regulations and, if no action is taken, arrange for remedial action to be taken and impose a penalty notice following the prescribed procedure. LAs must also publish a statement of principles regarding penalty notices.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2817"},{"id":"992","label":"Housing - carrying out works which would attract grant","desc":"A local authority may carry out works that attract a grant in certain circumstances","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/992"},{"id":"563","label":"Housing - charging for certain enforcement action","desc":"A local housing authority may make such reasonable charge as they consider appropriate as a means of recovering certain administrative and other expenses incurred by them in serving an improvement notice under section 11 or 12, making a prohibition order under section 20 or 21, serving a hazard awareness notice under section 28 or 29, taking emergency remedial action under section 40, making an emergency prohibition order under section 43 or making a demolition order under section 265 of the Housing Act 1985 (c. 68).","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/563"},{"id":"3467","label":"Housing - client money protection scheme enforcement","desc":"A local authority must enforce client money protection scheme regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3467"},{"id":"2763","label":"Housing - community protection and fixed penalty notices","desc":"A local authority may authorise a housing provider, as defined by section 20 of the Anti-social Behaviour, Crime and Policing 2014 Act to issue community protection notices and fixed penalty notices (section 52).","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2763"},{"id":"602","label":"Housing - compensation for interim empty dwelling management order","desc":"A local authority must pay compensation to third parties while an interim empty dwelling management order is in force in respect of a dwelling in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/602"},{"id":"603","label":"Housing - compensation payable to third parties in consequence of a final empty dwelling management order","desc":"A local authority must pay compensation to a third party in respect of any interference with his rights in consequence of a final empty dwelling management order in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/603"},{"id":"595","label":"Housing - compensation where housing subject to management orders","desc":"A local authority may pay compensation in respect of any interference with the rights of a third party in consequence of an interim or final management order.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/595"},{"id":"3972","label":"Housing - competence and conduct standards set by Regulator","desc":"A local authority must comply with the competence and conduct standards set out by the Regulator.NOTE this is applicable to any local authority, which is a registered provider of social housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3972"},{"id":"3233","label":"Housing - considering application for a rent repayment order","desc":"A Local Authority in England must, upon becoming aware that a person has been convicted of an offence to which Chapter 4 of the Act applies in relation to housing in its area, consider applying for a rent repayment order.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3233"},{"id":"944","label":"Housing - consultation on matters of housing management for introductory tenancies","desc":"The local authority must comply with its duties to inform and consult with regard to introductory tenancies.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/944"},{"id":"1918","label":"Housing - continuance of certain powers to borrow for housing purposes","desc":"A local authority may borrow for housing purposes as authorised by: section 136(1) of the Housing Act 1957, section 54(1) of the Housing (Financial Provisions) Act 1958, or paragraph 19 of Schedule 8 to the Housing Act 1969.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1918"},{"id":"1911","label":"Housing - dealing with land acquired for clearance","desc":"A local housing authority who have purchased land shall, so soon as may be, cause every building on the land to be vacated and demolish every building on the land and thereafter appropriate or dispose of the land","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1911"},{"id":"945","label":"Housing - demoted tenancies","desc":"The local authority must comply with statutory requirements in relation to demoted tenancies.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/945"},{"id":"3965","label":"Housing - deregistration of registered provider","desc":"A local authority must comply with the requirements of the housing regulator in relation to the deregistration of itself as a registered provider or the deregistration of a registered provider in its area.NOTE this is applicable to any local authority eligible to become a registered provider of social housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3965"},{"id":"3968","label":"Housing - designation of health and safety lead","desc":"A local authority must designate a health and safety lead as required by section 126A and 126D to carry out the functions set out in section 126B and comply with the requirements of section 126C to enable the lead to do his or her job.NOTE - this is applicable to any local authority, which is a registered provider of social housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3968"},{"id":"576","label":"Housing - designation of selective licensing areas","desc":"A local authority may subject to certain conditions being met designate the whole or part of their area as a selective licensing area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/576"},{"id":"3974","label":"Housing - directions about performance information","desc":"A local authority must comply with directions from the Regulator regarding performance information.NOTE this is applicable to any local authority, which is a registered provider of social housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3974"},{"id":"976","label":"Housing - directions as to certain charges by social landlords","desc":"A local authority must comply with directions with regard to the making of certain charges.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/976"},{"id":"590","label":"Housing - discretionary final management orders","desc":"A local authority may make a final management order in certain circumstances and must take certain steps once it is in force.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/590"},{"id":"588","label":"Housing - discretionary interim management orders","desc":"A local authority may make an interim management order in certain circumstances and must take certain steps once it is in force.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/588"},{"id":"547","label":"Housing - discretionary review of suspended improvement notice","desc":"A local authority may at any time review an improvement notice whose operation is suspended. Copies of the authority's decision on a review under this section must be served on the person on whom the improvement notice was served, and on every other person on whom a copy of the notice was required to be served.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/547"},{"id":"555","label":"Housing - discretionary review of suspended prohibition order","desc":"A local authority may review a prohibition order in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/555"},{"id":"546","label":"Housing - discretionary revocation of an improvement notice","desc":"A local authority may revoke an improvement notice if, in the case of a notice served under section 11, they consider that there are any special circumstances making it appropriate to revoke the notice or in the case of a notice served under section 12, they consider that it is appropriate to revoke the notice.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/546"},{"id":"554","label":"Housing - discretionary revocation of prohibition order","desc":"A local authority may revoke a prohibition in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/554"},{"id":"1899","label":"Housing - duties with respect to buildings acquired for housing purposes","desc":"Where a local housing authority acquire a building which may be made suitable as a dwelling, they have to make it suitable for living or lease or sell the building to someone that will make the building suitable as a dwelling.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1899"},{"id":"1924","label":"Housing - duty of local housing authority to publicise availability of assistance","desc":"Within three months of the designation of defective dwellings, the local housing authority must publish a notice in the local newspaper to inform eligible residents about assistance in respect of the defective dwellings.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1924"},{"id":"3021","label":"Housing - duty to consider selling vacant higher value housing","desc":"A Local Authority must in certain circumstances consider selling its interest in any higher value housing that has become vacant.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3021"},{"id":"1913","label":"Housing - duty to inspect, report and prepare proposals regarding overcrowding","desc":"If it appears to the local housing authority that occasion has arisen for a report on overcrowding, the authority shall cause an inspection to be made and prepare a report showing the result of the inspection and the number of new dwellings required in order to abate the overcrowding","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1913"},{"id":"960","label":"Housing - eligibility of migrants","desc":"A local authority may request the Secretary of State for information regarding the eligibility of migrants for housing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/960"},{"id":"562","label":"Housing - emergency prohibition order where category 1 hazard","desc":"A local authority must in certain circumstances issue an emergency prohibition order where a category 1 hazard is identified.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/562"},{"id":"561","label":"Housing - emergency remedial action where category 1 hazard","desc":"A local authority must in certain circumstances take emergency remedial action where a Category 1 hazard is identified.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/561"},{"id":"940","label":"Housing - energy conservation reports","desc":"A local authority must produce, copy, distribute and modify a home energy conservation report or reports and comply with guidance and directions of the secretary of state in so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/940"},{"id":"537","label":"Housing - enforcement action category 1 hazard","desc":"A local authority must take the appropriate enforcement action, as definedin legislation, where a Category 1 hazard is identified.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/537"},{"id":"538","label":"Housing - enforcement action category 2 hazard","desc":"A local authority may take enforcement action, as specified in the legislation,where a category 2 hazard is identified on residential premises.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/538"},{"id":"3981","label":"Housing - enforcement notice - appeal","desc":"A local authority may appeal against the requirements of an enforcement notice.NOTE this is applicable to any local authority which is a registered provider of social housing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3981"},{"id":"3236","label":"Housing - entering details of banning order on database of rogue landlords and property agents","desc":"A Local Authority in England must enter certain information regarding a person with a banning order on to the database of rogue landlords and property agents","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3236"},{"id":"3235","label":"Housing - entering information in rogue landlord and property agents database","desc":"A Local Authority in England may, having followed the required process, enter certain information regarding a person convicted of a banning offence in the database of rogue landlords and property agents.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3235"},{"id":"1927","label":"Housing - entry for survey or examination to determine whether housing powers should be exercised","desc":"A person authorised by the local housing authority may at any reasonable time, on giving seven days' notice of his intention to the occupier, and to the owner if the owner is known, enter premises for the purpose of survey and examination where it appears to the authority that survey or examination is necessary in order to determine whether any powers should be exercised.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1927"},{"id":"1896","label":"Housing - exercise of housing powers by the authority outside their district","desc":"A local housing authority may, for supplying the needs of their district, exercise their powers outside their district","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1896"},{"id":"3976","label":"Housing - extraordinary audit","desc":"A local authority must allow its accounts to be audited when required to do so by the Regulator.NOTE this is applicable to any local authority, which is a registered provider of social housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3976"},{"id":"600","label":"Housing - final empty dwelling management order","desc":"A local authority may make a final empty dwelling management order in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/600"},{"id":"596","label":"Housing - financial arrangements on termination of management order","desc":"A local authority must pay the financial balance in certain circumstances on the termination of a final management order.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/596"},{"id":"1971","label":"Housing - financial assistance for privately let housing accommodation","desc":"A local housing authority shall have power to provide any person with financial assistance for the purposes of, or in connection with, the acquisition, construction, conversion, rehabilitation, improvement, maintenance or management (whether by that person or by another) of any property which is or is intended to be privately let as housing accommodation.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1971"},{"id":"995","label":"Housing - financial assistance for regeneration or development","desc":"A local authority must comply with any terms imposed on any financial assistance received from the Secretary of State for regeneration or development under section 127 of the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/995"},{"id":"3846","label":"Housing - financial penalties for prohibited rent","desc":"An enforcement authority may impose a financial penalty, subject to the financial limits and restrictions set out in section 9, on a person if the authority is satisfied beyond reasonable doubt that the person has breached regulations regarding prohibited rent.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3846"},{"id":"3244","label":"Housing - financial penalty for banning order","desc":"A Local Authority in England may impose a financial penalty on a person if it is satisfied beyond reasonable doubt that the person\u2019s conduct amounts to an offence under section 21(1). Having regard to any guidance published by the Secretary of State when doing so.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3244"},{"id":"2744","label":"Housing - fraud investigation (England)","desc":"A local authority may authorise an individual to exercise the powers conferred on an authorised officer to require information from specified persons for housing fraud investigation purposes, namely the prevention, detection or securing evidence for the conviction of one of the offences listed in section 7(7) of the Prevention of Social Housing Fraud (Detection of Fraud) Act 2013.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2744"},{"id":"2743","label":"Housing - fraud investigation (Wales)","desc":"A local authority may authorise an individual to exercise the powers conferred on an authorised officer to require information from specified persons for housing fraud investigation purposes, namely the prevention, detection or securing evidence for the conviction of one of the offences listed in section 7(7) of the Prevention of Social Housing Fraud (Detection of Fraud) Act 2013.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2743"},{"id":"594","label":"Housing - furniture in housing subject to a management order","desc":"A local authority may renounce its ownership of or supply furniture for a house to which an interim or final management order relates in certain circumstances as defined in the legislation.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/594"},{"id":"1907","label":"Housing - general improvement areas","desc":"Where a local housing authority have declared an area to be a general improvement area, they may, carry out works on land owned by them and assist in the carrying out of works on land not owned by them, acquire any land by agreement, and let or otherwise dispose of land for the time being owned by them;","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1907"},{"id":"1905","label":"Housing - general powers to compulsorily acquire land and provide housing accommodation","desc":"Where a local housing authority have declared an area to be a housing action area, they may, compulsorily acquire land and undertake the provision of housing accommodation by the construction, conversion or improvement of buildings; carrying out work for the improvement or repair of housing accommodation; management of housing accommodation; provision of furniture, fittings or services in or in relation to housing accommodation.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1905"},{"id":"583","label":"Housing - grant or refusal of licence in selective licensing area","desc":"A local authority must grant or refuse an application for a residential accommodation licence subject to such conditions as may be prescribed or determined by the authority","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/583"},{"id":"3019","label":"Housing - grants to private registered providers","desc":"The Greater London Authority may make grants to private registered providers in respect of right to buy discounts for dwellings in London on such terms as it considers to be appropriate.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3019"},{"id":"540","label":"Housing - guidance about inspection and enforcement action","desc":"A local authority must have regard to guidance given by the appropriate national authority when exercising functions in relation to the inspection of premises and the assessment of hazards; improvement notices, prohibition orders or hazard awareness notices; emergency remedial action and emergency prohibition orders; or demolition orders and slum clearance.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/540"},{"id":"3849","label":"Housing - guidance on prohibited rent recovery","desc":"An enforcement authority must have regard to any guidance issued by:(a) the Secretary of State, about the exercise of its functions under this Act in relation to a lease of premises in England;(b) the Welsh Ministers, about the exercise of its functions under this Act in relation to a lease of premises in Wales.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3849"},{"id":"3009","label":"Housing - guidance regarding self build and custom house building","desc":"A local authority must have regard to guidance issued by the Secretary of State when carrying out its duties under the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3009"},{"id":"558","label":"Housing - hazard awareness notice where category 1 hazard","desc":"A local authority must in certain circumstances serve a hazard awareness notice where a category 1 hazard is identified.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/558"},{"id":"559","label":"Housing - hazard awareness notice where category 2 hazard","desc":"A local authority may serve a hazard awareness notice where a category 2 hazard is identified.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/559"},{"id":"3961","label":"Housing - HCA financial assistance","desc":"A local authority must comply with the requirements of the HCA where it receives financial assistance from the HCA in respect of social housing.NOTE this is applicable to any local authority, which is a registered provider of social housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3961"},{"id":"2794","label":"Housing - homelessness (intentionality)","desc":"A local authority must give written notice of its decision to have regard to intentionality to the Welsh Ministers, at least 14 days before it takes effect. The notice must specify the category of applicants in relation to which the LA will consider intentionality; reasons and be published as prescribed. The local authority must have regard to the requirements in relation to revisions and existing applicants.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2794"},{"id":"3914","label":"Housing - homelessness offer from private rented sector","desc":"A local authority may discharge their duty to offer accommodation to someone who is homeless by making a 'private rented sector offer'.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3914"},{"id":"2795","label":"Housing - homelessness review","desc":"Local authorities must follow the prescribed procedure when dealing with a review under section 85 of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014 of specific decisions relating to homelessness","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2795"},{"id":"615","label":"Housing - house in multiple occupation declaration","desc":"A local authority may serve a notice in the prescribed form declaring a building to be a house in multiple occupation.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/615"},{"id":"2194","label":"Housing - house numbering and street naming","desc":"A local authority must number houses and name streets and cause the same to be displayed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2194"},{"id":"949","label":"Housing - housing allocation","desc":"A local authority must comply with certain provisions when allocating housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/949"},{"id":"3977","label":"Housing - implied terms in management service agreements","desc":"A local authority must comply with the terms implied into management service agreements by section 217A.NOTE this is applicable to any local authority, which is a registered provider of social housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3977"},{"id":"542","label":"Housing - improvement notice where category 1 hazard","desc":"A local authority may in certain circumstances serve an improvement notice where a category 1 hazard is identified.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/542"},{"id":"543","label":"Housing - improvement notice where category 2 hazard","desc":"A local authority may serve an improvement notice where a category 2 hazard is identified on any residential premises.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/543"},{"id":"549","label":"Housing - improvement notices appeals procedure","desc":"A local authority must comply with the procedure and appeals procedure relating to improvement notices.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/549"},{"id":"560","label":"Housing - improvement notices enforcement action","desc":"A local authority must comply with the procedure and appeals procedure relating to enforcement action for improvement notices if the same is used.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/560"},{"id":"3973","label":"Housing - information and transparency standards set by Regulator","desc":"A local authority must comply with the information and transparency standards set out by the Regulator.NOTE this is applicable to any local authority, which is a registered provider of social housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3973"},{"id":"3234","label":"Housing - information in relation to a banning order application","desc":"A Local Authority in England may require an individual to provide specified information in connection with a decision as to whether it should apply for a banning order.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3234"},{"id":"3868","label":"Housing - information sharing for supported exempt accommodation","desc":"A local housing authority in England must comply with any Regulations published by the Secretary of State regarding information sharing relating to supported exempt accommodation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3868"},{"id":"536","label":"Housing - inspection of residential premises for category 1 or 2 hazard","desc":"A local authority must, if they think it appropriate to do so or if an official complaint is made, inspect any residential premises in their district with a view to determining whether any category 1 or 2 hazard exists on those premises.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/536"},{"id":"3848","label":"Housing - interest on recovered prohibited rent","desc":"Where an enforcement authority orders a person to pay an amount of recovered prohibited rent, the authority may include provision in the order for interest to be payable on that amount in accordance with the conditions set out in section 11.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3848"},{"id":"598","label":"Housing - interim empty dwelling management order","desc":"A local authority may make an interim empty dwelling management order in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/598"},{"id":"942","label":"Housing - introductory tenancies","desc":"The local authority may elect to operate the introductory tenancy regime.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/942"},{"id":"614","label":"Housing - licences and other documents in electronic form","desc":"A local authority may serve certain licences and notices in electronic form.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/614"},{"id":"105","label":"Housing - limits on indebtedness","desc":"A local housing authority may not hold housing debt in contravention of any determination by the Secretary of State","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/105"},{"id":"3867","label":"Housing - local housing authority licensing regulations functions","desc":"A local housing authority in England must in the exercise of its functions under licensing regulations, have regard to:(a) National Supported Housing Standards (if any), and(b) any guidance issued by the Secretary of State for the purposes of this section.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3867"},{"id":"3866","label":"Housing - local supported housing regulations","desc":"A local housing authority in England must comply with any Regulations issued by the Secretary of State in relation to licensing of supported exempt accommodation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3866"},{"id":"3864","label":"Housing - local supported housing strategies","desc":"A local housing authority in England must\u2014(a) carry out a review of the supported exempt accommodation in its district, and(b) in the light of that review, publish a strategy, to be known as a \"supported housing strategy\" , for the provision of supported exempt accommodation in its district.In so doing a local housing authority(a) must comply carry out and complete the above steps before such date as may be specified in regulations made by the Secretary of State,(b) subsequently, must comply with that subsection before the end of each five-year period beginning with the day on which it published its most recent supported housing strategy, and (c) have regard to Guidance issued by the Secretary of State.A supported housing strategy must include\u2014(a) the local housing authority's assessment of\u2014(i) the current availability of supported exempt accommodation in its district, and(ii) the likely need for supported exempt accommodation in its district during the period of five years beginning with the date on which the strategy is published;(b) such other matters as may be specified in regulations made by the Secretary of State.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3864"},{"id":"2608","label":"Housing - management agreements","desc":"Where a tenant management organisation proposes to enter into a management agreement with a local housing authority under section 27 of that Act, the local authority must, in specified circumstances, enter into a management agreement as prescribed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2608"},{"id":"591","label":"Housing - management scheme for final management orders","desc":"A local authority must prepare a management scheme when a final management order is in force.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/591"},{"id":"601","label":"Housing - management where final empty dwelling management order in force","desc":"A local authority must take certain steps when a final empty dwelling management order is in place and must from time to time review the operation of the order.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/601"},{"id":"599","label":"Housing - management where interim empty dwelling management order in force","desc":"A local authority must take certain steps when an interim empty dwelling management order is in place and if the authority concludes that there are no steps it could appropriately take it must make a final empty dwelling management order or revoke the interim order.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/599"},{"id":"589","label":"Housing - mandatory final management orders","desc":"A local authority must make a final management order in certain circumstances and must take certain steps once it is in force.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/589"},{"id":"587","label":"Housing - mandatory interim management orders","desc":"A local authority must make an interim management order in certain circumstances as detailed in regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/587"},{"id":"548","label":"Housing - mandatory review of suspended improvement notice","desc":"The local housing authority must review an improvement notice whose operation is suspended not later than one year after the date of service of the notice and at subsequent intervals of not more than one year. Copies of the authority's decision on a review under this section must be served on the person on whom the improvement notice was served, and on every other person on whom a copy of the notice was required to be served.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/548"},{"id":"556","label":"Housing - mandatory review of suspended prohibition order","desc":"A local authority must review a prohibition order in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/556"},{"id":"545","label":"Housing - mandatory revocation of improvement notice","desc":"A local authority must revoke an improvement notice if they are satisfied it been complied with.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/545"},{"id":"553","label":"Housing - mandatory revocation of prohibition order","desc":"A local authority must revoke a prohibition order notices once the hazard to which it relates no longer exists.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/553"},{"id":"1964","label":"Housing - offences related to tenants' first right of refusal","desc":"A landlord commits an offence if, without reasonable excuse, he makes a relevant disposal affecting premises without having first complied with the requirements regards the service of notices on the qualifying tenants of flats contained in the premises, or in contravention of any prohibition or restriction imposed. Proceedings may be brought by a local housing authority.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1964"},{"id":"604","label":"Housing - overcrowding notice for HMO","desc":"The local housing authority may serve an overcrowding notice on one or more relevant persons if, having regard to the rooms available, it considers that an excessive number of persons is being, or is likely to be, accommodated in the HMO concerned. When serving the notice the authority must comply with relevant regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/604"},{"id":"1917","label":"Housing - overcrowding power of entry or abatement notice","desc":"A person authorised by the local housing authority may at all reasonable times, on giving 24 hours' notice to the occupier, and to the owner if the owner is known, enter any premises for the purpose of survey and examination where it appears to the authority that survey or examination is necessary","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1917"},{"id":"3979","label":"Housing - performance improvement plan - appeal","desc":"A local authority may appeal against the requirements of a performance improvement plan.NOTE this is applicable to any local authority which is a registered provider of social housing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3979"},{"id":"1889","label":"Housing - periodical review of housing needs","desc":"Every local housing authority shall consider housing conditions in their district and the needs of the district with respect to the provision of further housing accommodation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1889"},{"id":"3008","label":"Housing - permission for self build and custom house building","desc":"A local authority must give suitable development permission in respect of enough serviced plots of land to meet the demand for self-build and custom house building in the authority's area arising in each base period and must also comply with Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3008"},{"id":"1916","label":"Housing - power of entry to determine permitted number of persons","desc":"A person authorised by the local housing authority may at any reasonable time, on giving 24 hours' notice of his intention to the occupier, and to the owner if the owner is known, enter premises for the purpose of measuring the rooms of a dwelling in order to ascertain the number of persons permitted to use the dwelling for sleeping.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1916"},{"id":"611","label":"Housing - power of entry to premises","desc":"A local authority may enter premises in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/611"},{"id":"1919","label":"Housing - power of local authorities to advance money","desc":"A local authority may advance money to a person for the purpose of acquiring a house, constructing a house, converting another building into a house or acquiring another building and converting it into a house, or for the purpose of facilitating the repayment of an amount outstanding on a previous loan made for any of those purposes.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1919"},{"id":"1920","label":"Housing - power of local authority on disposal to leave amount outstanding on mortgage.","desc":"The local authority has power on disposal of a house/land by them for housing purposes to leave an amount outstanding on mortgage.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1920"},{"id":"1908","label":"Housing - power to apply for orders extinguishing right to use vehicles on highway","desc":"A local housing authority who have declared a general improvement area may exercise the powers of a local planning authority with respect to a highway in that area notwithstanding that they are not the local planning authority","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1908"},{"id":"1926","label":"Housing - power to compensate shop-keepers in areas affected by clearance","desc":"Where as a result of action taken by a local housing authority relating to clearance areas, the population of the locality is materially decreased, the authority may pay to any person carrying on a retail shop in the locality such reasonable allowance as they think fit towards any loss involving personal hardship","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1926"},{"id":"1903","label":"Housing - power to dispose of land held for housing purposes","desc":"Local authorities have power to dispose of land held by them for housing purposes","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1903"},{"id":"1925","label":"Housing - power to enter and determine short tenancies of land acquired or appropriated","desc":"Where a local housing authority have agreed to purchase or have determined to appropriate land for the purposes of housing/area improvement if a person's interest in possession of the land is not greater than that of a tenant for a year, or from year to year, the authority may, after giving him not less than 14 days' notice, enter on and take possession of the land, or such part of the land as is specified in the notice, without previous consent.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1925"},{"id":"1914","label":"Housing - power to require information about persons sleeping in dwelling","desc":"The local housing authority may, for the purpose of enabling them to discharge their duties serve notice on the occupier of a dwelling requiring him to give them within 14 days a written statement of the number, ages and sexes of the persons sleeping in the dwelling.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1914"},{"id":"1915","label":"Housing - power to require production of rent book","desc":"A duly authorised officer of the local housing authority may require an occupier of a dwelling to produce for inspection any rent book or similar document which is being used in relation to the dwelling and is in his custody or under his control","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1915"},{"id":"1912","label":"Housing - powers of entry","desc":"A person authorised by the local housing authority may at any reasonable time, on giving seven days' notice of his intention to the occupier, and to the owner if the owner is known, enter premises for the purpose of survey and examination in order to determine whether certain powers should be exercised; survey and examination where a demolition order has been made in respect of the premises; or for the purpose of survey or valuation where the authority are authorised to purchase the premises compulsorily.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1912"},{"id":"1910","label":"Housing - powers of entry for survey or valuation where premises compulsorily purchased","desc":"A person authorised by the local housing authority may at any reasonable time, on giving 24 hours' notice, enter premises to survey and examine where it appears to the authority that survey or examination is necessary or for the purpose of survey or valuation where the authority are authorised to purchase the premises compulsorily","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1910"},{"id":"3845","label":"Housing - prohibited rent enforcement by another authority","desc":"A local weights and measures authority may issue a prohibited rent enforcement notice in an area other than its own.A local authority which is not a weights and measures authority may also issue an enforcement notice in relation to prohibited rents in it's own area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3845"},{"id":"3844","label":"Housing - prohibited rent enforcement by responsible authority","desc":"A local weights and measures authority must enforce regulations relating to prohibited rents in the authority area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3844"},{"id":"557","label":"Housing - prohibition order appeals procedure","desc":"A local authority must comply with the procedure and appeals procedure relating to prohibition orders.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/557"},{"id":"550","label":"Housing - prohibition order where category 1 hazard","desc":"A local authority must in certain circumstances serve a prohibition order where a Category 1 hazard is identified.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/550"},{"id":"551","label":"Housing - prohibition order where category 2 hazard","desc":"A local authority may serve a prohibition order where a Category 2 hazard is identified.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/551"},{"id":"1902","label":"Housing - provision of accommodation for employees of county councils","desc":"A county council may provide houses for persons employed or paid by, or by a statutory committee of, the council.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1902"},{"id":"1892","label":"Housing - provision of board and laundry facilities","desc":"A local housing authority may provide accommodation which has facilities for obtaining meals and refreshments, and facilities for doing laundry and laundry services","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1892"},{"id":"1891","label":"Housing - provision of furnishings and fittings","desc":"A local housing authority may fit out, furnish and supply a house provided by them and may sell, or supply under a hire-purchase agreement or a conditional sale agreement, furniture to the occupants of houses so provided, and may for that purpose buy furniture","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1891"},{"id":"1890","label":"Housing - provision of housing accommodation","desc":"A local housing authority may provide housing accommodation by erecting houses, or converting buildings into houses, on land acquired by them, or by acquiring houses.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1890"},{"id":"106","label":"Housing - provision of housing finance information","desc":"A local housing authority must provide Secretary of State with information which is requested regarding housing finance","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/106"},{"id":"1894","label":"Housing - provision of shops, recreation grounds, etc","desc":"A local housing authority may, with the consent of the Secretary of State, provide buildings adapted for use as shops, recreation grounds, and other buildings or land which, in the opinion of the Secretary of State, will serve a beneficial purpose in connection with the requirements of the persons for whom the housing accommodation is provided.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1894"},{"id":"1895","label":"Housing - provision of streets, roads and open spaces and development generally","desc":"A local housing authority may lay out and construct public streets or roads and open spaces on land acquired by them","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1895"},{"id":"1893","label":"Housing - provision of welfare services","desc":"A local housing authority may provide such services for promoting the welfare of the persons for whom accommodation is so provided, as accord with the needs of those persons.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1893"},{"id":"1909","label":"Housing - publication of information regarding a general improvement area","desc":"Where a local housing authority have passed a resolution declaring an area to be a general improvement area, they shall bring to the attention of persons residing in the area or owning property in it","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1909"},{"id":"1906","label":"Housing - publication of information regarding a housing action area","desc":"Where a local housing authority have declared an area to be a housing action area, they shall bring to the attention of persons residing or owning property in the area the action they propose to take in relation to the housing action area and the assistance available for the improvement of the housing accommodation in the area","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1906"},{"id":"577","label":"Housing - publication of notice of selective licensing area","desc":"A local authority must publish a notice in the prescribed form relating to selective licensing areas.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/577"},{"id":"943","label":"Housing - publicity of introductory tenancies","desc":"The local authority must from time to time publish information about introductory tenancies.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/943"},{"id":"2882","label":"Housing - purchase of equitable interest (England)","desc":"A local authority as housing authority may with the agreement of the tenant purchase an equitable interest in a flat where the conditions in paragraph (2) are satisfied.(2) The conditions mentioned in paragraph (1) are that\u2014(a) a long lease of the flat was granted or assigned by the landlord or another housing authority;(b) the tenant is liable under the terms of the lease to pay service charges to the landlord in respect of repairs or improvement contributions (whether to the flat, the building in which it is situated or any other building or land); and(c) the purpose of the purchase is to assist the tenant to meet some or all of the service charge payments.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2882"},{"id":"2581","label":"Housing - purchase of equitable interest (Wales)","desc":"A local authority (housing authority) which is a landlord of a flat under a long lease can purchase an equitable interest in the flat in order to assist the tenant to meet some or all of the costs of service charge payments payable by the tenant to the landlord in respect of repairs and improvement contributions providing specified conditions are met and (where agreed by the tenant deduct landlord's administrative expenses in connection with the purchase) from the purchase price.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2581"},{"id":"539","label":"Housing - reasons for decision to take enforcement action on category 1 or 2 hazard","desc":"A local authority must prepare and serve a statement of reasons when taking enforcement action on residential premises with category 1 or 2 hazards pursuant to section 5 or section 7.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/539"},{"id":"3847","label":"Housing - recovery of prohibited rent","desc":"The enforcement authority may order any one of the following persons to pay to the tenant the amount that has not been refunded:(a) the landlord under the lease at the time the payment was made;(b) the landlord under the lease at the time the enforcement authority makes the order;(c) where the payment was made to a person acting on behalf of the landlord under the lease, that person.This is subject to the limitations and restrictions set out in section 10.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3847"},{"id":"3048","label":"Housing - reduction in social housing rents","desc":"Between 2016-17 and 2019-20 local authority registered providers of social housing must have (subject to exemptions) secured that the amount of rent payable in respect of that relevant year by a tenant of their social housing in England is at least 1% less than the amount of rent that was payable by the tenant in respect of the preceding 12 months.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3048"},{"id":"3120","label":"Housing - reduction of influence on housing providers","desc":"A local housing authority must comply with Regulations designed to reduce its influence on private registered housing providers.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3120"},{"id":"3007","label":"Housing - regard to self build register","desc":"A local authority must have regard to each register under section 1 that relates to its area when carrying out the following functions.planning;housing;the disposal of any land of the authority; andregeneration.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3007"},{"id":"609","label":"Housing - register of licences and management orders","desc":"A local authority must establish, maintain and allow inspection of a register of licences and management orders and must provide copies of documents for which they may charge a fee.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/609"},{"id":"3006","label":"Housing - register of self-build and custom build interest","desc":"A local authority must keep a register of\u2014individuals, and associations of individuals who are seeking to acquire serviced plots of land in the authority's area for their own self-build and custom housebuilding.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3006"},{"id":"3964","label":"Housing - registration fee","desc":"A local authority who becomes a registered provider of social housing must pay a registration fee.NOTE this is applicable to any local authority eligible to become a registered provider of social housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3964"},{"id":"3237","label":"Housing - removal of entries from rogue landlord or property agent database","desc":"A Local Authority in England must remove an entry from the database in certain circumstances and must notify the relevant person accordingly","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3237"},{"id":"2195","label":"Housing - renewal of house numbering","desc":"A local authority may mark a house with its number where the occupier has failed to carry out the work and to charge the occupier for that work.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2195"},{"id":"3022","label":"Housing - rent for high income tenants","desc":"A Local Authority must comply with regulations making provision about the levels of rent that it must charge a high income tenant of social housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3022"},{"id":"3118","label":"Housing - rent repayment orders - application","desc":"If a local housing authority becomes aware that a person has been convicted of an offence to which this Chapter (Rent repayment orders) applies in relation to housing in its area, the authority must consider applying for a rent repayment order.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3118"},{"id":"3119","label":"Housing - rent repayment orders - assisting tenants","desc":"A local housing authority in England may help a tenant to apply for a rent repayment order.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3119"},{"id":"586","label":"Housing - rent repayment orders for unlicensed houses","desc":"A local authority may apply for a rent repayment order in the prescribed manner where a house which requires a licence is unlicensed.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/586"},{"id":"3214","label":"Housing - rent review","desc":"The authority shall from time to time review rents and make such changes, either of rents generally or of particular rents, as circumstances may require.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3214"},{"id":"3213","label":"Housing - rent setting","desc":"A local housing authority may make such reasonable charges as they may determine for the tenancy or occupation of their houses.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3213"},{"id":"579","label":"Housing - requirement for Part 3 houses to be licensed","desc":"A local authority must take all reasonable steps to secure that applications for licences are made to them in respect of houses in their area which are required to be licensed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/579"},{"id":"1901","label":"Housing - reserve powers to provide housing accommodation","desc":"County councils may undertake any activity for the purposes of, or incidental to, establishing the needs of the whole or a part of the county with respect to the provision of housing accommodation.With the approval of the Secretary of State given on an application made by them, they may undertake the provision of housing accommodation in any manner in which a local housing authority for a district within the county might do so.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1901"},{"id":"3966","label":"Housing - restrictions to payments of members of registered providers","desc":"A local authority must not make a payment to any of its members which is prohibited.NOTE this is applicable to any local authority, which is a registered provider of social housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3966"},{"id":"578","label":"Housing - review and revocation of selective licensing areas","desc":"A local authority must review and in certain circumstances revoke a designation relating to selective licensing areas.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/578"},{"id":"535","label":"Housing - review of housing conditions","desc":"A local authority must keep the housing conditions in their area under review with a view to identifying any action that may need to be taken by them under various enactments/provisions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/535"},{"id":"593","label":"Housing - revocation of final management orders","desc":"A local authority may revoke a final management order where conditions for revocation, as defined in the legislation, are met.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/593"},{"id":"616","label":"Housing - revocation of HMO declaration","desc":"A local authority may revoke a declaration that a building is a house in multiple occupation.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/616"},{"id":"585","label":"Housing - revocation of licence in selective licensing area","desc":"A local authority may revoke a residential accommodation licence where conditions specified in the legislation and/or in the regulations apply.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/585"},{"id":"597","label":"Housing - right of entry to carry out work where management order","desc":"A local authority may enter a house and carry out work in certain circumstances whilst a management order is in place.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/597"},{"id":"2815","label":"Housing - selective licensing","desc":"A local housing authority may make a selective licensing designation in relation to an area if a set of conditions (in addition to those set out in section 80 of the Housing Act 2004) is satisfied in relation to an area. It must contain a high proportion of properties in the private rented sector, in relation to the total housing accommodation in that area. These privately rented properties must be occupied under assured tenancies or licenses to occupy.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2815"},{"id":"575","label":"Housing - selective licensing of other residential accommodation","desc":"A local authority mustof the (i) make such arrangements as are necessary to secure the effective implementation in their district of the licensing regime; and (ii) ensure that all applications for licences and other issues falling to be determined by them are determined within a reasonable time.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/575"},{"id":"613","label":"Housing - service of documents","desc":"A local authority must take certain steps when serving certain notices under the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/613"},{"id":"2041","label":"Housing - services for owners and occupiers of houses for work on them","desc":"A relevant authority shall have power to provide professional, technical and administrative services for owners or occupiers of dwellings in connection with their arranging or carrying out relevant works or to encourage or facilitate the carrying out of such works, whether or not on payment of such charges as the authority may determine.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2041"},{"id":"104","label":"Housing - settlement payments","desc":"An authority which is a local housing authority that keeps a Housing Revenue Account must comply with provisions regarding settlement payments and further payments to be made to the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/104"},{"id":"2907","label":"Housing - slum clearance areas","desc":"A local housing authority may declare a slum clearance area and purchase land in the slum clearance area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2907"},{"id":"3971","label":"Housing - social housing standards set by Regulator","desc":"A local authority must comply with the social housing standards set out by the Regulator.NOTE this is applicable to any local authority, which is a registered provider of social housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3971"},{"id":"3969","label":"Housing - submission of accounts and reports to the Regulator","desc":"A local authority must submit accounts and reports to the social housing regulator in accordance with the requirements of section 128.NOTE - this is applicable to any local authority, which is a registered provider of social housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3969"},{"id":"1904","label":"Housing - supplementary powers for entry for survey and examination","desc":"A person authorised by a local housing authority or the Secretary of State may, at any reasonable time, on giving 24 hours' notice of his intention to the occupier, and to the owner if the owner is known, enter premises for the purpose of survey and examination where it is necessary or for compulsory purchase","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1904"},{"id":"3975","label":"Housing - survey by the Regulator","desc":"A local authority must comply with a lawful request from the Regulator to allow a survey of a property and pay any fee requested in connection with a report.NOTE this is applicable to any local authority, which is a registered provider of social housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3975"},{"id":"544","label":"Housing - suspension of improvement notice","desc":"A local authority may incorporate provisions for suspension into an improvement notice served under sections 11 or 12.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/544"},{"id":"552","label":"Housing - suspension of prohibition order","desc":"A local authority may incorporate provisions for suspension into a prohibition order served under sections 20 or 21.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/552"},{"id":"580","label":"Housing - temporary exemption from selective licensing","desc":"A local authority in certain circumstances may issue a notice allowing for a temporary exemption from licensing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/580"},{"id":"107","label":"Housing - tenancy strategy","desc":"A local housing authority must consult upon, prepare, publish, review and have regard to a tenancy strategy.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/107"},{"id":"2684","label":"Housing - tenant group proposal for transfer to private registered provider","desc":"A local authority must comply with the regulations, made under section 34A of the Housing Act 1985, which set out the procedure to be followed where a tenant group wishes to serve a notice on an authority proposing that the authority should dispose of particular land used for housing purposes under Part 2 of the Housing Act 1985 to a private registered provider of social housing. A local authority must co-operate where a notice is served pursuant to these Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2684"},{"id":"3970","label":"Housing - tenant\u2019s right to acquire","desc":"A local authority must comply with a tenant\u2019s right to acquire as set out in sections 180 to 184.NOTE this is applicable to any local authority, which is a registered provider of social housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3970"},{"id":"947","label":"Housing - unlawful use of premises injunction","desc":"The local authority may apply for an unlawful use of premises injunction in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/947"},{"id":"3869","label":"Housing - use of information for statutory purposes","desc":"A local housing authority in England may use any information to which this section applies:(a) for any purpose connected with the exercise of any of the authority's functions under or by virtue of this Act, or otherwise relating to specified exempt accommodation, or(b) for the purpose of investigating whether any offence has been committed by virtue of this Act.This section applies to any information which has been obtained by the authority in the exercise of functions under (a) section 134 of the Social Security Administration Act 1992 (housing benefit), or(b) Part 1 of the Local Government Finance Act 1992 (council tax).This section does not authorise the use of information if the use would (taking the powers conferred by this section into account) contravene the data protection legislation.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3869"},{"id":"3232","label":"Housing - use of rogue landlords and property agents database","desc":"A Local Authority in England may utilise information contained in the Rogue Landlords and Property Agents Database for certain purposes.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3232"},{"id":"3020","label":"Housing - vacant higher value housing","desc":"A Local Authority must make payments to the Secretary of State in respect of vacant higher value housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3020"},{"id":"3231","label":"Housing - variation of database of rogue landlords or property agents","desc":"A Local Authority in England may remove from or vary an entry in the database in certain circumstances and must notify the relevant person accordingly.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3231"},{"id":"584","label":"Housing - variation of licence in selective licensing area","desc":"The local housing authority may vary a licence if they do so with the agreement of the licence holder, or if they consider that there has been a change of circumstances since the time when the licence was granted. For this purpose change of circumstances includes any discovery of new information.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/584"},{"id":"606","label":"Housing - variation or revocation of overcrowding notices","desc":"A local authority may vary or revoke an overcrowding notice.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/606"},{"id":"592","label":"Housing - variation to final management orders","desc":"A local authority may may vary a final management order if they consider it appropriate to do so.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/592"},{"id":"3967","label":"Housing - voluntary undertakings","desc":"A local authority may give a voluntary undertaking to the regulator of social housing.NOTE this is applicable to any local authority, which is a registered provider of social housing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3967"},{"id":"952","label":"Housing allocation - allocation scheme","desc":"Every local housing authority must have a scheme (their allocation scheme) for determining priorities, and as to the procedure to be followed, in allocating housing accommodation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/952"},{"id":"955","label":"Housing allocation - co-operation from registered social landlords","desc":"A local authority may request a registered social landlord to co-operate with them in relation to the allocation of housing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/955"},{"id":"951","label":"Housing allocation - information, advice and assistance","desc":"A local authority must provide information, advice and assistance and inform the applicant of certain rights as prescribed in relation to the allocation of housing and to applications for housing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/951"},{"id":"2759","label":"Housing allocation - local connection","desc":"Local authorities must not use local connection (within the meaning of section 199 of the Housing Act 1996) as a criterion in deciding whether relevant persons are not qualifying persons, if the allocation involves a transfer of housing accommodation from the district of another local housing authority in England.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2759"},{"id":"950","label":"Housing allocation - only to eligible and qualifying persons","desc":"A local authority must only allocate housing to eligible and qualifying persons.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/950"},{"id":"953","label":"Housing allocation - publication of allocation scheme","desc":"A local authority must publicise its allocation scheme, make it available for inspection and publicise alterations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/953"},{"id":"954","label":"Housing allocation - regard to guidance","desc":"A local authority must have regard to guidance when exercising its functions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/954"},{"id":"1384","label":"Housing and council tax benefits - supply of information","desc":"A local authority may supply or receive information in relation to housing benefit issues in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1384"},{"id":"1930","label":"Housing associations - power to supply furniture to housing association tenants","desc":"A local housing authority may sell, or supply under a hire-purchase agreement, furniture to the occupants of houses provided by a housing association under arrangements made with the authority and may buy furniture for the purpose.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1930"},{"id":"1929","label":"Housing associations - powers of local authorities to promote and assist housing associations","desc":"A local authority may promote the formation or extension of a housing association and may for the assistance of a housing association subscribe for share or loan capital of the association.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1929"},{"id":"1928","label":"Housing associations - provision of land by county councils","desc":"Where a housing association wishes to erect houses which in the opinion of the Secretary of State are required and the local housing authority in whose district the houses are proposed to be built are unwilling to acquire land with a view to selling or leasing it to the association, the county council, on the application of the association, may acquire land for that purpose.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1928"},{"id":"1381","label":"Housing benefits - collecting information and power of entry","desc":"A person authorised by a local authority in connection with housing related benefits may exercise certain powers in respect of requiring information and entry.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1381"},{"id":"1382","label":"Housing benefits - electronic access to information","desc":"A person authorised by a local authority in connection with housing related benefits may require electronic access to information in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1382"},{"id":"1385","label":"Housing benefits - funding and administration","desc":"A local authority must fund and administer housing benefit.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1385"},{"id":"1383","label":"Housing benefits - legal proceedings","desc":"A local authority may bring legal proceedings for housing related benefit fraud in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1383"},{"id":"541","label":"Housing consultation with fire and rescue authority on enforcement action","desc":"A local authority must consult with the fire and rescue authority before taking enforcement action where certain risks are identified.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/541"},{"id":"2030","label":"Housing finance - duty to keep housing revenue account","desc":"A local housing authority shall keep, in accordance with proper practices, an account, called the Housing Revenue Account, of sums falling to be credited or debited in respect of houses, land or any other property","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2030"},{"id":"2031","label":"Housing finance - housing accounts","desc":"The local housing authority shall, during the months of January and February immediately preceding the relevant year, formulate proposals relating to the income of the authority for the year from rents and other charges, the expenditure of the authority for the year in respect of the repair, maintenance, supervision and management of such property; and such other matters connected with the exercise of the authority's housing function","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2031"},{"id":"2032","label":"Housing finance - housing repairs account","desc":"A local housing authority who are required to keep a Housing Revenue Account may also keep, in accordance with proper practices, an account called the Housing Repairs Account. An authority who keep a Housing Repairs Account shall carry to the credit of the account for any year - sums transferred for the year from their Housing Revenue Account; and sums receivable by the authority for the year in connection with the repair or maintenance of houses or other property within their Housing Revenue Account (either from their tenants or from the sale of scrapped or salvaged materials). The authority shall carry to the debit of the account for any year of the all expenditure incurred by them for the year in connection with the repair or maintenance of houses or other property within their Housing Revenue Account; such expenditure incurred by them for the year in connection with the improvement or replacement of houses or other property within their Housing Revenue Account as may from time to time be determined by the Secretary of State; and sums transferred for the year to the Housing Revenue Account","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2032"},{"id":"2033","label":"Housing finance - information to Welsh ministers","desc":"A local housing authority in Wales, and any officer or employee of a local housing authority in Wales concerned with their housing functions, shall supply the Welsh Ministers with such information as the Welsh Ministers may specify, either generally or in any particular case, for the purpose of enabling the Welsh Ministers to exercise their functions","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2033"},{"id":"990","label":"Housing grant - change of circumstances of disabled occupant","desc":"A local authority must determine what do with regard to a grant where there is a change of circumstances of the disabled occupant as prescribed by section 41.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/990"},{"id":"981","label":"Housing grants - application in prescribed form","desc":"A local authority must only consider an application for grant if it is in the prescribed form and is otherwise eligible.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/981"},{"id":"993","label":"Housing grants - contributions by the Secretary of State","desc":"A local authority must apply to the Secretary of State for more funds if it believes the Secretary of State's determination to be inadequate.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/993"},{"id":"987","label":"Housing grants - decision and notification","desc":"A local housing authority shall by notice in writing notify an applicant for a grant as soon as reasonably practicable, and, in any event, not later than six months after the date of the application concerned, whether the application is approved or refused. The procedures for determination and notification should be as prescribed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/987"},{"id":"985","label":"Housing grants - determination of amount of grant","desc":"A local authority must determine a grant in the prescribed manner.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/985"},{"id":"986","label":"Housing grants - maximum amount of grants","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations regarding the maximum amount of grant.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/986"},{"id":"984","label":"Housing grants - means testing in case of application by owner-occupier or tenant","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations regarding the means testing of grants.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/984"},{"id":"988","label":"Housing grants - payment of grant","desc":"A local authority must pay an approved grant in accordance with sections 35 to 39 of the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/988"},{"id":"991","label":"Housing grants -
