information about independent mental health advocates","desc":"The responsible person in relation to a qualifying patient shall take such steps as are practicable to ensure that the patient understands that help is available to him from an independent mental health advocate; and how he can obtain that help.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2353"},{"id":"2351","label":"Mental health - prosecution by local authorities","desc":"A local social services authority may institute proceedings for any offence under this Part of this Act, but without prejudice to any provision of this Part of this Act requiring the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions for the institution of such proceedings.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2351"},{"id":"3029","label":"Migrant children - compliance with transfer scheme","desc":"A local authority must, comply with a Scheme for the transfer of responsibility for relevant children prepared by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3029"},{"id":"3028","label":"Migrant children - directed transfer of responsibility","desc":"A local authority must, when directed to do so by the Secretary of State, enter into arrangements under section 69 of the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3028"},{"id":"3027","label":"Migrant children - provision of information","desc":"A local authority must when directed to do so by the Secretary of State provide information to the Secretary of State relevant to the exercise of sections 69 or 72 of the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3027"},{"id":"3026","label":"Migrant children - transfer of responsibilities","desc":"A local authority may make arrangements with another authority for the transfer of certain responsibilities relating to migrant children.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3026"},{"id":"1932","label":"Mineral workings - power to enter former mining land etc","desc":"Where a local authority have carried out, are carrying out or are considering whether to carry out works on any land under section 89(2) of the National Parks and Access to the Countryside Act 1949 (treatment of derelict land etc.) for the purpose of reclaiming or improving land under which relevant operations have been, but are no longer being, carried out an authorised person may at any reasonable time enter the land to carry out works; to survey the land for the purpose of ascertaining the effect on it of works carried out; or to survey the land for the purpose of ascertaining the location, extent and state of mine working produced by relevant operations, the state of the land, the risk of collapse of its surface, the likely extent of collapse, and the nature and extent of any works which may be necessary to prevent collapse or to deal with a collapse which has occurred.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1932"},{"id":"1631","label":"Museums and galleries - admission charges","desc":"A local authority may charge for entry to museums and galleries in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1631"},{"id":"1632","label":"Museums and galleries - contribution towards expenses","desc":"A local authority may make contributions towards the expenses of running museums or galleries or provide advisory or other services there.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1632"},{"id":"1633","label":"Museums and galleries - fund for purchase of exhibits","desc":"A local authority may establish a fund for the purchase of exhibits for its museums and galleries.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1633"},{"id":"1630","label":"Museums and galleries - provision and maintenance","desc":"A local authority may provide and maintain museums and galleries in its area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1630"},{"id":"3468","label":"National Data Guardian - guidance","desc":"A local authority must have regard to guidance published by the National Data Guardian for Health and Social Care when processing health and adult social care data.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3468"},{"id":"1691","label":"National Parks - improvements to waterways","desc":"A local authority whose area consists of or includes the whole or any part of a National Park may make improvements to waterways for the purposes of recreation.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1691"},{"id":"1690","label":"National Parks - provision of facilities","desc":"A local authority whose area consists of or includes the whole or any part of a National Park may make arrangements for securing the provision of accommodation, meals and refreshments, camping sites and of parking places.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1690"},{"id":"1689","label":"National Parks - regard to purposes when exercising functions","desc":"A local authority must In exercising or performing any functions in relation to land in a National Park, have regard to the purposes specified in subsection 5(1) the Act and, if it appears that there is a conflict between those purposes, shall attach greater weight to the purpose of conserving and enhancing the natural beauty, wildlife and cultural heritage of the area comprised in the National Park","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1689"},{"id":"401","label":"Natural environment - agreement to carry out a DEFRA function","desc":"A local authority may enter into an agreement with the Secretary of State to carry out a DEFRA function under the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/401"},{"id":"402","label":"Natural environment - agreement with another body to carry out designated DEFRA function","desc":"A local authority may enter into an agreement with another designated body to carry out a function under the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/402"},{"id":"1692","label":"Nature reserves - establishment","desc":"A local authority may establish nature reserves and enter into certain agreements relating to the same.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1692"},{"id":"3139","label":"New towns - overseeing development","desc":"Where the Secretary of State has by order appointed one or more local authorities to oversee the development of the area as a new town the local authority must exercise the functions of the Secretary of State in relation to the new town.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3139"},{"id":"1093","label":"Noise - entry and seizure","desc":"Where a warning notice has been served and at any time in the period specified in the notice, noise emitted from the dwelling has exceeded the permitted level an officer of the local authority, or a person authorised by the authority for the purpose, may enter the dwelling from which the noise in question is being or has been emitted and may seize and remove any equipment which it appears to him is being or has been used in the emission of the noise.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1093"},{"id":"1091","label":"Noise - evidence used in proceedings","desc":"Any evidence used in proceedings brought for an offence must comply with the requirements of section 7 of the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1091"},{"id":"1092","label":"Noise - fixed penalty notice","desc":"An officer authorised by a local authority may issue a fixed penalty notice in the prescribed form if he believes that an offence has been committed and has the power to request the offender to give his name and address.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1092"},{"id":"1089","label":"Noise - investigation of complaints","desc":"An officer of a local authority may investigate certain complaints relating to noise at night emanating from private dwellings and certain other premises and may issue a warning notice.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1089"},{"id":"1094","label":"Noise - loudspeakers in streets or roads","desc":"A local authority may resolve (which resolution must be published) that Schedule 2 (regulation the authorisation process for the operation of loud speakers in streets and roads) is to apply to its area and if it does so resolve, Schedule 2 shall come into force in its area on such date as may be specified for that purpose in the resolution.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1094"},{"id":"1090","label":"Noise - warning notices","desc":"Any warning notice issued must comply with regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1090"},{"id":"2096","label":"Noise pollution - consent to excessive noise","desc":"A local authority may consent to noise being produced at a level above the permitted level in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2096"},{"id":"2093","label":"Noise pollution - construction sites","desc":"A local authority may, by notice or a consent, impose conditions upon the emanation of noise from a construction site.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2093"},{"id":"2099","label":"Noise pollution - execution and costs of works","desc":"A local authority may recover costs for carrying out works required by a noise abatement order in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2099"},{"id":"2092","label":"Noise pollution - inspection for noise abatement areas","desc":"A local authority must cause its area to be inspected from time to time so it can decide how to use its noise abatement powers.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2092"},{"id":"2095","label":"Noise pollution - measurement of noise levels","desc":"A local authority must in relation to an area which it has designated as a noise abatement zone, measure noise levels.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2095"},{"id":"2094","label":"Noise pollution - noise abatement zones","desc":"A local authority may, by order, designate any part of its area a noise abatement zone.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2094"},{"id":"3368","label":"Noise reduction - motor cycle silencer and exhaust systems","desc":"The local authority has the power to ensure compliance with schedule 3 and to enforce the act as necessary to prevent the supply of exhaust systems, silencers and components which are likely to result in motor cycles to which they are fitted emitting excessive noise.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3368"},{"id":"3094","label":"Non domestic rating - levy payment","desc":"A local authority must make a levy payment to the Secretary of State in prescribed circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3094"},{"id":"2895","label":"Non-domestic rates - chargeable amounts","desc":"A local authority must comply with the Regulations when making the calculations which fall within those Regulations","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2895"},{"id":"3791","label":"Non-domestic rates - exceptional billing calculations","desc":"Special provision for the relevant years beginning on 1st April 2021 and 1st April 2022. This paragraph applies to a billing authority where, in the relevant year beginning on 1st April 2021, the exceptional balance the billing authority calculates in accordance with the schedule in Regulations is a negative amount.Where this paragraph applies for the relevant year beginning on 1st April 2021, a billing authority must: (a) include in the amount specified an amount equal to two thirds of the exceptional balance expressed as a positive amount;(b)for the relevant year beginning on 1st April 2022, a billing authority must include in the amount specified an amount equal to one third of the exceptional balance expressed as a positive amount.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3791"},{"id":"2896","label":"Non-domestic rates - lists and appeals","desc":"A local authority must comply with the Regulations when making the calculations which fall within those Regulations","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2896"},{"id":"3808","label":"Non-domestic rates - relief for public lavatories","desc":"Where on the charging day for non-domestic rates a hereditament consists wholly or mainly of public lavatories the chargeable amount on the chargeable day is zero. Liability to any business rate supplement is also zero.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3808"},{"id":"3807","label":"Non-domestic rating - dates for submission of lists","desc":"The Local Government Finance Act 1988 is amended as follows.(2) In section 41 (local non-domestic rating lists)\u2014(a) in subsection (2A) (date on which English local rating lists must be compiled), in paragraph (b), after \"2017\" insert \", on 1 April 2023\";(b) in subsection (5) (deadline for proposed list to be sent to billing authority), for \"30 September\" substitute \"31 December\".(3) In section 52 (central non-domestic rating lists)\u2014(a) in subsection (2A) (date on which English central rating lists must be compiled), in paragraph (b), after \"2017\" insert \", on 1 April 2023\";(b) in subsection (5) (deadline for proposed list to be sent to Secretary of State or Welsh Ministers), for \"30 September\" substitute \"31 December\".(4) In section 54A (postponement of compilation of Welsh lists for 2015 onwards)\u2014(a) in subsection (4)(b) (date on which Welsh local rating lists must be compiled), after \"specified date\" insert \", on 1 April 2023\";(b) in subsection (5)(b) (date on which Welsh central rating lists must be compiled), after \"specified date\" insert \", on 1 April 2023\".","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3807"},{"id":"3809","label":"Non-domestic rating - determinations in respect of lists","desc":"Determinations made by a local authority in respect of certain non-domestic rating lists must take into account what is considered a relevant determination in this legislation when so doing. The authority must take into account Coronavirus related matters when making their determination.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3809"},{"id":"2688","label":"Non-domestic rating - disregarded income 2013","desc":"Local authorities (billing authorities) must disregard a prescribed proportion of the non-domestic rating income from certain prescribed calculations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2688"},{"id":"2738","label":"Non-domestic rating - disregarded income 2014","desc":"Local authorities (billing authorities) must disregard a prescribed proportion of the non-domestic rating income from certain prescribed calculations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2738"},{"id":"2673","label":"Non-domestic rating - levy and safety net payments assessment","desc":"A local authority may request that the Secretary of State calculate whether a safety net payment is likely to be required to be made to the authority in respect of the relevant year. A local authority must make a levy payment to the Secretary of State in prescribed circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2673"},{"id":"1972","label":"Non-domestic rating - local rating lists","desc":"The valuation officer for a billing authority shall compile, and then maintain, lists for the authority (to be called its local non-domestic rating lists). As soon as is reasonably practicable after receiving the copy the authority shall deposit it at its principal office and take such steps as it thinks most suitable for giving notice of it.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1972"},{"id":"1976","label":"Non-domestic rating - partly occupied hereditaments","desc":"Where a hereditament is shown in a billing authority's local non-domestic rating list and it appears to the authority that part of the hereditament is unoccupied but will remain so for a short time only the authority may require the valuation officer for the authority to apportion the rateable value of the hereditament between the occupied and unoccupied parts of the hereditament and to certify the apportionment to the authority.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1976"},{"id":"1975","label":"Non-domestic rating - preparation and maintenance of lists","desc":"The billing authority shall, throughout the period of three months preceding the beginning of the first chargeable financial year for which a rural settlement list is to have effect, make available for inspection a draft of the list in the form in which the authority proposes that it should have effect for that year.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1975"},{"id":"2672","label":"Non-domestic rating - rates retention","desc":"Local authorities (billing authorities) may deduct amounts as prescribed from the central share payable to the Secretary of State or to county councils, fire and rescue authorities in whose area the billing authority is and, for London authorities, the Greater London Authority as prescribed and as may be directed. Provisions may be made in relation to costs, bad debts, reconciliation and for surplus or deficit calculations and according to prescribed time limits.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2672"},{"id":"1977","label":"Non-domestic rating - reduction or remission of liability","desc":"A billing authority may reduce any amount a person is liable to pay for hereditaments or remit payment of the whole of any amount a person would otherwise be liable to pay if the ratepayer would sustain and it is reasonable for the authority to do so, having regard to the interests of persons liable to pay council tax set by it.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1977"},{"id":"2689","label":"Non-domestic rating - renewable energy projects","desc":"A local authority (billing authority) may disregard an amount of non-domestic rating income in relation to designated classes of hereditaments for the purpose of certain calculations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2689"},{"id":"1974","label":"Non-domestic rating - rural settlement lists","desc":"Each billing authority shall compile and maintain, a list (to be called its rural settlement list). It shall identify for each such year any settlements which are wholly or partly within the authority's area, appear to the authority to have had a population of not more than 3,000 on the last 31st December before the beginning of the chargeable financial year in question, and in that financial year are wholly or partly within an area designated by the Secretary of State by order as a rural area for the purposes of this section.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1974"},{"id":"2807","label":"Non-domestic rating - small business relief","desc":"Billing authorities must have regard to the provisions relating to which hereditaments are excepted from the small business rate relief scheme including: a maximum rateable value of \u00a312,000 for hereditaments which might be eligible for relief from non-domestic rates; prescribed conditions of eligibility for relief from non-domestic rates; a temporary rate relief scheme which commences on 1 April 2015 and ceases on 31 March 2016 and information to be included in the notice, the time within which such a notice is to be served and the method of service.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2807"},{"id":"2690","label":"Non-domestic rating - transitional protection payments","desc":"Where a transitional relief scheme is in place a local authority (billing authority) must, on 31st January in the preceding year, estimate the amount of its deemed and actual ratings income for the relevant year (as prescribed) and notify the Secretary of State of the estimated amounts. On or before 31st July in the year following a relevant year a billing authority must calculate the amount of its deemed and actual ratings income for the relevant year, arrange for the calculations and amounts to be certified and, if necessary, pay a reconciliation payment (calculated as prescribed).","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2690"},{"id":"1973","label":"Non-domestic rating Wales - local non-domestic rating lists for amalgamated authorities","desc":"A new billing authority receiving a copy of an amalgamated list (amalgamated list shall contain the information which was included in the local non-domestic rating lists complied on 1st April 1995 for the old billing authorities) shall, as soon as is reasonably practicable, deposit it at its principal office.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1973"},{"id":"1980","label":"Norfolk and Suffolk Broads - general duty of public bodies","desc":"If undertaking work in the Broads, a relevant authority shall have regard to the purposes of conserving and enhancing the natural beauty, wildlife and cultural heritage of the Broads; promoting opportunities for the understanding and enjoyment of the special qualities of the Broads by the public; and protecting the interests of navigation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1980"},{"id":"1874","label":"Officers and members - indemnity from liability","desc":"A local authority must indemnify its officers and members from personal liability in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1874"},{"id":"1496","label":"Officers appointed as receivers or administrators - indemnities","desc":"A local authority may indemnify its officers in their role as receivers or administrators in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1496"},{"id":"2812","label":"Open data - re-use of public sector information","desc":"Local authorities (as public sector bodies) are under a general duty to permit re-use within prescribed timescales and if doing so, must act in accordance with regulations 11 to 16 and establish an internal complaints procedure to determine complaints arising under the Regulations. (Implementing Directive 2013/37/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 26 June 2013 (O.J. No. L175/1, 27.6.2013), which amends Directive 2003/98/EC on the re-use of public sector information).","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2812"},{"id":"1751","label":"Open spaces - appropriation for enjoyment of the public","desc":"A local authority may use its land for the purposes of open spaces.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1751"},{"id":"1754","label":"Open spaces - public walks and pleasure grounds","desc":"A local authority may acquire, lay out and maintain land to be used as public walks and pleasure grounds.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1754"},{"id":"1749","label":"Open spaces - transfer to local authority","desc":"A local authority may accept that certain open spaces may be transferred into its possession.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1749"},{"id":"1752","label":"Open spaces and burial grounds - acquisition of land","desc":"A local authority may acquire, manage and maintain land for the purposes of open spaces or burial grounds.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1752"},{"id":"1756","label":"Open spaces and burial grounds - authorities acting jointly","desc":"Two or more local authorities may act jointly in exercising their powers under the Act and may defray each other expenses.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1756"},{"id":"1757","label":"Open spaces and burial grounds - borrowing","desc":"A local authority may borrow for the purposes of the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1757"},{"id":"1755","label":"Open spaces and burial grounds - byelaws","desc":"A local authority may make byelaws to govern the use of the open spaces and burial grounds that it has acquired.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1755"},{"id":"1753","label":"Open spaces and burial grounds - compensation","desc":"A local authority must pay compensation in certain circumstances in relation to open spaces and burial grounds","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1753"},{"id":"1021","label":"Overseas assistance - advice and assistance","desc":"A local authority may provide non- financial advice and assistance as respects any matter in which they have skill and experience to a body engaged outside the United Kingdom in the carrying on of any of the activities of local government and must comply with any relevant Regulations and have regard to guidance when so doing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1021"},{"id":"2149","label":"Parish or community council - use of schoolroom etc.","desc":"A local authority must allow a parish or community council to use a room in a maintained school or other premises free of charge in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2149"},{"id":"1765","label":"Parks and gardens - additional facilities","desc":"A local authority may provide ice skating, infant play, sports, and recreational facilities and cafes in parks and gardens.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1765"},{"id":"1766","label":"Parks and gardens - wardens","desc":"A local authority may appoint officers to serve as wardens for parks and gardens.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1766"},{"id":"1872","label":"Parks and pleasure gardens - provision and byelaws","desc":"A local authority may purchase or take on lease lay out plant improve and maintain lands for the purpose of being used as public walks or pleasure grounds, and may support or contribute to the support of public walks or pleasure grounds provided by any person and make byelaws in respect of the same.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1872"},{"id":"1613","label":"Parks and pleasure grounds - boating pools and lakes","desc":"A local authority may exercise certain powers relating to the provision and management of boating pools and lakes.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1613"},{"id":"1612","label":"Parks and pleasure grounds - closing","desc":"A local authority may close parks and pleasure grounds at certain times.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1612"},{"id":"1866","label":"Parks and pleasure grounds - hire of boats","desc":"An urban authority may either themselves provide and let for hire, or may license any person to let for hire, any pleasure boats on any lake or piece of water in any such park or pleasure ground, and may make byelaws for regulating the numbering and naming of such boats, the number of persons to be carried therein, the boathouses and mooring places for the same, and for fixing rates of hire and the qualifications of boatmen, and for securing their good and orderly conduct while in charge of any boat.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1866"},{"id":"1867","label":"Parks and pleasure grounds - improvement of lands","desc":"A local authority may lay out plant and improve land forming part of a park or pleasure ground.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1867"},{"id":"1611","label":"Parks and pleasure grounds - management","desc":"A local authority may, exercise certain powers regarding the management of parks and pleasure grounds.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1611"},{"id":"1865","label":"Parks and pleasure grounds - temporary closure for shows","desc":"A local authority may temporarily close a park or pleasure ground, for payment or otherwise to any public charity or institution, or for any agricultural, horticultural, or other show, or any other public purpose.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1865"},{"id":"1775","label":"Parks and recreation grounds - charges for sports","desc":"Where part of a park or recreation ground is set aside for sport a local authority may charge for use of the same.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1775"},{"id":"1498","label":"Payments for restoration or continuation of supply of water, gas or electricity","desc":"A local authority may come to arrangements to enable the continuity or restoration of utility supplies to any premises in its area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1498"},{"id":"1760","label":"Performing animals - enforcement","desc":"A local authority may prosecute proceedings where any person commits an offence under the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1760"},{"id":"1759","label":"Performing animals - powers of entry","desc":"An officer duly authorised by a local authority may enter premises to inspect the animals kept there and to inspect the occupant's certificate","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1759"},{"id":"1758","label":"Performing animals - register","desc":"A local authority must keep a register (which must be available for inspection) for the purpose of this Act containing the details of any person who exhibits or trains animals who applies for registration in the prescribed form and on payment of such fee as appears to the local authority to be appropriate and give to the applicant a certificate of registration.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1758"},{"id":"2955","label":"Personal property - Lost and uncollected property","desc":"A local Authority may take possession of lost and uncollected property in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2955"},{"id":"1686","label":"Persons in hospital - temporary protection of property","desc":"A local authority must provide for the temporary protection of property of certain persons admitted to hospital in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1686"},{"id":"1713","label":"Pest control - compliance with Ministerial order","desc":"A local authority must comply with an order made by the appropriate Minister utilising his default powers where he is satisfied that functions are not being satisfactorily performed by the authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1713"},{"id":"1715","label":"Pest control - legal proceedings for offences regarding rats and mice","desc":"A local authority may institute legal proceedings or give consent for them being instituted.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1715"},{"id":"1710","label":"Pest control - notice requiring destruction of rats and mice","desc":"A local authority may serve notice upon the occupier of land requiring the destruction of rats and mice on the land or otherwise for keeping the land free from rats and mice.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1710"},{"id":"1711","label":"Pest control - power to carry out works to remove rats and mice","desc":"A local authority where a notice has been served under section 4 and not complied with, may carry out those works itself and recover certain expenses.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1711"},{"id":"1714","label":"Pest control - powers of entry for inspection related to functions dealing with rats and mice","desc":"A person duly authorised by a local authority may enter land for the purpose of the authority's functions under the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1714"},{"id":"1709","label":"Pest control - rats and mice","desc":"A local authority must carry out inspections and take action to ensure that its area is kept free (as far as practicable) of rats and mice and to take action to ensure owners of other land comply with the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1709"},{"id":"1712","label":"Pest control - works on multiple premises to control rats and mice","desc":"A local authority may where there is an infestation of rats and mice in an area made up of several premises, enter land, carry out the work and recover certain expenses from the owners.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1712"},{"id":"1707","label":"Pet shops - inspection","desc":"An officer or any veterinary surgeon or veterinary practitioner duly authorised by a local authority may enter a pet shop for the purposes of inspection.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1707"},{"id":"1706","label":"Pet shops - licensing","desc":"A local authority may licence a pet shop, subject to conditions on payment of a fee.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1706"},{"id":"1708","label":"Pet shops - prosecutions","desc":"A local authority may prosecute proceedings for any offence under the Act committed in the area of the authority.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1708"},{"id":"1362","label":"Planning - acquisition of buildings of special interest by agreement","desc":"A local authority may acquire, by agreement, buildings of special architectural or historic interest and contiguous / adjacent land required for the preservation of, access to or management of the building.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1362"},{"id":"1720","label":"Planning - acquisition of land by agreement","desc":"A local authority may acquire land by agreement in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1720"},{"id":"1453","label":"Planning - acquisition of land for exchange","desc":"A local authority may acquire land for exchange purposes in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1453"},{"id":"1448","label":"Planning - action notice for control of advertisements","desc":"A local authority may serve an action notice in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1448"},{"id":"1464","label":"Planning - advance of money in relation to blight notices","desc":"A local authority may advance money to any person in certain circumstances connected with blight notices.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1464"},{"id":"3023","label":"Planning - alternative planning permission providers","desc":"A Local Authority must comply with regulations regarding the provision of information to alternate planning providers.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3023"},{"id":"1424","label":"Planning - appeal against enforcement notice","desc":"A local authority must comply with the procedure for appeals with regard to enforcement notices.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1424"},{"id":"1347","label":"Planning - appeals against listed buildings consent decision","desc":"A local authority must comply with the procedure regarding appeals on listed building consent decisions and the decision of the appeal.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1347"},{"id":"1358","label":"Planning - appeals against listed buildings enforcement notice","desc":"A local authority must comply with the procedure regarding appeals relating to listed building enforcement notices and the outcome of that appeal.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1358"},{"id":"1404","label":"Planning - appeals against planning decisions","desc":"A local authority must comply with the procedure for planning appeals.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1404"},{"id":"1333","label":"Planning - appeals and hearings regarding hazardous substances consents","desc":"A local authority must comply with the appeals procedure and the determination of the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1333"},{"id":"2875","label":"Planning - appeals in Sites of Special Scientific Interest (SSIs)","desc":"A local authority must, where acting as a planning authority utilise this Appeals procedure for SSIs as are laid down in these Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2875"},{"id":"1354","label":"Planning - appeals regarding certificate of lawfulness for listed building","desc":"A local authority must comply with the appeals procedure with regard to certificates of lawfulness.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1354"},{"id":"1433","label":"Planning - appeals to the Secretary of State","desc":"A local authority shall comply with procedures relating to appeals to the Secretary of State against refusal or failure to give decision on a planning application.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1433"},{"id":"1392","label":"Planning - applications to Secretary of State where local authority is designated for not adequately performing function of determining applications","desc":"A designated local authority must comply with any requests made or directions given by the Secretary of State in relation to planning applications made to the Secretary of State in place of the local authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1392"},{"id":"1452","label":"Planning - appropriation of common land","desc":"A local authority may with the consent of the Secretary of State appropriate part of the common land.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1452"},{"id":"1721","label":"Planning - appropriation of land","desc":"A local authority may appropriate land in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1721"},{"id":"1397","label":"Planning - assessment of environmental effects in determination of applications","desc":"A local authority must have regard to prescribed environmental considerations when determining an application.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1397"},{"id":"1422","label":"Planning - assurance regarding prosecution where enforcement notice served","desc":"A local authority may issue and serve an assurance regarding prosecution in circumstances where it has served an enforcement notice.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1422"},{"id":"3648","label":"Planning - availability of local documents","desc":"Where a planning authority is required to make documents available for inspection they must do so by either making the documents available at the offices of the local planning authority or placing the documents on the local planning authority web site for the period of time specified in regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3648"},{"id":"1428","label":"Planning - breach of conditions notice","desc":"A local authority may issue and serve a breach of conditions notice in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1428"},{"id":"3090","label":"Planning - brownfield land register","desc":"Each local planning authority must prepare, maintain and publish a register of previously developed land which is within their area and which meets the criteria defined in these regulations.The register is to be known as that local planning authority\u2019s \u201cBrownfield Land Register\u201dThe register must be published by 31st December 2017","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3090"},{"id":"1343","label":"Planning - buildings preservation notice","desc":"A local authority may serve in the prescribed form a building preservation notice in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1343"},{"id":"1431","label":"Planning - certificate of lawful use or development","desc":"A local authority shall provide a certificate of lawful use or development in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1431"},{"id":"1353","label":"Planning - certificate of lawfulness of proposed works to listed building","desc":"A local authority must issue a certificate of lawfulness of proposed works in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1353"},{"id":"2741","label":"Planning - certificates of lawfulness procedures","desc":"The local authority (planning authority) on receipt of an application for a certificate of lawfulness of proposed works must follow the prescribed procedure, including the period within which an application is to be determined; the procedures for appeals against refusal or failure to give a decision and for revoking a certificate.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2741"},{"id":"3912","label":"Planning - CIL charging schedules","desc":"A local authority which proposes to charge the community infrastructure levy must issue a charging schedule that is subject to examination.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3912"},{"id":"1355","label":"Planning - compensation for decisions on listed buildings","desc":"A local authority must pay compensation in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1355"},{"id":"1427","label":"Planning - compensation for loss due to stop notice","desc":"A local authority must pay compensation where a stop notice has been served in certain circumstances","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1427"},{"id":"1415","label":"Planning - compensation for refusal or conditional grant of planning permission","desc":"A local authority must pay compensation in certain circumstances relating to the refusal or conditional grant of planning permission and in certain circumstances recover those payments.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1415"},{"id":"1330","label":"Planning - compensation for revocation or modification of hazardous substances consent","desc":"A local authority must pay compensation in certain circumstances where an Order is made under section 14.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1330"},{"id":"1414","label":"Planning - compensation for revocation or modification of planning permission","desc":"A local authority must pay compensation in certain circumstances relating to the modification or revocation of planning permission and may in certain circumstances recover some or all of the compensation paid if development is subsequently carried out on the same land.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1414"},{"id":"1438","label":"Planning - compensation for tree preservation orders","desc":"A local authority may, by regulations be placed under a duty to keep registers and pay compensation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1438"},{"id":"2820","label":"Planning - compensation on withdrawal of planning permission","desc":"When local authorities withdraw the development rights prescribed, compensation is only payable in respect of planning applications made within 12 months beginning on the date the directions took effect. They may use the mechanism prescribed for the permitted development rights to be withdrawn without compensation being payable, provided the prescribed procedures are followed as to the manner of withdrawal, the manner of publishing the withdrawal and the maximum period of notice that may be given in respect of withdrawal. Likewise regarding permitted development rights granted by a local development order, and in respect of neighbourhood development orders","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2820"},{"id":"1409","label":"Planning - completion notices for development","desc":"A local authority may serve a completion notice stating that the planning permission will cease to have effect at the expiration of a further period specified in the notice in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1409"},{"id":"1461","label":"Planning - compulsory acquisition in connection with highways","desc":"A local authority may compulsory acquire land in connection with highway in certain circumstances and extinguish certain rights and rights of way.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1461"},{"id":"1450","label":"Planning - compulsory acquisition of land","desc":"A local authority may acquire land for development and other planning purposes in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1450"},{"id":"1361","label":"Planning - compulsory acquisition of listed buildings","desc":"A local authority may acquire a listed building which is not being properly preserved where the Secretary of State authorises it do so.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1361"},{"id":"3025","label":"Planning - compulsory purchase - damage compensation","desc":"Where a Local Authority entering and surveying land which it is acquiring by compulsory purchase causes damage it must pay compensation in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3025"},{"id":"3024","label":"Planning - compulsory purchase - entry of land","desc":"A Local Authority may enter and survey land which it is acquiring by compulsory purchase providing certain conditions are met.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3024"},{"id":"1398","label":"Planning - conditional grant of planning permission","desc":"A local authority may attach conditions to a grant of planning permission.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1398"},{"id":"1326","label":"Planning - conditions for hazardous substances consents","desc":"A local authority may impose conditions when granting a hazardous substance consent.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1326"},{"id":"2625","label":"Planning - confirmation of tree preservation orders","desc":"A local authority may confirm a Tree Preservation Order in accordance with the prescribed provisions and must do so within 6 months and must adhere to the provisions regarding service, notice, publication and availability of copies, representations, variations, revocations and appeals of any Order and any compensation claims as prescribed. Local authorities must keep a public register of applications, appeals and conditions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2625"},{"id":"2620","label":"Planning - conservation areas and listed buildings","desc":"A local authority must follow prescribed procedures for conservation area consent, for the variation or discharge of conditions attached to listed building or conservation area consents and for appeals in respect of these matters and other procedural matters relating to listed building and conservation area consents","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2620"},{"id":"2937","label":"Planning - consultation on development order","desc":"A local authority must have regard to the duty to consult in certain cases.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2937"},{"id":"1331","label":"Planning - continuation of hazardous substances consents","desc":"A local authority must consider and determine application for the continuation of a hazardous substance consent and must pay compensation in certain circumstances..","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1331"},{"id":"1365","label":"Planning - contribution to preservation of listed buildings","desc":"A local authority may by grant or loan and subject to conditions, contribute towards the preservation of a listed building.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1365"},{"id":"1446","label":"Planning - control of advertisements","desc":"A local authority must comply with and enforce regulations providing for the control of advertisements and pay compensation for their removal in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1446"},{"id":"1373","label":"Planning - control of demolition in conservation areas","desc":"A local authority may take certain actions in relation to dangerous structures in a conservation area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1373"},{"id":"1376","label":"Planning - Crown land","desc":"A local authority must comply with provisions relating to Crown land.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1376"},{"id":"2936","label":"Planning - decision notices","desc":"A local authority must have regard to prescribed decision notices","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2936"},{"id":"1449","label":"Planning - defacement of premises","desc":"A local authority may serve notice and remedy the defacement or premises bus shelters or street furniture in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1449"},{"id":"1369","label":"Planning - designation of conservation areas","desc":"A local authority must determine which parts of their area are areas of special architectural or historic interest the character or appearance of which it is desirable to preserve or enhance, shall designate those areas as conservation areas, shall review that determination and shall comply with any directions from the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1369"},{"id":"1454","label":"Planning - determination by the Secretary of State to acquire land","desc":"A local authority must comply with a determination by the Secretary of State to require acquisition or development of land.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1454"},{"id":"1399","label":"Planning - determination of an application to vary conditions","desc":"On an application for planning permission for development of land without complying with conditions subject to which a previous planning permission was granted, a local authority must determine an application for planning permission considering only the question of the conditions subject to which planning permission should be granted.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1399"},{"id":"1378","label":"Planning - determination of procedure for listed buildings","desc":"A local authority must comply with procedures determined by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1378"},{"id":"1375","label":"Planning - determination of relevant application","desc":"A local authority may decline to determine certain applications in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1375"},{"id":"1407","label":"Planning - development in enterprise zones","desc":"A local authority must comply with the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 in so far as it relates to enterprise zone schemes.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1407"},{"id":"2821","label":"Planning - development management procedures","desc":"Local authorities (planning authorities) are required to follow procedures connected with planning applications, consultations in relation to planning applications, the determination of planning applications, appeals, local development orders, certificates of lawful use or development and the maintenance of registers of planning applications and related matters.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2821"},{"id":"1457","label":"Planning - development of land","desc":"A local authority may develop land that has been acquired or appropriated by a local authority for planning purposes, and is for the time being held by the authority for the purposes for which it was so acquired or appropriated.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1457"},{"id":"1388","label":"Planning - development orders for granting of planning permission","desc":"A local authority may grant planning permission pursuant to a development order, which may be subject to conditions or limitations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1388"},{"id":"2638","label":"Planning - development procedure","desc":"A local authority (planning authority) must follow prescribed procedures (including time limits) for planning applications (including planning permission), consultations in relation to planning applications, the determination of planning applications, appeals, local development orders, certificates of lawful use or development, the maintenance of registers of planning applications and other related matters.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2638"},{"id":"1459","label":"Planning - directed stopping up or diversion of highway","desc":"A local authority must comply with an order made by the Secretary of State re the stopping up or diversion of highways","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1459"},{"id":"1351","label":"Planning - direction on local listed building consent orders","desc":"A local authority must comply with directions of the Secretary of State in relation to local listed building consent orders.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1351"},{"id":"1401","label":"Planning - directions etc. as to method of dealing with applications","desc":"A local authority must comply with development orders and directions when dealing with planning applications including in relation to the discharge of planning conditions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1401"},{"id":"1458","label":"Planning - discretionary stopping up or diversion of highway","desc":"A local authority may authorise the stopping up or diversion of a highway for certain planning purposes.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1458"},{"id":"1456","label":"Planning - disposal of appropriated or acquired land","desc":"A local authority may dispose of land appropriated or acquired for planning purposes by following certain procedures.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1456"},{"id":"1722","label":"Planning - disposal of land","desc":"A local authority must take certain steps before disposing of certain types of land and must seek the best price when disposing of land.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1722"},{"id":"1408","label":"Planning - duration of planning permission","desc":"A local authority must incorporate time limits for the commencement of authorised works or for approval of reserved matters into planning permissions and outline planning permissions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1408"},{"id":"3642","label":"Planning - emergency development","desc":"A local authority or a local health service body is permitted to develop on land owned, leased, occupied or maintained by it for the purposes of preventing an emergency, reducing, controlling or mitigating the effects of an emergency or taking other action in connection with an emergency.Any development undertaken must comply with the conditions of these regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3642"},{"id":"1364","label":"Planning - emergency works to preserve listed buildings","desc":"A local authority may carry out emergency works necessary for the preservation of a listed building and may recover the expenses involved in so doing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1364"},{"id":"1439","label":"Planning - enforcement of replacement of trees","desc":"A local authority may take action to enforce the replacement of trees in certain circumstances, including entering land, carrying out works and recovering expenses.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1439"},{"id":"1443","label":"Planning - entry to land under warrant in relation to tree preservation orders","desc":"A person authorised by a local authority may enter land under a warrant issued by the magistrates' court for certain purposes.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1443"},{"id":"1442","label":"Planning - entry to land without warrant in relation to tree preservation orders","desc":"A person authorised by a local authority may enter land without a warrant for certain purposes.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1442"},{"id":"1435","label":"Planning - entry under warrant","desc":"A person duly authorised by a local authority may, at any reasonable hour, enter land with a warrant issued by magistrates for purposes connected to the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1435"},{"id":"1434","label":"Planning - entry without warrant","desc":"A person duly authorised by a local authority may, at any reasonable hour, enter land without a warrant for purposes connected to the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1434"},{"id":"2572","label":"Planning - environmental impact assessment","desc":"A planning authority shall not grant planning permission or subsequent consent unless they have first taken the environmental information into consideration and they shall state in their decision that they have done so. A local authority must follow specified procedures concerning screening opinions, applications, environmental statements, notifications, unauthorised development and other miscellaneous developments.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2572"},{"id":"2842","label":"Planning - Environmental Impact Assessment consideration","desc":"A local authority must not grant consent to an application made in pursuance of a requirement imposed by an order granted development consent for nationally significant infrastructure unless it has first taken the environmental information into consideration, and it must state in its decision that it has done so and in doing so must follow the prescribed procedure.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2842"},{"id":"1432","label":"Planning - established use certificates","desc":"A local authority shall comply with procedures relating to established use certificates.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1432"},{"id":"1445","label":"Planning - execution and cost of works for proper maintenance of land","desc":"A local authority may enter land, carry out works and recover expenses in respect of a notice requiring proper maintenance of land in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1445"},{"id":"1425","label":"Planning - execution and cost of works required by enforcement notice","desc":"A local authority may enter land and carry out works required by an enforcement notice in certain circumstances and recover reasonable expenses for doing so.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1425"},{"id":"1359","label":"Planning - execution of works required by listed building enforcement notice","desc":"A local authority may in certain circumstances where an enforcement notice has not been complied with, enter premises, carry out works and recover the expenses involved in doing so.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1359"},{"id":"1371","label":"Planning - exercise of planning functions in conservation areas","desc":"A local authority must pay special attention to the desirability of preserving or enhancing the character or appearance of a conservation area when exercising planning functions with respect to any buildings or other land in a conservation area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1371"},{"id":"1466","label":"Planning - expenses of county councils","desc":"The council of a county may direct that any expenses incurred by them under the provisions specified in Parts I and II of Schedule 16 shall be treated as special expenses of a county council chargeable upon such part of the county as may be specified in the directions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1466"},{"id":"1460","label":"Planning - extinguishment of rights of way over highway","desc":"A local authority may extinguish rights of way over a highway in certain circumstances having followed a particular procedure.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1460"},{"id":"2639","label":"Planning - fees","desc":"A local authority must forward any fee received in respect of a planning application to the planning authority who are to determine the application and refund any fee where an application is rejected or an authority fails to determine relevant applications in time. A LA may decide that a fee does not apply when it is satisfied that various prescribed reasons are established.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2639"},{"id":"1463","label":"Planning - fees for planning applications etc.","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations made regarding the fees it should charge for exercising certain planning functions and other costs and contributions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1463"},{"id":"1391","label":"Planning - form of applications for planning permission","desc":"A local authority may require that a planning application must include such particulars and evidence as the authority thinks necessary.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1391"},{"id":"1395","label":"Planning - general considerations for determination of applications","desc":"A local authority must have regard to the development plan and any other material considerations and consult when dealing with an application for planning permission.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1395"},{"id":"2822","label":"Planning - general permitted development","desc":"Local authorities (Planning authorities) may grant planning permission for certain prescribed classes of development without the requirement for a planning application to be made under Part 3 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2822"},{"id":"1335","label":"Planning - hazardous substances consent application fees","desc":"A local authority must charge prescribed fees for certain applications.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1335"},{"id":"1325","label":"Planning - hazardous substances consents","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations regarding hazardous substance applications and consents and their determination.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1325"},{"id":"1334","label":"Planning - hazardous substances contravention notice","desc":"A local authority may issue, serve, vary or withdraw (in the prescribed manner) a hazardous substances contravention notice in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1334"},{"id":"1327","label":"Planning - hazardous substances established presence","desc":"A local authority must take certain steps when established presence is claimed in relation to a hazardous substance consent.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1327"},{"id":"1336","label":"Planning - hazardous substances injunctions","desc":"A local authority may apply to the high court or the primary court for any actual or apprehended contravention of hazardous substances control to be restrained by injunction","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1336"},{"id":"1328","label":"Planning - hazardous substances new consent","desc":"A local authority must take certain steps with regard to a new request for consent without the conditions attached to a previous consent.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1328"},{"id":"1339","label":"Planning - hazardous substances on Crown land","desc":"A local authority must comply with provisions relating to hazardous substances on Crown Land.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1339"},{"id":"1337","label":"Planning - hazardous substances temporary exemptions directions","desc":"A local authority must comply with a temporary exemption direction.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1337"},{"id":"1349","label":"Planning - heritage partnership agreements","desc":"A local authority may enter into a heritage partnership agreement with prescribed legal individuals, which may contain prescribed conditions and/or measures.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1349"},{"id":"2740","label":"Planning - heritage partnership agreements procedures","desc":"The local authority (local planning authority) must follow the prescribed procedures for heritage partnership agreements. In particular, the local authority must publicise its intention to make a heritage partnership agreement granting listed building consent and consult English Heritage in prescribed circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2740"},{"id":"1471","label":"Planning - information as to interests in Crown land","desc":"A local authority must provide the Secretary of State with information regarding interests in Crown land for certain purposes connected with the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1471"},{"id":"1470","label":"Planning - information regarding interests in land","desc":"A local authority may by notice in writing require the occupier of any premises and any person who, either directly or indirectly, receives rent in respect of any premises to give in writing certain information.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1470"},{"id":"1441","label":"Planning - injunctions for breach of tree preservation orders","desc":"A local authority may apply for an injunction to prevent a breach of this part of the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1441"},{"id":"1360","label":"Planning - injunctions for enforcement of listed buildings consent","desc":"A local authority may apply to the high or county courts for injunctive relief in certain circumstances connected to enforcement.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1360"},{"id":"1429","label":"Planning - injunctions restraining breaches of planning control","desc":"A local authority may seek an injunction in the county or high courts to enforce planning control.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1429"},{"id":"1344","label":"Planning - issue of certificate that building not intended to be listed","desc":"A local authority may not serve a building preservation notice for the period during which a certificate from the Secretary of State (or Welsh Ministers) that the building is not intended to be listed is in force.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1344"},{"id":"1421","label":"Planning - issue of enforcement notice","desc":"A local authority may issue and serve an enforcement notice where it appears to them that there has been a breach of planning control and that it is expedient to issue the notice having regard to the development plan and any other material considerations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1421"},{"id":"2612","label":"Planning - land compensation (England)","desc":"A local authority must follow the prescribed procedure for issuing certificates under section 17 of the Land Compensation Act 1961 and send copies to other prescribed planning authorities.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2612"},{"id":"2613","label":"Planning - land compensation (Wales)","desc":"A local authority must follow the prescribed procedure when issuing certificates under section 17 of the Land Compensation Act 1961.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2613"},{"id":"1342","label":"Planning - list of buildings of special architectural or historical interest","desc":"A local authority must be guided by the list of buildings of special architectural or historical interest approved by the Secretary of State when carrying out its functions under the Act and must where applicable make a list of such buildings within its area available for inspection.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1342"},{"id":"2742","label":"Planning - listed building consent orders","desc":"Local authorities must follow prescribed procedures for local listed building consent orders regarding their preparation and revocation and for notice, publicity, public inspection and consultation. LAs must also have regard to prescribed matters in relation to compensation for withdrawal.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2742"},{"id":"1345","label":"Planning - listed buildings consent","desc":"A local authority may award listed buildings consent for the alteration, extension or demolition of a listed building in the manner prescribed and subject to conditions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1345"},{"id":"1357","label":"Planning - listed buildings enforcement notice","desc":"A local authority may issue, serve, amend, vary or withdraw a listed building enforcement notice in the prescribed manner in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1357"},{"id":"1368","label":"Planning - listed buildings in Greater London","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations regarding directions from the Historic Buildings and Monuments Commission for any application for planning permission for any development in Greater London which would, in the opinion of the local planning authority to which the application is made, involve the demolition, in whole or in part, or a material alteration, of a listed building.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1368"},{"id":"1356","label":"Planning - listed buildings purchase notices","desc":"A local authority must comply with the procedure relating to listed building purchase notices.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1356"},{"id":"1350","label":"Planning - local listed building consent orders","desc":"A local authority may grant listed building consent for works by means of a local listed building consent order.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1350"},{"id":"2640","label":"Planning - local plans","desc":"Local authorities must comply with the prescribed procedures in relation to local plans and supplementary planning documents and procedures regarding publication of the local plan or supplementary planning document, consultation on those documents and consideration of representations made and their subsequent adoption or withdrawal. Further with requirements and procedures regarding submission to or intervention by the Secretary of State, independent examination of the local plan and publication of the recommendations of the person appointed to examine the local plan. An LA must also have regard to procedures relating to joint development documents, availability of documents and the monitoring reports which they must prepare.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2640"},{"id":"3649","label":"Planning - London spatial development availability of documents","desc":"The Mayor of London must make copies of the London Spatial Development Strategy available for public inspection.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3649"},{"id":"1402","label":"Planning - major infrastructure projects","desc":"A local authority must refer certain planning applications to the Secretary of State for determination if the Secretary of State thinks that the development to which the application relates is of national or regional importance and so directs.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1402"},{"id":"1363","label":"Planning - management and disposal of acquired listed buildings","desc":"A local authority may manage and disposal of any buildings acquired under sections 47 or 52 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1363"},{"id":"2627","label":"Planning - neighbourhood area designation","desc":"A local authority must follow the procedure regarding applications for designation of a neighbourhood area or forum; for making neighbourhood development plans and in relation to neighbourhood development orders and the EIA Directive","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2627"},{"id":"2628","label":"Planning - neighbourhood area referendums","desc":"An LA must conduct a referendum in accordance with the Neighbourhood Planning Referendums Rules and other electoral legislation and these regulations including using the form of words prescribed, publish further information not fewer than 28 days before the date it is held and comply with the various specified restrictions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2628"},{"id":"1390","label":"Planning - neighbourhood development orders","desc":"A local authority must, in certain circumstances, make a Neighbourhood Development Order.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1390"},{"id":"1410","label":"Planning - non-material changes to planning permission","desc":"A local authority may make non-material changes to planning permissions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1410"},{"id":"1393","label":"Planning - notice of applications for planning permission","desc":"A local authority must not entertain an application for planning permission unless notice requirements have been complied with.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1393"},{"id":"1444","label":"Planning - notice requiring proper maintenance of land","desc":"A local authority may serve a notice requiring a person to properly maintain land and must comply with the appeals procedure.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1444"},{"id":"1412","label":"Planning - orders for discontinuance, alterations or removals etc.","desc":"A local authority may (subject to confirmation by the Secretary of State) make orders, with regard to planning permissions, requiring continuance, discontinuance, alterations or removals etc. and recover expenses in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1412"},{"id":"2823","label":"Planning - override of easements","desc":"Local authorities may override easements and other rights which would otherwise restrict their use of land that has been acquired or appropriated for planning purposes. They can do this only if the use is in accordance with planning permission.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2823"},{"id":"1400","label":"Planning - permission for development already carried out","desc":"A local authority may grant planning permission for development already carried out.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1400"},{"id":"3647","label":"Planning - permitted development - use of land for market","desc":"The use of any land for the purposes of holding a market by or on behalf of a local authority and the provision on the land of any moveable structure for the permitted use at any time during the period when these regulations apply.Such development is not permitted if the land is, or is within, a site of special scientific interest.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3647"},{"id":"1419","label":"Planning - planning contravention notice","desc":"A local authority may issue a planning contravention notice in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1419"},{"id":"1418","label":"Planning - planning enforcement order","desc":"A local authority may apply to the Magistrates' Court for a planning enforcement order in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1418"},{"id":"1413","label":"Planning - planning obligations","desc":"A local authority may enter into, modify or discharge planning obligations in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1413"},{"id":"1366","label":"Planning - planning permission for listed buildings","desc":"A local authority considering whether to grant planning permission for development which affects a listed building or its setting, shall have special regard to the desirability of preserving the building or its setting or any features of special architectural or historic interest which it possesses.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1366"},{"id":"1396","label":"Planning - power to decline to determine applications","desc":"A local authority may decline to determine applications in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1396"},{"id":"1377","label":"Planning - powers of entry for listed buildings and conservation areas","desc":"An authorised officer of a local authority may for certain purposes under the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 enter land for those purposes.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1377"},{"id":"1467","label":"Planning - procedure for certain proceedings and local inquiries","desc":"A local authority must comply with certain procedures and inquiries relating to the planning process. A determination must provide for the proceedings to be considered in whichever of the following ways appears to the Secretary of State to be most appropriate at a local inquiry, at a hearing or on the basis of representations in writing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1467"},{"id":"1370","label":"Planning - proposals for preservation and enhancement of conservation areas","desc":"A local authority must formulate and publicise proposals for the preservation and enhancement of conservation areas.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1370"},{"id":"1436","label":"Planning - provision for preservation and planting of trees","desc":"A local authority shall ensure that in granting planning permission for any development, adequate provision is made, by the imposition of conditions, for the preservation or planting of trees","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1436"},{"id":"3651","label":"Planning - publication for development of nationally significant infrastructure","desc":"Where a developer has made an application for a development of nationally significant infrastructure publicity for the proposed application, notice of the accepted application (where this applies) and publicising of the acceptance notice must all be done in accordance with regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3651"},{"id":"1372","label":"Planning - publicity for applications affecting conservation areas","desc":"A local authority must comply with directions from the Secretary of State with regard to publicity to be given to planning applications affecting conservation areas.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1372"},{"id":"1367","label":"Planning - publicity for applications affecting listed buildings","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations regarding publicity for applications for planning permissions which may affect listed buildings.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1367"},{"id":"1416","label":"Planning - purchase notices","desc":"A local authority must comply with a purchase notice in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1416"},{"id":"1417","label":"Planning - purchase of blighted land notice","desc":"A local authority must comply with a purchase of blighted land notice in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1417"},{"id":"1465","label":"Planning - recovery of compensation","desc":"A local authority must pay amounts equivalent to compensation paid to the Secretary of State in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1465"},{"id":"1332","label":"Planning - referral of applications for hazardous substances consents","desc":"A local authority must comply with directions requiring the referral of certain applications to the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1332"},{"id":"1403","label":"Planning - referral of applications to the Secretary of State","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations regarding the referral of planning applications to the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1403"},{"id":"1394","label":"Planning - register of applications etc.","desc":"A local authority must keep, maintain and make available a register of planning related matters.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1394"},{"id":"1430","label":"Planning - register of enforcement and stop notices","desc":"A local authority shall, in the manner prescribed keep a register of enforcement and stop notices and other enforcement action.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1430"},{"id":"1338","label":"Planning - register of hazardous substances applications and consents","desc":"A local authority must compile, maintain and make available a register with the prescribed content relating to hazardous substances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1338"},{"id":"3057","label":"Planning - register of land","desc":"A local authority must comply with Regulations requiring it to prepare and maintain a register of certain types of land.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3057"},{"id":"1440","label":"Planning -
