In order to investigate the authority has the power to enter premises and to make test purchases.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3290"},{"id":"3342","label":"Product safety - gas appliances","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance and enforce the Regulations relating to gas appliances","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3342"},{"id":"3289","label":"Product safety - general enforcement","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and enforce regulations relating to general product safety.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3289"},{"id":"3343","label":"Product safety - issue of notices for gas appliances","desc":"A local authority may serve a compliance notice, a withdrawal notice or a recall notice on a relevant economic operator in respect of an appliance or fitting if the authority has reasonable grounds for believing that there is non-compliance with regulations","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3343"},{"id":"3375","label":"Product safety - nightwear","desc":"The local authority has the power to seize and test goods to ensure compliance with regulations relating to nightwear safety.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3375"},{"id":"3382","label":"Product safety - oil heaters","desc":"The local authority may test oil heaters to ensure compliance with safety regulations","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3382"},{"id":"3387","label":"Product safety - pedal bicycles","desc":"The local authority has the power to institute proceedings against anyone who fails to comply with regulations relating to the supply of either assembled bicycles or bicycles with unassembled parts.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3387"},{"id":"3396","label":"Product safety - pressure equipment","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to the safety of pressure equipment and assemblies of pressure equipment.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3396"},{"id":"3285","label":"Product safety - pyrotechnic articles","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce the regulations relating to the safety of pyrotechnic articles as defined in the regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3285"},{"id":"3411","label":"Product safety - REACH enforcement","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to REACH (the registration, evaluation, authorisation and restriction of chemicals)","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3411"},{"id":"3412","label":"Product safety - recreational craft","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to recreational craft.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3412"},{"id":"3421","label":"Product safety - simple pressure vessels","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to the safety of simple pressure vessels","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3421"},{"id":"3433","label":"Product safety - supply of machinery","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to the safety of supplied machinery","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3433"},{"id":"2691","label":"Protection of freedom - surveillance cameras","desc":"Local authorities must have regard to the Code of Practice issued under section 29(1) of the Protection of Freedoms Act 2012 when exercising any functions to which the Code relates.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2691"},{"id":"1590","label":"Provision of garage accommodation","desc":"A local authority may provide, maintain and repair garage facilities.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1590"},{"id":"1490","label":"Provision of recreational facilities","desc":"A local authority may provide, grant loans or charge for recreational facilities.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1490"},{"id":"1491","label":"Provision of sanitary appliances at places of entertainment","desc":"A local authority may by notice require the owner or occupier of a place of entertainment to provide sanitary appliances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1491"},{"id":"3037","label":"Psychoactive substances - enforcement of access provisions","desc":"A person authorised by a local authority may\u2014enter premises in respect of which an access prohibition is in effect (see section 22(6)); anddo anything necessary to secure the premises against entry.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3037"},{"id":"3040","label":"Psychoactive substances - entry or search of premises","desc":"A local authority may apply to a Magistrate\u2019s court for a warrant to enter and search premises in certain circumstances","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3040"},{"id":"3045","label":"Psychoactive substances - entry, search and seizure \u2013 reasonable force","desc":"A local authority officer may use reasonable force in exercising the powers of entry, search and seizure under the Act","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3045"},{"id":"3041","label":"Psychoactive substances - examination, testing and taking samples","desc":"A local authority officer to whom a warrant under section 39 has been issued may examine, test and take samples of substances found on the premises","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3041"},{"id":"3046","label":"Psychoactive substances - forfeiture of seized items","desc":"A local authority may apply to a court for the forfeiture of seized items.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3046"},{"id":"3035","label":"Psychoactive substances - premises notice","desc":"A local authority may issues a premises notice in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3035"},{"id":"3042","label":"Psychoactive substances - production of documents","desc":"A local authority officer to whom a warrant under section 39 has been issued may require the production of documents","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3042"},{"id":"3034","label":"Psychoactive substances - prohibition notices","desc":"A local authority may issues a prohibition notice in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3034"},{"id":"3036","label":"Psychoactive substances - prohibition or premises order","desc":"A local authority may apply for a Prohibition or Premises Order in certain circumstances","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3036"},{"id":"3038","label":"Psychoactive substances - recovery of costs","desc":"A local authority may apply to a court to recover its costs expended in enforcing access provisions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3038"},{"id":"3047","label":"Psychoactive substances - return or disposal of seized items","desc":"A local authority must comply with its duty to return or dispose of items seized under the Act","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3047"},{"id":"3044","label":"Psychoactive substances - seizure and detention of items, notices and records","desc":"A local authority officer who has seized items using powers under the Act must comply with the requirements under the Act relating to the giving of notices and keeping records","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3044"},{"id":"3043","label":"Psychoactive substances - seizure of items or documents","desc":"A local authority officer to whom a warrant under section 39 has been issued may seize and/or detain items and take copies of documents or records.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3043"},{"id":"3039","label":"Psychoactive substances - variation or discharge of prohibition or premises orders","desc":"A local authority may apply for the variation or discharge of a Prohibition or Premises Order in certain circumstances","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3039"},{"id":"4078","label":"Public Authorities (Fraud, Error and Recovery) Act 2025 Provision of Information","desc":"A local authority must, provide the Minister with information when presented with a valid Information Notice.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/4078"},{"id":"4079","label":"Public Authorities (Fraud, Error and Recovery) Act 2025 Provision of Information - Review","desc":"A local authority may apply to the Minister to review the issue of the Information Notice.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/4079"},{"id":"4080","label":"Public Authorities (Fraud, Error and Recovery) Act 2025 Recovery of proceeds \u2013 Sharing","desc":"A local authority may share proceeds recovered where the Minister has recovered sums on its behalf with the Minister.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/4080"},{"id":"4077","label":"Public Authorities (Fraud, Error and Recovery) Act 2025 \u2013 General Duty","desc":"A local authority must, co-operate with an investigation by the Cabinet Office Minister into fraud and must pay any fees incurred by the Minister.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/4077"},{"id":"1873","label":"Public clocks - provision","desc":"Any urban authority may from time to time provide such clocks as they consider necessary, and cause them to be fixed on or against any public building, or, with the consent of the owner or occupier, on or against any private building the situation of which may be convenient for that purpose, and may cause the dials thereof to be lighted at night, and may from time to time alter and remove any such clocks to such other like situation as they may consider expedient.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1873"},{"id":"1868","label":"Public clocks - repairing, maintaining, winding up, and lighting","desc":"A local authority may repair, maintain, wind up and light up a public clock.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1868"},{"id":"2560","label":"Public health - animals","desc":"LAs have the powers along with the Secretary of State and the Food Standards Agency to appoint inspectors, who have powers of entry and inspection","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2560"},{"id":"1823","label":"Public health - application of legislation to Crown property","desc":"A local authority may enter into an agreement regarding the application of the Act to Crown property.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1823"},{"id":"3727","label":"Public health - appointment of Director of Public Health","desc":"Each local authority must, acting jointly with the Secretary of State, appoint an individual to have responsibility for public health functions within the authority area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3727"},{"id":"370","label":"Public health - appointment of directors","desc":"A local authority must, acting jointly with the Secretary of State, appoint a director of public health. A local authority must have regard to any guidance given by the Secretary of State in relation to its director of public health, including guidance as to appointment and termination of appointment, terms and conditions and management.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/370"},{"id":"1822","label":"Public health - arbitration of water rights","desc":"A local authority may refer certain disputes relating to water rights to arbitration.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1822"},{"id":"394","label":"Public health - arrangements between local authorities and NHS bodies","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations made by the Welsh ministers regarding co-operation between them and NHS bodies in Wales.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/394"},{"id":"373","label":"Public health - arrangements between NHS bodies and local authorities","desc":"A local authority must have regard to regulations regarding joint arrangements between the NHS and the local authority for carrying out prescribed arrangements for the discharge of prescribed functions concerning exercise of its health function.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/373"},{"id":"3768","label":"Public health - authority actions where child excluded from school","desc":"Where a local authority has required that a child is kept away from school for public health reasons the authority must as soon as reasonably practicable after serving such notice inform the headteacher of the child's school that it has served the notice and of the contents of the notice.The authority must review the notice within 5 working days beginning with the day on which the request is made where the child's parent is requesting a review in respect of that notice for the first time and must inform the parent and the headteacher of the child's school of the outcome of the review.A local authority must inform the child's parent and the headteacher of the child's school as soon as reasonably practicable where a notice has expired and no further notice is to be served.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3768"},{"id":"1800","label":"Public health - bathing huts","desc":"A local authority may provide bathing huts or conveniences and charge for the use of the same.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1800"},{"id":"1762","label":"Public health - byelaws","desc":"A local authority may pass byelaws under the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1762"},{"id":"1616","label":"Public health - byelaws concerning pleasure fairs and roller skating","desc":"A local authority may pass bye laws to regulate pleasure fairs and roller skating to ensure public safety.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1616"},{"id":"1801","label":"Public health - byelaws for privately run swimming baths and pools","desc":"A local authority may make byelaws regulation the use of swimming baths and swimming pools whether open or covered not under local authority control.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1801"},{"id":"1808","label":"Public health - byelaws for tents, vans and sheds used for human habitation","desc":"A local authority may make byelaws for promoting cleanliness in, and the habitable conditions of, tents, vans, sheds and similar structures used for human habitation and generally for the prevention of nuisances in connection therewith.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1808"},{"id":"1785","label":"Public health - byelaws for the prevention of nuisances","desc":"A local authority may make byelaws to prevent the occurrence of nuisances from snow, filth, dust, ashes and rubbish, the keeping of animals so as to be prejudicial to health and the movement through streets of offensive matter or liquids.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1785"},{"id":"1810","label":"Public health - byelaws regulating hop and fruit pickers","desc":"A local authority may make byelaws regulating the provision of accommodation for hop, fruit, vegetable, flower or bulb pickers.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1810"},{"id":"1799","label":"Public health - byelaws to regulate public bathing","desc":"A local authority may make byelaws to regulate public bathing including specifying the times and places where public bathing is permitted or prohibiting bathing where it may be dangerous.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1799"},{"id":"3129","label":"Public health - canal boats","desc":"A local authority shall enforce any regulations regarding canal boats in respect of those boats present in it's area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3129"},{"id":"1781","label":"Public health - cleaning of common courts and passages","desc":"A local authority may sweep, clean and remove rubbish from common courts and passages and recover the expense of doing the same.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1781"},{"id":"1784","label":"Public health - cleansing of premises","desc":"A local authority may issue a notice requiring the cleansing of filthy or verminous premises and if that notice is not complied with it may carry out the work itself and recover the expenses involved in doing so.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1784"},{"id":"1788","label":"Public health - cleansing stations","desc":"A local authority may provide cleansing stations to enable it to discharge its functions under the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1788"},{"id":"1797","label":"Public health - closure of public baths during winter months","desc":"A local authority may temporarily close a public bath between 1 October and 31 March to allow its use for other purposes.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1797"},{"id":"377","label":"Public health - co-operation between NHS bodies and authorities","desc":"In exercising their respective functions NHS bodies (on the one hand) and local authorities (on the other) must co-operate with one another in order to secure and advance the health and welfare of the people of England and Wales.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/377"},{"id":"3812","label":"Public health - co-operation between NHS bodies and local authorities","desc":"In exercising their respective functions NHS bodies (on the one hand) and local authorities (on the other) must co-operate with one another in order to secure and advance the health and welfare of the people of England and Wales.Local Authorities must also have regard to any guidance published by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3812"},{"id":"1821","label":"Public health - compensation","desc":"A local authority must pay compensation to a person or body who suffers any direct pecuniary loss in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1821"},{"id":"372","label":"Public health - complaints about exercise of public health functions","desc":"A local authority must have regard to regulations made in relation to complaints concerning exercise of its health functions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/372"},{"id":"1798","label":"Public health - conducting water to baths and wash-houses","desc":"A local authority may lay pipes and apparatus for the purpose of conducting water to baths and wash-houses.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1798"},{"id":"1807","label":"Public health - contribution of expenses for works on watercourses","desc":"A local authority may defray the costs of works relating to certain watercourses.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1807"},{"id":"3128","label":"Public health - control of certain diseases","desc":"A local authority shall, where stipulated, comply with regulations for the control of certain diseases.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3128"},{"id":"1819","label":"Public health - cost of Ministerial orders","desc":"A local authority must pay the cost of Ministerial orders in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1819"},{"id":"1804","label":"Public health - court order for cleansing ponds, pools, ditches and gutters","desc":"A local authority may apply for a court order requiring a neighbouring local authority to carry out works in respect of ponds, pools, ditches and gutters lying near to, or forming, boundary of district.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1804"},{"id":"1805","label":"Public health - culverting for building works","desc":"A local authority may by notice require or allow the owner of land to culvert certain water courses in connection with building works.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1805"},{"id":"1778","label":"Public health - defective lavatories in buildings","desc":"A local authority may issue a notice requiring the repair of a defective closet (lavatory).","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1778"},{"id":"378","label":"Public health - dental public health","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations regarding its dental public health function.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/378"},{"id":"1794","label":"Public health - directed mortuaries and post-mortem rooms","desc":"A local authority must provide mortuaries and post-mortem rooms if required to do so by the Minister and may make byelaws and charge for the use of the same.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1794"},{"id":"376","label":"Public health - directed partnership arrangements in England","desc":"A local authority must comply with any directions made by the Secretary of State in respect of directed partnership arrangements for a failing body.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/376"},{"id":"397","label":"Public health - directed partnership arrangements in Wales","desc":"A local authority must enter into directed partnership arrangements when directed by the Welsh ministers.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/397"},{"id":"1793","label":"Public health - discretionary mortuaries and post-mortem rooms.","desc":"A local authority may provide mortuaries and post-mortem rooms, may make byelaws and charge for the use of the same","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1793"},{"id":"1619","label":"Public health - enforcement of byelaws for hairdressers and barbers","desc":"A local authority must enforce byelaws made under section 77 to regulate hairdressers and barbers.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1619"},{"id":"1814","label":"Public health - entry of premises in connection with Public Health Act","desc":"An officer duly authorised by a local authority may enter premises to ascertain compliance with byelaws and building regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1814"},{"id":"383","label":"Public health - equipment and facilities","desc":"A local authority may make equipment and facilities available to other authorities and accommodation available to certain local authority officers.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/383"},{"id":"375","label":"Public health - establishment of a care trust","desc":"A local authority must publish proposals, inform and consult in the prescribed manner before establishing a care trust.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/375"},{"id":"1779","label":"Public health - examination and testing of drains","desc":"A local authority may examine and test any sanitary convenience, drain, private sewer or cesspool believed to be defective.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1779"},{"id":"1811","label":"Public health - execution of works on sewers and drains","desc":"A local authority may with the agreement of a third party carry out certain works on sewers and drains on his behalf and at his expense.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1811"},{"id":"379","label":"Public health - exercise by local authorities of certain public health functions","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations regarding its public health function.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/379"},{"id":"1818","label":"Public health - expenses of joint boards","desc":"A local authority must pay towards the expenses of joint boards created under the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1818"},{"id":"1815","label":"Public health - expenses payable by instalments","desc":"A local authority may determine that certain expenses will be payable by instalment","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1815"},{"id":"1764","label":"Public health - fencing of land adjoining streets","desc":"A local authority may in certain circumstances issue a notice requiring an owner of land adjoining streets to fence off that land and if that work is not done, carry it out itself and recover the cost as a civil debt.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1764"},{"id":"1786","label":"Public health - filthy or verminous articles","desc":"A local authority may remove filthy or verminous articles from premises and cleanse or destroy them in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1786"},{"id":"2636","label":"Public health - general functions","desc":"A local authority has the functions specified in relation to public health (including dental health) and must have regard to any document published by the Secretary of State in the exercise of prescribed functions and must make arrangements for the handling and recording of complaints. An LA must ensure arrangements made by Local Healthwatch organisations with other persons include certain provisions about procedures, decision-making and the use of a trade mark. An overview and scrutiny committee of a LA must acknowledge receipt of a referral of a social care matter by a Local Healthwatch organisation contractor within 20 working days","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2636"},{"id":"371","label":"Public health - guidance from Secretary of State","desc":"A local authority must have regard to any document published by the Secretary of State when exercising health functions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/371"},{"id":"3728","label":"Public health - Health and Wellbeing Board","desc":"A local authority must establish a Health and Wellbeing Board for its area.The Health and Wellbeing Board is to consist of\u2014at least one councillor of the local authority, nominated in accordance with regulations,- the director of adult social services for the local authority,- the director of children\u2019s services for the local authority,- the director of public health for the local authority,- a representative of the Local Healthwatch organisation for the area of the local authority,- a representative of each relevant clinical commissioning group- such other persons, or representatives of such other persons, as the local authority thinks appropriate.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3728"},{"id":"398","label":"Public health - health and wellbeing strategies","desc":"A local authority must formulate and implement a health and wellbeing strategy in accordance with regulations from the Welsh ministers.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/398"},{"id":"369","label":"Public health - improving health of people in local area","desc":"A local authority must take steps it considers appropriate to improve the health of people living within its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/369"},{"id":"1817","label":"Public health - indemnity of members and officers","desc":"A local authority must indemnify members and officers in certain circumstances in relation to certain actions taken under the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1817"},{"id":"2550","label":"Public health - infection and contamination control","desc":"LAs in Wales have discretionary powers to prevent, protect against, control or provide a public health response to the incidence or spread of infection or contamination which presents or could present significant harm to human health. LAs can require that a child is kept away from school; a head teacher provide it with the names and contact details of the pupils at the school; disinfect or decontaminate things or premises on request from the owner or tenant; request specified things for health protection purposes and offer compensation or expenses in relation to a request; restrict contact with, and access to, a dead body and take action to relocate a dead body.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2550"},{"id":"1614","label":"Public health - inspection of derelict petrol tanks","desc":"An officer authorised by a local authority may inspect derelict petrol tanks to ensure their compliance with the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1614"},{"id":"3814","label":"Public health - Integrated Care Partnerships","desc":"An integrated care board and each responsible local authority whose area coincides with or falls wholly or partly within the board's area must establish a joint committee for the board's area, with one member appointed by each responsible local authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3814"},{"id":"1777","label":"Public health - joint boards","desc":"Certain local authorities may set up joint boards in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1777"},{"id":"3811","label":"Public health - joint committees with NHS Bodies and pooled funds","desc":"Where a function is exercisable jointly (by virtue of section 65Z5 or otherwise) by a relevant NHS Body and any local authority or a combined authority, those bodies may\u2014(a) arrange for the function to be exercised by a joint committee of theirs;(b) arrange for one or more of the bodies, or a joint committee of the bodies, to establish and maintain a pooled fund.Arrangements under this section may be made on such terms as may be agreed between the parties, including terms as to payment.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3811"},{"id":"3813","label":"Public health - joint Local Health and Wellbeing Strategies","desc":"Where a local authority receives an integrated care strategy under section 116ZB(7)(b) of the Act, the responsible local authority must prepare a strategy (\"a joint local health and wellbeing strategy\") setting out how the assessed needs in relation to the responsible local authority's area are to be met if required.In preparing a strategy the local authority must, in particular, consider the extent to which the assessed needs could be met more effectively by the making of arrangements under section 75 of the National Health Service Act 2006.When preparing a strategy under this section, the local authority must have regard to the integrated care strategy prepared under section 116ZB, the mandate published by the Secretary of State under section 13A of the National Health Service Act 2006, any guidance issued by the Secretary of State; and must involve the Local Healthwatch organisation for the area of the local authority, and involve the people who live or work in that area.The local authority must publish each strategy prepared by it under this section.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3813"},{"id":"382","label":"Public health - joint overview and scrutiny committee","desc":"A local authority may set up a joint overview and scrutiny committee with other local authorities in relation to health services in accordance with Regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/382"},{"id":"3810","label":"Public health - joint working and delegation arrangements with NHS bodies","desc":"A local authority may agree with any relevant NHS body for any functions exercisable by the NHS body be exercised by or jointly with a local authority.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3810"},{"id":"380","label":"Public health - joint working with prison service","desc":"A local authority must in carrying out its public health function co-operate with the prison service in making arrangements to improve the health of prisoners.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/380"},{"id":"1802","label":"Public health - life saving appliances.","desc":"A local authority may provide life- saving appliances at any place.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1802"},{"id":"1820","label":"Public health - Ministerial default powers","desc":"A local authority which has failed to discharge their functions must comply with the Minister when exercising his default powers and pay any expenses incurred by the Minister in so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1820"},{"id":"2359","label":"Public health - monitoring of risks","desc":"It is the duty of the relevant local authority to carry out the function of monitoring of public health risks, and imposing or enabling the imposition of restrictions or requirements on or in relation to persons, things or premises in the event of, or in response to, a threat to public health in the authority area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2359"},{"id":"1809","label":"Public health - moveable dwellings licensing","desc":"A local authority may licence the use of land for moveable dwellings which includes any tent, any van or other conveyance whether on wheels or not, and, subject as hereinafter provided, any shed or similar structure, being a tent, conveyance or structure which is used either regularly, or at certain seasons only, or intermittently, for human habitation","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1809"},{"id":"1790","label":"Public health - nuisances","desc":"A local authority may take action against certain nuisances arising outside its district.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1790"},{"id":"1780","label":"Public health - overflowing and leaking cesspools","desc":"A local authority may by notice require the repair of or other works to an overflowing or leaking cesspool.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1780"},{"id":"381","label":"Public health - overview and scrutiny committees","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations regarding the review and scrutiny of health services within its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/381"},{"id":"3455","label":"Public health - Part 2a orders (England)","desc":"LAs in England must make reasonable enquiries of and give notice to prescribed persons of an application for a Part 2A order under the Public Health (Control of Disease) Act 1984 and may impose reasonable charges to recover the costs of actions taken where an order is in relation things and premises. An LA must provide information to the person subject to the order and have regard to the impact of the order on the welfare of that person or any, where an order is for detention, isolation or quarantine. It must also report details of applications, orders and variations or revocations of orders to the Health Protection Agency","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3455"},{"id":"2551","label":"Public health - Part 2a orders (Wales)","desc":"LAs in Wales must make reasonable enquiries of and give notice to prescribed persons of an application for a Part 2A order under the Public Health (Control of Disease) Act 1984 and may impose reasonable charges to recover the costs of actions taken where an order is in relation things and premises. An LA must provide information to the person subject to the order and have regard to the impact of the order on the welfare of that person or any, where an order is for detention, isolation or quarantine. It must also report details of applications, orders and variations or revocations of orders to the Welsh Ministers","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2551"},{"id":"1813","label":"Public health - payment of compensation for damages","desc":"A local authority must pay compensation in certain circumstances to people who have suffered loss as a result of the exercise of its powers under the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1813"},{"id":"395","label":"Public health - payments to board or commissioning group in Wales","desc":"A local authority may make payments to a Strategic Health Authority, a Primary Care Trust or a Local Health Board towards expenditure incurred or to be incurred by the body in connection with the performance by it of prescribed functions. in accordance with directions made by the Welsh ministers.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/395"},{"id":"374","label":"Public health - payments to boards and commissioning groups in England","desc":"A local authority may make payments to various boards and commissioning groups in connection with the exercise of its health function and must have regard to directions prescribed by the Secretary of State when so doing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/374"},{"id":"1792","label":"Public health - polluted water supplies","desc":"A local authority may close or restrict use from certain polluted water supplies.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1792"},{"id":"1803","label":"Public health - ponds, pools, ditches and gutters","desc":"A local authority may carry out works in respect of ponds, pools, ditches and gutters or contribute towards the expenses of others doing the same.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1803"},{"id":"2938","label":"Public health - prevention, care and aftercare","desc":"A local authority may to the extent directed by the Secretary of State and with his approval make arrangements for provide prevention, care and aftercare in relation to its health function.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2938"},{"id":"1609","label":"Public health - prohibition of sale of verminous articles","desc":"A local authority may, in accordance with the prescribed procedure, require the removal of and destroy verminous household articles prepared or offered for sale and may recover certain expenses","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1609"},{"id":"1816","label":"Public health - prosecution of offences","desc":"A local authority may prosecute relevant offences under the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1816"},{"id":"2341","label":"Public health - protection of buildings","desc":"Where it appears to a local authority that any building in their area is unoccupied; or that the occupier of a building in their area is temporarily absent from it and it is not effectively secured against unauthorised entry; or is likely to become a danger to public health, the local authority may undertake works in connection with the building for the purpose of preventing unauthorised entry to it, or, as the case may be, for the purpose of preventing it becoming a danger to public health.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2341"},{"id":"385","label":"Public health - provision for the care of mothers","desc":"A local authority may make provision for the care of mothers, prevention, care and after-care, home help and laundry facilities,","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/385"},{"id":"399","label":"Public health - provision of premises, equipment or accommodation","desc":"A local authority may provide premises, equipment or accommodation for certain purposes.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/399"},{"id":"1795","label":"Public health - public baths and wash-houses","desc":"A local authority may provide public baths and wash houses, may issue byelaws in respect of the same and make charges for use.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1795"},{"id":"1789","label":"Public health - public conveniences","desc":"A local authority may provide public conveniences in certain circumstances, may make byelaws charges for the same or let them out for rent","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1789"},{"id":"1791","label":"Public health - public pumps, wells, cisterns, reservoirs, conduits","desc":"A local authority may utilise or close public pumps, wells, cisterns, reservoirs and conduits used for the free supply of water.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1791"},{"id":"1615","label":"Public health - reduction of pigeons and other birds","desc":"A local authority may take any steps for the purpose of abating or mitigating any nuisance, annoyance or damage caused by the congregation in any built-up area of house doves or pigeons or of starlings or sparrows.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1615"},{"id":"1618","label":"Public health - regulation of hairdressers and barbers","desc":"A local authority may make byelaws for the purpose of securing the cleanliness of premises on which a hairdresser's or barber's business is carried on and of the instruments, towels, materials and equipment used therein, and the cleanliness of the hairdressers or barbers working in such premises in regard to both themselves and their clothing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1618"},{"id":"1617","label":"Public health - regulation of seaside pleasure boats","desc":"For the prevention of danger, obstruction or annoyance to persons bathing in the sea or using the seashore, a local authority may make byelaws regulating the speed of pleasure boats, regulating the use of pleasure boats so as to prevent their navigation in a dangerous manner or without due care and attention or without reasonable consideration for other persons and requiring the use of effectual silencers on pleasure boats propelled by internal combustion engines.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1617"},{"id":"1607","label":"Public health - removal of accumulations of rubbish","desc":"A local authority may, in accordance with the prescribed procedure remove accumulations of rubbish.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1607"},{"id":"1783","label":"Public health - removal of manure from a stables or mews","desc":"A local authority may serve a notice to requiring the removal of manure from stables or mews in an urban district in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1783"},{"id":"1782","label":"Public health - removal of noxious matter","desc":"A local authority may serve a notice to require an occupier to remove certain noxious matter in certain circumstances, remove the noxious substance itself and recover expenses.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1782"},{"id":"1806","label":"Public health - repair and cleansing of culverts","desc":"A local authority may by notice require the owner of land to repair or cleanse culverts.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1806"},{"id":"1606","label":"Public health - repair of drains, private sewers and waste pipes","desc":"A local authority may repair or cleanse drains, private sewers and waste pipes in certain circumstances and may recover certain expenses.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1606"},{"id":"3767","label":"Public health - requirement to keep a child away from school","desc":"Where a local authority is satisfied that a child may be infected or contaminated, that the infection or contamination is one which presents or could present significant harm to human health, that there is a risk that the child might infect or contaminate others, that it is necessary to keep the child away from school in order to remove or reduce that risk and that keeping the child away from school is a proportionate response to the risk to others presented by the child, the authority may by serving notice on the child's parent require that the parent keep the child away from school.The content of the notice should be as detailed in regulations.The local authority may review the notice if they receive a request to do so (other than the first request from the child's parents).The local authority may vary or revoke such a notice.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3767"},{"id":"1812","label":"Public health - sale of waste materials from street works","desc":"A local authority may sell certain waste materials arising from certain street works and after deducting its proper expenses must pay the balance of the monies to the owner of the materials.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1812"},{"id":"1770","label":"Public health - seats, drinking fountains and cattle troughs","desc":"A local authority may erect or allow others to erect, subject to conditions, seats, drinking fountains or cattle troughs","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1770"},{"id":"1796","label":"Public health - temporary closure of public baths","desc":"A local authority may temporarily close a public bath to allow its use for swimming competitions and may make charges for that use.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1796"},{"id":"1608","label":"Public health - vacation of building for fumigation","desc":"A local authority may, in accordance with the prescribed procedure, require the vacation of a building for the purposes of fumigation and may recover certain expenses.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1608"},{"id":"1787","label":"Public health - verminous persons","desc":"A local authority may on request or with consent cleanse a verminous individual or his or her clothing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1787"},{"id":"2679","label":"Public health - water fluoridation schemes","desc":"Local authorities are required to follow procedural requirements in the exercise of their functions in relation to the consideration of proposals for new fluoridation schemes, variation or termination of existing fluoridation schemes, or the maintenance of existing fluoridation schemes.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2679"},{"id":"2687","label":"Public health - weighing and measuring of children","desc":"Where a local authority carries out a weighing and measuring exercise it must comply with prescribed conditions and may process the resulting information, including personal information relating to the children concerned, and disclose it to prescribed persons. It may also process it for the purposes of research, monitoring, audit or the planning of services or for any purpose connected with public health as prescribed and must have regard to guidance issued by the Secretary of State.Local authorities have powers to discharge health scrutiny functions by: overview and scrutiny committees and must discharge prescribed duties in so doing; or a joint committee and must do so in prescribed circumstances. A local authority may make reports and recommendations to providers of health services on matters reviewed or scrutinised by it and must take steps to try to reach agreement in relation to any recommendations it has made. A local authority may report relevant proposals to the Secretary of State in prescribed circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2687"},{"id":"2791","label":"Public health -FGM protection order","desc":"A local authority is specified as a Third Party for the purposes of applying for an FGM protection order under paragraph 2 of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Female Genital Mutilation Act 2003 and as such can apply to the court for an FGM protection order without the leave of the court.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2791"},{"id":"1621","label":"Public lavatories - abolition of turnstiles","desc":"A local authority must ensure that there are no turnstiles at public lavatories controlled or managed by a local authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1621"},{"id":"2148","label":"Public meetings and assemblies - provision of room","desc":"A local authority may acquire or provide and furnish halls, offices and other buildings, whether within or without the area of the authority, for use for public meetings and assemblies.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2148"},{"id":"1958","label":"Public order - prohibiting trespassory assemblies","desc":"If the chief officer of police reasonably believes that an assembly is intended to be held in a place which the public has no right to access or and that the assembly is likely to be held without the permission of the occupier of the land, and may result in serious disruption to the life of the community, or where the land, or a building or monument on it, is of historical, architectural, archaeological or scientific importance, in significant damage to the land, building or monument, he may apply to the council of the district for an order prohibiting for a specified period the holding of all trespassory assemblies in the district or a part of it, as specified. On receiving such an application, a council may and Wales, with the consent of the Secretary of State make an order either in the terms of the application or with such modifications as may be approved by the Secretary of State","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1958"},{"id":"1559","label":"Public performance licence - person under 16","desc":"A local authority may issue a public performance licence to a person aged under 16 in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1559"},{"id":"1561","label":"Public performance licence - variation or revocation for person under 16","desc":"A local authority may vary or revoke a performance licence issued to a person aged under 16 in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1561"},{"id":"1560","label":"Public performance licence person under 14","desc":"A local authority may issue a public performance licence to a person aged under 14 in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1560"},{"id":"1562","label":"Public performance training licence for person 12 to 16 - issue, variation or revocation","desc":"A local authority may issue, vary or revoke a performance training licence for performances of a dangerous nature for persons aged 12 to 16 in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1562"},{"id":"3743","label":"Public safety - co-operation to assess and manage risk from offenders","desc":"The local authority has a duty to co-operate with the responsible authority (ie. police, prisons and probation acting jointly) on MAPPA (multi-agency public protection arrangements) to assess and manage the risks posed in that area by relevant sexual and violent offenders, and other persons who are considered by the responsible authority to be persons who may cause serious harm to the public, to the extent that such co-operation is compatible with the exercise by the local authority of its functions under any other enactment.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3743"},{"id":"3855","label":"Public safety - collaboration to reduce and prevent serious violence","desc":"Local authorities must consult with certain stakeholders and collaborate with the police and with stakeholders in order to plan to prevent and reduce serious violence. Including a duty to plan together to exercise their functions so as to prevent and reduce serious violence in the area.In particular, the specified authorities for a local government area must:(a) identify the kinds of serious violence that occur in the area,(b) identify the causes of serious violence in the area, so far as it is possible to do so, and(c) prepare and implement a strategy for exercising their functions to prevent and reduce serious violence in the area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3855"},{"id":"3857","label":"Public safety - consultation when preparing a strategy for serious violence","desc":"Local authorities must consult with:- each educational authority for the area- each prison authority for the area;- each youth custody authority for the area when preparing a strategy for exercising their functions to prevent and reduce serious violence in the area.In addition where two or more specified authorities have chosen to collaborate (see section 9) they must also consult every other specified authority for the area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3857"},{"id":"3858","label":"Public safety - decision to collaborate to prevent and reduce serious violence","desc":"Two or more specified authorities may collaborate with each other to prevent and reduce serious violence in a relevant area, providing they consult stakeholders as required when doing so.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3858"},{"id":"3859","label":"Public safety - regard to guidance when collaborating on serious violence","desc":"Local authorities must have regard to Guidance issued by the Secretary of State, when exercising its powers and duties relating to collaborating and planning to prevent or reduce serious violence.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3859"},{"id":"3856","label":"Public safety - strategy to prevent and reduce serious violence","desc":"Once a strategy to prevent or reduce serious violence has been prepared for a local government area, the specified authorities for the area must:(a) publish the strategy,(b) keep the strategy under review, and(c) from time to time prepare and implement a revised strategy.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3856"},{"id":"3189","label":"Public service delivery - disclosure to improve provision","desc":"A local authority may disclose information to improve public service delivery in certain circumstances and must have regard to any code of practice when so doing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3189"},{"id":"3188","label":"Public service delivery - disclosure to water and sewage undertakers","desc":"A local authority may disclose information to water and sewage undertakers in certain circumstances and must have regard to any code of practice when so doing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3188"},{"id":"2426","label":"Public Spaces Protection Order - breach of prohibition on consuming alcohol","desc":"A person authorised by a local authority may, where a person is or has been consuming alcohol in breach of a prohibition in a public spaces protection order, or intends to consume alcohol in circumstances in which doing so would be a breach of such a prohibition, (upon showing his identity) require that person not to consume, in breach of the order, alcohol or anything which the authorised person reasonably believes to be alcohol; or to surrender anything in that person\u2019s possession which is, or which the authorised person reasonably believes to be, alcohol or a container for alcohol (and dispose of the same). If the person fails to co-operate he commits a criminal offence.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2426"},{"id":"2428","label":"Public Spaces Protection Order - fixed penalty notice","desc":"A person authorised by a local authority may issue a fixed penalty notice to anyone he or she has reason to believe has committed an offence under sections 63 or 67 in relation to a public spaces protection order.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2428"},{"id":"2429","label":"Public Spaces Protection Order - guidance","desc":"A person authorised must have regard to any guidance issued by the Secretary of State when exercising its powers in relation to public spaces protection orders.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2429"},{"id":"2424","label":"Public Spaces Protection Order - making and duration","desc":"A local authority may make a public spaces protection order if satisfied on reasonable grounds that activities carried on in a public place within the authority's area have had a detrimental effect on the quality of life of those in the locality, or it is likely that activities will be carried on in a public place within that area and that they will have such an effect; and that the effect, or likely effect, of the activities is, or is likely to be, of a persistent or continuing nature, is, or is likely to be, such as to make the activities unreasonable, and justifies the restrictions imposed by the notice.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2424"},{"id":"2427","label":"Public Spaces Protection Order - restriction of right of way over highway","desc":"A local authority must take certain matters into account and take certain steps before making a public spaces protection order which restricts public right of way over a highway.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2427"},{"id":"2425","label":"Public Spaces Protection Order - varying and discharge","desc":"A local authority may vary and discharge a public spaces protection order in accordance with regulations. Where an order is varied or discharged details of the variation or discharge must be published in accordance with regulations made by the Secretary of State..","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2425"},{"id":"1828","label":"Public transport - accounts","desc":"Where a local authority run public service vehicles under this Part of this Act they shall in the accounts relating to their transport undertakings distinguish, so far as may be practicable receipts and expenditure relating to their public service vehicles from receipts and expenditure relating to any other transport undertaking, and in the receipts and expenditure relating to their public service vehicles shall further distinguish receipts and expenditure on capital account from receipts and expenditure upon revenue account.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1828"},{"id":"1827","label":"Public transport - agreements for management of services","desc":"A local authority authorised to run public service vehicles under the Act may enter into agreements for the management and maintenance of such services with others.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1827"},{"id":"1829","label":"Public transport - borrowing","desc":"A local authority authorised to run public service may borrow money with the consent of the Minister.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1829"},{"id":"1776","label":"Public transport - byelaws and street furniture for waiting","desc":"A local authority may pass byelaws to regulate waiting for public vehicles and erect street furniture in support of those byelaws.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1776"},{"id":"1826","label":"Public transport - charging for passengers and parcels","desc":"A local authority authorised to run public service vehicles under the Act may demand and take for passengers and small parcels carried on such vehicles such fares and charges as they may think fit.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1826"},{"id":"1824","label":"Public transport - outside of area","desc":"A local authority who under any local Act or Order are operating a tramway, light railway, trolley vehicle, or omnibus undertaking, may as part of that undertaking run public service vehicles on any road inside or outside their district.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1824"},{"id":"3114","label":"Public transport - prohibition on forming bus company","desc":"A relevant authority may not, in exercise of any of its powers, form a company for the purpose of providing a local service.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3114"},{"id":"1825","label":"Public transport - purchase and maintenance of vehicles","desc":"A local authority may purchase and maintain vehicles for use in its public transport service and may purchase by agreement, take on lease, and hold lands and may on any lands so purchased by or leased to them or any lands lawfully appropriated by them for the purpose erect such buildings, sheds, and conveniences and may provide such plant and appliances as may be requisite or expedient for the establishment, running, equipment, maintenance and repair of their public service vehicles.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1825"},{"id":"2880","label":"Public transport - quality contract schemes","desc":"A local authority which is also a transport authority and is proposing a quality contract scheme for bus services in its area must comply with and where relevant enforce the following Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2880"},{"id":"1645","label":"Public transport facilities - capital expenditure","desc":"A local authority may make payments towards capital expenditure for public transport facilities in certain circumstances","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1645"},{"id":"363","label":"Publication of information - local area agreement","desc":"A local authority must publish information regarding its Local Area Agreement.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/363"},{"id":"3730","label":"Pupil referral units - management committee","desc":"Local authorities must establish management committees to run pupil referral units (PRUs) in their area, and make provision for the constitution and procedures of such committees.Local authorities must delegate some of their functions in relation to pupil referral units to the management committee but must not delegate functions in relation to staffing and finance of the unit, health and safety issues, control of premises and a reserve power in relation to prevention of a breakdown of discipline.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3730"},{"id":"2802","label":"Recycling - charging for use of recycling sites","desc":"Best value authorities must not (by the disapplication of section 93(1) of the Local Government Act 2003) use the discretionary power to charge residents to deposit household waste at a household waste recycling centre.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2802"},{"id":"2898","label":"Recycling - monitoring of compliance with battery recycling scheme","desc":"A local authority must monitor compliance with the scheme and accuracy of producer information","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2898"},{"id":"2900","label":"Recycling - publishing of information regarding waste batteries","desc":"A local authority must share and publish the prescribed information in the prescribed format in accordance with the Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2900"},{"id":"2595","label":"Recycling - records and information","desc":"A local authority must collect information and maintain records about municipal waste and submit returns using the Waste Data Flow system. It is liable to a penalty under the Measure of \u00a3200 per tonne by which it falls short of the target amount and \u00a31000 when it fails to maintain records, submit a return or fails to comply with the requirements of any notice served by the Welsh ministers or the monitoring authority in accordance with the Regulations and pay interest on late payment.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2595"},{"id":"2897","label":"Recycling - register of battery producers","desc":"A local authority must prepare, maintain and make available a register of producers and publish applications for inclusion in the register the prescribed form.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2897"},{"id":"2901","label":"Recycling - sharing of information regarding battery recycling schemes","desc":"A local authority may share certain information with certain bodies for certain purposes in accordance with the Regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2901"},{"id":"2899","label":"Recycling - waste batteries and accumulators","desc":"A local authority must comply with its general duties","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2899"},{"id":"1532","label":"Refuse disposal - acquisition of land","desc":"A local authority may acquire land for the purposes of refuse disposal in accordance with legislation.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1532"},{"id":"1533","label":"Refuse disposal - powers of entry","desc":"An officer authorised by a local authority may enter land for certain purposes under the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1533"},{"id":"1717","label":"Registrars - appointment of deputy","desc":"A local authority may employ a deputy superintendent registrars or deputy registrar of births and deaths.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1717"},{"id":"1716","label":"Registrars - appointment of officers","desc":"A local authority must employ (interim) superintendent registrars and registrars of births and deaths.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1716"},{"id":"2810","label":"Registration - marriage and civil partnership referrals","desc":"A superintendent registrar or a registration authority must make a referral as prescribed to the Secretary of State and give the information prescribed in regulations 17 and 18 to the parties for the purposes of section 28H(5)(c)(i) and (ii) of the 1949 Marriage Act and section 12A(5)(c)(i) and (ii) of the 2004 Civil Partnership Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2810"},{"id":"2792","label":"Registration - marriage/civil partnership gender recognition register","desc":"Local authorities (the Registrar General) must maintain a Gender Recognition Marriage Register, and a Gender Recognition Civil Partnership Register, which must not be open for public inspection or search. The Registrar General must register the marriage and create a link (which is not to be open to public inspection) between the original marriage register entry and the new entry in the Gender Recognition Marriage Register and maintain the details in the registers as prescribed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2792"},{"id":"3898","label":"Registration - wedding venue licence","desc":"The local authority may grant a licence for a premises to act as a venue for marriages and civil partnerships in accordance with condition set out in Regulations.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3898"},{"id":"2811","label":"Registration -marriages","desc":"Superintendent Registrars are required to follow the procedures prescribed relating to the registration of marriages.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2811"},{"id":"3637","label":"Registration of births - within three months of the date of birth","desc":"Where the relevant registrar receives from any qualified informant before the expiration of three months from the date of the birth of a child information of the particulars required by Regulation 7(1) he shall forthwith register the birth and the particulars, if not previously registered, in the presence of the informant.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3637"},{"id":"3472","label":"Registration of death - provision of information concerning death","desc":"Where, after the expiration of the relevant period from the date of the death or finding of the dead body of any person, the death of that person has, owing to the default of the persons required to give information concerning it, not been registered, the registrar may by notice in writing require any qualified informant to attend personally to provide the particulars needed to register the death and sign the register.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3472"},{"id":"3471","label":"Registration of deaths - recording in register","desc":"The death of every person dying in England or Wales and the cause thereof shall be registered by the registrar of births and deaths for the sub\u2013district in which the death occurred by entering in a register kept for that sub\u2013district such particulars concerning the death as may be prescribed. Provided that where a dead body is found and no information as to the place of death is available, the death shall be registered by the registrar of births and deaths for the sub\u2013district in which the body is found.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3471"},{"id":"3466","label":"Registration of marriage - regulations","desc":"A local authority must comply with Regulations made under this section relating to the registration of marriages.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3466"},{"id":"1718","label":"Registration service - district register offices","desc":"A local authority shall provide and maintain for the superintendent registrar of each district a register office according to a plan approved by the Registrar General, and shall provide a suitable fireproof repository for the safe custody of the records.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1718"},{"id":"1719","label":"Registration service - local schemes of organisation","desc":"A local authority shall prepare, submit and have approved a local scheme of organisation, complying with prescribed requirements, for the registration service.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1719"},{"id":"3191","label":"Registration services - disclosure of information","desc":"A civil registration official may disclose certain information to certain persons in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3191"},{"id":"3064","label":"Regulated activities - advice and guidance","desc":"A local authority must if it is a primary authority or the co-ordinator of a regulated group provide advice and guidance.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3064"},{"id":"3070","label":"Regulated activities - charging","desc":"A local authority may charge the Regulated Person in order to recover its reasonably incurred costs arising from its carrying out its functions under the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3070"},{"id":"3063","label":"Regulated activities - co-ordinator of a regulated group","desc":"A local authority must comply with the Secretary of State\u2019s nomination to be the co-ordinator of a regulated group under the Act and undertake the associated responsibilities","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3063"},{"id":"3072","label":"Regulated activities - complementary regulator","desc":"A local authority who is a complementary regulator must act consistently with primary authority advice and guidance in the exercise of the designated function.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3072"},{"id":"3074","label":"Regulated activities - compliance with directions","desc":"A local authority when exercising its functions under the Act must have regard to guidance and comply with directions issued by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3074"},{"id":"3065","label":"Regulated activities - enforcement action","desc":"A local authority when taking enforcement action as a primary authority must take certain steps.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3065"},{"id":"3066","label":"Regulated activities - enforcement action other than as primary authority","desc":"A local authority when taking enforcement action other than as a primary authority must take certain steps.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3066"},{"id":"3061","label":"Regulated activities - guidance and enforcement","desc":"A local authority has responsibilities under the Act with respect to any of the following matters\u2014(a)agricultural produce (quality standards and labelling);(b)animal health and welfare;(c)animal feed;(d)consumer protection;(e)environmental protection;(f)food hygiene and standards;(g)public health and safety;(h)weights and measures (including measuring instruments).","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3061"},{"id":"3067","label":"Regulated activities - making of inspection plan","desc":"A local authority\u2019s partnership function consists of or includes a function of inspection, the primary authority may make an inspection plan.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3067"},{"id":"3073","label":"Regulated activities - notification to complementary regulator","desc":"A local authority who is a qualifying regulator or enforcing authority must inform the co-ordinating primary authority of the proposed enforcement action.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3073"},{"id":"3062","label":"Regulated activities - primary authority","desc":"A local authority must comply with the Secretary of State\u2019s nomination to be a Primary Authority in relation to a regulated Person under the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3062"},{"id":"3068","label":"Regulated activities - regard to inspection plan","desc":"A local authority must have regard to its approved Inspection Plan when carrying out its functions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3068"},{"id":"3069","label":"Regulated activities - revocation or revision of inspection plan","desc":"A local authority may revoke or revise an Inspection Plan by taking the required steps.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3069"},{"id":"3071","label":"Regulated activities - supporting primary authority","desc":"A local authority who is a supporting regulator may support a primary authority in carrying out certain of its functions and must take certain steps when doing so.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3071"},{"id":"2954","label":"Regulation - temporary markets","desc":"A local Authority may resolve to control temporary markets in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2954"},{"id":"121","label":"Regulatory enforcement - charging of fees and costs","desc":"The primary authority may charge the regulated person such fees as it considers to represent the costs reasonably incurred by it in the exercise of its functions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/121"},{"id":"120","label":"Regulatory enforcement - compliance with inspection plan","desc":"A local authority must comply with an inspection plan in respect of a regulated activity which is drawn up by a Primary Authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/120"},{"id":"130","label":"Regulatory enforcement - disclosure of information","desc":"A local authority may, where deemed to be the Regulator share information relating to its function where the authority has an enforcement function in relation to an offence, and the information is disclosed for the purpose of the exercise by the regulator of any powers conferred on it under or by virtue of this Part in relation to that offence.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/130"},{"id":"124","label":"Regulatory enforcement - discretionary requirements in relation to an offence","desc":"A local authority may, where deemed to be the Regulator and where authorised by an SI to do so impose discretionary requirements in relation to an offence. Discretionary requirements may be a monetary penalty, a requirement to take such steps as a regulator may specify, within such period as it may specify, to secure that the offence does not continue or recur or a requirement to take such steps as a regulator may specify, within such period as it may specify, to secure that the position is, so far as possible, restored to what it would have been if the offence had not been committed.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/124"},{"id":"131","label":"Regulatory enforcement - duty not to impose or maintain unnecessary burdens","desc":"Any person exercising a regulatory function to which this section applies must keep that function under review and secure that in exercising the function the person does not impose burdens which that person considers to be unnecessary or maintain burdens which that person considers to have become unnecessary.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/131"},{"id":"126","label":"Regulatory enforcement - enforcement undertaking","desc":"A local authority may, where deemed to be the Regulator and where authorised by an SI to do so may accept an enforcement undertaking from a person in a case where the regulator has reasonable grounds to suspect that the person has committed a relevant offence.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/126"},{"id":"123","label":"Regulatory enforcement - fixed monetary penalty","desc":"A local authority may, where deemed to be the Regulator and where authorised by an SI to do so issue a fixed monetary penalty in relation to an offence.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/123"},{"id":"127","label":"Regulatory enforcement - guidance as to use of civil sanctions","desc":"A local authority must, where deemed to be the Regulator publish guidance in respect of its use of civil sanctions and enforcement as part of the regulatory regime.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/127"},{"id":"119","label":"Regulatory enforcement - inspection plan","desc":"A local authority which is a Primary Authority may draw up inspection plan in respect of a regulated activity.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/119"},{"id":"122","label":"Regulatory enforcement - LBRO guidance","desc":"A local authority must have regard to any guidance given to it by LBRO regarding regulatory enforcement, notification of inspection plans and charging of fees.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/122"},{"id":"118","label":"Regulatory enforcement - notification to primary authority","desc":"A local authority must notify the Primary Authority as to its intention to take enforcement action against a regulated person and follow the Primary Authority's directions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/118"},{"id":"129","label":"Regulatory enforcement - payment of penalties into consolidated fund","desc":"A local authority must, where deemed to be the Regulator pay income from fines etc. into the relevant consolidation fund.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/129"},{"id":"128","label":"Regulatory enforcement - publication of enforcement action","desc":"A local authority must, where deemed to be the Regulator publish reports in respect of its use of civil sanctions and enforcement as part of the regulatory regime.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/128"},{"id":"117","label":"Regulatory enforcement - responsibility of primary authority","desc":"A local authority must if nominated as a Primary Authority by the Secretary of State give advice and guidance to regulated persons and to other local authorities regarding that function.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/117"},{"id":"125","label":"Regulatory enforcement - stop notice","desc":"A local authority may, where deemed to be the Regulator and where authorised by an SI to do so issue a stop notice. A stop notice is a notice prohibiting a person from carrying on an activity specified in the notice until the person has taken the steps specified in the notice.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/125"},{"id":"827","label":"Religious education - advisory councils","desc":"A local authority must establish a standing advisory council to advise on religious education.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/827"},{"id":"3783","label":"Religious education - agreed syllabus conference","desc":"","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3783"},{"id":"828","label":"Religious education - Sunday schools","desc":"A local authority or a school maintained by it may not make access to education, further education or training conditional upon a child attending or not attending Sunday School.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/828"},{"id":"3003","label":"Religious events -
