LAs must make arrangements for determining any disputes between themselves and NHS bodies about whether or not something should be provided by the NHS as part of the health service.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2713"},{"id":"2484","label":"Social care - provision of services","desc":"A local authority must have regard to section 8 of the Care Act 2014 when considering how to make needs under section 18 to 20Section 8 says:(1)The following are examples of what may be provided to meet needs under sections 18 to 20\u2014(a)accommodation in a care home or in premises of some other type;(b)care and support at home or in the community;(c)counselling and other types of social work;(d)goods and facilities;(e)information, advice and advocacy.(2)The following are examples of the ways in which a local authority may meet needs under sections 18 to 20\u2014(a)by arranging for a person other than it to provide a service;(b)by itself providing a service;(c)by making direct payments.(3)\u201cCare home\u201d has the meaning given by section 3 of the Care Standards Act 2000.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2484"},{"id":"2453","label":"Social care - required carer support","desc":"Subject to the exception contained in sections 21 to 23, a local authority having made a determination under section 13(1) must meet a carer's needs for support which meet the eligibility criteria if\u2014(a) the adult needing care is ordinarily resident in the local authority's area or is present in its area but of no settled residence,(b) in so far as meeting the carer's needs involves the provision of support to the carer, there is no charge under section 14 for meeting the needs or, in so far as there is, condition 1 or 2 (of section 20) is met, and(c) in so far as meeting the carer's needs involves the provision of care and support to the adult needing care\u2014(i) there is no charge under section 14 for meeting the needs and the adult needing care agrees to the needs being met in that way, or(ii) in so far as there is such a charge, condition 3 or 4 (of section 20) is met.Where a local authority is required by this section to meet some or all of a carer's needs for support but it does not prove feasible for it to do so by providing care and support to the adult needing care, it must, so far as it is feasible to do so, identify some other way in which to do so.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2453"},{"id":"2474","label":"Social care - required register of sight impaired and disabled adults","desc":"A local authority must establish and maintain a register of sight-impaired and severely sight-impaired adults who are ordinarily resident in its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2474"},{"id":"2830","label":"Social care - review and termination of direct payments","desc":"Regulations 15 to 20 identify the eligibility criteria for persons entitled to receive direct payments from local authorities in England.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2830"},{"id":"2782","label":"Social care - review of charging decisions","desc":"Local authorities must appoint a person, who is a member of staff, to deal with a review request under section 73 of the Social Services and Well Being (Wales) Act 2014; must accept or reject the request and follow the procedure prescribed. LAs may recover any accrued amounts after the review period. If the requester notifies the LA that they will not pay the contribution during the review period, the LA must make gross payments during the review period and return any over payment to the requester or recover any underpayment as prescribed.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2782"},{"id":"2463","label":"Social care - Safeguarding Adults Board","desc":"Each local authority must establish a Safeguarding Adults Board (an \u201cSAB\u201d) for its area","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2463"},{"id":"2464","label":"Social care - safeguarding adults review","desc":"A local authority must carry out a safeguarding adults review in certain circumstances","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2464"},{"id":"2472","label":"Social care - support on discharge from hospital","desc":"A local authority must comply with the provisions in Schedule 3 with regard to the discharge of hospital patients likely to need care and support.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2472"},{"id":"3726","label":"Social care - transition for child to adult care","desc":"Where it appears to a local authority that a child is likely to have needs for care and support after becoming 18, the authority must, if it is satisfied that it would be of significant benefit to the child to do so and if the consent condition is met, assess the child's current needs and likely needs after becoming 18.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3726"},{"id":"2481","label":"Social care - transition from child to adult support","desc":"A local authority must take certain steps in relation to existing care arrangements for the child where an assessment is taking place under the Care Act 2014","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2481"},{"id":"2824","label":"Social care - visiting detained children","desc":"Local authorities as prescribed must arrange for a representative to visit a child within 10 working days of the child first being detained or required to reside in approve premises and thereafter whenever reasonably requested to do so by specified persons, for example, the child, the child's parents, or in line with the recommendations made by the representative. During each visit, the representative must speak to the child in private unless it is not appropriate to do so or the child refuses and provide a report of each visit providing content and copies as prescribed. LAs must also have regard to the further provision in relation to the duty under section 97(3)(b) of the Social Services and Well Being (Wales) Act 2014 to arrange for advice and support to be available to the child.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2824"},{"id":"2825","label":"Social care - young carers needs assessment","desc":"Local authorities must carry out the assessment of a young carer\u2019s needs appropriately and proportionately and must provide information about the manner and form of the assessment so far as reasonably practicable before it takes place. LAs must ensure that a person carrying out the assessment on their behalf is appropriately trained and has sufficient knowledge and skill to carry out that assessment; consult others with expertise and knowledge in relation to the young carer and must have regard to any other assessment which may have been carried out. LAs must consider the prescribed matters when carrying out the assessment.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2825"},{"id":"3115","label":"Social care -Care Act - compliance with guidance","desc":"A local authority must comply with guidance issued by the Secretary of State when carrying out its functions under the Care Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3115"},{"id":"1380","label":"Social security information - use for a relevant purpose","desc":"A local authority may use social security information for any relevant purpose.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1380"},{"id":"2111","label":"Social services - appointment of director.","desc":"A local authority must appoint a Director of Social Services or may jointly appoint with another authority and provide him with adequate staff for his function.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2111"},{"id":"2113","label":"Social services - compliance with directions","desc":"A local authority must comply with directions given by the Secretary of State when exercising its social services function.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2113"},{"id":"2719","label":"Social services - contracting out","desc":"A local authority may authorise another person, or that person's employees, to exercise social services functions (assessment of needs for community care services, duties of responsible authority following notice under section 2 and in respect of prescribed direct payments) provided they are by, or under the supervision of, a registered social worker or by a person who has the requisite qualifications or competencies. Functions must also be exercised in accordance with relevant directions and guidance given to local authorities by the Secretary of State.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2719"},{"id":"2114","label":"Social services - default powers where authority failed to perform functions","desc":"A local authority must comply with directions made by the Secretary of State when exercising his default powers.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2114"},{"id":"2112","label":"Social services - exercise of functions under guidance","desc":"A local authority must have regard to guidance from the Secretary of State when exercising its social services function.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2112"},{"id":"532","label":"Social services - investigation of complaints","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations regarding the investigation of complaints relating to its social services function.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/532"},{"id":"388","label":"Social services - research","desc":"A local authority may carry out or may assist another to carry out a research in relation to the powers and duties under the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/388"},{"id":"530","label":"Social services - review and inspections by Assembly","desc":"A local authority must comply with an investigation and make prescribed payments to the Assembly in relation to an investigation into its social services function.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/530"},{"id":"857","label":"Special educational needs - academies","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations requiring or authorising the local authority to make payments to an academy in respect of children with special educational needs.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/857"},{"id":"814","label":"Special educational needs - access to schools","desc":"An officer authorised by a local authority may access certain schools in connection with their SEN provision.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/814"},{"id":"821","label":"Special educational needs - advice and information for parents in England","desc":"A local authority must provide advice and information for parents with regard to SEN and must have regard to guidance from the Secretary of State when so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/821"},{"id":"822","label":"Special educational needs - advice and information for parents in Wales","desc":"A local authority must provide advice and information for parents with regard to SEN and must have regard to guidance from the Welsh Minister when so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/822"},{"id":"813","label":"Special educational needs - appeals","desc":"A local authority must comply with the SEN appeals procedure and its outcome.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/813"},{"id":"818","label":"Special educational needs - assessment of children under two","desc":"A local authority may assess a child under two for SEN provision in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/818"},{"id":"820","label":"Special educational needs - case friends","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations regarding case friends. A case friend is the name given to a person who may make representations on behalf of a child with a view to avoiding or resolving disagreements about the exercise by local education authorities in Wales of SEN functions and may exercise the rights of a child on the child's behalf.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/820"},{"id":"800","label":"Special educational needs - code of practice","desc":"A local authority and the governing bodies of schools maintained by it must have regard to special educational needs code of practice when dealing with SEN issues.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/800"},{"id":"826","label":"Special educational needs - compliance with tribunal order","desc":"A local authority must comply with an order of the tribunal within the prescribed timescale.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/826"},{"id":"2931","label":"Special educational needs - continued provision where EHC plan maintained","desc":"This section applies where, immediately before a child in need reaches the age of 18\u2014a local authority in England is providing services for the child in the exercise of functions conferred by section 17, andan EHC plan is maintained for the child.The local authority may continue to provide services for the child in the exercise of those functions after the child reaches the age of 18, but may not continue to do so after the EHC plan has ceased to be maintained.In this section \u201cEHC plan\u201d means a plan within section 37(2) of the Children and Families Act 2014.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2931"},{"id":"3631","label":"Special educational needs - detained persons - compliance with tribunal","desc":"Where a First-tier tribunal makes an order requiring an authority to take action the authority must:- If the order requires a home authority to make a detained person's EHC needs assessment, the home authority within 2 weeks of the order being made must notify the appropriate person that it must make the assessment.- Following the needs assessment send the results to designated persons within the proscribed timescales- Reconsider where the order directs it to do so within the proscribed timescalesIf the order requires the home authority to amend the name of the school or other institution or the type of school or other institution specified in the EHC plan, the home authority must issue the amended EHC plan within 2 weeks of the order being made.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3631"},{"id":"3635","label":"Special educational needs - detained persons - decision not to secure EHC plan","desc":"Where, following a detained person's EHC needs assessment, a home authority decides that it is not necessary for special educational provision to be made for the detained person in accordance with an EHC plan, the appropriate person must be notified as soon as practicable, and in any event within 16 weeks of the home authority receiving a request for a detained person's EHC needs assessment, or the date on which the detained person has been brought or comes to the attention of the authority.The home authority must also notify persons specified in Regulations.(3) When notifying the appropriate person the home authority must also notify them of:(a) their right to appeal that decision,(b) the time limits for doing so,(c) the information concerning mediation, set out in regulation 18, and(d) the availability of information and advice relating to the special educational needs of children and young people.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3635"},{"id":"3634","label":"Special educational needs - detained persons - decision on EHC needs assessment","desc":"The home authority must notify the appropriate person and the person in charge of the relevant youth accommodation where the detained person is detained of its decision whether or not it is necessary to secure a detained person's EHC needs assessment as soon as practicable and in any event within 6 weeks of either receiving a request to secure a detained person's EHC needs assessment or the date on which the detained person has been brought or comes to the attention of the authority. The home authority must also notify the persons who were notified in accordance with regulation 4(2) of its decision.(3) When notifying the appropriate person of its decision that it is not necessary to secure a detained person's EHC needs assessment, it must also notify them of:(a) their right to appeal that decision,(b) the time limits for doing so,(c) the information concerning mediation, (d) the availability of information and advice in connection with a detained person's EHC needs assessment.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3634"},{"id":"3633","label":"Special educational needs - detained persons - determination of need for SEN provision","desc":"Where a home authority determines that it is not necessary for special educational provision to be made for the detained person in accordance with an EHC plan on release from detention it must:- Notify the appropriate person and the person in charge of the relevant youth accommodation where the detained person is detained, as soon as practicable, but in any event within 6 weeks of either receiving a request to secure a detained person's EHC needs assessment or the date on which the detained person has been brought or comes to the attention of the authority.- Where the home authority is considering securing a detained person's EHC needs assessment it must also notify relevant parties as identified in this regulation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3633"},{"id":"3626","label":"Special educational needs - detained persons - disclosure of EHC plan","desc":"When an authority becomes responsible for keeping an EHC plan for a detained person it must send a copy of the plan to designated persons within 5 days.The EHC Plan must not be disclosed without the permission of the detained person except where specified by this legislation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3626"},{"id":"3627","label":"Special educational needs - detained persons - incomplete assessment","desc":"Where an EHC plan for a person leaving detention or as a consequence of a detention order was started but is not completed the authority must ensure:(a) any EHC plan is finalised within 20 weeks;(b) any decision not to secure an EHC plan is finalised within 16 weeks;(c)a decision whether or not to secure an EHC needs assessment is made within 6 weeks;","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3627"},{"id":"3629","label":"Special educational needs - detained persons - mediation","desc":"Where the appropriate person has informed the mediation adviser that he or she wishes to pursue mediation, the home authority must arrange for mediation between it and the appropriate person, within 30 days from the date on which the mediation adviser was informed by the appropriate person that he or she wishes to pursue mediation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3629"},{"id":"3630","label":"Special educational needs - detained persons - steps following mediation","desc":"Where mediation has resulted in an agreement such agreement must be documented in writing. Where the issues are such that there is a right of appeal the authority must comply with time limits. Where the issues do not allow the right of appeal the authority must take action within 2 weeks of the mediation agreement.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3630"},{"id":"3636","label":"Special educational needs - detained persons - timescales for EHC plans","desc":"When a home authority sends a draft plan to the appropriate person it must:(a) give them at least 15 days, beginning with the day on which the draft plan was served, in which to\u2014(i) make representations about the content of the draft plan, and to request that a particular school or other institution be named in the plan, and(ii) require the home authority to arrange a meeting between them and an officer of the home authority at which the draft plan can be discussed, and(b) advise them where they can find information about the schools and colleges that are available for the detained person to attend on release from detention. The final plan must be sent to persons specified in Regulations as soon as practicable, and in any event within 20 weeks of the home authority receiving a request for an EHC needs assessment, or on the date which the detained person has been brought or comes to the attention of the authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3636"},{"id":"3628","label":"Special educational needs - detained persons - transfer of EHC plan","desc":"Where a detained person with an EHC plan is to be released the EHC plan must be disclosed to relevant parties within 5 days of the date of release. Where the new authority receives a request to carry out an EHC assessment or to review the plan from the commissioning authority it must comply with the request.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3628"},{"id":"3632","label":"Special educational needs - detained persons - unopposed appeals","desc":"Where the detained person has appealed to the First-tier Tribunal and the home authority notifies the First-tier Tribunal that it does not oppose the appeal before it submits a response the home authority must:- within 2 weeks of the date it notified the First-tier Tribunal under paragraph (1), notify the appropriate person that it must make a detained person's EHC needs assessment.- inform relevant. parties of its decision regarding the need for an EHC plan within specified time limits (subject to exceptions described in regulations)- issue draft and final EHC plans to relevant persons within the time limits specified (unless exceptional circumstances defined in regulations apply)- issue the amended EHC plan within 2 weeks of the date it notified the First-tier Tribunal.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3632"},{"id":"823","label":"Special educational needs - dispute resolution procedure in England","desc":"A local authority must prepare and publish a dispute resolution procedure relating to SEN matters and must have regard to guidance from the Secretary of State when so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/823"},{"id":"824","label":"Special educational needs - dispute resolution procedure in Wales","desc":"A local authority must prepare and publish a dispute resolution procedure relating to SEN matters and must have regard to guidance from Welsh ministers when so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/824"},{"id":"804","label":"Special educational needs - duties of governing body or local education authority","desc":"A local authority and the governing body of a school maintained by a local authority must comply with certain general duties regarding SEN provision","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/804"},{"id":"802","label":"Special educational needs - education in mainstream school","desc":"A local authority must educate a child with SEN in a mainstream school unless it is incompatible with the wishes of his parent, or the provision of efficient education for other children.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/802"},{"id":"803","label":"Special educational needs - education in non-mainstream school","desc":"A local authority may educate a child with SEN in a non-mainstream school in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/803"},{"id":"3751","label":"Special educational needs - encouragement to remain in education or training","desc":"A local authority must make available to young people and relevant young adults such services as they consider appropriate to encourage, enable or assist them to engage and remain in education or training. The services are currently known as Connexions services. Local authorities can fulfil the duty to make services available either by providing them itself or by making arrangements with others which could include other local authorities.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3751"},{"id":"819","label":"Special educational needs - giving notice to or serving documents upon child","desc":"A local authority must give notice to or serve documents relating to a SEN appeal upon the child in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/819"},{"id":"809","label":"Special educational needs - identification and assessment of needs","desc":"A local authority has a general duty to identify and assess SEN provision for the children for whom they are responsible.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/809"},{"id":"825","label":"Special educational needs - independent advocacy services","desc":"A local authority must make arrangements for the provision of independent advocacy services (relating to SEN) in their area, publicise the same and must have regard to guidance from Welsh Ministers when so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/825"},{"id":"805","label":"Special educational needs - informing parent of SEN provision","desc":"A local authority in the case of a pupil referral unit or the governing body of a school maintained by the local authority must inform a parent when SEN provision is made.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/805"},{"id":"812","label":"Special educational needs - notice of no statement","desc":"A local authority must where it decides not to make a statement of SEN give the parent a notice in writing explaining the right to appeal.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/812"},{"id":"810","label":"Special educational needs - parental notification of assessment","desc":"Where an authority believes a child for whom they are responsible may have special educational needs they must notify the parents that they are considering an assessment and of the procedure for doing so.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/810"},{"id":"816","label":"Special educational needs - parental request for assessment","desc":"A local authority must assess a child's SEN at its parent's request in certain circumstances and comply with the appeals procedure and the outcome of any appeal.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/816"},{"id":"3731","label":"Special educational needs - payment and assistance to city colleges","desc":"A local education authority may pay all or any part of the cost incurred and may provide any other assistance in respect of securing that the statemented provision for a relevant child is made.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3731"},{"id":"806","label":"Special educational needs - provision of goods and services","desc":"A local authority may provide goods and services to the governing body of a maintained school in connection with SEN provision.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/806"},{"id":"807","label":"Special educational needs - provision otherwise than in schools","desc":"A local authority must consult the parent where it proposes to make SEN provision otherwise than at school.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/807"},{"id":"808","label":"Special educational needs - provision outside England and Wales","desc":"A local authority may make SEN provision outside England and Wales in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/808"},{"id":"3717","label":"Special educational needs - publication of information","desc":"A local education authority shall publish information about special educational provision for children with special educational needs (but without statements) in accordance with these regulations. Information to be published is detailed in the Schedule to these RegulationsThe authority should keep that information under review, and where there is a significant change in any of that information, revise the information accordingly and publish the revised information in accordance with regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3717"},{"id":"817","label":"Special educational needs - review and assessment on request of responsible body","desc":"A local authority must review or assess a child's SEN at the request of the responsible body in certain circumstances and comply with the appeals procedure and the outcome of any appeal.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/817"},{"id":"801","label":"Special educational needs - review of arrangements","desc":"A local authority must keep under review its SEN provision and consult with others as it thinks necessary or desirable.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/801"},{"id":"3732","label":"Special educational needs - review of city college arrangements","desc":"A local education authority shall keep under review the arrangements made under these Regulations and in doing so shall consult the governing bodies of any city college in the authority\u2019s area; and in any neighbouring local education authority\u2019s area to which the authority makes any payment, supplies any goods and services or provides any assistance under these Regulations.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3732"},{"id":"815","label":"Special educational needs - reviews of educational needs","desc":"A local authority must comply with the prescribed process for reviewing SEN provision and the appeals procedure.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/815"},{"id":"811","label":"Special educational needs - statement","desc":"If in the light of an assessment of any child's educational needs and of any representations made by the child's parent it is necessary for the local education authority to, determine the special educational provision which any learning difficulty he may have calls for, the authority shall make and maintain a statement of his special educational needs.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/811"},{"id":"2383","label":"Special educational needs and disability - compliance with SEN provision","desc":"Where a local authority maintains an EHC plan for a child the authority must secure the specified special educational provision for the child or young person.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2383"},{"id":"2384","label":"Special educational needs or disability - admittance to school","desc":"Where an EHC plan has been drawn up for a child with special educational needs or a disability and the plan names a school or other educational institution the governing body, proprietor or principal of the school or other institution must admit the child or young person for whom the plan is maintained.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2384"},{"id":"2372","label":"Special educational needs or disability - advice and information for families","desc":"A local authority must arrange for children and young people for whom it is responsible, and the parents of children for whom it is responsible, to be provided with advice and information about matters relating to the special educational needs or disabilities of the children or young people concerned.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2372"},{"id":"2374","label":"Special educational needs or disability - advice and information for others","desc":"A local authority may arrange for persons other than children and young people for whom it is responsible, and the parents of children for whom it is responsible, to be provided with advice and information about matters relating to the special educational needs or disabilities of the children or young people concerned.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2374"},{"id":"3645","label":"Special educational needs or disability - amendment of EHC plan following review","desc":"Where a review of an EHC plan has been carried out the authority must act in accordance with regulations and within specified time scales when considering amending an EHC plan or when deciding not to amend an EHC plan.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3645"},{"id":"2394","label":"Special educational needs or disability - appeal mediation","desc":"A local authority must inform the parent or young person of the right to mediation and participate in the same and notify other relevant bodies where appropriate.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2394"},{"id":"2396","label":"Special educational needs or disability - appeals pilot scheme","desc":"A local authority must comply with a pilot scheme for its area enabling child to appeal.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2396"},{"id":"2403","label":"Special educational needs or disability - appointment of SEN co-ordinator","desc":"The appropriate authority in mainstream schools and maintained nursery schools must designate a member of staff at the school (to be known as the \u201cSEN co-ordinator\u201d) as having responsibility for co-ordinating the provision for pupils with special educational needs.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2403"},{"id":"2395","label":"Special educational needs or disability - arrangements for resolving disagreements","desc":"A local authority must make arrangements for resolving disagreements between certain bodies in certain circumstances regarding and EHC plan.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2395"},{"id":"2398","label":"Special educational needs or disability - arrangements outside England and Wales","desc":"A local authority may arrange for the delivery of an EHC plan outside of England or Wales.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2398"},{"id":"2388","label":"Special educational needs or disability - cessation of EHC plan","desc":"A local authority may cease to maintain an EHC plan for a child or young person only if\u2014(a) the authority is no longer responsible for the child or young person, or(b) the authority determines that it is no longer necessary for the plan to be maintained.The circumstances in which it is no longer necessary for an EHC plan to be maintained for a child or young person include where the child or young person no longer requires the special educational provision specified in the plan.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2388"},{"id":"2370","label":"Special educational needs or disability - co-operation with governing bodies","desc":"A local authority must co-operate with governing bodies of academic institutions and each governing body must co-operate with the authority, in the exercise of the authority's functions in relation to special educational needs.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2370"},{"id":"2414","label":"Special educational needs or disability - co-operation with partners","desc":"A local authority must co-operate with each of its local partners, and each local partner must co-operate with the authority, in the exercise of the authority's functions under Part 3.The authority must also make arrangements for ensuring co-operation between the officers of the authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2414"},{"id":"2406","label":"Special educational needs or disability - Code of Practice","desc":"A local authority must have regard to the Secretary of State\u2019s Code of Practice regarding special educational needs and disabilities.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2406"},{"id":"2387","label":"Special educational needs or disability - discretionary re-assessment of EHC plan","desc":"A local authority may re-assess the educational, health care and social care needs of a child or young person for whom it maintains an EHC plan at any time and must consult as required.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2387"},{"id":"2380","label":"Special educational needs or disability - draft EHC plan","desc":"A local authority must where it is required to secure that an EHC plan is prepared for a child or young person, consult the child's parent or the young person about the content of the plan during the preparation of a draft of the plan.The local authority must then\u2014(a) send the draft plan to the child's parent or the young person, and(b) give the parent or young person notice of his or her right to\u2014(i) make representations about the content of the draft plan, and(ii) request the authority to secure that a particular school or other institution is named in the plan","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2380"},{"id":"2378","label":"Special educational needs or disability - EHC assessment","desc":"A local authority must make an EHC (Education, Health and Care) assessment for a qualifying child or young person. The authority must take into account the views of that child, young person or parent and must notify the child, young person and parents of the outcome with reasons.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2378"},{"id":"2379","label":"Special educational needs or disability - EHC plan","desc":"Where, in the light of an EHC needs assessment, it is necessary for special educational provision to be made for a child or young person in accordance with an EHC plan\u2014(a)the local authority must secure that an EHC plan is prepared for the child or young person, and(b)once an EHC plan has been prepared, it must maintain the plan.A local authority must send the finalised EHC plan to\u2014(a) the child's parent or to the young person;(b) the governing body, proprietor or principal of any school, other institution or provider of relevant early years education named in the EHC plan; and(c) to the responsible commissioning body, as soon as practicable, and in any event within 20 weeks of the local authority receiving a request for an EHC needs assessment in accordance with section 36(1) of the Act, or of the local authority becoming responsible for the child in accordance with section 24 of the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2379"},{"id":"2389","label":"Special educational needs or disability - EHC plan after 25th birthday","desc":"A local authority may continue to maintain an EHC plan for a young person until the end of the academic year during which the young person attains the age of 25.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2389"},{"id":"2393","label":"Special educational needs or disability - EHC plan appeals","desc":"A local authority must comply with the appeals process regarding EHC plans","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2393"},{"id":"3643","label":"Special educational needs or disability - EHC plan in relation to higher education","desc":"When a young person is intending to undertake a course of higher education, the local authority must disclose a copy of that young person\u2019s EHC plan to: - any person in connection with the young person\u2019s application for a disabled student\u2019s allowance in accordance with chapter 3 of part 5 of the Education (Student Support) Regulations 2011(1)- the principal (or equivalent position) of the institution at which it has been confirmed that the young person has a place to undertake a course of higher education,within 15 working days of being asked to do so by the young person.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3643"},{"id":"2409","label":"Special educational needs or disability - general duties","desc":"When exercising function under Part 3 of the Act in the case of a child or young person, a local authority in England must have regard to certain general matters relating to inclusion and to sharing information with both parent(s) and the child/ young person","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2409"},{"id":"2410","label":"Special educational needs or disability - identification of children and young people with needs","desc":"A local authority in England must exercise its functions with a view to securing that it identifies\u2014(a) all the children and young people in its area who have or may have special educational needs, and(b) all the children and young people in its area who have a disability.A local authority in England is responsible for a child or young person if he or she is in the authority\u2019s area and has been identified by the authority as someone who has or may have special educational needs, or brought to the authority\u2019s attention by any person as someone who has or may have special educational needs.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2410"},{"id":"2404","label":"Special educational needs or disability - information regarding provision","desc":"If special educational provision is made for a child or young person at a maintained school, a maintained nursery school, or a pupil referral unit, and no EHC plan is maintained for the child or young person. The appropriate authority for the school must inform the child's parent or the young person that special educational provision is being made for the child or young person.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2404"},{"id":"2401","label":"Special educational needs or disability - inspection of institution","desc":"Where a local authority maintains an EHC plan for a child or young person, a person authorised by the authority is entitled to have access at any reasonable time to the premises of a school, post-16 institution or other institution at which education or training is provided in pursuance of the plan, for the purpose of monitoring the education or training.This power does not apply to the premises of a mainstream post-16 institution in Wales.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2401"},{"id":"2411","label":"Special educational needs or disability - integration of services","desc":"A local authority in England must exercise its functions with a view to ensuring the integration of educational provision and training provision with health care provision and social care provision, where it thinks that this would\u2014(a) promote the well-being of children or young people in its area who have special educational needs or a disability, or(b) improve the quality of special educational provision.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2411"},{"id":"2412","label":"Special educational needs or disability - joint commissioning arrangements","desc":"A local authority and its partner commissioning bodies must make arrangements (\u201cjoint commissioning arrangements\u201d) about the education, health and care provision to be secured for\u2014(a) children and young people for whom the authority is responsible who have special educational needs, and(b) children and young people in the authority's area who have a disability.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2412"},{"id":"3644","label":"Special educational needs or disability - local offer","desc":"A local authority is responsible for providing children and young people with special educationalneeds or disabilities and their families information about what supportservices the local authority think will be available in their local area (known as the 'local offer') and for makingsure the local offer is available for everyone to see. The authority must consult with all parties specified in these Regulations when compiling the local offer and must involve children, their parents and young people in preparation and review of local offer.The authority must seek comments on the local offer from children and young people with special educational needs or a disability, and the parents of children with special educational needs or a disability must publish comments and the authority's response (in a form that does not enable any individual to be identified) together with the local offer on its website at least annually.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3644"},{"id":"2375","label":"Special educational needs or disability - mainstream schooling with EHC plan","desc":"A local authority must secure that the EHC plan provides for the child or young person to be educated in a maintained nursery school, mainstream school or mainstream post-16 institution, unless that is incompatible with \u2014(a) the wishes of the child's parent or the young person, or(b) the provision of efficient education for others","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2375"},{"id":"2376","label":"Special educational needs or disability - mainstream schooling without EHC plan","desc":"A local authority must secure that the child or young person to be educated in a maintained nursery school, mainstream school or mainstream post-16 institution, unless certain exceptions laid down in the section apply.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2376"},{"id":"2391","label":"Special educational needs or disability - maintenance of EHC plan on release from detention","desc":"Where a child or young person who has been subject to a detention order is released,(b) on the release date, a local authority becomes responsible for him or her, and(c) an EHC plan was\u2014(i) maintained for him or her immediately before the start of the detention, or(ii) kept for him or her under section 74 during the detention.(2) The local authority must\u2014(a) maintain the plan, and(b) review the plan as soon as reasonably practicable after the release date.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2391"},{"id":"2402","label":"Special educational needs or disability - meeting special educational needs","desc":"If a registered pupil or a student at a school or other institution has special educational needs, the appropriate authority must, in exercising its functions in relation to the school or other institution, use its best endeavours to secure that the special educational provision called for by the pupil's or student's special educational needs is made.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2402"},{"id":"2382","label":"Special educational needs or disability - no institution requested","desc":"Where a local authority is not requested to name a particular institution in the EHC plan it must name an institution that is suitable for the age, ability, aptitude or special educational needs of the child or young person concerned. It must after consultation with the governing body or proprietor of that institution name that institution in the EHC.The local authority must then forward a copy of the final EHC plan to the child\u2019s parents or young person and to the institution named.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2382"},{"id":"2377","label":"Special educational needs or disability - nursery and mainstream schooling","desc":"Where a child with special educational needs is being educated in a maintained nursery school or a mainstream school those concerned with making special educational provision for the child must secure that the child engages in the activities of the school together with children who do not have special educational needs, subject to it being reasonably practicable and compatible with\u2014(a) the child receiving the special educational provision called for by his or her special educational needs,(b) the provision of efficient education for the children with whom he or she will be educated, and(c) the efficient use of resources.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2377"},{"id":"2399","label":"Special educational needs or disability - payment of fees","desc":"A local authority must pay the fees (including board and lodging) of the institution concerned where it maintains an EHC plan for a child or young person under which special educational provision in respect of the child or young person is made at a school, post-16 institution or place at which relevant early years education is provided, and that school, institution or place is named in the EHC plan.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2399"},{"id":"2392","label":"Special educational needs or disability - personal budgets","desc":"A local authority that maintains an EHC plan, or is securing the preparation of an EHC plan, for a child or young person must prepare a personal budget for him or her if asked to do so by the child's parent or the young person.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2392"},{"id":"2397","label":"Special educational needs or disability - provision at other institution","desc":"A local authority may arrange for any special educational provision that it has decided is necessary for a child or young person for whom it is responsible to be made otherwise than in a school or post-16 institution or a place at which relevant early years education is provided.An authority may do so only if satisfied that it would be inappropriate for the provision to be made in a school or post-16 institution or at such a place.Before doing so, the authority must consult the child's parent or the young person.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2397"},{"id":"2371","label":"Special educational needs or disability - publication of local offer","desc":"A local authority must publish information about\u2014(a) the provision it expects to be available in its area at the time of publication for children and young people who have special educational needs or a disability, and(b) the provision that it expects to be available outside its area.The local offer should include information about all the areas specified in Schedule 2 of the Special Educational Needs and Disability Regulations 2014The local offer should be published on the authority's website. The authority should also publish arrangements for enabling those without access to the internet to get information","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2371"},{"id":"2405","label":"Special educational needs or disability - report containing SEN information","desc":"If special educational provision is made for a child or young person at a maintained school, a maintained nursery school, or a pupil referral unit, and no EHC plan is maintained for the child or young person. The appropriate authority for the school must inform the child's parent or the young person that special educational provision is being made for the child or young person.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2405"},{"id":"2373","label":"Special educational needs or disability - request for co-operation","desc":"A local authority may require the co-operation of certain bodies in certain circumstances in connection with its functions in relation to Special Educational Needs.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2373"},{"id":"2381","label":"Special educational needs or disability - requested institution","desc":"Where a local authority is requested to name a particular institution in the EHC it must after consultation with the governing body or proprietor of that institution name that institution in the EHC unless the school or other institution requested is unsuitable for the age, ability, aptitude or special educational needs of the child or young person concerned, or the attendance of the child or young person at the requested school or other institution would be incompatible with the provision of efficient education for others, or the efficient use of resources. In which case after consultation a further institution must be named. The local authority must then forward a copy of the final EHC plan to the child\u2019s parents or young person and to the institution named.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2381"},{"id":"2386","label":"Special educational needs or disability - requested re-assessment of EHC plan","desc":"A local authority must secure a re-assessment of the educational, health care and social care needs of a child or young person for whom it maintains an EHC plan if a request is made to it by\u2014(a) the child's parent or the young person, or(b) the governing body, proprietor or principal of the school, post-16 institution or other institution which the child or young person attends.and must consult as required.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2386"},{"id":"2413","label":"Special educational needs or disability - review of educational, training and social care provision","desc":"A local authority must keep under review and consult where required regarding the educational, training provision and social care provision made in its area for children and young people who have special educational needs or a disability, and(b) the educational provision, training provision and social care provision made outside its area for\u2014(i) children and young people for whom it is responsible who have special educational needs, and(ii) children and young people in its area who have a disability.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2413"},{"id":"2385","label":"Special educational needs or disability - review of EHC plan","desc":"A local authority must review an EHC plan that it maintains\u2014in the period of 12 months starting with the date on which the plan was first made, andin each subsequent period of 12 months starting with the date on which the plan was last reviewed under this section.and must consult as required.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2385"},{"id":"2400","label":"Special educational needs or disability - supply of goods or services","desc":"A local authority may supply goods and services to\u2014the governing body of a maintained school or maintained nursery school in England; orthe proprietor of an Academy; orthe governing body of an institution within the further education sector that the authority thinks is or is to be attended by a young person for whom the authority maintains an EHC plan, in connection with the provision of special educational needs on such terms and conditions as it thinks fit including payment.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2400"},{"id":"2390","label":"Special educational needs or disability - transfer of EHC plan","desc":"A local authority must comply with Regulations regarding the transfer of an EHC plan.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2390"},{"id":"1535","label":"Sports grounds - amendment or replacement of safety certificates","desc":"A local authority may amend or replace a safety certificate in accordance with the prescribed procedure.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1535"},{"id":"1536","label":"Sports grounds - appeals against determinations on safety certificates","desc":"A local authority must comply with the appeals procedure concerning safety certificates.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1536"},{"id":"1540","label":"Sports grounds - entry and inspection","desc":"An officer authorised by a local authority may enter a sports ground for the purpose of inspection and take a copy of certain records.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1540"},{"id":"1539","label":"Sports grounds - inspection and enforcement","desc":"A local authority must arrange for the periodical inspection of sports grounds.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1539"},{"id":"1537","label":"Sports grounds - issue, amendment, transfer and cancellation of safety certificates","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations regarding the issue, amendment, transfer and cancellation of safety certificates.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1537"},{"id":"1538","label":"Sports grounds - prohibition notices","desc":"A local authority may issue or withdraw a prohibition notice in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1538"},{"id":"1534","label":"Sports grounds - safety certificates","desc":"A local authority must consider applications for safety certificates for qualifying sports grounds and comply with the prescribed procedure for so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1534"},{"id":"142","label":"Staff - establishment of staff commission","desc":"A local authority must comply with Secretary of State's directions regarding co-operation with and the payment of expenses to a staff commission.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/142"},{"id":"2666","label":"Staff - family absence","desc":"Local authorities must maintain a record of all notifications made by members of periods of family absence; the periods of family absence taken and keep them for at least 10 years.LAs have duties to inform, regarding cancellation of family absence, complaints and standing orders relating to members whilst taking a period of family absence.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2666"},{"id":"2188","label":"Staff - superannuation of persons employed in local government service","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations made under the Act providing for pension schemes for its employees.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2188"},{"id":"2564","label":"Staff pensions - discretionary payments","desc":"A LA who is a Local Government Pension Scheme employer may make discretionary payments to employees who in the course of carrying out their work sustain an injury or contract a disease and must publish its policy regarding the exercise of its powers.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2564"},{"id":"3238","label":"Statistics - disclosure to to the Statistics and Registration Service Board","desc":"A local authority may, subject to the provisions of this section, disclose to the Statistics and Registration Service Board any information held by the authority in connection with its functions.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3238"},{"id":"3249","label":"Statistics and registration - disclosure of information","desc":"A local authority must disclose certain information to the Statistics and Information Service in certain circumstances","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3249"},{"id":"1864","label":"Statues and monuments - erection, maintenance and removal","desc":"A local authority may provide, maintain and, remove statues and monuments in their district.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1864"},{"id":"1241","label":"Statutory nuisances - criminal and civil proceedings for breach of abatement notice","desc":"A local authority may bring criminal and criminal proceedings in the case of a breach of an abatement notice.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1241"},{"id":"1240","label":"Statutory nuisances - inspection and investigation","desc":"A local authority must inspect its area from time to time to identify statutory nuisances and must investigate complaints about statutory nuisance.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1240"},{"id":"1242","label":"Statutory nuisances - notice to recover expenses","desc":"A local authority may serve a notice to recover expenses in certain circumstances which will become a charge on premises.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1242"},{"id":"2935","label":"Statutory nuisances - proceedings","desc":"A local authority must commence proceedings for statutory nuisance in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2935"},{"id":"1254","label":"Stray dogs - appointment and actions by officer","desc":"A local authority must appoint an officer to discharge the functions of seizing, serving notices regarding, disposing of or returning stray dogs and may charge for certain expenses for so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1254"},{"id":"2104","label":"Street cleaning - non-highway","desc":"A local authority may, with the agreement of the owner or occupier, carry out street cleaning on land which does not form part of the highway.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2104"},{"id":"2090","label":"Street cleaning - prohibition of parking","desc":"A local authority may by notice prevent parking upon streets upon which street cleaning is to be carried out","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2090"},{"id":"1761","label":"Street collections - regulations","desc":"A local authority may make regulations, subject to the approval of the relevant Minister, governing street collections of money for charitable or other purposes.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1761"},{"id":"1620","label":"Street furniture - civil debt for recovery of damage","desc":"A local authority may recover damage caused by negligence to certain items of street furniture as a civil debt.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1620"},{"id":"1610","label":"Street lighting - affixing to buildings","desc":"A local authority may, with the agreement of a building's owner, affix street lighting to buildings.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1610"},{"id":"1763","label":"Street names - alteration","desc":"A local authority may with the consent of two thirds of the relevant council tax payers change a street name and mark the same.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1763"},{"id":"1772","label":"Street names - naming or alteration","desc":"A local authority may name or alter the name of a street in accordance with the prescribed procedure.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1772"},{"id":"1771","label":"Street names - objection","desc":"A local authority may object to a proposed street name in accordance with the prescribed procedure.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1771"},{"id":"1773","label":"Street names - placement of street nameplates","desc":"A local authority must mark or place the name of a street on the street and renew it in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1773"},{"id":"2485","label":"Street trading - regulation","desc":"A local authority may adopt schedule 4 of the Act to enable it to Regulate street trading.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2485"},{"id":"1307","label":"Street works - advance notice","desc":"A local authority may prescribe requirements when given an advance notice by an undertaker proposing to execute street works.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1307"},{"id":"1309","label":"Street works - co-ordination of street works","desc":"A local authority must use its best endeavours to coordinate the execution of works of all kinds.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1309"},{"id":"1321","label":"Street works - cost sharing for major road works and apparatus","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations regarding cost sharing in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1321"},{"id":"1302","label":"Street works - directions as to placing of apparatus","desc":"A local authority may give directions as to the placing of apparatus in connection with street works.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1302"},{"id":"1301","label":"Street works - directions as to timing","desc":"If it appears to the authority that proposed street works are likely to cause serious disruption to traffic, and that the disruption would be avoided or reduced if the works were carried out only at certain times, the authority may give the undertaker such directions as may be appropriate as to the times when the works may or may not be carried out.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1301"},{"id":"1318","label":"Street works - maintenance of apparatus","desc":"A local authority must take certain steps relating to the maintenance of apparatus as regards the safety and convenience of persons using the street (having regard, in particular, to the needs of people with a disability), the structure of the street and the integrity of apparatus of the authority in the street.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1318"},{"id":"1320","label":"Street works - major road works and apparatus","desc":"A local authority must co-operate with others and the owners of apparatus in certain information regarding certain major road works.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1320"},{"id":"1308","label":"Street works - notice restricting works following substantial road works","desc":"A local authority may give notice restricting street works following substantial road works.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1308"},{"id":"1310","label":"Street works - protected streets","desc":"A local authority may give its consent for the placing of apparatus in protected streets and may charge fees for so doing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1310"},{"id":"1315","label":"Street works - reinstatement","desc":"A local authority may investigate the reinstatement of a road, require the undertaker to repair and in certain circumstances carry out the repairs itself and charge the undertaker for so doing.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1315"},{"id":"1319","label":"Street works - road works and apparatus.","desc":"A local authority must provide the owners of apparatus with certain information regarding certain road works in certain circumstances. This section applies to works for road purposes other than major highway works.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1319"},{"id":"1313","label":"Street works - safety measures","desc":"A local authority may give directions as to safety measures to an undertaker of street works in their area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1313"},{"id":"1311","label":"Street works - streets with special engineering difficulties","desc":"A local authority must consider designating street as a street with special engineering difficulties when requested to do so.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1311"},{"id":"1317","label":"Street works - temporary traffic regulation","desc":"Where by reason of street works the traffic authority makes an order or issues a notice under section 14 of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 (temporary prohibition or restriction of traffic), the authority may recover from the undertaker the whole of the costs incurred by them in connection with or in consequence of the order or notice.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1317"},{"id":"1312","label":"Street works - traffic sensitive streets","desc":"A local authority may make a limited designation order in relation to traffic sensitive streets in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1312"},{"id":"1324","label":"Street works - undertaken by street authority or district council","desc":"A street authority or district council may enter into an agreement with an undertaker for the execution by the authority or council on behalf of the undertaker of any street works.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1324"},{"id":"1314","label":"Street works - unreasonable delay or obstruction","desc":"A local authority may issue a notice to prevent unreasonable delay and obstruction and may recover certain costs.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1314"},{"id":"1316","label":"Street works - unreasonably prolonged works","desc":"A local authority must comply with regulations relating to unreasonably prolonged works.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1316"},{"id":"1305","label":"Street works licence","desc":"A local authority may, in certain circumstances, grant a street works licence permitting a person to place, or to retain, apparatus in the street and thereafter to inspect, maintain, adjust, repair, alter or renew the apparatus, change its position or remove it and to execute for those purposes any works required.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1305"},{"id":"1306","label":"Street works register","desc":"A local authority must maintain and make available a street works register which must comply with prescribed conditions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1306"},{"id":"1871","label":"Streets - naming streets and house numbering","desc":"A local authority must name streets and number houses.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1871"},{"id":"3827","label":"Subsidy control - compliance with regulations made by Secretary of State","desc":"A local authority must comply with Regulations made by the Secretary of State regarding information to be included on the subsidy database.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3827"},{"id":"3821","label":"Subsidy control - consideration of principles","desc":"A local authority(a) must consider the subsidy control principles before deciding to give a subsidy, and(b) must not give the subsidy unless it is of the view that the subsidy is consistent with those principles.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3821"},{"id":"3828","label":"Subsidy control - consideration of when subsidy control does not apply","desc":"A local authority should have regard to circumstances in which the subsidy control requirements do not apply to the giving of a subsidy.Where the subsidy control requirements do not apply to the giving of a subsidy, those requirements are to be taken as not applying to the making of a subsidy scheme so far as it provides for the giving of such a subsidy.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3828"},{"id":"3823","label":"Subsidy control - energy and environment principles","desc":"A local authority(a) must consider the energy and environment principles before deciding to give a subsidy in relation to energy and environment, and(b) must not give the subsidy unless it is of the view that the subsidy is consistent with those principles.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3823"},{"id":"3824","label":"Subsidy control - energy and environment principles for schemes","desc":"A local authority(a) must consider the energy and environment principles before making a subsidy scheme that provides for the giving of subsidies in relation to energy and environment, and(b) must not make the scheme unless it is of the view that the subsidies provided for by the scheme will be consistent with those principles.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3824"},{"id":"3826","label":"Subsidy control - inclusion of information in subsidy database","desc":"A local authority must ensure that an entry in the subsidy database is made in respect of (a) a subsidy given by the authority, and(b) a subsidy scheme made by the authority.The above does not apply to a subsidy if(a) it is given under a subsidy scheme,(b) an entry is made in the subsidy database in respect of the scheme, and(c) the amount of the subsidy is no more than \u00a3100,000.When doing so the local authority must comply with specified time limits and with any Regulations made by the Secretary of State supplementing or modifying the above.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3826"},{"id":"3829","label":"Subsidy control - mandatory referral to CMA","desc":"A local authority must request a report from the CMA: (a) before giving a subsidy, or making a subsidy scheme, of particular interest, or(b) where directed to do so by the Secretary of State under section 55.The request must(a) include the information in relation to the subsidy or subsidy scheme that would be required under section 34, if the subsidy or scheme were to be given or made,(b) provide such other information as is specified in regulations under subsection (3)(a),(c) explain, in the case of a request under subsection (1)(a), why the public authority considers that the subsidy or subsidy scheme would meet the criteria for being a subsidy, or subsidy scheme, of particular interest,(d) include an assessment by the public authority as to whether the subsidy or scheme would comply with the requirements of Chapters 1 and 2 of Part 2, and the reasons for that conclusion, and(e) include any evidence relevant to that assessment.The request must also comply with Regulations issue by the Secretary of State.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3829"},{"id":"3831","label":"Subsidy control - pre-action information for potential review","desc":"Where a local authority receives a request for pre-action information in relation to a potential review of a subsidy decision, the authority must provide such information as would enable, or assist in, the making of a determination as to whether the subsidy was given, or the scheme was made, in accordance with the requirements of Chapters 1 and 2 of Part 2.The information must be provided by the public authority(a) in writing, and(b) within 28 days of receiving the request for information.In providing information, a public authority may impose such restrictions as it considers proportionate in order to protect(a) commercially sensitive information,(b) confidential information,(c) information subject to legal privilege, or(d) information, the disclosure of which would be contrary to the public interest.Information provided in response to a request made under this section may be used only(a) for the purpose for which it was requested, and(b) in accordance with any restrictions imposed by the public authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3831"},{"id":"3825","label":"Subsidy control - prohibitions and requirements","desc":"A local authority must comply with any prohibitions determined by legislation when giving certain subsidies, and meet any requirements stipulated in relation to the giving of certain other subsidies.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3825"},{"id":"3832","label":"Subsidy control - recovery of misused subsidy","desc":"A local authority which has given a subsidy has the right to recover from the beneficiary the whole or part of its amount to the extent that the subsidy is used for a purpose other than the purpose for which it was given.This right is enforceable as if created by contract between the public authority and the beneficiary.Nothing in this section affects any other remedy that the authority may have in connection with the giving of the subsidy.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3832"},{"id":"3833","label":"Subsidy control - regard to guidance","desc":"A public authority must have regard to guidance issued by the Secretary of State (so far as applicable to the authority and the circumstances of the case) when giving a subsidy or making a subsidy scheme.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3833"},{"id":"3830","label":"Subsidy control - request for report from CMA","desc":"A local authority may request a report from the CMA before giving a subsidy, or making a subsidy scheme, of interest.The request must(a) include the information in relation to the subsidy or subsidy scheme that would be required under section 34, if the subsidy or scheme were to be given or made,(b) provide such other information as is specified in regulations under subsection (3)(a),(c) explain why the public authority considers that the subsidy or subsidy scheme would meet the criteria for being a subsidy, or subsidy scheme, of interest,(d) include an assessment by the public authority as to whether the subsidy or scheme would comply with the requirements of Chapters 1 and 2 of Part 2, and the reasons for that conclusion, and(e) include any evidence relevant to that assessment.The request must comply with any Regulations issued by the Secretary of State.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3830"},{"id":"3822","label":"Subsidy control - subsidy schemes","desc":"A local authority(a) must consider the subsidy control principles before making a subsidy scheme, and(b) must not make the scheme unless it is of the view that the subsidies provided for by the scheme will be consistent with those principles.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3822"},{"id":"3122","label":"Taxation - decision on taxable status","desc":"If a local authority enters into a contract to which Section 61M applies, If the contract is entered into on or after 6 April 2017, the duty under subsection (1) must be complied with-(a) on or before the time of entry into the contract, or(b) if the services begin to be performed at a later time, before that later time.If the contract is entered into before 6 April 2017, the duty under subsection (1) must be complied with on or before the date of the first payment made under the contract on or after 6 April 2017","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3122"},{"id":"3123","label":"Taxation - information to establish taxable status","desc":"If a local authority enters into a contract to which Section 61M applies, the local authority may ask the person such questions as it requires to enable it to comply with its duty under Section 61T.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3123"},{"id":"3121","label":"Taxation - self employed persons contracted to local authority","desc":"If a local authority contracts with a third party for a person to carry out work for it and that person would be considered to be an employee if engaged directly by the local authority then the local authority must treat that person as an employee for the purposes of tax and national insurance.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3121"},{"id":"3862","label":"Taxi and private hire licences - acting on reported concerns","desc":"Where an English licensing authority (\"authority A\"):(a) receives information from another licensing authority (\"authority B\") relating to a person who has driven in authority B's area in reliance on a driver's licence granted by authority A, or(b) receives information of a similar nature from a relevant authority (\"authority C\") relating to a person who has driven in authority C's area in reliance on a driver's licence granted by authority A.(2) Before the end of the period of 20 working days beginning with the date on which authority A becomes aware of the information, authority A must:(a) consider whether to suspend or revoke the person's driver's licence in reliance on(i) the information, and(ii) any other information available to authority A, and(b) inform authority B or authority C (as the case may be) in writing(i) whether or not it has suspended or revoked, or intends to suspend or revoke, the person's driver's licence, and(ii) the reasons for that action or intended action.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3862"},{"id":"3861","label":"Taxi and private hire licences - provision of information","desc":"Where:(a) an English licensing authority (\"the first authority\") becomes aware of relevant information relating to a person who has driven in the first authority's area in reliance on a driver's licence or a relevant licence (one issued in Scotland or in Wales) granted by another licensing authority or a relevant authority (\"the second authority\"),(b) the information relates to the person's conduct in the first authority's area, and(c) the first authority is satisfied that, had it granted the licence, it would have considered suspending or revoking it in reliance on the information.(2) The first authority must provide to the second authority:(a) the relevant information, and(b) any other information of which it is aware which is relevant to identifying the person,before the end of the period of 10 working days beginning with the day on which the first authority became aware of the relevant information relating to the person's conduct in its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3861"},{"id":"3860","label":"Taxi and private hire licences -
