recording of licensing decisions","desc":"In certain circumstances relating to the refusal, revocation or suspension of a taxi or private hire licence a local authority must:(a) make an entry recording the decision, and prescribed information, in the licensing information database,(b) ensure (whether by amending, removing or reinstating it) that the entry is kept up-to-date so as to reflect any subsequent change made to the decision(i) by the authority,(ii) on appeal against the authority's decision, or(iii) on any subsequent appeal,during the period of 11 years beginning with the day on which the entry is first made, and(c) keep a record of the relevant information and the decision until the end of the period referred to in paragraph (b).This must be done within 5 working days of the local authority notifying the person of their decision.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3860"},{"id":"3863","label":"Taxi and private hire licences - regard to guidance","desc":"A licensing authority must have regard to guidance issued to licensing authorities in connection with their functions under this Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3863"},{"id":"3257","label":"Television services - enforcement","desc":"The relevant local authority may enforce the requirements of these Regulations and has the power to make test purchases, search, seize, test and detain equipment (and relevant documentation with regard to seizure) and to apply for forfeiture of equipment.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3257"},{"id":"3639","label":"Temporary road traffic order for Coronavirus - notice of intent","desc":"Where a traffic authority is satisfied that an order should be made for purposes connected to coronavirus the traffic authority must, not less than 7 days before making an order, publish notice of its intention to make the order using such arrangements as the traffic authority considers appropriate for the purpose of informing persons likely to be affected by its provisions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3639"},{"id":"3640","label":"Temporary road traffic order for Coronavirus - notice of order","desc":"The traffic authority must, on or before the day on which the order is made, give notice of the order to:(a) the chief officer of police of any police area in which any road to which the order relates is situated(b)where the traffic authority is not the fire authority for the area in which any road to which the order relates is situated, to the chief officer of the fire authority for that area(c)where the order would be likely to have direct effect on traffic, or any class of traffic, on any road for the maintenance of which another traffic authority is responsible, to that other traffic authority(d)the concessionaire where the order is likely to have a direct effect on traffic, or any class of traffic, on a road which is subject to a concession or a road in respect of which an assignation has been granted under section 28(1) of the 1991 Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3640"},{"id":"3641","label":"Temporary road traffic order for Coronavirus - publication of order","desc":"Within 14 days after making the order the traffic authority must publish a notice of the making of the order in one or more newspapers, whether in print or online, circulating in the area in which any road to which the order relates is situated.Where the traffic authority considers that it is not reasonably practicable to comply with these requirements for reasons connected to the effects of coronavirus, including restrictions on movement, the traffic authority must publish a notice of the making of the order using such alternative arrangements as the traffic authority considers appropriate for the purpose of informing persons likely to be affected by its provisions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3641"},{"id":"3465","label":"Tenant fees - assistance in civil recovery","desc":"A local authority may assist a person who has made an unlawful payment in breach of sections 1 or 2 or Schedule 2, to recover that amount by way of an application to a first-tier tribunal.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3465"},{"id":"3456","label":"Tenant fees - duty to enforce prohibitions applying to landlords","desc":"A local weights and measures authority must enforce legislation relating to prohibitions which apply to landlords as detailed in Section 1 of the Tenant Fees Act 2019","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3456"},{"id":"3457","label":"Tenant fees - duty to enforce prohibitions applying to letting agents","desc":"A local weights and measures authority must enforce prohibitions applying to letting agents as detailed in Section 2 of the Tenant Fees Act 2019","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3457"},{"id":"3462","label":"Tenant fees - financial penalties","desc":"A local authority being satisfied beyond reasonable doubt that a person has breached section 1 or 2 or Schedule 2 of the Act, may impose a financial penalty on the person in respect of the breach (subject to restrictions and limitations imposed by the Act).","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3462"},{"id":"3464","label":"Tenant fees - notification of enforcement","desc":"A local authority (subject to certain limitations imposed by the Act) taking enforcement action must notify another local authority of enforcement action taking place in the area of that second authority and certain other prescribed matters.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3464"},{"id":"3459","label":"Tenant fees - power to enforce prohibitions applying to landlords","desc":"A district council which is not a local weights and measures authority may enforce legislation relating to prohibitions which apply to landlords as detailed in Section 1 of the Tenant Fees Act 2019","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3459"},{"id":"3460","label":"Tenant fees - power to enforce prohibitions applying to letting agents","desc":"A district council which is not a local weights and measures authority may enforce prohibitions applying to letting agents as detailed in Section 2 of the Tenant Fees Act 2019","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3460"},{"id":"3463","label":"Tenant fees - repayment of amount improperly paid","desc":"A local authority may, subject to certain limitations imposed by the Act, require the person responsible to repay the amount improperly paid in breach of section 1 or 2 or Schedule 2 of the Act and may require the person responsible to pay interest on that amount.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3463"},{"id":"2407","label":"Tobacco purchasing - prohibition of purchase by adult for consumption by child","desc":"A local authority must enforce this criminal offence in its role as weights and measures authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2407"},{"id":"2162","label":"Tourism - visitor and conference facilities","desc":"A local authority may encourage visitors and provide conference facilities or make contributions to others providing the same.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2162"},{"id":"1730","label":"Town development - appropriation of land for planning purposes","desc":"A local authority may appropriate land, if authorised to do so by the Minister for the purposes of town development.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1730"},{"id":"1723","label":"Town development - conditions of payment of Exchequer contributions","desc":"A local authority must comply with conditions attached to any exchequer contributions towards the cost of town development.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1723"},{"id":"1729","label":"Town development - contributions to expenses of land drainage works","desc":"The council of a receiving district or an authority eligible to participate may contribute towards expenses incurred by the National Rivers Authority or by an internal drainage board in the execution of works rendered necessary by the carrying out of development which, in the opinion of the authority making the contribution, is town development within the meaning of this Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1729"},{"id":"1724","label":"Town development - contributions to receiving district","desc":"A local authority which will benefit from town development in another district may make financial contributions to that district.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1724"},{"id":"1725","label":"Town development - extension of powers of receiving district","desc":"A local authority which will benefit from town development may take certain actions that relate to another district.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1725"},{"id":"1726","label":"Town development - Ministerial approval for acquisition of land","desc":"A local authority may, with ministerial approval, acquire land compulsorily for the purposes of the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1726"},{"id":"1727","label":"Town development - participation by agreement","desc":"A local authority may enter into a participation agreement for the purposes of the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1727"},{"id":"1728","label":"Town development - re-transfers of land","desc":"A local authority must comply with any order made by the Minister regarding re-transfers of land or other adjustments.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1728"},{"id":"1644","label":"Trading standards - compensation for goods seized","desc":"A local authority must pay compensation for certain goods seized in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1644"},{"id":"1965","label":"Trading standards - enforcement of remedies for copyright enfringement","desc":"It is the duty of every local weights and measures authority to enforce within their area the copyright provisions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1965"},{"id":"1640","label":"Trading standards - enforcing authorities","desc":"A local authority must enforce the Act and orders made thereunder utilising powers in Schedule 5 to the Consumer Rights Act 2015 and deliver reports to the Board of Trade.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1640"},{"id":"1642","label":"Trading standards - entry to premises and seizure of goods and documents","desc":"An officer authorised by a local authority may enter premises and seize goods and documents for certain purposes connected with the enforcement of the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1642"},{"id":"740","label":"Trading standards - entry to premises for tobacco advertising and promotion enforcement","desc":"An authorised officer of a local authority may enter premises and make purchases (subject to certain conditions and obligations) in order to enforce the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/740"},{"id":"1643","label":"Trading standards - notification of test results","desc":"An officer authorised by a local authority must notify the owner of goods of the results of certain tests.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1643"},{"id":"2808","label":"Trading standards - packaging of goods","desc":"Local authorities (weights and measures authorities) in Great Britain must enforce the regulations on packaging to ensure that it satisfies essential requirements: that lead, cadmium, mercury and hexavalent chromium do not exceed prescribed levels and that technical documentation on compliance are made available to them on request.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2808"},{"id":"1193","label":"Trading standards - sales of tobacco to children","desc":"A local authority must consider, at least once in every period of twelve months, the extent to which it is appropriate for them to carry out in their area a programme of enforcement action and carry out that enforcement action.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1193"},{"id":"1641","label":"Trading standards - test purchases","desc":"A local authority may make test purchases for the purposes of the enforcement of the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1641"},{"id":"2622","label":"Trading standards - textile labelling","desc":"Local authorities (weights and measures authorities) are included as market surveillance authorities for the purposes of carrying out market surveillance checks on fibre composition and labelling under the EU Regulation. Those market surveillance checks are to be carried out in accordance with Articles 19 and 20 and Annexes VII, VIII and IX to the EU Regulation. Local authorities are obliged to enforce the Regulations in their areas.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2622"},{"id":"739","label":"Trading standards - tobacco advertising and promotion enforcement","desc":"A local authority must enforce the Act and the provisions made therein.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/739"},{"id":"1152","label":"Trading standards - trade marks","desc":"A local authority must enforce the prohibition on unauthorised use of trade marks in section 92 of the Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1152"},{"id":"4068","label":"Training for planning authority members","desc":"A local planning authority must comply with Regulations issued by the Secretary of State regarding training for its Members.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/4068"},{"id":"2816","label":"Transparency - smaller authorities","desc":"Local authorities in England to which the Transparency code for smaller authorities issued on 17th December 2014 applies, must comply with that Code.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2816"},{"id":"134","label":"Transport - authorities review of arrangements","desc":"Any one or more local authorities for an area with an integrated transport authority may undertake review related to one or more integrated transport areas or proposed integrated transport areas. With an incidental duty to prepare and publish a scheme.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/134"},{"id":"1863","label":"Transport - cab drivers' shelters","desc":"A local authority may provide, maintain, remove and charge for cab drivers' shelters and make byelaws in respect of the same.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1863"},{"id":"1934","label":"Transport - co-operation between certain councils and London Regional Transport","desc":"Any non-metropolitan county or district council and Wales and Transport for London shall each have power to enter into any agreement or arrangements with the other under which they undertake to contribute towards any expenditure incurred by the other party to the agreement or arrangements in making payments to a person providing a public passenger transport service under any agreement entered into by that other party in exercise of any power that other party may have to secure the provision of that service.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1934"},{"id":"1673","label":"Transport - compensation for temporary removal of bus shelter","desc":"A local authority must when requested to do so by a street works undertaker temporarily remove a bus shelter maintained by them or pay compensation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1673"},{"id":"2908","label":"Transport - competitive tender for services","desc":"It shall be the duty of an authority to enter into competitive tenders for transport services in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2908"},{"id":"2497","label":"Transport - compliance in respect of transport management","desc":"A local authority must comply with the intervention powers of the Secretary of State in relation to its management of the transport network in its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2497"},{"id":"3013","label":"Transport - creation of sub national transport body","desc":"A local authority must comply with an Order of the Secretary of State regarding the creation of sub national transport bodies.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3013"},{"id":"136","label":"Transport - delegation of functions","desc":"Duty to comply with the delegation of functions by the Secretary of State in respect of an Integrated Transport Area including the conferral of a power to direct.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/136"},{"id":"2506","label":"Transport - delegation of functions by Secretary of State","desc":"Duty to comply with the delegation of functions by the Secretary of State in respect of an Integrated Transport Area including the conferral of a power to direct.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2506"},{"id":"2505","label":"Transport - directed review of transport effectiveness in area with an ITA","desc":"The Secretary of State may direct any one or more local authorities for an area with an integrated transport authority may undertake review of transport effectiveness in area and to prepare and publish a scheme.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2505"},{"id":"2503","label":"Transport - Directed review of transport effectiveness in area with no ITA","desc":"When directed by the Secretary of State any two or more local authorities for an area with no integrated transport authority must undertake review of transport effectiveness in area and prepare and publish a scheme.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2503"},{"id":"1933","label":"Transport - district securing provision of public transport services","desc":"A non-metropolitan district council shall have power to secure the provision of such public passenger transport services as they consider it appropriate to secure to meet any public transport requirements within their area which would not in their view be met apart from any action taken by them for that purpose.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1933"},{"id":"1939","label":"Transport - expenditure on public passenger transport services","desc":"It shall be the duty of any authority responsible for expenditure on public passenger transport services to enter into agreements providing for service subsidies (however framed, and whether arising under this Act or under any other enactment) to co-operate with one another so as to secure, in the interests of the ratepayers of their areas","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1939"},{"id":"1937","label":"Transport - financial backing for establishment and operations of public transport companies","desc":"A district council shall have power to make loans to any associated company, or to guarantee loans made to any associated company by any other person, for the provision of working capital.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1937"},{"id":"1942","label":"Transport - grants for bus services","desc":"A parish council or community council may make grants to any body towards expenditure incurred or to be incurred by that body in connection with the operation of a bus service appearing to the council to be wholly or mainly for the benefit of members of the public who are elderly or disabled; or a community bus service","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1942"},{"id":"1941","label":"Transport - grants for transport facilities and services","desc":"An authority to whom this applies may make grants to any other person towards expenditure incurred or to be incurred by that person in providing, maintaining or improving any vehicle, equipment or other facilities provided wholly or mainly for the purpose of facilitating travel by members of the public who are disabled; or any equipment or other facilities specially designed or adapted for that purpose which are incorporated in any vehicle, equipment or other facilities not provided wholly or mainly for that purpose.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1941"},{"id":"1188","label":"Transport - grants to transport authorities","desc":"A local authority must comply with the conditions of any transport grant.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1188"},{"id":"1674","label":"Transport - maintenance of existing bus shelters and queue barriers","desc":"A local authority may maintain existing bus shelters or queue barriers.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1674"},{"id":"132","label":"Transport - new integrated transport authority","desc":"Any two or more local authorities for an area with no integrated transport authority may undertake review of transport effectiveness in area. With an incidental duty to prepare and publish a scheme.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/132"},{"id":"1935","label":"Transport - powers of investment and disposal in relation to public transport companies","desc":"A district council can subscribe for shares on formation of a company formed by them (whether alone or jointly with any other council) in pursuance of this Act; or acquire any shares in or other securities of a company. Any such council shall have power to provide for the disposal, in such manner as they think fit, of any such shares or other securities.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1935"},{"id":"3099","label":"Transport - promoting availability and convenience of use of public transport","desc":"A non-metropolitan county council and Wales shall have power to take any measures that appear to be appropriate for the purpose of or in connection with promoting the availability of public passenger transport services or the convenience of the public (including persons who are elderly or disabled) in using all available public passenger transport services","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3099"},{"id":"1672","label":"Transport - provision and maintenance of bus shelters","desc":"A local authority may provide and maintain bus shelters in their area subject to them obtaining required consents.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1672"},{"id":"1936","label":"Transport - provision of services for public transport companies","desc":"A district council shall have power to enter into an agreement with any associated company, or with any subsidiary of an associated company, for the provision of any administrative, professional or technical services.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1936"},{"id":"1938","label":"Transport - provision, maintenance and operation of bus stations","desc":"Where a council who, at the time when section 66 of the Act came into force (January 11, 2010), were providing a service for the carriage of passengers by road which required a PSV operator's licence, that council shall have power to maintain, repair and operate bus stations and associated facilities provided by them under their former powers.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1938"},{"id":"137","label":"Transport - regard to guidance issued by Secretary of State","desc":"A local authority must have regard to the Secretary of State's guidance in respect of Integrated Transport Area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/137"},{"id":"2507","label":"Transport - regard to the Secretary of State\u2019s guidance in respect of Integrated Transport Area","desc":"A local authority must have regard to the Secretary of State\u2019s guidance in respect of Integrated Transport Area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2507"},{"id":"135","label":"Transport - review directed by Secretary of State","desc":"The Secretary of State may direct any one or more local authorities for an area with an integrated transport authority may undertake review of transport effectiveness in area and to prepare and publish a scheme.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/135"},{"id":"133","label":"Transport - review of the effectiveness and efficiency of transport","desc":"The Secretary of State may direct any two or more local authorities for an area with no integrated transport authority may undertake review of transport effectiveness in area and to prepare and publish a scheme for the establishment of an ITA for any area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/133"},{"id":"2504","label":"Transport - Review of transport effectiveness in area with ITA","desc":"Any one or more local authorities for an area with an integrated transport authority or where the area could be included in a proposed integrated transport authority may undertake review of transport effectiveness in area. With an incidental duty to prepare and publish a scheme.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2504"},{"id":"2502","label":"Transport - Review of transport effectiveness in area with no ITA","desc":"Any two or more local authorities for an area with no integrated transport authority may undertake review of transport effectiveness in area. With an incidental duty to prepare and publish a scheme.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2502"},{"id":"3098","label":"Transport - securing of public transport provision by county","desc":"In each non-metropolitan county of England and Wales it shall be the duty of the county council to secure the provision of such public passenger transport services as the council consider it appropriate to secure to meet requirements within the county that would not be provided by any other means.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3098"},{"id":"1940","label":"Transport - travel concessions on services provided by local authorities","desc":"There is power to provide travel concessions for persons travelling on the service in accordance with a scheme established under section 93 of this Act or in accordance with section 145A(1) or 145B(1) of the Transport Act 2000","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1940"},{"id":"2496","label":"Transport \u2013 management of transport network","desc":"A local authority must manage and make arrangements for the management of the transport network in its area and have regard to the guidance of the secretary of state when so doing.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2496"},{"id":"3483","label":"Transportation of dead bodies - complying with directions","desc":"A local authority must comply with directions from the Secretary of State (England) or Welsh Ministers (Wales) to do things within or outside its area to deal with the transportation, storage or disposal of dead bodies or other human remains.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3483"},{"id":"3484","label":"Transportation of dead bodies - directions concerning transportation, storage or disposal of bodies","desc":"A designated local authority may give directions requiring a person (not acting as an individual or as part of a public authority) to do anything calculated to facilitate the transportation, storage or disposal of dead bodies or other human remains within or from its area. Directions may include the provision of services or equipment and how the direction should be carried out. The local authority must have regard to certain matters before making that Direction.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3484"},{"id":"3480","label":"Transportation of dead bodies - disclosure of information","desc":"A local authority may disclose any information obtained for the purposes of ascertaining the capacity within its area to deal with the transportation, storage or disposal of dead bodies or other human remains only for that purpose or for complying with another legal obligation.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3480"},{"id":"3487","label":"Transportation of dead bodies - failure to comply","desc":"A local authority must comply with a Direction form the Secretary of State (England) or Welsh Ministers (Wales) in relation to a perceived or actual failure to properly comply with its duties under this Schedule or its general duties relating to dead bodies, human remains, cremations or burials.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3487"},{"id":"3481","label":"Transportation of dead bodies - information request from Secretary of State","desc":"A local authority must (subject to data protection legislation and the Investigatory Powers Act 2016) comply with a request for information from the Secretary of State, where that request is in writing and is for the purpose of ascertaining the capacity within its area to deal with the transportation, storage or disposal of dead bodies or other human remains either locally or nationally.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3481"},{"id":"3482","label":"Transportation of dead bodies - information request from Welsh Ministers","desc":"A local authority must (subject to data protection legislation and the Investigatory Powers Act 2016) comply with a request for information from Welsh Ministers, where that request is in writing and is for the purpose of ascertaining the capacity within its area to deal with the transportation, storage or disposal of dead bodies or other human remains either locally or nationally.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3482"},{"id":"3485","label":"Transportation of dead bodies - payment where directions issued","desc":"Where a local authority has given directions requiring a person (not acting as an individual or as part of a public authority) to do anything calculated to facilitate the transportation, storage or disposal of dead bodies or other human remains within or from its area it must make payments in accordance with a scheme to be published by the appropriate national authority.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3485"},{"id":"3479","label":"Transportation of dead bodies - provision of information","desc":"A local authority may require a person to give information for the purpose of ascertaining the capacity within its area to deal with the transportation, storage or disposal of dead bodies or other human remains. The request must be made in writing and explain to whom the information is to be provided, how it is provided and by when it is to be provided. This power is subject to restrictions imposed by data protection legislation and by the Investigatory Powers Act 2016.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3479"},{"id":"3486","label":"Transportation of dead bodies - regard to guidance","desc":"Where a local authority has been designated by the Secretary of State or Welsh Ministers it must have regard to guidance published by the Secretary of State or Welsh Ministers with regard to the exercise of its functions in relation to the transportation, storage or disposal of dead bodies or other human remains within or from its area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3486"},{"id":"1649","label":"Travel concessions - financial contributions","desc":"A local authority may contribute to the cost of travel concessions incurred by a another authority.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1649"},{"id":"435","label":"Unlawful use of drugs on premises - discharge of closure order","desc":"A local authority may make an application that a closure order is discharged in relation to premises where drugs are used unlawfully or may appeal against the refusal to make such an order.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/435"},{"id":"436","label":"Unlawful use of drugs on premises - reimbursement of costs","desc":"A local authority may apply to have the cost of cleaning, securing or maintaining premises where drugs are used unlawfully reimbursed.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/436"},{"id":"1229","label":"Unlawfully deposited waste - compliance with directions","desc":"A local authority must comply with directions from the Secretary of State with regard to waste unlawfully deposited upon land and must in certain circumstances publicise those directions.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1229"},{"id":"1228","label":"Unlawfully deposited waste - removal","desc":"A local authority may give directions regarding waste unlawfully deposited upon land and in certain circumstances may remove the waste itself and recover costs.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1228"},{"id":"3938","label":"Unlawfully kept or disposed of waste - removal","desc":"A local authority may give directions regarding controlled or excavated waste unlawfully kept or disposed of deposited upon land and in certain circumstances may remove the waste itself and recover costs.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3938"},{"id":"1501","label":"Use of spare capacity of computers of local authorities","desc":"A local authority may, in certain circumstances, enter into an agreement to allow others to share computer facilities and charge for the same.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1501"},{"id":"216","label":"Vehicles for repair or sale on road - fixed penalty notice","desc":"An authorised officer of a local authority may give a fixed penalty notice for a suspected breach of sections 3 or 4 of the Act (repairing or exposing vehicles for sale on the road).","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/216"},{"id":"219","label":"Vehicles for repair or sale on road - information about receipts","desc":"A local authority must provide information about its use of receipts from fixed penalty notices to the appropriate person and comply with regulations..","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/219"},{"id":"217","label":"Vehicles for repair or sale on road - request for personal details","desc":"An authorised officer may require the name and address of a person to whom he proposes to give a fixed penalty notice under section 6 of the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/217"},{"id":"218","label":"Vehicles for repair or sale on road - use of receipts","desc":"Power to use receipts from fixed penalty notices for various purposes.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/218"},{"id":"2368","label":"Video recordings - enforcement","desc":"The functions of a local weights and measures authority include the enforcement in their area of this Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2368"},{"id":"2154","label":"Voluntary organisations - provision of information regarding financial assistance","desc":"A local authority must make the provision of certain financial assistance to voluntary organisations conditional upon provision of information regarding how that money has been spent.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2154"},{"id":"3469","label":"Volunteering - Emergency Volunteering Certificates","desc":"Local authorities in England and Wales may issue Emergency Volunteering Certificates in connection with volunteering in the Health or Social Care Sectors from a specific date for a specific period of between 2 and 4 weeks. The production of a certificate allows a worker to be absent from work for the purposes of emergency volunteering but still entitled to receive the benefits under his or her contract of employment whilst on leave.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3469"},{"id":"1851","label":"War memorials - maintenance and repair","desc":"A local authority may incur reasonable expenditure in the maintenance repair and protection of any war memorial within their district whether vested in them or not.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1851"},{"id":"2509","label":"Ward councillor - non-controlled waste","desc":"A local authority may collect information about, and make arrangements for the disposal of, waste which is situated or likely to be situated in its area and is not controlled waste.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2103"},{"id":"743","label":"Waste disposal - employment of officers","desc":"A local authority who are for the time being, or have at any time been, a local weights and measures authority under this Act or the Weights and Measures Act 1963 may provide and maintain within their area for use by the public such weighing or measuring equipment as may appear to the authority to be expedient.Without prejudice to the provisions of any other Act, and subject to section 18 above, a local authority may employ persons to attend to any weighing or measuring by means of equipment provided by that authority for use by the public.Except in the case of a weighing or measuring for which, under any other Act, the charge falls to be regulated from time to time by some other person, a local authority by whom any weighing or measuring equipment is provided for use by the public may make such charges for any weighing or measuring by means of that equipment as they may from time to time think fit.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2913"},{"id":"2911","label":"Weights and measures - exchange of standards or equipment","desc":"A local authority may\u2014provide a particular working standard or item of equipment by making arrangements with another person for the standard or item to be made available by him, andmake arrangements with another person for standards or equipment provided by the authority, except stamping equipment, to be made available to the other person","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2911"},{"id":"2917","label":"Weights and measures - fees for work resulting from EU obligation","desc":"A local weights and measures authority may charge such reasonable fees as they may determine\u2014for services or facilities provided by them, or by the inspectors appointed for their area, in pursuance of a EU obligation, and for authorisations, certificates or other documents issued by the authority or any such inspector in pursuance of a EU 1 obligation.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2917"},{"id":"2912","label":"Weights and measures - hiring of equipment","desc":"A local authority may If they are of the opinion that any particular description of testing equipment is proper and sufficient for the efficient discharge of the functions of the inspectors appointed for the authority's area, butthat, having regard to the expenditure involved and the frequency with which such equipment is likely to be used by those inspectors, it would not be reasonable for the authority to provide and maintain such equipment,request the Secretary of State to provide and maintain such equipment and to make it available for hire to the authority","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2912"},{"id":"2918","label":"Weights and measures - investigatory powers","desc":"The investigatory powers available to a local weights and measures authority for the purposes of the enforcement of this Act, are set out in Schedule 5 to the Consumer Rights Act 2015.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2918"},{"id":"2909","label":"Weights and measures - local standards","desc":"There shall be maintained by each local weights and measures authority such standards (in this Act referred to as \u201clocal standards\u201d) of such of the measures and weights set out in Schedule 3 to this Act as the Secretary of State may from time to time approve or require in the case of that authority as being proper and sufficient for the purposes of this Act.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2909"},{"id":"3363","label":"Weights and measures - measuring instruments","desc":"A local weights and measures authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to measuring instruments.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3364"},{"id":"3376","label":"Weights and measures - non-automatic weighing equipment","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to non-automatic weighing instruments.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3376"},{"id":"3441","label":"Weights and measures - packaged goods","desc":"The local authority has a duty to ensure compliance with and to enforce regulations relating to packaged goods.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3441"},{"id":"2919","label":"Weights and measures - prosecutions","desc":"A local weights and measures authority may prosecute offences under the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2919"},{"id":"1943","label":"Weights and measures - special powers of inspectors with respect to certain goods","desc":"An inspector may, at all reasonable times, inspect and test any weighing or measuring equipment which is, or which he has reasonable cause to believe to be, used for trade or in the possession of any person or upon any premises for such use, inspect any goods regarding which a representation has been made as to the quantity of any goods offered or exposed for sale or sold, and enter any premises at which he has reasonable cause to believe there to be any such equipment or goods, not being premises used only as a private dwelling-house.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1943"},{"id":"2914","label":"Weights and measures - weighing by inspectors","desc":"Local authority inspectors may weigh and measure goods, require the production of documents and weigh vehicles in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/2914"},{"id":"3198","label":"Weights and measures - weighing equipment certificate","desc":"A local authority may issue a certificate for public weighing and measuring equipment and for individuals using such equipment.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3198"},{"id":"2910","label":"Weights and measures \u2013 Working standards testing and stamping equipment","desc":"Each local weights and measures authority shall provide for use by the inspectors appointed for the authority's area, and maintain or from time to time replace\u2014(a) such standards (in this Act referred to as \u201cworking standards\u201d) of such of the measures and weights set out in Schedule 3 to this Act.(b) such testing equipment, and(c) such stamping equipment,as are proper and sufficient for the efficient discharge by those inspectors of their functions in the authority's area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2910"},{"id":"1681","label":"Welfare - arrangements for persons with a disability","desc":"A local authority may with the approval of the Secretary of State and to the extent directed by him make welfare arrangements for persons with a disability.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1681"},{"id":"1678","label":"Welfare - charges for provision of accommodation","desc":"A local authority must recover charges for accommodation provided in certain circumstances","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1678"},{"id":"1687","label":"Welfare - expenses of officer applying to Court of Protection as a deputy","desc":"A local authority may defray the expenses of any of its officer's applying to the Court of Protection as a Deputy, under the Act, that are not recoverable elsewhere.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1687"},{"id":"1679","label":"Welfare - management of premises in which accommodation provided","desc":"A local authority may make rules as to the conduct of premises under their management in which accommodation is provided and as to the preservation of order in the premises.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1679"},{"id":"1677","label":"Welfare - provision of accommodation","desc":"A local authority must provide accommodation with the approval of the Secretary of State and to the extent directed by him and must take into account the welfare of persons for whom the accommodation is provided.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1677"},{"id":"1680","label":"Welfare - provision of accommodation for person with no settled residence","desc":"A local authority may provide accommodation to a person of no settled residence as if he were ordinarily resident in their area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1680"},{"id":"1684","label":"Welfare - recovery in cases of misrepresentation or non-disclosure","desc":"A local authority may recover sums spent under the Act in cases of misrepresentation or non-disclosure.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1684"},{"id":"1683","label":"Welfare - recovery of expenditure from another authority","desc":"A local authority may recover expenditure under the Act from another local authority in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1683"},{"id":"1688","label":"Welfare - recovery of money through criminal proceedings or civil debt actions","desc":"A local authority may institute certain criminal proceedings or civil debt actions to recover money.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1688"},{"id":"1685","label":"Welfare - removal of persons needing care and attention","desc":"A local authority in Wales may remove persons in need of care and attention to certain premises in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1685"},{"id":"1682","label":"Welfare - research","desc":"A local authority may carry out or promote and assist research into local authority powers and duties related to welfare services under the Act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1682"},{"id":"3227","label":"Welfare of children - safeguarding practice and child death reviews","desc":"A local safeguarding board must comply with sections 16(C) to (P) of the Children Act 2004 when considering Local Child Safeguarding Practice Reviews and Child Death Reviews.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3227"},{"id":"1584","label":"Welfare of old people - promotion","desc":"A local authority may to the extent approved by the Secretary of State and as directed make provision for the promotion of the welfare of old people.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1584"},{"id":"1030","label":"Wellbeing strategy in England","desc":"A local authority must prepare and may modify a strategy for promoting economic, social and environmental well being in its area, in accordance with the prescribed procedure.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1030"},{"id":"1029","label":"Wellbeing strategy in Wales","desc":"A Welsh authority may do anything (subject to limits) to promote or improve the economic, social or environmental well being of their area.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1029"},{"id":"1477","label":"Welsh language - amendment of scheme","desc":"A local authority in Wales may amend its Welsh language scheme in certain circumstances.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1477"},{"id":"1474","label":"Welsh language - consultation on preparation of scheme","desc":"A local authority in Wales must consult regarding its proposed Welsh language scheme and comply with any directions from the Board.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1474"},{"id":"1478","label":"Welsh Language - directed amendment of scheme","desc":"A local authority in Wales must amend its Welsh language scheme in certain circumstances.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1478"},{"id":"1479","label":"Welsh language - directions on scheme from Secretary of State","desc":"A local authority in Wales must comply with any directions made by the Secretary of State with regard to its Welsh language scheme following an investigation.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1479"},{"id":"1475","label":"Welsh language - intervention in schemes","desc":"A local authority in Wales must comply with any intervention from the Secretary of State regarding Welsh language schemes.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1475"},{"id":"1476","label":"Welsh language - periodic revision of scheme","desc":"A local authority in Wales must comply with a notice received from the Board requiring it to revise its Welsh language scheme.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1476"},{"id":"1472","label":"Welsh language - preparation of scheme","desc":"A local authority in Wales must prepare a scheme regarding its usage of the Welsh language and comply with any direction or guidance from the Board.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1472"},{"id":"1473","label":"Welsh language - submission of scheme","desc":"A local authority in Wales must submit its scheme to the Board in the prescribed manner.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1473"},{"id":"1875","label":"Works - Joint working","desc":"Two or more local authorities may jointly carry out works and defray each other's expenses.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1875"},{"id":"17","label":"Young person - learning and support agreement","desc":"A local authority may enter into a conditional learning and support agreement with a young person.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/17"},{"id":"19","label":"Young person or young adult - information provision","desc":"A person or body as defined in the legislation may supply information about a young person or relevant young adult to an English local authority with an education function where that information is required for the provision of services under section 68 and 70 of the same act.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/19"},{"id":"3740","label":"Youth detention - treatment as looked after child","desc":"A child who is remanded to youth detention accommodation is to be treated as a child who is looked after by the designated authority.The cost of this accommodation must be met by the designated local authority","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3740"},{"id":"3748","label":"Youth justice - aims of the service","desc":"It is the duty of all persons and bodies carrying out functions in relation to the youth justice system to have regard to the principal aim of the youth justice system to prevent offending by children and young persons.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3748"},{"id":"2818","label":"Youth justice - EHC plan for detained persons","desc":"Local authorities (home authorities) must follow the procedures for carrying out a detained person's EHC needs assessment and making an EHC plan including: adhering to prescribed time-scales in which decisions need to be made; the factors which the home authority need to consider when carrying out an assessment and the information and advice which should be made available to the detained person or a detained child's parent.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/2818"},{"id":"3747","label":"Youth justice - guidance from Secretary of State","desc":"Local Authorities and other bodies who carry out youth justice duties are required to act in accordance with any guidance given to them by the Secretary of State","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3747"},{"id":"776","label":"Youth justice - local provision of services","desc":"A local authority must, acting in co-operation with certain other bodies secure that, to such extent as is appropriate for their area, all youth justice services are available there.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/776"},{"id":"778","label":"Youth justice - notification of detention of child or young person","desc":"A youth offending team of a local authority must notify certain bodies when a young person is convicted of an offence.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/778"},{"id":"3782","label":"Youth justice - payments","desc":"The local authority and every person or body mentioned in subsection (2) of this section shall have power to make payments towards expenditure incurred in the provision of youth justice services by making the payments directly orby contributing to a fund, established and maintained by the local authority, out of which the payments may be made.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3782"},{"id":"3749","label":"Youth justice - prevention of offending","desc":"The Local Authority is under a duty to \"reduce the need to bring criminal proceedings against children within their area\" \"encourage children within their area not to commit criminal offences\" and \"avoid the need for children within their area to be placed in secure accommodation\" [secure accommodation means secure children's homes].","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3749"},{"id":"3761","label":"Youth justice - secure accommodation order","desc":"A local authority can apply to the court for a secure accommodation order if it either appears that the young person has a history of absconding and is likely to abscond from any other description of accommodation and if the young person absconds, he/she is likely to suffer significant harm or, that if he/she is kept in any other description of accommodation he/she is likely to injure himself or other persons.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/3761"},{"id":"779","label":"Youth justice - youth justice plans","desc":"A local authority must, after consultation with the relevant persons and bodies, formulate and implement for each year a youth justice plan.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/779"},{"id":"777","label":"Youth justice - youth offending teams","desc":"A local authority must, acting in co-operation with certain other bodies establish one or more youth offending teams for their area.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/777"},{"id":"3746","label":"Youth offending - electronic monitoring","desc":"Youth Offending Teams must inform the court that electronic monitoring is suitable when the court is considering the imposition of electronic monitoring on a young person aged between 12 and 17 released on bail.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3746"},{"id":"3744","label":"Youth offending - referral orders","desc":"Youth Offending Teams must establish and support youth offender panels. Including the provision of staff and accommodation as well as supervision of youth offender contract","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3744"},{"id":"3745","label":"Youth offending - youth cautions","desc":"Where the Youth Offending Teams is advised of a young person being warned or cautioned the Youth Offending Team is required to assess the young person and arrange for him/her to participate in a rehabilitation programme if appropriate","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/3745"},{"id":"1007","label":"Youth support - provision of information by public bodies","desc":"A local authority in Wales may supply information about a young person to certain other bodies in connection with the provision of certain services to young people.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1007"},{"id":"1006","label":"Youth support - conduct and effect of inspections","desc":"A local authority must take certain steps with regard to inspections relating to the provision of certain services to 11 to 25 year olds in Wales.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1006"},{"id":"1004","label":"Youth support - directed services for 11 to 25 year olds","desc":"A local authority must comply with directions from the National Assembly and take other steps with regard to the provision of certain services to 11 to 25 year olds in Wales.","type":"duty","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/duty/1004"},{"id":"1005","label":"Youth support - discretionary services for 11 to 25 year olds","desc":"A local authority may exercise certain powers in connection with its duty to comply with Directions from the National Assembly and take other steps with regard to the provision of certain services to 11 to 25 year olds in Wales.","type":"power","uri":"http://id.esd.org.uk/power/1005"}]; const STORAGE_KEY = "lgam_taxonomy_workbench_draft"; // Application State const state = { workingMapping: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(BASELINE_MAPPING.mappings)), currentDomainId: "FG_AdultSocial", inspectedFunctionId: "148", // Default to Adult Social Care function activeTab: "inspector", domainSearchTerm: "", domainCategoryFilter: "all", expandedServices: {}, pdSearchTerm: "", pdFilterType: "all", focusedAutocompleteIndex: -1, hasDraftSaved: false, functionNotes: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lgam_function_notes') || '{}') }; if (!toast) return; toast.textContent = message; toast.className = `workbench-toast workbench-toast--${type} is-visible`; setTimeout(() => { toast.className = "workbench-toast"; }, 3200); } // Persistence: Save to LocalStorage function saveToLocalStorage() { try { const draftPayload = { timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), mappings: state.workingMapping }; localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(draftPayload)); localStorage.setItem('lgam_function_notes', JSON.stringify(state.functionNotes)); updateDraftStatusBanner(); updateDiffMetrics(); renderDomainList(); } catch (e) { console.error("LocalStorage save error:", e); } } // Persistence: Check & Load Draft function initDraftPersistence() { try { const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY); if (saved) { const parsed = JSON.parse(saved); if (parsed && parsed.mappings) { state.workingMapping = parsed.mappings; state.hasDraftSaved = true; const banner = document.getElementById("draft-recovery-banner"); const msg = document.getElementById("draft-banner-message"); if (banner && msg) { const dateStr = parsed.timestamp ? new Date(parsed.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString([], {hour: '2-digit', minute:'2-digit'}) : "earlier"; msg.textContent = `Draft restored from your local session (${dateStr}). Unexported modifications are active.`; banner.classList.add("is-active"); } } } } catch (e) { console.warn("Could not parse saved draft:", e); } } // Compute Diff between workingMapping and BASELINE_MAPPING function calculateDiff() { const base = BASELINE_MAPPING.mappings; const work = state.workingMapping; const diff = { domainsModified: 0, totalAdded: 0, totalRemoved: 0, notesUpdated: 0, details: [] }; for (const domainId in base) { const baseDomain = base[domainId]; const workDomain = work[domainId] || { functions: [], curator_notes: "" }; const baseFns = new Map((baseDomain.functions || []).map(f => [String(f.function_id), f.label])); const workFns = new Map((workDomain.functions || []).map(f => [String(f.function_id), f.label])); const added = []; const removed = []; for (const [fid, flabel] of workFns.entries()) { if (!baseFns.has(fid)) { added.push({ id: fid, label: flabel }); } } for (const [fid, flabel] of baseFns.entries()) { if (!workFns.has(fid)) { removed.push({ id: fid, label: flabel }); } } const baseNotes = (baseDomain.curator_notes || "").trim(); const workNotes = (workDomain.curator_notes || "").trim(); const noteChanged = baseNotes !== workNotes; if (added.length > 0 || removed.length > 0 || noteChanged) { diff.domainsModified++; diff.totalAdded += added.length; diff.totalRemoved += removed.length; if (noteChanged) diff.notesUpdated++; diff.details.push({ domainId: domainId, domainName: baseDomain.name, domainType: baseDomain.type, added: added, removed: removed, noteChanged: noteChanged, workNotes: workNotes }); } } return diff; } function updateDraftStatusBanner() { const diff = calculateDiff(); const banner = document.getElementById("draft-recovery-banner"); const diffBadge = document.getElementById("export-diff-badge"); const filterModifiedCount = document.getElementById("filter-modified-count"); if (filterModifiedCount) { filterModifiedCount.textContent = `(${diff.domainsModified})`; } if (diff.domainsModified > 0) { if (banner) banner.classList.add("is-active"); if (diffBadge) { diffBadge.textContent = diff.domainsModified; diffBadge.style.display = "inline-block"; diffBadge.className = "tab-badge tab-badge--warning"; } } else { if (diffBadge) diffBadge.style.display = "none"; } } function updateDiffMetrics() { const diff = calculateDiff(); const domStat = document.getElementById("diff-domains-stat"); const addStat = document.getElementById("diff-added-stat"); const remStat = document.getElementById("diff-removed-stat"); const noteStat = document.getElementById("diff-notes-stat"); const detailsContainer = document.getElementById("diff-details-container"); if (domStat) domStat.textContent = diff.domainsModified; if (addStat) addStat.textContent = `+${diff.totalAdded}`; if (remStat) remStat.textContent = `-${diff.totalRemoved}`; if (noteStat) noteStat.textContent = diff.notesUpdated; if (!detailsContainer) return; if (diff.details.length === 0) { detailsContainer.innerHTML = `
    No curation modifications yet. Working state matches baseline taxonomy mapping.
    `; return; } let html = ""; diff.details.forEach(d => { html += `
    ${d.domainName} (${d.domainId})
    `; d.added.forEach(a => { html += `

    `; }); d.removed.forEach(r => { html += `
    - Removed Function [ESD-${r.id}] ${r.label}
    `; }); if (d.noteChanged) { html += `
